questionText: 已知曲线 L：$y=\frac{4}{9} x^{2} ( x\geqslant0)$，点 O(0,0)，点 A(0,1).设 P是 L上的动点，S是直线 OA与直线 AP及曲线 L所围图形的面积.若 P运动到点（3,4）时沿 x轴正向的速度是4，求此时 S关于时间 t的变化率.
analysisRich:
本题中，既可以利用定积分计算 S，也可以利用二重积分计算 S.

解曲线 L如图所示，直线 OA与直线 AP及曲线 L所围区域为 D.设点 P的坐标为（x,y），过点 P作 x轴的垂线，垂足为 Q，则点 Q的坐标为（x,0）.由于点 P位于曲线 L上，故点 P的坐标可写为$\left(x,\frac{4}{9} x^{2}\right).$下面用三种方法计算 S.

（法一）区域 D的面积 S等于梯形 OAPQ的面积$S_{1}$减去曲边三角形 OPQ的面积$S_{2}.$由图可知，梯形OAPQ的两条底边长分别为1和$\frac{4}{9} x^{2}$，高为x.根据梯形的面积公式，$S_{1}= \frac{1+\frac{4}{9} x^{2}}{2} \cdot x=\frac{2}{9} x^{3}+\frac{x}{2}.$根据定积分的几何意义，曲边三角形 OPQ的面积$S_{2}=\int_{0}^{x}\frac{4}{9} t^{2}\mathrm{d}t=\frac{4}{27} x^{3}.$因此，$S = S _ {1} - S _ {2} = \frac {2}{9} x ^ {3} + \frac {x}{2} - \frac {4}{2 7} x ^ {3} = \frac {2}{2 7} x ^ {3} + \frac {x}{2}.$（法二）直线 AP的方程为$Y - 1 = \frac {\frac {4}{9} x ^ {2} - 1}{x - 0} (X - 0), \quad \mathrm {即} Y = \left(\frac {4}{9} x - \frac {1}{x}\right) X + 1.$根据定积分的几何意义，$S = \int_ {0} ^ {x} \left[ \left(\frac {4}{9} x - \frac {1}{x}\right) t + 1 - \frac {4}{9} t ^ {2} \right] \mathrm {d} t = \left(\frac {4}{9} x - \frac {1}{x}\right) \cdot \frac {x ^ {2}}{2} + x - \frac {4}{2 7} x ^ {3} = \frac {2}{2 7} x ^ {3} + \frac {x}{2}.$（法三）由法二可得直线 AP的方程为$Y=\left(\frac{4}{9} x-\frac{1}{x}\right) X+1.$将区域 D看作X型区域，区域 D可表示为$D = \left\{(X, Y) \mid \frac {4}{9} X ^ {2} \leqslant Y \leqslant \left(\frac {4}{9} x - \frac {1}{x}\right) X + 1, 0 \leqslant X \leqslant x \right\}.$根据二重积分的几何意义，$\begin{aligned} S &= \iint_ {D} \mathrm {d} X \mathrm {d} Y = \int_ {0} ^ {x} \mathrm {d} X \int_ {\frac {4}{9} X ^ {2}} ^ {\left(\frac {4}{9} x - \frac {1}{x}\right) X + 1} \mathrm {d} Y = \int_ {0} ^ {x} \left[ \left(\frac {4}{9} x - \frac {1}{x}\right) X + 1 - \frac {4}{9} X ^ {2} \right] \mathrm {d} X \\ &= \left(\frac {4}{9} x - \frac {1}{x}\right) \cdot \frac {x ^ {2}}{2} + x - \frac {4}{2 7} x ^ {3} = \frac {2}{2 7} x ^ {3} + \frac {x}{2}. \end{aligned}$根据链式法则，$\frac {\mathrm {d} S}{\mathrm {d} t} = \frac {\mathrm {d} S}{\mathrm {d} x} \cdot \frac {\mathrm {d} x}{\mathrm {d} t} = \left(\frac {2}{9} x ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2}\right) \cdot \frac {\mathrm {d} x}{\mathrm {d} t}.$当 x=3时，$\left.\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}\right|_{x=3}=4.$因此，$\left. \frac {\mathrm {d} S}{\mathrm {d} t} \right| _ {x = 3} = \left(\frac {2}{9} x ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2}\right) \cdot \left. \frac {\mathrm {d} x}{\mathrm {d} t} \right| _ {x = 3} = \left(\frac {2}{9} \times 9 + \frac {1}{2}\right) \times 4 = 1 0.$因此，所求 S关于时间 t的变化率为10.

questionText: 求曲线$y=\mathrm{e}^{-x}\sin x(x\geqslant 0)$与x轴之间图形的面积.
analysisRich:
如图所示，曲线$y=\mathrm{e}^{-x}\sin x(x\geqslant 0)$与 x轴有无穷多个交点，$x=n\pi$（n为非负整数）均为曲线与 x轴的交点. 因此，该曲线与 x轴围成的平面图形在 x轴上方与 x轴下方均有无穷多部分. 计算面积时，应分别计算该平面图形位于 x轴上方部分的面积与位于 x轴下方部分的面积，再求级数和.

解（法一）注意到$\mathrm{e}^{-x}$恒大于零.根据定积分的几何意义，曲线位于（$k\pi$，$( k+1)\pi$）的部分与 x轴之间的图形面积等于$\int_{k\pi}^{(k+1)\pi} \mathrm{e}^{-x}|\sin x|\mathrm{d}x.$计算$S_{n}。$$\begin{array}{l} S _ {n} = \sum_ {k = 0} ^ {n - 1} \int_ {k \pi} ^ {(k + 1) \pi} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} | \sin x | \mathrm {d} x \underline {{= x - k \pi}} \sum_ {k = 0} ^ {n - 1} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \mathrm {e} ^ {- (t + k \pi)} | \sin (t + k \pi) | \mathrm {d} t \\ = \sum_ {k = 0} ^ {n - 1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- k \pi} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \sin t \mathrm {d} t. \\ \end{array}$下面计算$\int_{0}^{\pi}\mathrm{e}^{-t}\sin t\mathrm{d}t.$$\begin{aligned} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \sin t \mathrm {d} t &= - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin t \mathrm {d} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- t}\right) = - \left(\sin t \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi} - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \cos t \mathrm {d} t\right) \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \cos t \mathrm {d} t = - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \cos t \mathrm {d} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- t}\right) \\ &= - \cos t \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi} - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \sin t \mathrm {d} t \\ &= \mathrm {e} ^ {- \pi} + 1 - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \sin t \mathrm {d} t. \end{aligned}$由上式可得$2\int_{0}^{\pi}\mathrm{e}^{-t}\sin t\mathrm{d}t=\mathrm{e}^{-\pi}+1$，于是$\int_{0}^{\pi}\mathrm{e}^{-t}\sin t\mathrm{d}t=\frac{1}{2}\left(\mathrm{e}^{-\pi}+1\right).$$S = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} S _ {n} = \frac {1}{2} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- \pi} + 1\right) \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- n \pi}}{1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- \pi}} = \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- \pi} + 1}{1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- \pi}} = \frac {1}{2} + \frac {1}{\mathrm {e} ^ {\pi} - 1}.$（法二）注意到$\mathrm{e}^{-x}$恒大于零.当$x\in(2n\pi,(2n+1)\pi)$时，$\sin x > 0$；当$x\in((2n+1)\pi,$$(2n+2)\pi)$时，$\sin x < 0$因此，根据定积分的几何意义，曲线位于$(2n\pi, (2n+1)\pi)$的部分与x轴之间的图形面积等于$\int_{2n\pi}^{(2n+1)\pi} \mathrm{e}^{-x}\sin x\mathrm{d}x$；曲线位于$((2n+1)\pi, (2n+2)\pi)$的部分与x轴之间的图形面积等于$-\int_{(2n+1)\pi}^{(2n+2)\pi} \mathrm{e}^{-x}\sin x\mathrm{d}x.$记所求面积为 S，则$S = \sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} \int_ {2 n \pi} ^ {(2 n + 1) \pi} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \sin x \mathrm {d} x - \sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} \int_ {(2 n + 1) \pi} ^ {(2 n + 2) \pi} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \sin x \mathrm {d} x.$下面计算$\int\mathrm{e}^{-x}\sin x\mathrm{d}x.$$\begin{aligned} \int \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \sin x \mathrm {d} x &= - \int \sin x \mathrm {d} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- x}\right) = - \left(\sin x \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} - \int \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \cos x \mathrm {d} x\right) \\ &= - \sin x \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} + \int \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \cos x \mathrm {d} x = - \sin x \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} - \int \cos x \mathrm {d} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- x}\right) \\ &= - \sin x \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} - \left(\cos x \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} + \int \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \sin x \mathrm {d} x\right). \end{aligned}$由上式可得$2\int \mathrm{e}^{-x}\sin x\mathrm{d}x = -\mathrm{e}^{-x}(\sin x + \cos x) - C$，于是$\int \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \sin x \mathrm {d} x = - \frac {1}{2} \left[ \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} (\sin x + \cos x) + C \right],$其中 C为任意常数.

因此，$\begin{array}{l} S = \sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} \left[ - \frac {1}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} (\sin x + \cos x) \right] \left| _ {2 n \pi} ^ {(2 n + 1) \pi} + \sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} \left[ \frac {1}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} (\sin x + \cos x) \right] \right| _ {(2 n + 1) \pi} ^ {(2 n + 2) \pi} \\ = \frac {1}{2} \sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} \left[ \mathrm {e} ^ {- (2 n + 1) \pi} + \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 n \pi} \right] + \frac {1}{2} \sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} \left[ \mathrm {e} ^ {- (2 n + 2) \pi} + \mathrm {e} ^ {- (2 n + 1) \pi} \right] \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left[ \sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 n \pi} + 2 \sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- (2 n + 1) \pi} + \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 n \pi} \right] \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {1}{1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 \pi}} + \frac {2 \mathrm {e} ^ {- \pi}}{1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 \pi}} + \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 \pi}}{1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 \pi}}\right) = \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {\left(1 + \mathrm {e} ^ {- \pi}\right) ^ {2}}{\left(1 + \mathrm {e} ^ {- \pi}\right) \left(1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- \pi}\right)} \\ = \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {1 + \mathrm {e} ^ {- \pi}}{1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- \pi}} = \frac {1}{2} + \frac {1}{\mathrm {e} ^ {\pi} - 1}. \\ \end{array}$

analysisRich: 计算$y^{\prime}。$$y ^ {\prime} = (\ln \cos x) ^ {\prime} = \frac {- \sin x}{\cos x} = - \tan x.$由曲线弧长公式，可得所求弧长为$\begin{aligned} s &= \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{6}} \sqrt {1 + \left(y ^ {\prime}\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{6}} \sqrt {1 + \tan^ {2} x} \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{6}} \sec x \mathrm {d} x = \ln | \sec x + \tan x | \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{6}} \\ &= \ln \left(\frac {2}{\sqrt {3}} + \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}}\right) = \frac {1}{2} \ln 3. \end{aligned}$

questionText: 设平面区域$D=\left\{(x,y)\left| \frac{x}{2}\leqslant y\leqslant \frac{1}{1+x^{2}},0\leqslant x\leqslant 1\right. \right\}$，则 D绕 y轴旋转所成的旋转体的体积为 ___.
analysisRich:
解 由已知条件可知，区域 D由曲线$y=\frac{1}{1+x^{2}},y=\frac{x}{2},x=0,x=1$围成，其绕 y轴旋转一周所得旋转体的体积可看作两个旋转体的体积之差.

由旋转体的体积公式可得，所求旋转体的体积$\begin{array}{l} V = 2 \pi \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \left(\frac {1}{1 + x ^ {2}} - \frac {x}{2}\right) \mathrm {d} x = 2 \pi \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(\frac {x}{1 + x ^ {2}} - \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}\right) \mathrm {d} x \\ = 2 \pi \left[ \frac {1}{2} \ln \left(1 + x ^ {2}\right) - \frac {x ^ {3}}{6} \right] \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} = \pi \ln 2 - \frac {\pi}{3}. \\ \end{array}$

questionText: 设函数 f(x)的定义域为（0，+∞）且满足$2 f ( x )+x^{2} f \left( \frac{1}{x} \right)=\frac{x^{2}+2 x}{\sqrt{1+x^{2}}}$求 f(x)，并求曲线 y=f(x)，y$=\frac{1}{2},$$y=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$及 y轴所围图形绕 x轴旋转一周而成的旋转体的体积.
analysisRich:
解 令$\frac{1}{x}=t,t\in(0,+\infty)$，代入$2 f ( x )+x^{2} f \left( \frac{1}{x} \right)=\frac{x^{2}+2 x}{\sqrt{1+x^{2}}}$可得$2 f \left(\frac {1}{t}\right) + \frac {1}{t ^ {2}} f (t) = \frac {\frac {1}{t ^ {2}} + \frac {2}{t}}{\sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{t ^ {2}}}} = \frac {1 + 2 t}{t \sqrt {1 + t ^ {2}}}.$(1) 式中的 t换为 x 可得$2 f \left(\frac {1}{x}\right) + \frac {1}{x ^ {2}} f (x) = \frac {1 + 2 x}{x \sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}}.$原方程乘以$\frac{2}{x^{2}}$可得$2 f \left(\frac {1}{x}\right) + \frac {4}{x ^ {2}} f (x) = \frac {x ^ {2} + 2 x}{\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}} \cdot \frac {2}{x ^ {2}} = \frac {2 (x + 2)}{x \sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}}.$(3) 式-（2）式消去$f\left(\frac{1}{x}\right)$可得$\frac{3}{x^{2}} f(x)=\frac{3}{x\sqrt{1+x^{2}}}$.解得$f(x)=\frac{x}{\sqrt{1+x^{2}}}$即$y=\frac{x}{\sqrt{1+x^{2}}}$将$y=\frac{x}{\sqrt{1+x^{2}}}$写成$x=g(y)$的形式.

由$y=\frac{x}{\sqrt{1+x^{2}}}$可得$y^{2}=\frac{x^{2}}{1+x^{2}}$，从而$y^{2}+x^{2}y^{2}=x^{2}$即$(1-y^{2})x^{2}=y^{2}$，解得$x^{2}=\frac{y^{2}}{1-y^{2}}$由于$x>0$，故由$y=\frac{x}{\sqrt{1+x^{2}}}$可知$0<y<1.$于是，$x=\frac{y}{\sqrt{1-y^{2}}}.$平面区域如图所示.

由旋转体的体积公式可得，所求旋转体体积$\begin{aligned} V &= 2 \pi \int_ {\frac {1}{2}} ^ {\frac {\sqrt {3}}{2}} y g (y) \mathrm {d} y = 2 \pi \int_ {\frac {1}{2}} ^ {\frac {\sqrt {3}}{2}} \frac {y ^ {2}}{\sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} y \underline {{y = \sin t}} 2 \pi \int_ {\frac {\pi}{6}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} \frac {\sin^ {2} t}{\cos t} \cdot \cos t \mathrm {d} t \\ &= 2 \pi \int_ {\frac {\pi}{6}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} \sin^ {2} t \mathrm {d} t = 2 \pi \int_ {\frac {\pi}{6}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} \frac {1 - \cos 2 t}{2} \mathrm {d} t = \pi \left(t - \frac {\sin 2 t}{2}\right) \Bigg | _ {\frac {\pi}{6}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} \\ \frac {\sin \frac {\pi}{3} = \sin \frac {2 \pi}{3}}{\pi} \frac {\pi^ {2}}{6} - 0 &= \frac {\pi^ {2}}{6}. \end{aligned}$

questionText: 设平面区域 D 由曲线$y=\sqrt{x}\sin\pi x(0\leqslant x\leqslant1)$与 x轴围成，则 D绕 x轴旋转所成的旋转体的体积为 ___.
analysisRich: （法一）根据旋转体的体积公式，$\begin{array}{l} V = \pi \int_ {0} ^ {1} (\sqrt {x} \sin \pi x) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x = \pi \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \sin^ {2} \pi x \mathrm {d} x \xlongequal {\pi x = t} \frac {1}{\pi} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} t \sin^ {2} t \mathrm {d} t = \frac {1}{\pi} \cdot \frac {\pi}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin^ {2} t \mathrm {d} t \\ = \frac {1}{2} \cdot 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {2} t \mathrm {d} t = \frac {\pi}{4}. \\ \end{array}$（法二）下面用另一种方法计算$\int_{0}^{\pi} t\sin^{2}t\mathrm{d}t.$$\begin{array}{l} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} t \sin^ {2} t \mathrm {d} t = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} t \cdot \frac {1 - \cos 2 t}{2} \mathrm {d} t = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} (t - t \cos 2 t) \mathrm {d} t = \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {t ^ {2}}{2} \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi} - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} t \cos 2 t \mathrm {d} t\right) \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left[ \frac {\pi^ {2}}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} t \mathrm {d} (\sin 2 t) \right] = \frac {\pi^ {2}}{4} - \frac {1}{4} \left(t \sin 2 t \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi} - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin 2 t \mathrm {d} t\right) \\ = \frac {\pi^ {2}}{4} - \frac {1}{4} \left(0 + \frac {\cos 2 t}{2} \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi}\right) = \frac {\pi^ {2}}{4}. \\ \end{array}$

questionText: 设函数 f(x)满足$\int\frac{f(x)}{\sqrt{x}} \mathrm{d} x=\frac{1}{6} x^{2}-x+C,L$为曲线 y=f(x)(4≤x≤9). L的弧长为s，L绕x轴旋转一周所形成的曲面面积为A，求s和A.
analysisRich: 解 对$\int \frac{f(x)}{\sqrt{x}} \mathrm{d} x=\frac{1}{6} x^{2}-x+C$两端关于 x求导，可得$\frac{f(x)}{\sqrt{x}}=\frac{x}{3}-1.$于是，$f(x)=\frac{x^{\frac{3}{2}}}{3}-\sqrt{x}.$$f ^ {\prime} (x) = \frac {1}{3} \cdot \frac {3}{2} \cdot \sqrt {x} - \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {x}} = \frac {1}{2} \left(\sqrt {x} - \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}}\right).$L的弧长为$\begin{aligned} s &= \int_ {4} ^ {9} \sqrt {1 + \left[ f ^ {\prime} (x) \right] ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {4} ^ {9} \sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{4} \left(x + \frac {1}{x} - 2\right)} \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {4} ^ {9} \sqrt {\frac {1}{4} \left(\sqrt {x} + \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}}\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= \frac {1}{2} \int_ {4} ^ {9} \left(\sqrt {x} + \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}}\right) \mathrm {d} x = \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {2}{3} x ^ {\frac {3}{2}} + 2 \sqrt {x}\right) \Bigg | _ {4} ^ {9} = \left(\frac {1}{3} x ^ {\frac {3}{2}} + \sqrt {x}\right) \Bigg | _ {4} ^ {9} = \frac {2 2}{3}. \end{aligned}$L绕 x轴旋转一周所形成的曲面面积为$\begin{aligned} A &= 2 \pi \int_ {4} ^ {9} f (x) \sqrt {1 + \left[ f ^ {\prime} (x) \right] ^ {2}} d x = 2 \pi \int_ {4} ^ {9} \left(\frac {x ^ {\frac {3}{2}}}{3} - \sqrt {x}\right) \cdot \frac {1}{2} \left(\sqrt {x} + \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}}\right) d x \\ &= \pi \int_ {4} ^ {9} \sqrt {x} \left(\frac {x}{3} - 1\right) \left(\sqrt {x} + \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}}\right) d x = \frac {\pi}{3} \int_ {4} ^ {9} (x - 3) (x + 1) d x = \frac {\pi}{3} \int_ {4} ^ {9} \left(x ^ {2} - 2 x - 3\right) d x \\ &= \frac {\pi}{3} \left. \left(\frac {x ^ {3}}{3} - x ^ {2} - 3 x\right) \right| _ {4} ^ {9} = \frac {4 2 5 \pi}{9}. \end{aligned}$

questionText:
已知平面区域$D=\left\{(x,y)\left|0\leqslant y\leqslant \frac{1}{x\sqrt{1+x^{2}}},x\geqslant 1\right.\right\}$I. 求 D的面积;

II. 求 D绕 x轴旋转所成旋转体的体积.
analysisRich:
分析 本题主要考查定积分的几何应用.

如图所示，区域 D是由曲线$y=\frac{1}{x\sqrt{1+x^{2}}}$，直线 x=1以及 x轴围成的无界区域，求面积与旋转体的体积时，需要计算反常积分.

解（I）区域 D是由曲线$y=\frac{1}{x\sqrt{1+x^{2}}}$，直线 x=1以及 x轴围成的无界区域，其面积为$\begin{aligned} S &= \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{x \sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} x \xlongequal {x = \tan t} \int_ {\frac {\pi}{4}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {\mathrm {d} (\tan t)}{\tan t \sqrt {1 + \tan^ {2} t}} = \int_ {\frac {\pi}{4}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {\sec^ {2} t}{\tan t \sec t} \mathrm {d} t \\ &= \int_ {\frac {\pi}{4}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {\mathrm {d} t}{\sin t} = \int_ {\frac {\pi}{4}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {\mathrm {d} (- \cos t)}{1 - \cos^ {2} t} \xlongequal {u = \cos t} \int_ {\frac {\sqrt {2}}{2}} ^ {0} \frac {- \mathrm {d} u}{1 - u ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\sqrt {2}}{2}} \left(\frac {1}{1 - u} + \frac {1}{1 + u}\right) \mathrm {d} u \\ &= \frac {1}{2} \ln \frac {1 + u}{1 - u} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\frac {\sqrt {2}}{2}} = \ln (\sqrt {2} + 1). \end{aligned}$（Ⅱ）由旋转体的体积公式可知，区域 D绕 x轴旋转所成旋转体的体积为$\begin{aligned} V &= \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \pi \left(\frac {1}{x \sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}}\right) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x = \pi \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {1}{x ^ {2} \left(1 + x ^ {2}\right)} \mathrm {d} x = \pi \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \left(\frac {1}{x ^ {2}} - \frac {1}{1 + x ^ {2}}\right) \mathrm {d} x \\ &= \pi \left(- \frac {1}{x} - \arctan x\right) \Bigg | _ {1} ^ {+ \infty} = \pi \left(1 - \frac {\pi}{4}\right). \end{aligned}$

questionText: 曲线$y=\int_{-\sqrt{3}}^{x}\sqrt{3-t^{2}}\mathrm{d}t$的弧长为 ___
analysisRich: 解注意到当$| x | > \sqrt{3}$时，$\sqrt{3-x^{2}}$无定义，故变限积分函数$y=\int_{-\sqrt{3}}^{x}\sqrt{3-t^{2}}\mathrm{d}t$的定义域为$[-\sqrt{3},\sqrt{3}].$由变限积分的求导公式可知，$y ^ {\prime} = \left(\int_ {- \sqrt {3}} ^ {x} \sqrt {3 - t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t\right) ^ {\prime} = \sqrt {3 - x ^ {2}}.$由弧长公式可知，曲线的弧长为$\begin{aligned} \int_ {- \sqrt {3}} ^ {\sqrt {3}} \sqrt {1 + \left(y ^ {\prime}\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x &= \int_ {- \sqrt {3}} ^ {\sqrt {3}} \sqrt {4 - x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \xlongequal {\text {对称性}} 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {3}} \sqrt {4 - x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \\ \xlongequal {x = 2 \sin t} 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} 2 \cos t \cdot 2 \cos t \mathrm {d} t &= 8 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} \cos^ {2} t \mathrm {d} t \\ &= 8 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} \frac {1 + \cos 2 t}{2} \mathrm {d} t = \frac {4 \pi}{3} + 4 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} \cos 2 t \mathrm {d} t \\ &= \frac {4 \pi}{3} + 2 \sin 2 t \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} = \frac {4 \pi}{3} + \sqrt {3}. \end{aligned}$

questionText: 设 t>0，平面有界区域 D由曲线$y=x\mathrm{e}^{-2x}$与直线 x=t,x=2t及 x轴围成，D的面积为 S(t)，求 S(t)的最大值.
analysisRich:
解 由于$x\mathrm{e}^{-2x} > 0$，故区域D的面积$S(t) = \int_{t}^{2t}x\mathrm{e}^{-2x}\mathrm{d}x.$由变限积分的求导公式可得，$S ^ {\prime} (t) = \left(\int_ {t} ^ {2 t} x \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x} \mathrm {d} x\right) ^ {\prime} = 2 \cdot 2 t \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 t} - t \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 t} = 4 t \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 t} - t \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 t} = t \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 t} \left(4 - \mathrm {e} ^ {2 t}\right).$解$4-\mathrm{e}^{2 t}=0$可得$t=\ln 2$.于是，当$0 < t < \ln 2$时，$S^{\prime}(t)>0,S(t)$单调增加，当$t > \ln 2$时，$S^{\prime}(t)<0,S(t)$单调减少.

因此，$S ( t )$的最大值在$t=\ln 2$时取得，最大值为$S (\ln 2).$下面用两种方法计算$S(\ln 2).$（法一）$\begin{array}{l} S (\ln 2) = \int_ {\ln 2} ^ {2 \ln 2} x \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x} \mathrm {d} x = - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {\ln 2} ^ {2 \ln 2} x \mathrm {d} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x}\right) = - \frac {1}{2} \left(x \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x} \Big | _ {\ln 2} ^ {2 \ln 2} - \int_ {\ln 2} ^ {2 \ln 2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x} \mathrm {d} x\right) \\ = - \frac {1}{2} \left(2 \ln 2 \cdot \frac {1}{1 6} - \ln 2 \cdot \frac {1}{4} + \frac {1}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x} \Big | _ {\ln 2} ^ {2 \ln 2}\right) = \frac {\ln 2}{1 6} - \frac {1}{4} \left(\frac {1}{1 6} - \frac {1}{4}\right) \\ = \frac {\ln 2}{1 6} + \frac {3}{6 4}. \\ \end{array}$（法二）也可以计算出$S(t)$的表达式再代入$t = \ln 2$.$\begin{array}{l} S (t) = \int_ {t} ^ {2 t} x \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x} \mathrm {d} x = - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {t} ^ {2 t} x \mathrm {d} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x}\right) = - \frac {1}{2} \left(x \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x} \Big | _ {t} ^ {2 t} - \int_ {t} ^ {2 t} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x} \mathrm {d} x\right) \\ = - \frac {1}{2} \left(2 t \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 t} - t \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 t} + \frac {1}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x} \Big | _ {t} ^ {2 t}\right) = - \frac {1}{2} \left(2 t \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 t} - t \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 t} + \frac {1}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 t} - \frac {1}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 t}\right) \\ = - \frac {1}{2} \left[ \left(2 t + \frac {1}{2}\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 t} - \left(t + \frac {1}{2}\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 t} \right]. \\ \end{array}$因此，$S (\ln 2) = - \frac {1}{2} \left[ \left(2 \ln 2 + \frac {1}{2}\right) \cdot \frac {1}{1 6} - \left(\ln 2 + \frac {1}{2}\right) \cdot \frac {1}{4} \right] = \frac {\ln 2}{1 6} + \frac {3}{6 4}.$

questionText: 设 t>0，平面有界区域 D由曲线$y=\sqrt{x}\mathrm{e}^{-x}$与直线 x=t,x=2t及 x轴围成，D绕 x轴旋转一周所得旋转体的体积为 V(t)，求 V(t) 的最大值.
analysisRich:
解 根据旋转体的体积公式，$V (t) = \pi \int_ {t} ^ {2 t} \left(\sqrt {x} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x}\right) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x = \pi \int_ {t} ^ {2 t} x \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x} \mathrm {d} x.$由变限积分的求导公式可得，$V ^ {\prime} (t) = \left(\pi \int_ {t} ^ {2 t} x \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x} \mathrm {d} x\right) ^ {\prime} = \pi \left(2 \cdot 2 t \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 t} - t \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 t}\right) = \pi t \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 t} \left(4 - \mathrm {e} ^ {2 t}\right).$解$4-\mathrm{e}^{2 t}=0$可得$t=\ln 2$.于是，当$0 < t < \ln 2$时，$V^{\prime}(t)>0,V(t)$单调增加，当$t > \ln 2$时，$V^{\prime}(t)<0,V(t)$单调减少.

因此，$V(t)$的最大值在$t = \ln 2$时取得，最大值为$V(\ln 2)$.

下面用两种方法计算$V(\ln 2).$$\begin{aligned} (\text {法 一}) V (\ln 2) &= \pi \int_ {\ln 2} ^ {2 \ln 2} x e ^ {- 2 x} d x = - \frac {\pi}{2} \int_ {\ln 2} ^ {2 \ln 2} x d \left(e ^ {- 2 x}\right) = - \frac {\pi}{2} \left(x e ^ {- 2 x} \left| _ {\ln 2} ^ {2 \ln 2} - \int_ {\ln 2} ^ {2 \ln 2} e ^ {- 2 x} d x \right.\right) \\ &= - \frac {\pi}{2} \left(2 \ln 2 \cdot \frac {1}{1 6} - \ln 2 \cdot \frac {1}{4} + \frac {1}{2} e ^ {- 2 x} \Big | _ {\ln 2} ^ {2 \ln 2}\right) = \frac {\pi}{1 6} \ln 2 - \frac {\pi}{4} \left(\frac {1}{1 6} - \frac {1}{4}\right) \\ &= \frac {\pi}{6 4} (4 \ln 2 + 3). \end{aligned}$（法二）也可以计算出$V(t)$的表达式再代入$t = \ln 2$$\begin{aligned} V (t) &= \pi \int_ {t} ^ {2 t} x \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x} \mathrm {d} x = - \frac {\pi}{2} \int_ {t} ^ {2 t} x \mathrm {d} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x}\right) = - \frac {\pi}{2} \left(x \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x} \Big | _ {t} ^ {2 t} - \int_ {t} ^ {2 t} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x} \mathrm {d} x\right) \\ &= - \frac {\pi}{2} \left(2 t \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 t} - t \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 t} + \frac {1}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x} \Big | _ {t} ^ {2 t}\right) = - \frac {\pi}{2} \left(2 t \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 t} - t \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 t} + \frac {1}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 t} - \frac {1}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 t}\right) \\ &= - \frac {\pi}{4} \left[ (4 t + 1) \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 t} - (2 t + 1) \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 t} \right]. \end{aligned}$因此，$V (\ln 2) = - \frac {\pi}{4} \left[ \left(4 \ln 2 + 1\right) \cdot \frac {1}{1 6} - \left(2 \ln 2 + 1\right) \cdot \frac {1}{4} \right] = \frac {\pi}{6 4} \left(4 \ln 2 + 3\right).$

questionText: 设单位质点 $P,Q$ 分别位于点 $(0,0)$ 和 $(0,1)$ 处，$P$ 从点 $(0,0)$ 出发沿 $x$ 正向移动，记 $G$ 为引力常量，则当质点 $P$ 移动到点 $(l,0)$ 时，克服质点 $Q$ 的引力所做的功为（　）。
analysisRich:
解 当质点 P从点（0，0）移动到点（l，0）时，引力 F的方向是变化的，始终沿点 P，Q的连线方向，克服质点 Q的引力所做的功等于克服 F沿 x轴方向的分力所做的功.

如图所示，当质点P运动到点$(x,0)$时，单位质点P，Q之间的距离$r = \sqrt{1 + x^2}$，从而引力F的大小为$\frac{G}{1 + x^2}$记PQ与x轴的夹角为$\theta$，则$\cos \theta = \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 + x^2}}$，F沿x轴方向的分力大小为$\frac{G}{1 + x^2}\cdot \cos \theta = \frac{Gx}{(1 + x^2)^{\frac{3}{2}}}$，克服引力的做功元素为$\mathrm{d}W = \frac{Gx}{(1 + x^2)^{\frac{3}{2}}}\mathrm{d}x.$因此，当质点 P从点（0,0）移动到点（l,0）时，克服质点 Q的引力所做的功$W=\int_{0}^{l}\frac{Gx}{\left(1+x^{2}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}}\mathrm{d}x$，应选B.

questionText:
17. (本题满分10分)

I. 比较$\int_{0}^{1}|\ln t|[\ln(1+t)]^{n}\mathrm{d}t$与$\int_{0}^{1}t^{n}|\ln t|\mathrm{d}t$（ n=1,2，$\cdots$）的大小，说明理由；

II. 记$u_{n}=\int_{0}^{1}|\ln t|[\ln(1+t)]^{n}\mathrm{d}t$（ n=1,2，$\cdots$），求极限$\lim_{n\to\infty}u_{n}.$
analysisRich:
解（I）在（0，1]上，$|\ln t|$$\ln(1+t)$与 t均非负，故比较$\int_{0}^{1}|\ln t|[\ln(1+t)]^{n}\mathrm{d}t$与$\int_{0}^{1}t^{n}|\ln t|\mathrm{d}t(n=1,2,\cdots)$的大小，只需比较$\ln(1+t)$与 t的大小.

考虑 f（t）=$\ln(1+t)-t.$$f ^ {\prime} (t) = \frac {1}{1 + t} - 1.$当$t\in (0,1]$时，$f^{\prime}(t) < 0,f(t)\leqslant f(0) = 0.$因此，当$t \in [0,1]$时，$\ln (1 + t) \leqslant t.$由于两被积函数仅在$t = 1$处相等，故$\int_ {0} ^ {1} | \ln t | [ \ln (1 + t) ] ^ {n} \mathrm {d} t < \int_ {0} ^ {1} t ^ {n} | \ln t | \mathrm {d} t (n = 1, 2, \dots).$（Ⅱ）（法一）由第（I）问知，$0 < u_{n} < \int_{0}^{1} t^{n}|\ln t|\mathrm{d}t.$$\begin{aligned} \int_ {0} ^ {1} t ^ {n} \mid \ln t \mid \mathrm {d} t &= \frac {- 1}{n + 1} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \ln t \mathrm {d} \left(t ^ {n + 1}\right) = \frac {- 1}{n + 1} \left(t ^ {n + 1} \ln t \mid_ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} t ^ {n + 1} \cdot \frac {1}{t} \mathrm {d} t\right) \\ \frac {\lim _ {t \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} t ^ {n + 1} \ln t = 0}{\overline {{\quad}}} \frac {1}{n + 1} \int_ {0} ^ {1} t ^ {n} \mathrm {d} t &= \frac {1}{(n + 1) ^ {2}}. \end{aligned}$因此，$\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \int_ {0} ^ {1} t ^ {n} | \ln t | \mathrm {d} t = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {1}{(n + 1) ^ {2}} = 0.$由夹逼准则知，$\lim_{n\to \infty}u_n = 0.$（法二）由第（I）问知，$0 < u_{n} < \int_{0}^{1} t^{n}|\ln t|\mathrm{d}t.$又因为$\lim_{t\to 0^{+}}(t\ln t) = 0$，所以存在$M > 0$，使得对任意的$t\in (0,1]$，有$t|\ln t|\leqslant M$，从而$0 < u _ {n} < \int_ {0} ^ {1} t ^ {n} | \ln t | \mathrm {d} t \leqslant M \int_ {0} ^ {1} t ^ {n - 1} \mathrm {d} t = \frac {M}{n}.$由夹逼准则知，$\lim_{n\to \infty}u_n = 0.$（法三）由于$t\in[0,1]$时，$\ln(1 + t)\leqslant \ln 2 < 1$，故$u_{n}\leqslant (\ln 2)^{n}\int_{0}^{1}|\ln t|\mathrm{d}t.$计算$\int_{0}^{1}|\ln t| \mathrm{d} t$得，$\int_ {0} ^ {1} | \ln t | \mathrm {d} t = - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \ln t \mathrm {d} t = - \left(t \ln t \left| _ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} 1 \mathrm {d} t\right)\right) \xlongequal {\lim _ {t \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} t \ln t = 0} 1.$从而$0 < u_{n}\leqslant (\ln 2)^{n}$因为$\lim_{n\to \infty}(\ln 2)^n = 0$，所以由夹逼准则知，$\lim_{n\to \infty}u_n = 0.$

于是，$J _ {2} + J _ {3} > \mathrm {e} ^ {(2 \pi) ^ {2}} \left(\int_ {2 \pi} ^ {3 \pi} \sin x \mathrm {d} x - \left| \int_ {\pi} ^ {2 \pi} \sin x \mathrm {d} x \right|\right) = 0,$即$I_{3} > I_{1}.$因此，$I_{2} < I_{1} < I_{3}$应选D.

questionText: $\text {求} \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} \frac {k}{n ^ {2}} \ln \left(1 + \frac {k}{n}\right)$
analysisRich: 解 根据定积分的定义，提出因子$\frac{1}{n}$，可得$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} \frac {k}{n ^ {2}} \ln \left(1 + \frac {k}{n}\right) &= \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} \frac {k}{n} \ln \left(1 + \frac {k}{n}\right) \cdot \frac {1}{n} = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \ln (1 + x) d x \\ &= \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \ln (1 + x) d \left(x ^ {2}\right) \xlongequal {\text {分 部 积 分}} \frac {x ^ {2}}{2} \ln (1 + x) \left| _ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {x ^ {2}}{2 (1 + x)} d x \right. \\ &= \frac {\ln 2}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {x ^ {2} - 1 + 1}{1 + x} d x = \frac {\ln 2}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(x - 1 + \frac {1}{1 + x}\right) d x \\ &= \frac {\ln 2}{2} - \frac {1}{2} \left[ \frac {x ^ {2}}{2} - x + \ln (1 + x) \right] \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {1}{4}. \end{aligned}$因此，原极限$= \frac{1}{4}.$

questionText: 设$M=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{(1+x)^{2}}{1+x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x$，$N=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{1+x}{\mathrm{e}^{x}}\mathrm{d}x$，$K=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(1+\sqrt{\cos x})\mathrm{d}x$，则（    )
analysisRich:
解分别计算 M,N,K.

由于$\frac{2x}{1 + x^2}$是奇函数，故$\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{2x}{1 + x^2}\mathrm{d}x = 0.$于是，$M = \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {(1 + x) ^ {2}}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {1 + x ^ {2} + 2 x}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \xlongequal {\frac {\int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {2 x}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x = 0}{}} \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \mathrm {d} x = \pi .$注意到当$x\neq 0$时，$\mathrm{e}^{x} > 1 + x.$于是，在$\left[-\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}\right]$上，$\frac{1+x}{\mathrm{e}^{x}}\leqslant 1$且等号仅在$x=0$处成立.$N = \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {1 + x}{\mathrm {e} ^ {x}} \mathrm {d} x < \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \mathrm {d} x = \pi .$由于$\sqrt{\cos x}$是偶函数，且当 x$\in\left[-\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}\right]$时，$\cos x\geqslant0$且等号仅在端点处成立，故$\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sqrt{\cos x}\mathrm{d}x=2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sqrt{\cos x}\mathrm{d}x>0.$于是，$K = \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \left(1 + \sqrt {\cos x}\right) \mathrm {d} x = \pi + \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sqrt {\cos x} \mathrm {d} x > \pi .$综上所述，$K > M > N$应选C.

questionText: 设函数 f(x)在区间[0,1]上连续，则$\int_{0}^{1} f(x)\mathrm{d}x=$(    )
analysisRich:
解 由于 f(x)连续，故$\int_{0}^{1} f(x)\mathrm{d}x$存在，从而可对区间[0，1]进行划分，将该积分写为 n项和式的极限.

将[0，1]分为n等份，每个小区间为$\left[ \frac{k-1}{n},\frac{k}{n}\right]$$k=1,2,\dots,n$从$\left[ \frac{k-1}{n},\frac{k}{n}\right]$中取点$\frac{2k-1}{2n}$故由$\int_{0}^{1} f(x)\mathrm{d}x$存在以及定积分的定义可得$\int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm {d} x = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} f \left(\frac {2 k - 1}{2 n}\right) \cdot \frac {1}{n}.$因此，应选B.

下面说明选项A、C、D均不正确.

选项A：$\lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{k = 1}^{n}f\left(\frac{2k - 1}{2n}\right)\frac{1}{2n} = \frac{1}{2}\lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{k = 1}^{n}f\left(\frac{2k - 1}{2n}\right)\frac{1}{n} = \frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{1}f(x)\mathrm{d}x.$选项C：$\lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{k = 1}^{2n}f\left(\frac{k - 1}{2n}\right)\frac{1}{n} = 2\lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{k = 1}^{2n}f\left(\frac{k - 1}{2n}\right)\frac{1}{2n} = 2\int_{0}^{1}f(x)\mathrm{d}x.$选项D：$\lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{k = 1}^{2n}f\left(\frac{k}{2n}\right)\frac{2}{n} = 4\lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{k = 1}^{2n}f\left(\frac{k}{2n}\right)\frac{1}{2n} = 4\int_{0}^{1}f(x)\mathrm{d}x.$

questionText: 若$I_{1}=\int_{0}^{1}\frac{x}{2(1+\cos x)}\mathrm{d}x,I_{2}=\int_{0}^{1}\frac{\ln(1+x)}{1+\cos x}\mathrm{d}x,I_{3}=\int_{0}^{1}\frac{2x}{1+\sin x}\mathrm{d}x$，则（    )
analysisRich:
解 通过观察可发现，要比较$I_{1}$与$I_{2}$的大小，只需比较$\frac{x}{2}$与$\ln(1+x)$的大小.

令$f(x)=\ln(1+x)-\frac{x}{2}$，则$f(0)=0$$f^{\prime}(x)=\frac{1}{1+x}-\frac{1}{2}$当$x\in(0,1)$时，$f^{\prime}(x)>0$$f(x)$单调增加，从而$f(x)>f(0)=0$即$\ln(1+x) > \frac{x}{2},\frac{\ln(1+x)}{1+\cos x} > \frac{x}{2(1+\cos x)}$因此，$I_{2}>I_{1}$此外，同样的方法不难证明在(0,1)内，$\ln(1+x)<x.$另一方面，由于在(0,1)内，$0<\sin x,\cos x<1,1<1+\sin x<2$故$I_{3}$的被积函数$\frac{2x}{1+\sin x} > x.$结合$\ln(1+x)<x$可得，$\frac{\ln(1+x)}{1+\cos x} < \frac{x}{1+\cos x} < x.$于是，$\frac{2x}{1+\sin x}>x > \frac{\ln(1+x)}{1+\cos x}.$因此，$I_{3}>I_{2}.$综上所述，应选A.

18. (本题满分10分)

I. 比较$\int_{0}^{1}|\ln t|[\ln(1+t)]^{n}\mathrm{d}t$与$\int_{0}^{1}t^{n}|\ln t|\mathrm{d}t$（ n=1,2，$\cdots$）的大小，说明理由；

II. 记$u_{n}=\int_{0}^{1}|\ln t|[\ln(1+t)]^{n}\mathrm{d}t$（ n=1,2，$\cdots$），求极限$\lim_{n\to\infty}u_{n}.$
analysisRich:
解（I）在（0,1]上，$\mid \ln t\mid$$\ln(1+t)$与 t均非负，故比较$\int_{0}^{1}|\ln t|[\ln(1+t)]^{n}\mathrm{d}t$与$\int_{0}^{1}t^{n}|\ln t|\mathrm{d}t(n=1,2,\cdots)$的大小，只需比较$\ln(1+t)$与 t的大小.

考虑$f(t)=\ln(1+t)-t$考虑$f ( t )=\ln( 1+t)-t.$$f ^ {\prime} (t) = \frac {1}{1 + t} - 1.$当$t\in (0,1]$时，$f^{\prime}(t) < 0,f(t)\leqslant f(0) = 0.$因此，当$t\in [0,1]$时，$\ln (1 + t)\leqslant t.$由于两被积函数仅在$t = 1$处相等，故$\int_ {0} ^ {1} | \ln t | [ \ln (1 + t) ] ^ {n} \mathrm {d} t < \int_ {0} ^ {1} t ^ {n} | \ln t | \mathrm {d} t (n = 1, 2, \dots).$（Ⅱ）（法一）由第（I）问知，$0 < u_{n} < \int_{0}^{1} t^{n}|\ln t|\mathrm{d}t.$$\begin{aligned} \int_ {0} ^ {1} t ^ {n} \mid \ln t \mid \mathrm {d} t &= \frac {- 1}{n + 1} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \ln t \mathrm {d} \left(t ^ {n + 1}\right) = \frac {- 1}{n + 1} \left(t ^ {n + 1} \ln t \mid_ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} t ^ {n + 1} \cdot \frac {1}{t} \mathrm {d} t\right) \\ \frac {\lim _ {t \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} t ^ {n + 1} \ln t = 0}{\overline {{\quad}}} \frac {1}{n + 1} \int_ {0} ^ {1} t ^ {n} \mathrm {d} t &= \frac {1}{(n + 1) ^ {2}}. \end{aligned}$因此，$\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \int_ {0} ^ {1} t ^ {n} | \ln t | \mathrm {d} t = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {1}{(n + 1) ^ {2}} = 0.$由夹逼准则知，$\lim_{n\to \infty}u_n = 0.$（法二）由第（I）问知，$0 < u_{n} < \int_{0}^{1} t^{n}|\ln t|\mathrm{d}t.$又因为$\lim_{t\to 0^{+}}t\ln t = 0$，所以存在$M > 0$，使得对任意的$t\in (0,1]$，有$t|\ln t|\leqslant M$，从而$0 < u _ {n} < \int_ {0} ^ {1} t ^ {n} | \ln t | \mathrm {d} t \leqslant M \int_ {0} ^ {1} t ^ {n - 1} \mathrm {d} t = \frac {M}{n}.$由夹逼准则知，$\lim_{n\to \infty}u_n = 0.$（法三）由于$t\in[0,1]$时，$\ln(1 + t)\leqslant \ln 2 < 1$，故$u_{n}\leqslant (\ln 2)^{n}\int_{0}^{1}|\ln t|\mathrm{d}t.$计算$\int_{0}^{1}|\ln t| \mathrm{d} t$得，$\int_ {0} ^ {1} | \ln t | \mathrm {d} t = - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \ln t \mathrm {d} t = - \left(t \ln t \left| _ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} 1 \mathrm {d} t\right)\right) \xlongequal {\lim _ {t \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} t \ln t = 0} 1.$从而$0 < u_{n}\leqslant (\ln 2)^{n}$因为$\lim_{n\to \infty}(\ln 2)^n = 0$，所以由夹逼准则知，$\lim_{n\to \infty}u_n = 0.$

questionText:
设函数 f(x), g(x)在区间 [a,b]上连续，且 f(x)单调增加，$0 \leqslant g ( x ) \leqslant1$证明：

I.$0 \leqslant\int_{a}^{x} g ( t ) \mathrm{d} t \leqslant x-a,x \in[a,b]$II.$\int_{a}^{a+\int_{a}^{b} g ( t ) \mathrm{d} t} f ( x ) \mathrm{d} x \leqslant\int_{a}^{b} f ( x ) g ( x ) \mathrm{d} x.$
analysisRich:
证（I）由于在$[a,b]$上，$0\leqslant g(x)\leqslant 1$，故$0 = \int_ {a} ^ {x} 0 \mathrm {d} t \leqslant \int_ {a} ^ {x} g (t) \mathrm {d} t \leqslant \int_ {a} ^ {x} 1 \mathrm {d} t = x - a.$（Ⅱ）（法一）构造辅助函数$F ( u )=\int_{a}^{u} f ( x ) g ( x ) \mathrm{d} x-\int_{a}^{a+\int_{a}^{u} g ( t ) \mathrm{d} t} f ( x ) \mathrm{d} x, u \in[ a, b ],$则第（Ⅱ）问中的不等式等价于$F ( b ) \geqslant0.$由于$F ( a )=0$故若能证明$F^{\prime} ( u ) \geqslant0$则由 F(u)在[a,b]上单调增加可推出$F ( b ) \geqslant0.$计算$F^{\prime}(u).$$F ^ {\prime} (u) = f (u) g (u) - f \left(a + \int_ {a} ^ {u} g (t) \mathrm {d} t\right) g (u) = g (u) \left[ f (u) - f \left(a + \int_ {a} ^ {u} g (t) \mathrm {d} t\right) \right].$由第（I）问知，$0 \leqslant \int_{a}^{u} g ( t ) \mathrm{d} t \leqslant u - a$，故$a \leqslant a + \int_{a}^{u} g ( t ) \mathrm{d} t \leqslant u.$于是，由$f ( x )$在$[ a,b]$上单调增加可知，$f (u) - f \left(a + \int_ {a} ^ {u} g (t) \mathrm {d} t\right) \geqslant 0.$从而$F^{\prime}(u)\geqslant 0$，故$F(u)$在$[a,b]$上单调增加.

因此，$F ( b ) \geqslant F ( a ) = 0$，原不等式成立.

（法二）在下面的证明中，我们将用到积分中值定理的一个一般形式.

若$f ( x )$,$g ( x )$在$[ a,b]$上连续，且$g ( x )$在$[ a,b]$上不变号，则$\int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) g (x) \mathrm {d} x = f (\xi) \int_ {a} ^ {b} g (x) \mathrm {d} x,$其中$\xi\in[a,b].$记$D=\int_{a}^{b} f ( x ) g ( x ) \mathrm{d} x-\int_{a}^{a+\int_{a}^{b} g ( t ) \mathrm{d} t} f ( x ) \mathrm{d} x.$我们证明$D \geqslant 0$注意到$a+\int_{a}^{b} g ( t ) \mathrm{d} t \in[ a,b]$，故$\begin{aligned} D &= \int_ {a} ^ {a + \int_ {a} ^ {b} g (t) \mathrm {d} t} [ f (x) g (x) - f (x) ] \mathrm {d} x + \int_ {a + \int_ {a} ^ {b} g (t) \mathrm {d} t} ^ {b} f (x) g (x) \mathrm {d} x \\ &= \int_ {a} ^ {a + \int_ {a} ^ {b} g (t) \mathrm {d} t} f (x) [ g (x) - 1 ] \mathrm {d} x + \int_ {a + \int_ {a} ^ {b} g (t) \mathrm {d} t} ^ {b} f (x) g (x) \mathrm {d} x. \end{aligned}$由于$0 \leqslant g(x) \leqslant 1$，故$g(x) - 1$在$[a,b]$上不变号.由积分中值定理可得$D = f \left(\xi_ {1}\right) \int_ {a} ^ {a + \int_ {a} ^ {b} g (t) \mathrm {d} t} [ g (x) - 1 ] \mathrm {d} x + f \left(\xi_ {2}\right) \int_ {a + \int_ {a} ^ {b} g (t) \mathrm {d} t} ^ {b} g (x) \mathrm {d} x,$其中，$\xi_{1}\in \left[ a,a + \int_{a}^{b}g(t)\mathrm{d}t\right],\xi_{2}\in \left[ a + \int_{a}^{b}g(t)\mathrm{d}t,b\right].$由于$f(x)$在$[a,b]$上单调增加，故$f(\xi_{1})\leqslant f(\xi_{2})$，从而$\begin{array}{l} D \geqslant f \left(\xi_ {1}\right) \left\{\int_ {a} ^ {a + \int_ {a} ^ {b} g (t) \mathrm {d} t} [ g (x) - 1 ] \mathrm {d} x + \int_ {a + \int_ {a} ^ {b} g (t) \mathrm {d} t} ^ {b} g (x) \mathrm {d} x \right\} = f \left(\xi_ {1}\right) \left[ \int_ {a} ^ {b} g (x) \mathrm {d} x - \int_ {a} ^ {a + \int_ {a} ^ {b} g (t) \mathrm {d} t} 1 \mathrm {d} x \right] \\ = f \left(\xi_ {1}\right) \left[ \int_ {a} ^ {b} g (x) \mathrm {d} x - \int_ {a} ^ {b} g (t) \mathrm {d} t \right] = 0. \\ \end{array}$因此，$D\geqslant 0$，故原不等式得证.

questionText: $0. \mathrm {极 限} \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} \left(\sin \frac {1}{n} + 2 \sin \frac {2}{n} + \dots + n \sin \frac {n}{n}\right) = \underline {{}}$
analysisRich: 解 将原表达式作恒等变形，提出因子$\frac{1}{n}$$\frac {1}{n ^ {2}} \left(\sin \frac {1}{n} + 2 \sin \frac {2}{n} + \dots + n \sin \frac {n}{n}\right) = \frac {1}{n} \left(\frac {1}{n} \sin \frac {1}{n} + \frac {2}{n} \sin \frac {2}{n} + \dots + \frac {n}{n} \sin \frac {n}{n}\right).$$\begin{aligned} \mathrm {原 极 限} &= \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \left(\frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {i}{n} \sin \frac {i}{n}\right) = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \sin x \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \mathrm {d} (- \cos x) \\ &= - x \cos x \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} + \int_ {0} ^ {1} \cos x \mathrm {d} x = \sin 1 - \cos 1. \end{aligned}$

questionText: 设$M=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{(1+x)^{2}}{1+x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x,N=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{1+x}{\mathrm{e}^{x}}\mathrm{d}x,K=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(1+\sqrt{\cos x})\mathrm{d}x$，则（    )
analysisRich:
分别计算 M,N,K.

由于$\frac{2x}{1+x^{2}}$是奇函数，故$\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{2x}{1+x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x=0.$于是，$M = \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {(1 + x) ^ {2}}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {1 + x ^ {2} + 2 x}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \frac {\int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {2 x}{1 + x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x = 0}{\int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \mathrm {d} x = \pi}.$注意到当$x\neq 0$时，$\mathrm{e}^{x}>1+x$.于是，在$\left[-\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}\right]$上，$\frac{1+x}{e^{x}}\leqslant 1$且等号仅在$x=0$处成立.$N = \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {1 + x}{\mathrm {e} ^ {x}} \mathrm {d} x < \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \mathrm {d} x = \pi .$由于$\sqrt{\cos x}$是偶函数，且当 x$\in\left[-\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}\right]$时，$\cos x\geqslant0$且等号仅在端点处成立，故$\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sqrt{\cos x}\mathrm{d}x=2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sqrt{\cos x}\mathrm{d}x>0.$于是，$K = \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \left(1 + \sqrt {\cos x}\right) \mathrm {d} x = \pi + \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sqrt {\cos x} \mathrm {d} x > \pi .$综上所述，$K > M > N$应选C.

questionText: $\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} \left[ \ln \frac {1}{n} + 2 \ln \frac {2}{n} + \dots + (n - 1) \ln \frac {n - 1}{n} \right] = \underline {{}}$
analysisRich: 解 从定积分的定义出发，对原极限进行恒等变形，注意到$\ln 1 = 0$，故$\ln \frac {1}{n} + 2 \ln \frac {2}{n} + \dots + (n - 1) \ln \frac {n - 1}{n} = \ln \frac {1}{n} + 2 \ln \frac {2}{n} + \dots + (n - 1) \ln \frac {n - 1}{n} + n \ln \frac {n}{n}.$进一步可得$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {i}{n} \ln \frac {i}{n} &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \ln x d x = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \ln x d \left(x ^ {2}\right) \\ &= \frac {1}{2} \left(x ^ {2} \ln x \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {2} \cdot \frac {1}{x} d x\right) = \frac {1}{2} \left(0 - \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} x ^ {2} \ln x - \frac {x ^ {2}}{2} \Big | _ {0} ^ {1}\right) \\ \frac {\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} x ^ {2} \ln x = 0}{\frac {1}{2}} - \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {x ^ {2}}{2} \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} &= - \frac {1}{4}. \end{aligned}$

questionText: $\lim_{n \to \infty} \int_{0}^{1} \mathrm{e}^{-x} \sin nx \mathrm{d}x=$___
analysisRich: 解 （法一）由分部积分法，可得$\int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \sin n x \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \mathrm {d} \left(- \frac {\cos n x}{n}\right) = - \frac {1}{n} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \mathrm {d} (\cos n x) = - \frac {1}{n} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \cos n x \mid_ {0} ^ {1} + \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \cos n x \mathrm {d} x\right).$当$x\in[0,1]$时，$\mathrm{e}^{-x}\in\left[\frac{1}{\mathrm{e}},1\right],|\cos nx|\leqslant1$从而$\left| \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \cos n x \mathrm {d} x \right| \leqslant \int_ {0} ^ {1} | \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \cos n x | \mathrm {d} x \leqslant \int_ {0} ^ {1} 1 \mathrm {d} x \leqslant 1.$因此，$0 \leqslant \left| \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \cos n x \right| _ {0} ^ {1} + \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \cos n x \mathrm {d} x \leqslant \left| \frac {\cos n}{\mathrm {e}} - 1 \right| + 1 \leqslant 3.$从而$\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \sin n x \mathrm {d} x = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \left(- \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \cos n x \Big| _ {0} ^ {1} + \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \cos n x \mathrm {d} x}{n}\right) \stackrel {\text {分 子 有 界}} {=} 0.$（法二）记$I_{n} = \int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{e}^{-x}\sin nx\mathrm{d}x.$我们可以计算出$I_{n}$的值，再求$\lim_{n\to \infty}I_{n}.$$\begin{aligned} I _ {n} &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \sin n x \mathrm {d} x = - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sin n x \mathrm {d} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- x}\right) = - \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \sin n x \left| _ {0} ^ {1} + n \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \cos n x \mathrm {d} x \right. \\ &= - \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \sin n x \left| _ {0} ^ {1} - n \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \cos n x \right| _ {0} ^ {1} - n ^ {2} I _ {n}. \end{aligned}$整理得，$I _ {n} = - \frac {n \cos n + \sin n}{\mathrm {e} \left(n ^ {2} + 1\right)} + \frac {n}{n ^ {2} + 1}.$因此，$\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} I _ {n} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \left[ - \frac {n \cos n + \sin n}{\mathrm {e} \left(n ^ {2} + 1\right)} + \frac {n}{n ^ {2} + 1} \right] = 0.$

questionText: $\displaystyle\int_0^{\pi^2}\sqrt x\cos\sqrt x\,dx=$ ______。
analysisRich: $\begin{aligned} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi^ {2}} \sqrt {x} \cos \sqrt {x} \mathrm {d} x \stackrel {t = \sqrt {x}} {=} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} t \cos t \mathrm {d} \left(t ^ {2}\right) \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} 2 t ^ {2} \cos t \mathrm {d} t = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} 2 t ^ {2} \mathrm {d} (\sin t) \\ \underline {{\mathrm {分 部 积 分}}} (\sin t \cdot 2 t ^ {2}) \left| _ {0} ^ {\pi} - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} 4 t \sin t \mathrm {d} t &= \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} 4 t \mathrm {d} (\cos t) \right. \\ \underline {{\mathrm {分 部 积 分}}} (\cos t \cdot 4 t) \left| _ {0} ^ {\pi} - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} 4 \cos t \mathrm {d} t &= - 4 \pi . \right. \end{aligned}$

analysisRich: 解$\sqrt{2 x-x^{2}}=\sqrt{1-(x-1)^{2}}.$令 t=x-1，则有$\begin{aligned} \int_ {0} ^ {2} x \sqrt {2 x - x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x &= \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} (t + 1) \sqrt {1 - t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t = \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} t \sqrt {1 - t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t + \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} \sqrt {1 - t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t \\ \underline {{\text {对称性}}} 0 + 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {1 - t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t \\ \underline {{\underline {{t = \sin \theta}}}} 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos^ {2} \theta \mathrm {d} \theta &= \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} (1 + \cos 2 \theta) \mathrm {d} \theta = \frac {\pi}{2}. \end{aligned}$

questionText: 计算$\int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {f (x)}{\sqrt {x}} \mathrm {d} x, \text {其 中} f (x) = \int_ {1} ^ {x} \frac {\ln (t + 1)}{t} \mathrm {d} t.$
analysisRich: 解（法一）由题设知，$f^{\prime}(x) = \frac{\ln(x + 1)}{x}, x\in(0,1],$且$f(1)=0$，于是$\begin{aligned} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {f (x)}{\sqrt {x}} \mathrm {d} x &= 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm {d} (\sqrt {x}) = 2 \left[ \sqrt {x} f (x) \left| _ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {x} f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm {d} x \right] \right. \\ &= 0 - 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {x} \cdot \frac {\ln (x + 1)}{x} \mathrm {d} x = - 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\ln (x + 1)}{\sqrt {x}} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= - 4 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \ln (x + 1) \mathrm {d} (\sqrt {x}) \\ &= - 4 \left[ \sqrt {x} \ln (x + 1) \left| _ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\sqrt {x}}{x + 1} \mathrm {d} x \right] \right. \\ \underline {{= - 4}} \left[ \sqrt {x} \ln (x + 1) \left| _ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\sqrt {x}}{x + 1} \mathrm {d} x \right] \right. \\ &= - 4 \ln 2 + 4 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {t}{t ^ {2} + 1} \cdot 2 t \mathrm {d} t \\ &= - 4 \ln 2 + 8 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(1 - \frac {1}{t ^ {2} + 1}\right) \mathrm {d} t \\ &= - 4 \ln 2 + 8 \left(t - \arctan t\right) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} \\ &= - 4 \ln 2 + 8 - 2 \pi . \end{aligned}$$\begin{array}{l} \frac {\text {交换 积 分}}{\text {次 序}} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} t \int_ {0} ^ {t} \frac {\ln (t + 1)}{t} \cdot \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} \mathrm {d} x = - 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\ln (t + 1)}{\sqrt {t}} \mathrm {d} t \\ \underline {{\text {同 法 一}}} - 4 \ln 2 + 8 - 2 \pi . \\ \end{array}$

questionText: 若$\int_{-\pi}^{\pi} \left(x-a_{1}\cos x-b_{1}\sin x\right)^{2}\mathrm{d}x=\min_{a,b\in\mathbf{R}}\left\{\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}\left(x-a\cos x-b\sin x\right)^{2}\mathrm{d}x\right\}$，则$a_{1}\cos x+b_{1}\sin x=$(    )
analysisRich:
解（法一）$\begin{aligned} \int_ {- \pi} ^ {\pi} \left(x - a \cos x - b \sin x\right) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x &= \int_ {- \pi} ^ {\pi} \left(x ^ {2} + a ^ {2} \cos^ {2} x + b ^ {2} \sin^ {2} x - 2 a x \cos x - 2 b x \sin x + 2 a b \sin x \cos x\right) \mathrm {d} x \\ \xlongequal {\text {对称性}} 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} x ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x + 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \left(a ^ {2} \cos^ {2} x + b ^ {2} \sin^ {2} x - 2 b x \sin x\right) \mathrm {d} x \\ &= \frac {2}{3} \pi^ {3} + \left(a ^ {2} + b ^ {2} - 4 b\right) \pi . \end{aligned}$当 a=0时，$a^{2}$最小；当 b=2时，$b^{2}-4b$最小，从而当 a=0，b=2时，$\int_{- \pi}^{\pi} \left(x-a\cos x-b\sin x\right)^{2}\mathrm{d}x$最小.因此$a_{1}=0,b_{1}=2$，从而$a_{1}\cos x+b_{1}\sin x=2\sin x$，应选A.

（法二）看作二元函数的最值问题求解.

令$f ( a,b)=\int_{-\pi}^{\pi} \left(x-a\cos x-b\sin x\right)^{2}\mathrm{d}x$，则$\frac {\partial f (a , b)}{\partial a} = \int_ {- \pi} ^ {\pi} \left[ - 2 (x - a \cos x - b \sin x) \cos x \right] \mathrm {d} x = 2 a \int_ {- \pi} ^ {\pi} \cos^ {2} x \mathrm {d} x = 2 a \pi ,$$\frac {\partial f (a , b)}{\partial b} = \int_ {- \pi} ^ {\pi} \left[ - 2 \left(x - a \cos x - b \sin x\right) \sin x \right] \mathrm {d} x = 2 \int_ {- \pi} ^ {\pi} \left(b \sin^ {2} x - x \sin x\right) \mathrm {d} x = 2 \left(b \pi - 2 \pi\right).$令$\frac{\partial f(a,b)}{\partial a} = 0,\frac{\partial f(a,b)}{\partial b} = 0$，解得$a = 0,b = 2$，从而$a_1 = 0,b_1 = 2$.应选A.

（法三）将选项A、B、C、D的值分别代入$\int_{-\pi}^{\pi} \left(x-a\cos x-b\sin x\right)^{2}\mathrm{d}x$，得到$\int_ {- \pi} ^ {\pi} (x - 2 \sin x) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x = \frac {2}{3} \pi^ {3} - 4 \pi ,$$\int_ {- \pi} ^ {\pi} \left(x - 2 \cos x\right) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x = \frac {2}{3} \pi^ {3} + 4 \pi ,$$\int_ {- \pi} ^ {\pi} \left(x - 2 \pi \sin x\right) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x = \frac {2}{3} \pi^ {3} + 4 \pi^ {2} (\pi - 2),$$\int_ {- \pi} ^ {\pi} \left(x - 2 \pi \cos x\right) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x = \frac {2}{3} \pi^ {3} + 4 \pi^ {3}.$由于$\frac{2}{3}\pi^{3}-4\pi<\frac{2}{3}\pi^{3}+4\pi<\frac{2}{3}\pi^{3}+4\pi^{2}(\pi-2)<\frac{2}{3}\pi^{3}+4\pi^{3}$，故选A.

questionText: 设$f(x)$是周期为4的可导奇函数,且$f^{\prime}(x)=2(x-1),x\in[0,2]$,则$f(7)=$___.
analysisRich:
由于$f ( x )$是周期为4的函数，且$7=2\times4-1$，故$f ( 7 ) = f (-1).$(a)

(b)

（法一）由 f(x)为奇函数可得$f(0)=0$.由当$x\in[0,2]$时，$f^{\prime}(x)=2(x-1)$可得， f(x)在 [0,2]上的表达式为$f (x) = \int_ {0} ^ {x} 2 (t - 1) \mathrm {d} t + f (0) = x ^ {2} - 2 x = (x - 1) ^ {2} - 1.$于是$f(1) = -1.$由$f(x)$为奇函数得，$f(-1) = -f(1) = 1$，即$f(7) = 1.$（法二）由 f(x)为奇函数可知，$f(x)=-f(-x).$在等式两端求导得$f^{\prime}(x)=f^{\prime}(-x),$从而$f^{\prime}(x)$为偶函数，$f^{\prime}(x)$的图像关于y轴对称.在[0，2]上，$f^{\prime}(x)=2(x-1),$为一条过点（0，-2）和点（1，0）的直线。由此可知，在[-2，0]上，$y=f^{\prime}(x)$为过点（0，-2）和点（-1，0）的直线，可求得$f^{\prime}(x)=-2(x+1).$从而，$f(x)$在[-2，0]上为$f (x) = \int_ {0} ^ {x} - 2 (t + 1) \mathrm {d} t + f (0) = - x ^ {2} - 2 x = - (x + 1) ^ {2} + 1.$因此，$f(-1)=1$，即$f(7)=1.$

questionText: $\int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \left(\frac {\sin x}{1 + \cos x} + | x |\right) \mathrm {d} x = \underline {{}}$
analysisRich: 由于$\frac{\sin x}{1 + \cos x}$是奇函数，$|x|$是偶函数，故$\int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {\sin x}{1 + \cos x} \mathrm {d} x = 0, \quad \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} | x | \mathrm {d} x = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} x \mathrm {d} x = \frac {\pi^ {2}}{4}.$因此，$\int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \left(\frac {\sin x}{1 + \cos x} + | x |\right) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {\sin x}{1 + \cos x} \mathrm {d} x + \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} | x | \mathrm {d} x = 0 + \frac {\pi^ {2}}{4} = \frac {\pi^ {2}}{4}.$

analysisRich: 由于$[-\pi ,\pi ]$是对称区间，且$\sin^{3}x$是关于x的奇函数，$\sqrt{\pi^{2}-x^{2}}$是关于x的偶函数，故原积分$\frac{\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}\sin^{3}x\mathrm{d}x=0}{\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}\sqrt{\pi^{2}-x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x} \int_{-\pi}^{\pi}\sqrt{\pi^{2}-x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x$$\frac{x=\pi\sin t}{2} 2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\pi\cos t\cdot \pi\cos t\mathrm{d}t=\pi^{2}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}2\cos^{2}t\mathrm{d}t$$= \pi^{2}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(1+\cos 2t)\mathrm{d}t=\pi^{2}\times \left(\frac{\pi}{2}+0\right)=\frac{\pi^{3}}{2}.$

questionText: 已知函数$f ( x )=\int_{1}^{x}\sqrt{1+t^{4}}\mathrm{d} t$，则$\int_{0}^{1} x^{2} f ( x ) \mathrm{d} x=$___.
analysisRich:
（法一）利用分部积分法.

注意到 f（1）=0.$\begin{aligned} \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {2} f (x) \mathrm {d} x &= \frac {1}{3} \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm {d} \left(x ^ {3}\right) = \frac {1}{3} \left[ x ^ {3} f (x) \left| _ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {3} \cdot f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm {d} x \right] = - \frac {1}{3} \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {3} \sqrt {1 + x ^ {4}} \mathrm {d} x \right. \\ &= - \frac {1}{1 2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {1 + x ^ {4}} \mathrm {d} \left(x ^ {4}\right) = - \frac {1}{1 2} \cdot \frac {2}{3} \cdot \left(1 + x ^ {4}\right) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {1 - 2 \sqrt {2}}{1 8}. \end{aligned}$（法二）交换积分次序.

将 f(x) 代入所求积分.$\int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {2} f (x) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {2} \left(\int_ {1} ^ {x} \sqrt {1 + t ^ {4}} \mathrm {d} t\right) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {1} ^ {x} \sqrt {1 + t ^ {4}} \mathrm {d} t.$写出该积分对应的二重积分的积分区域 D. 由二次积分的表达式可知，边界曲线为 t=x，t=1以及 x=0，故$D = \{(x, t) \mid x \leqslant t \leqslant 1, 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1 \}.$如图所示，交换积分次序可得$D = \{(x, t) \mid 0 \leqslant x \leqslant t, 0 \leqslant t \leqslant 1 \}.$因此，$\begin{array}{l} = - \frac {1}{3} \cdot \frac {1}{4} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {1 + t ^ {4}} \mathrm {d} \left(t ^ {4}\right) = - \frac {1}{1 2} \cdot \frac {2}{3} \cdot \left(1 + t ^ {4}\right) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {1 - 2 \sqrt {2}}{1 8}. \\ \end{array}$

questionText: 已知函数$f ( x )=x \int_{1}^{x} \frac{\sin t^{2}}{t} \mathrm{d} t$，则$\int_{0}^{1} f ( x ) \mathrm{d} x=$___.
analysisRich:
解 （法一）利用分部积分法.

记$F ( x )=\int_{1}^{x}\frac{\sin t^{2}}{t}\mathrm{d} t$，则$F ( 1 )=0,F^{\prime}(x)=\frac{\sin x^{2}}{x}.$$\begin{aligned} \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm {d} x &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} x F (x) \mathrm {d} x = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} F (x) \mathrm {d} \left(x ^ {2}\right) = \frac {1}{2} \left[ x ^ {2} F (x) \left| _ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {2} \cdot F ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm {d} x \right. \right] \\ &= - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {2} \cdot \frac {\sin x ^ {2}}{x} \mathrm {d} x = - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \sin x ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x = - \frac {1}{4} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sin x ^ {2} \mathrm {d} \left(x ^ {2}\right) \\ &= \frac {1}{4} \cos x ^ {2} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {1}{4} (\cos 1 - 1). \end{aligned}$（法二）交换积分次序.

将 f(x) 代入所求积分.$\int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \left(\int_ {1} ^ {x} \frac {\sin t ^ {2}}{t} \mathrm {d} t\right) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \mathrm {d} x \int_ {1} ^ {x} \frac {\sin t ^ {2}}{t} \mathrm {d} t.$写出该积分对应的二重积分的积分区域 D. 由二次积分的表达式可知，边界曲线为 t=x， t=1以及 x=0，故$D = \left\{(x, t) \mid x \leqslant t \leqslant 1, 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1 \right\}.$如图所示，交换积分次序可得$D = \left\{(x, t) \mid 0 \leqslant x \leqslant t, 0 \leqslant t \leqslant 1 \right\}.$因此，$\begin{aligned} \mathrm {原 积 分} &= - \iint_ {D} \frac {x \sin t ^ {2}}{t} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} t = - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\sin t ^ {2}}{t} \mathrm {d} t \int_ {0} ^ {t} x \mathrm {d} x = - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\sin t ^ {2}}{t} \cdot \frac {t ^ {2}}{2} \mathrm {d} t \\ &= - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} t \sin t ^ {2} \mathrm {d} t = - \frac {1}{4} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sin t ^ {2} \mathrm {d} \left(t ^ {2}\right) = \frac {1}{4} \cos t ^ {2} \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {1}{4} (\cos 1 - 1). \end{aligned}$

analysisRich: 当$\sqrt{5} < x < 3$时，$x^{2}-9<0$；当 3 < x < 5时，$x^{2}-9>0.$$\begin{aligned} \int_ {\sqrt {5}} ^ {5} \frac {x}{\sqrt {| x ^ {2} - 9 |}} \mathrm {d} x &= \int_ {\sqrt {5}} ^ {3} \frac {x}{\sqrt {9 - x ^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} x + \int_ {3} ^ {5} \frac {x}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} - 9}} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {\sqrt {5}} ^ {3} \frac {\mathrm {d} \left(9 - x ^ {2}\right)}{\sqrt {9 - x ^ {2}}} + \frac {1}{2} \int_ {3} ^ {5} \frac {\mathrm {d} \left(x ^ {2} - 9\right)}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} - 9}} \\ &= \left(- \frac {1}{2}\right) \times 2 \times \sqrt {9 - x ^ {2}} \left| _ {\sqrt {5}} ^ {3} + \frac {1}{2} \times 2 \times \sqrt {x ^ {2} - 9} \right| _ {3} ^ {5} \\ &= - (0 - 2) + (4 - 0) = 6. \end{aligned}$

questionText: $1 2. \int_ {1} ^ {\mathrm {e} ^ {2}} \frac {\ln x}{\sqrt {x}} \mathrm {d} x = \underline {{}}$
analysisRich:
解（法一）利用根式代换.

令$t = \sqrt{x}$，则$x = t^{2}$，$\mathrm{d}x = 2t\mathrm{d}t.$$\begin{aligned} \int_ {1} ^ {e ^ {2}} \frac {\ln x}{\sqrt {x}} \mathrm {d} x \xlongequal {t = \sqrt {x}} \int_ {1} ^ {e} \frac {2 \ln t}{t} \cdot 2 t \mathrm {d} t &= 4 \int_ {1} ^ {e} \ln t \mathrm {d} t = 4 \left(t \ln t \Big | _ {1} ^ {e} - \int_ {1} ^ {e} t \cdot \frac {1}{t} \mathrm {d} t\right) \\ &= 4 \left[ \mathrm {e} - (\mathrm {e} - 1) \right] = 4. \end{aligned}$（法二）利用分部积分法.$\begin{aligned} \int_ {1} ^ {\mathrm {e} ^ {2}} \frac {\ln x}{\sqrt {x}} \mathrm {d} x &= 2 \int_ {1} ^ {\mathrm {e} ^ {2}} \ln x \mathrm {d} (\sqrt {x}) = 2 \left(\sqrt {x} \ln x \Big | _ {1} ^ {\mathrm {e} ^ {2}} - \int_ {1} ^ {\mathrm {e} ^ {2}} \sqrt {x} \cdot \frac {1}{x} \mathrm {d} x\right) = 2 \left(2 \mathrm {e} - \int_ {1} ^ {\mathrm {e} ^ {2}} \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} \mathrm {d} x\right) \\ &= 4 \mathrm {e} - 4 \sqrt {x} \Big | _ {1} ^ {\mathrm {e} ^ {2}} = 4 \mathrm {e} - (4 \mathrm {e} - 4) = 4. \end{aligned}$

questionText: $\int_ {0} ^ {2} \frac {2 x - 4}{x ^ {2} + 2 x + 4} \mathrm {d} x = \underline {{}}$
analysisRich: 解注意到$( x^{2}+2 x+4)^{\prime}=2 x+2$，$\frac{2 x-4}{x^{2}+2 x+4}=\frac{2 x+2}{x^{2}+2 x+4}$$-\frac{6}{x^{2}+2 x+4}.$因此，$\begin{aligned} \int_ {0} ^ {2} \frac {2 x - 4}{x ^ {2} + 2 x + 4} d x &= \int_ {0} ^ {2} \frac {2 x + 2}{x ^ {2} + 2 x + 4} d x - 6 \int_ {0} ^ {2} \frac {1}{x ^ {2} + 2 x + 4} d x \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {2} \frac {\mathrm {d} \left(x ^ {2} + 2 x + 4\right)}{x ^ {2} + 2 x + 4} - 2 \int_ {0} ^ {2} \frac {1}{1 + \left[ \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} (x + 1) \right] ^ {2}} d x \\ &= \ln \left(x ^ {2} + 2 x + 4\right) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {2} - 2 \sqrt {3} \int_ {0} ^ {2} \frac {\mathrm {d} \left[ \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} (x + 1) \right]}{1 + \left[ \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} (x + 1) \right] ^ {2}} \\ &= \ln 3 - 2 \sqrt {3} \arctan \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} (x + 1) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {2} \\ &= \ln 3 - 2 \sqrt {3} \times \left(\frac {\pi}{3} - \frac {\pi}{6}\right) = \ln 3 - \frac {\sqrt {3}}{3} \pi . \end{aligned}$

questionText: $\int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {2 x + 3}{x ^ {2} - x + 1} \mathrm {d} x = \underline {{}}$
analysisRich: 解注意到$( x^{2}-x+1)^{\prime}=2 x-1$，$\frac{2 x+3}{x^{2}-x+1}=\frac{2 x-1}{x^{2}-x+1}+\frac{4}{x^{2}-x+1}.$因此，$\begin{aligned} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {2 x + 3}{x ^ {2} - x + 1} \mathrm {d} x &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {2 x - 1}{x ^ {2} - x + 1} \mathrm {d} x + 4 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{\left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {2} + \frac {3}{4}} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\mathrm {d} \left(x ^ {2} - x + 1\right)}{x ^ {2} - x + 1} + \frac {1 6}{3} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{1 + \left[ \frac {2}{\sqrt {3}} \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) \right] ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= \ln \left(x ^ {2} - x + 1\right) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} + \frac {8 \sqrt {3}}{3} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\mathrm {d} \left[ \frac {2}{\sqrt {3}} \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) \right]}{1 + \left[ \frac {2}{\sqrt {3}} \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) \right] ^ {2}} \\ &= \frac {8 \sqrt {3}}{3} \arctan \frac {2}{\sqrt {3}} \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {8 \sqrt {3}}{3} \times \frac {\pi}{3} = \frac {8 \sqrt {3} \pi}{9}. \end{aligned}$

questionText: 设连续函数 f(x)满足$f(x+2)-f(x)=x,\int_{0}^{2} f(x)\mathrm{d} x=0$，则$\int_{1}^{3} f(x)\mathrm{d} x=$___
analysisRich:
解注意到$\int_{2}^{3} f ( x ) \mathrm{d} x=\int_{0}^{1} f ( x+2 ) \mathrm{d} x$，故由$f ( x+2 )-f ( x )=x$可得，$\int_{2}^{3} f ( x ) \mathrm{d} x-\int_{0}^{1} f ( x ) \mathrm{d} x=\int_{0}^{1} f ( x+2 ) \mathrm{d} x-\int_{0}^{1} f ( x ) \mathrm{d} x=\int_{0}^{1} x \mathrm{d} x=\frac{1}{2}.$(1)

又因为$\int_{0}^{1} f ( x ) \mathrm{d} x+\int_{1}^{2} f ( x ) \mathrm{d} x=\int_{0}^{2} f ( x ) \mathrm{d} x=0$，所以$-\int_{0}^{1} f ( x ) \mathrm{d} x=\int_{1}^{2} f ( x ) \mathrm{d} x.$从而由（1）式可得$\int_{2}^{3} f ( x ) \mathrm{d} x+\int_{1}^{2} f ( x ) \mathrm{d} x=\frac{1}{2},$即$\int_{1}^{3} f ( x ) \mathrm{d} x=\frac{1}{2}.$

questionText: 计算$\int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{(x + 1) \left(x ^ {2} - 2 x + 2\right)} \mathrm {d} x.$
analysisRich: 解设$\frac {1}{(x + 1) \left(x ^ {2} - 2 x + 2\right)} = \frac {A}{x + 1} + \frac {B x + C}{x ^ {2} - 2 x + 2}.$通分并整理可得，$\frac {1}{(x + 1) \left(x ^ {2} - 2 x + 2\right)} = \frac {(A + B) x ^ {2} + (B + C - 2 A) x + 2 A + C}{(x + 1) \left(x ^ {2} - 2 x + 2\right)}.$比较$x^{2}, x$的系数以及常数项可得，$A + B = 0,$$\left\{B + C - 2 A = 0, \right.$$2 A + C = 1.$由（1）式可得 B=-A.将 B=-A 代入（2）式可得 C=3A.将 C=3A 代入（3）式可得 5A=1，即$A=\frac{1}{5}.$进一步可得 B=-$\frac{1}{5},$C$=\frac{3}{5}.$由此可得，$\frac {1}{(x + 1) \left(x ^ {2} - 2 x + 2\right)} = \frac {1}{5} \left(\frac {1}{x + 1} - \frac {x - 3}{x ^ {2} - 2 x + 2}\right).$下面分别计算$\int_{0}^{1}\frac{1}{x+1}\mathrm{d}x$与$\int_{0}^{1}\frac{x-3}{x^{2}-2x+2}\mathrm{d}x.$$\int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{x + 1} \mathrm {d} x = \ln (x + 1) \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} = \ln 2.$$\begin{aligned} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {x - 3}{x ^ {2} - 2 x + 2} \mathrm {d} x &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {x - 1}{x ^ {2} - 2 x + 2} \mathrm {d} x - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {2}{x ^ {2} - 2 x + 2} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\mathrm {d} \left(x ^ {2} - 2 x + 2\right)}{x ^ {2} - 2 x + 2} - 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{1 + (x - 1) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= \frac {1}{2} \ln \left(x ^ {2} - 2 x + 2\right) \left| _ {0} ^ {1} - 2 \arctan (x - 1) \right| _ {0} ^ {1} \\ &= - \frac {1}{2} \ln 2 - 2 [ 0 - \arctan (- 1) ] = - \frac {1}{2} \ln 2 - \frac {\pi}{2}. \end{aligned}$因此，$\int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{(x + 1) \left(x ^ {2} - 2 x + 2\right)} \mathrm {d} x = \frac {1}{5} \left[ \ln 2 - \left(- \frac {1}{2} \ln 2 - \frac {\pi}{2}\right) \right] = \frac {3 \ln 2 + \pi}{1 0}.$

questionText: 求极限$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {(1 - \cos x) [ x - \ln (1 + \tan x) ]}{\sin^ {4} x}.$
analysisRich:
解 （法一）使用等价无穷小替换结合洛必达法则求极限.

当$x\to0$时，$1-\cos x\sim \frac{1}{2} x^{2},\sin^{4}x\sim x^{4},\tan x\sim x.$因此，$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {(1 - \cos x) [ x - \ln (1 + \tan x) ]}{\sin^ {4} x} &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\frac {1}{2} x ^ {2} [ x - \ln (1 + \tan x) ]}{x ^ {4}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \ln (1 + \tan x)}{2 x ^ {2}} \\ \underline {{\text {洛必达}}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - \frac {\sec^ {2} x}{1 + \tan x}}{4 x} &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 + \tan x - \sec^ {2} x}{4 x} \\ &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {(1 - \tan x) \tan x}{4 x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\tan x}{4 x} \underline {{\frac {\tan x \sim x}{4}}} \frac {1}{4}. \end{aligned}$（法二）同法一的步骤化简原极限式，之后利用泰勒公式来求$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x-\ln(1+\tan x)}{2x^{2}}.$利用$\ln(1+x)=x-\frac{1}{2}x^{2}+o\left(x^{2}\right)$得$\ln (1 + \tan x) = \tan x - \frac {\left(\tan x\right) ^ {2}}{2} + o \left(\tan^ {2} x\right) = \tan x - \frac {\left(\tan x\right) ^ {2}}{2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right).$因此，$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \ln (1 + \tan x)}{2 x ^ {2}} &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \tan x + \frac {\left(\tan x\right) ^ {2}}{2} - o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{2 x ^ {2}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\frac {\left(\tan x\right) ^ {2}}{2}}{2 x ^ {2}} + \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \tan x}{2 x ^ {2}} \\ \underline {{\text {洛必达}}} \frac {1}{4} + \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - \sec^ {2} x}{4 x} &= \frac {1}{4} - \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\tan^ {2} x}{4 x} \\ \underline {{\frac {\tan x - x}{4}}} \frac {1}{4} - \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x}{4} &= \frac {1}{4}. \end{aligned}$因此，原极限$= \frac{1}{4}.$

questionText: 极限$\lim_{x\to \infty}\left[\frac{x^{2}}{(x-a)(x+b)}\right]^{x}=(\quad)$
analysisRich:
解（法一）若 a,b 不同时为0，则$( a-b) x+a b\neq0$由$\lim_{x\to\infty}\frac{(a-b)x+ab}{(x-a)(x+b)}=0$以及重要极限$\lim_{x\to\infty}\left(1+\frac{1}{x}\right)^{x}=e$的复合形式可知，$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} \left[ \frac {x ^ {2}}{(x - a) (x + b)} \right] ^ {x} &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} \left[ 1 + \frac {(a - b) x + a b}{(x - a) (x + b)} \right] ^ {x} \\ &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} \left[ \left[ 1 + \frac {(a - b) x + a b}{(x - a) (x + b)} \right] ^ {\frac {(x - a) (x + b)}{(a - b) x + a b}} \right] ^ {\left[ \frac {(a - b) x + a b}{(x - a) (x + b)} \cdot x \right]} \\ &= \mathrm {e} ^ {\lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} \frac {(a - b) x ^ {2} + a b x}{x ^ {2} - (a - b) x - a b}} = \mathrm {e} ^ {\lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} \frac {(a - b) + \frac {a b}{x}}{- \frac {a - b}{x} - \frac {a b}{x ^ {2}}}} = \mathrm {e} ^ {a - b}. \end{aligned}$若$a = b = 0$，则原式$= \lim_{x\to \infty}1^{x} = 1 = \mathrm{e}^{a - b}$.

综上所述，应选C.

（法二）当$x\to \infty$时（无论是$+\infty$还是$-\infty$），$\frac{x^{2}}{(x-a)(x+b)}>0$，故可以对$\left[ \frac{x^{2}}{(x-a)(x+b)} \right]^{x}$取对数.又$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} \ln \left[ \frac {x ^ {2}}{(x - a) (x + b)} \right] ^ {x} &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} x \ln \frac {x ^ {2}}{(x - a) (x + b)} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} x \ln \left[ 1 + \frac {(a - b) x + a b}{(x - a) (x + b)} \right] \\ &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} \left[ x \cdot \frac {(a - b) x + a b}{(x - a) (x + b)} \right] = \lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} \frac {(a - b) x ^ {2} + a b x}{(x - a) (x + b)} = a - b, \end{aligned}$故原式$= \mathrm{e}^{a - b}.$应选C.

questionText: 求极限$\lim_{x\to +\infty}\left(x^{\frac{1}{x}} - 1\right)^{\frac{1}{\ln x}}.$
analysisRich: 解（法一）记$y = \left(x^{\frac{1}{x}} - 1\right)^{\frac{1}{\ln x}}$，则$\ln y = \frac {\ln \left(x ^ {\frac {1}{x}} - 1\right)}{\ln x}.$利用洛必达法则计算$\lim \ln y$得，$\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\ln \left(x ^ {\frac {1}{x}} - 1\right)}{\ln x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\ln \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {\ln x}{x}} - 1\right)}{\ln x} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {\ln x}{x}} \cdot \frac {1 - \ln x}{x ^ {2}}}{\frac {1}{x} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {\ln x}{x}} - 1\right)} \xlongequal {\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {\ln x}{x}} = 1} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\frac {1 - \ln x}{x}}{\frac {\ln x}{x}} \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {1 - \ln x}{\ln x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \left(\frac {1}{\ln x} - 1\right) = - 1. \\ \end{array}$因此，原极限$= \mathrm{e}^{-1}$或者也可以这样计算.$\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\ln \left(x ^ {\frac {1}{x}} - 1\right)}{\ln x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\ln \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {\ln x}{x}} - 1\right)}{\ln x} \stackrel {\text {洛必达}} {=} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {\ln x}{x}} \cdot \frac {1 - \ln x}{x ^ {2}}}{\frac {1}{x} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {\ln x}{x}} - 1\right)}}{\frac {\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {\ln x}{x}} = 1}{\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {1 - \ln x}{x}}} \\ \underline {{\mathrm {洛必达}}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\frac {- 2 + \ln x}{x ^ {2}}}{\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {\ln x}{x}} \cdot \frac {1 - \ln x}{x ^ {2}}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {- 2 + \ln x}{1 - \ln x} = - 1. \\ \end{array}$（法二）注意到$\lim_{u\to 0^{+}}\frac{\ln(\mathrm{e}^{u}-1)}{\ln u}\xlongequal{\text{洛必达}}\lim_{u\to 0^{+}}\frac{u\mathrm{e}^{u}}{\mathrm{e}^{u}-1}\xlongequal{\text{e}^{u}-1\sim u}\lim_{u\to 0^{+}}\frac{u\mathrm{e}^{u}}{u}=1$，故$\frac {\ln \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {\ln x}{x}} - 1\right)}{\ln \frac {\ln x}{x}} \cdot \ln \frac {\ln x}{x}$$\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\ln \left(x ^ {\frac {1}{x}} - 1\right)}{\ln x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\ln \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {\ln x}{x}} - 1\right)}{\ln x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\ln \frac {\ln x}{x} ^ {x}}{\ln x} \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\ln \frac {\ln x}{x}}{\ln x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\ln \ln x - \ln x}{\ln x} \\ \underline {{\underline {{\text {洛必达}}}}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \left(\frac {1}{\ln x} - 1\right) = - 1. \\ \end{array}$因此，原极限$= \mathrm{e}^{-1}$

questionText: 求极限 $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to0}\left[\frac{\ln(1+x)}x\right]^{\frac1{e^x-1}}$。
analysisRich:
解（法一）由于当$x\to 0$时，$\frac{\ln(1+x)}{x}>0$，故可以对函数$\left[\frac{\ln(1+x)}{x}\right]^{\frac{1}{e^{x}-1}}$取对数.又$\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1}{\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1} \ln \frac {\ln (1 + x)}{x} \xlongequal {\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1 \sim x} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\ln \left[ 1 + \frac {\ln (1 + x) - x}{x} \right]}{x} \\ \xlongequal {\ln (1 + t) - t} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\ln (1 + x) - x}{x ^ {2}} \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \frac {1}{2} x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right) - x}{x ^ {2}} = - \frac {1}{2}, \\ \end{array}$故$\lim_{x\to 0}\left[\frac{\ln(1 + x)}{x}\right]^{\frac{1}{e^x - 1}} = \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{1}{2}}.$(法二)$\lim_{x\to 0}\left[\frac{\ln(1 + x)}{x}\right]^{\frac{1}{e^x - 1}} = \lim_{x\to 0}\left[1 + \frac{\ln(1 + x) - x}{x}\right]^{\frac{x}{\ln(1 + x) - x} \cdot \frac{\ln(1 + x) - x}{x} \cdot \frac{1}{e^x - 1}}.$由于$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left[ \frac {\ln (1 + x) - x}{x} \cdot \frac {1}{\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1} \right] = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\ln (1 + x) - x}{x ^ {2}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\frac {1}{1 + x} - 1}{2 x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {- 1}{2 (1 + x)} = - \frac {1}{2},$$= \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}$（法三）由于

注意该技巧！添加绝对值后不用分情况讨论.$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1}{\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1} \ln \frac {\ln (1 + x)}{x} &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\ln \left| \frac {\ln (1 + x)}{x} \right|}{\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\ln | \ln (1 + x) | - \ln | x |}{x} \\ \underline {{\text {洛必达}}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left[ \frac {\frac {1}{1 + x}}{\ln (1 + x)} - \frac {1}{x} \right] &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - (1 + x) \ln (1 + x)}{x (1 + x) \ln (1 + x)} \\ \underline {{\frac {\ln (1 + x) - x}{\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} (1 + x) = 1}}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - (1 + x) \ln (1 + x)}{x ^ {2}} \\ \underline {{\text {洛必达}}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {- \ln (1 + x)}{2 x} &= - \frac {1}{2}, \end{aligned}$故$\lim_{x\to 0}\left[\frac{\ln(1 + x)}{x}\right]^{\frac{1}{e^x - 1}} = \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{1}{2}}.$

questionText: 已知函数 F(x)$= \frac{\int_{0}^{x}\ln(1+t^{2})\mathrm{d}t}{x^{\alpha}}$. 设$\lim_{x\rightarrow+\infty}F(x)=\lim_{x\rightarrow 0^{+}}F(x)=0$，试求$\alpha$的取值范围.
analysisRich:
解记$f ( x )=\int_{0}^{x}\ln(1+t^{2})\mathrm{d} t$，则$F ( x )=\frac{f ( x )}{x^{\alpha}}.$可以看出，$\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}f(x) = 0,$$\lim_{x\to +\infty}f(x) = +\infty.$$\textcircled{1}$$x \to+\infty$时的情形.

当$\alpha \leqslant 0$时，$\lim_{x\to +\infty}\frac{f(x)}{x^{\alpha}} = +\infty$当$\alpha > 0$时，$\lim_{x\to +\infty}\frac{f(x)}{x^{\alpha}}$为$\frac{\infty}{\infty}$型未定式.$\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {f (x)}{x ^ {\alpha}} \xlongequal {\text {洛 必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\ln \left(1 + x ^ {2}\right)}{\alpha x ^ {\alpha - 1}}.$- 当$0 < \alpha \leqslant 1$时，$\lim_{x\to +\infty}\frac{\ln(1 + x^2)}{\alpha x^{\alpha -1}} = +\infty .$- 当$\alpha >1$时，$\lim_{x\rightarrow +\infty}\frac{\ln(1+x^{2})}{\alpha x^{\alpha-1}}$为$\frac{\infty}{\infty}$型未定式，继续使用洛必达法则得$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\ln \left(1 + x ^ {2}\right)}{\alpha x ^ {\alpha - 1}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\frac {2 x}{x ^ {2} + 1}}{\alpha (\alpha - 1) x ^ {\alpha - 2}} &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {2}{\alpha (\alpha - 1) \left(x ^ {2} + 1\right) x ^ {\alpha - 3}} \\ &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {2}{\alpha (\alpha - 1) x ^ {\alpha - 1} \left(1 + \frac {1}{x ^ {2}}\right)} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {2}{\alpha (\alpha - 1) x ^ {\alpha - 1}} = 0. \end{aligned}$因此，当$\alpha > 1$时，$\lim_{x\to +\infty}\frac{f(x)}{x^{\alpha}} = 0.$$\textcircled{2}$$x\to 0^{+}$时的情形.

当$\alpha \leqslant 0$时，$\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{f(x)}{x^{\alpha}} = 0.$当$\alpha > 0$时，$\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{f(x)}{x^{\alpha}}$为$\frac{0}{0}$型未定式.$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {f (x)}{x ^ {\alpha}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\ln \left(1 + x ^ {2}\right)}{\alpha x ^ {\alpha - 1}} \xlongequal {\text {~} \ln \left(1 + x ^ {2}\right) \sim x ^ {2}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {x ^ {2}}{\alpha x ^ {\alpha - 1}} = \frac {1}{\alpha} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} x ^ {3 - \alpha}.$因此，当$\alpha > 3$时，$\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{f(x)}{x^{\alpha}}=+\infty$；当$\alpha =3$时，$\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{f(x)}{x^{3}}=\frac{1}{3}$；当$\alpha < 3$时，$\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{f(x)}{x^{\alpha}}=0.$综上所述，$1 < \alpha < 3.$

questionText: 求极限$\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\int_ {1} ^ {x} \left[ t ^ {2} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{t}} - 1\right)-t \right] \mathrm {d} t}{x ^ {2} \ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{x}\right)}.$
analysisRich:
解 由于$\mathrm{e}^{x}$在 x=0处的带拉格朗日余项的2阶泰勒公式为$\mathrm{e}^{x}=1+x+\frac{x^{2}}{2}+\frac{\mathrm{e}^{\theta x}}{3!} x^{3}$其中$0 < \theta < 1$，故当 x > 0时，$\mathrm{e}^{x}>1+x+\frac{x^{2}}{2}.$于是，$\mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{t}}-1 > \frac{1}{t}+\frac{1}{2t^{2}}(t > 0),$$t ^ {2} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{t}} - 1\right) - t > t ^ {2} \left(\frac {1}{t} + \frac {1}{2 t ^ {2}}\right) - t = \frac {1}{2}.$从而$\int_{1}^{+\infty}\left[ t^{2}\left(\mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{t}} - 1\right) - t\right]\mathrm{d}t\to +\infty .$另一方面，$\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \left[ x ^ {2} \ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{x}\right)\right] \xlongequal {\ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{x}\right) \sim \frac {1}{x}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} x = + \infty .$因此，原极限为$\frac{\infty}{\infty}$型未定式.

当$x\to +\infty$时，$\ln \left(1 + \frac{1}{x}\right)\sim \frac{1}{x}$，故$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\int_ {1} ^ {x} \left[ t ^ {2} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{t}} - 1\right) - t \right] \mathrm {d} t}{x ^ {2} \ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{x}\right)} \xlongequal {\ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{x}\right) \sim \frac {1}{x}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\int_ {1} ^ {x} \left[ t ^ {2} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{t}} - 1\right) - t \right] \mathrm {d} t}{x} \\ \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {x ^ {2} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{x}} - 1\right) - x}{1} &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{x}} - 1 - \frac {1}{x}}{\frac {1}{x ^ {2}}} \\ \xlongequal {u = \frac {1}{x}} \lim _ {u \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {u} - u - 1}{u ^ {2}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {u \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {u} - 1}{2 u} \\ \xlongequal {\mathrm {e} ^ {u} - 1 \sim u} \lim _ {u \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {u}{2 u} &= \frac {1}{2}. \end{aligned}$因此，原极限$= \frac{1}{2}.$将原极限化简为$\lim_{x\to +\infty}[x^{2}(\mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{x}} -1) - x]$后，也可以用泰勒公式来求该极限.

当$x\to +\infty$时，$\frac{1}{x}\rightarrow 0^{+}$.由$\mathrm{e}^{u}$在$u = 0$处的泰勒公式得，$\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{x}} = 1 + \frac {1}{x} + \frac {1}{2 !} \cdot \frac {1}{x ^ {2}} + o \left(\frac {1}{x ^ {2}}\right).$从而，$\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \left[ x ^ {2} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{x}} - 1\right) - x \right] = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \left\{x ^ {2} \left[ \frac {1}{x} + \frac {1}{2 !} \cdot \frac {1}{x ^ {2}} + o \left(\frac {1}{x ^ {2}}\right)\right] - x \right\} \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \left[ \frac {1}{2} + x ^ {2} \cdot o \left(\frac {1}{x ^ {2}}\right)\right] = \frac {1}{2}. \\ \end{array}$

questionText: 设函数 f(x) = arctanx. 若 f(x) = xf'($\xi$)，则$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\xi^{2}}{x^{2}}$= (    )
analysisRich:
解 由于$f^{\prime}(x)=(\arctan x)^{\prime}=\frac{1}{1+x^{2}}$，故$f^{\prime}(\xi)=\frac{1}{1+\xi^{2}}$. 由于$f(x)=xf^{\prime}(\xi)=\frac{x}{1+\xi^{2}}$，解得$\xi^{2}=\frac{x}{f(x)}-1.$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\xi^ {2}}{x ^ {2}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\frac {x}{\arctan x} - 1}{x ^ {2}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \arctan x}{x ^ {2} \arctan x}.$下面我们用两种方法计算上面的极限.

（法一）由于$\arctan x$的3阶泰勒公式为$\arctan x = x - \frac{x^3}{3} + o(x^3)$，故当$x\to 0$时，$\arctan x \sim x, \quad x - \arctan x \sim \frac {x ^ {3}}{3}.$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \arctan x}{x ^ {2} \arctan x} \xlongequal {\arctan x \sim x} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \arctan x}{x ^ {3}} \xlongequal {x - \arctan x \sim \frac {x ^ {3}}{3}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\frac {1}{3} x ^ {3}}{x ^ {3}} = \frac {1}{3}.$应选 D.

（法二）利用洛必达法则计算该极限.$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \arctan x}{x ^ {2} \arctan x} \xlongequal {\arctan x \sim x} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \arctan x}{x ^ {3}} \xlongequal {\text {洛 必 达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - \frac {1}{1 + x ^ {2}}}{3 x ^ {2}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x ^ {2}}{3 x ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{3}.$

questionText: $\lim _ {r \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\int_ {1} ^ {x} \left[ t ^ {2} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{t}} - 1\right) - t \right] \mathrm {d} t}{x ^ {2} \ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{x}\right)}.$
analysisRich:
解 由于$\mathrm{e}^{x}$在 x=0处的带拉格朗日余项的2阶泰勒公式为$\mathrm{e}^{x}=1+x+\frac{x^{2}}{2}+\frac{\mathrm{e}^{\theta x}}{3!} x^{3}$其中$0 < \theta < 1$，故当 x > 0时，$\mathrm{e}^{x}>1+x+\frac{x^{2}}{2}.$于是，$\mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{t}}-1 > \frac{1}{t} +\frac{1}{2t^{2}}(t > 0),$$t ^ {2} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{t}} - 1\right) - t > t ^ {2} \left(\frac {1}{t} + \frac {1}{2 t ^ {2}}\right) - t = \frac {1}{2}.$从而$\int_1^{+\infty}\left[ t^2\left(\mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{t}} -1\right) - t\right]\mathrm{d}t\to +\infty .$另一方面，$\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \left[ x ^ {2} \ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{x}\right)\right] \xlongequal {\ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{x}\right) \sim \frac {1}{x}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} x = + \infty .$因此，原极限为$\frac{\infty}{\infty}$型未定式.

当$x\to +\infty$时，$\ln \left(1 + \frac{1}{x}\right)\sim \frac{1}{x}$，故$\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\int_ {1} ^ {x} \left[ t ^ {2} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{t}} - 1\right) - t \right] \mathrm {d} t}{x ^ {2} \ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{x}\right)} \xlongequal {\ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{x}\right) \sim \frac {1}{x}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\int_ {1} ^ {x} \left[ t ^ {2} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{t}} - 1\right) - t \right] \mathrm {d} t}{x}$$\begin{aligned} \underline {{\text {洛必达}}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {x ^ {2} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{x}} - 1\right) - x}{1} &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{x}} - 1 - \frac {1}{x}}{\frac {1}{x ^ {2}}} \\ \underline {{\frac {u = \frac {1}{x}}}} \lim _ {u \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {u} - u - 1}{u ^ {2}} \underline {{\underline {{\text {洛必达}}}}} \lim _ {u \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {u} - 1}{2 u} \\ \underline {{\frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {u} - 1 \sim u}{u \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}}}} \lim _ {u \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {u}{2 u} &= \frac {1}{2}. \end{aligned}$因此，原极限$= \frac{1}{2}.$将原极限化简为$\lim_{x\to +\infty}[x^{2}(\mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{x}} - 1) - x]$后，也可以用泰勒公式来求该极限.

当$x\to +\infty$时，$\frac{1}{x}\rightarrow 0^{+}$.由$\mathrm{e}^{u}$在$u = 0$处的泰勒公式得，$\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{x}} = 1 + \frac {1}{x} + \frac {1}{2 !} \cdot \frac {1}{x ^ {2}} + o \left(\frac {1}{x ^ {2}}\right).$从而，$\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \left[ x ^ {2} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{x}} - 1\right) - x \right] = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \left\{x ^ {2} \left[ \frac {1}{x} + \frac {1}{2 !} \cdot \frac {1}{x ^ {2}} + o \left(\frac {1}{x ^ {2}}\right)\right] - x \right\} \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \left[ \frac {1}{2} + x ^ {2} \cdot o \left(\frac {1}{x ^ {2}}\right)\right] = \frac {1}{2}. \\ \end{array}$

analysisRich: 解（法一）将原极限改写，得$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left[ 2 - \frac {\ln (1 + x)}{x} \right] ^ {\frac {1}{x}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left\{\left[ 1 + \frac {x - \ln (1 + x)}{x} \right] ^ {\frac {x}{x - \ln (1 + x)}} \right\} ^ {\frac {x - \ln (1 + x)}{x}}. \frac {1}{x}.$由于$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \ln (1 + x)}{x} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - \frac {1}{1 + x}}{1} = 0,$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \ln (1 + x)}{x ^ {2}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - \frac {1}{1 + x}}{2 x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1}{2 (1 + x)} = \frac {1}{2},$故利用重要极限$\lim_{x\to 0}(1 + x)^{\frac{1}{x}} = \mathrm{e}$可得原极限$= \sqrt{\mathrm{e}}.$（法二）由于$\ln \left[ 2 - \frac{\ln(1 + x)}{x} \right]^{\frac{1}{x}} = \frac{1}{x}\ln \left[ 2 - \frac{\ln(1 + x)}{x} \right],$故$\lim_{x\to 0}\left[ 2 - \frac{\ln(1 + x)}{x} \right]^{\frac{1}{x}} = \mathrm{e}^{\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\ln[2 - \frac{\ln(1 + x)}{x}]}{x}}.$下面求$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\ln\left[2 - \frac{\ln(1 + x)}{x}\right]}{x}$.$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\ln \left[ 2 - \frac {\ln (1 + x)}{x} \right]}{x} &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\ln \left[ 1 + 1 - \frac {\ln (1 + x)}{x} \right]}{x} \\ \underline {{\underline {{\ln \left[ 1 + 1 - \frac {\ln (1 + x)}{x} \right] \sim 1 - \frac {\ln (1 + x)}{x}}}}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - \frac {\ln (1 + x)}{x}}{x} \\ &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \ln (1 + x)}{x ^ {2}} \xlongequal {\text {洛 必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - \frac {1}{1 + x}}{2 x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1}{2 (1 + x)} = \frac {1}{2}. \end{aligned}$因此，原极限$= \sqrt{\mathrm{e}}.$也可以利用$\ln (1 + x) = x - \frac{x^2}{2} + o\left(x^2\right)$来求$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x - \ln(1 + x)}{x^2}$.$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \ln (1 + x)}{x ^ {2}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - x + \frac {x ^ {2}}{2} - o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{x ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{2}.$

questionText: 已知函数 f(x)满足$\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{\sqrt{1+f(x)\sin 2x}-1}{\mathrm{e}^{3x}-1}=2$，则$\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}f(x)=$___.
analysisRich: 解（法一）由极限的四则运算法则知，$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} (\sqrt {1 + f (x) \sin 2 x} - 1) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\sqrt {1 + f (x) \sin 2 x} - 1}{\mathrm {e} ^ {3 x} - 1} \cdot \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {3 x} - 1\right)=2 \times 0=0.$从而$\lim_{x\to 0}\sqrt{1+f(x)\sin 2x}=1$，故$\lim_{x\to 0}f(x)\sin 2x=\lim_{x\to 0}[\left(\sqrt{1+f(x)\sin 2x}\right)^{2}-1]=0.$，当 x→0时，$\sqrt{1+f(x)\sin 2x}-1\sim \frac{1}{2} f(x)\sin 2x.$因此，$\begin{array}{l} 2 = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\sqrt {1 + f (x) \sin 2 x} - 1}{\mathrm {e} ^ {3 x} - 1} \xlongequal {\mathrm {e} ^ {3 x} - 1 \sim 3 x} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\frac {1}{2} f (x) \sin 2 x}{3 x} \\ = \frac {1}{3} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x) \sin 2 x}{2 x} \xlongequal {\sin x \sim x} \frac {1}{3} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} f (x), \\ \end{array}$即$\lim_{x\to 0}f(x) = 6.$（法二）同法一可得$\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}f(x)\sin 2x=0$.于是$\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\sqrt{1+f(x)\sin 2x}+1=2.$从而$\begin{array}{l} 2 = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\sqrt {1 + f (x) \sin 2 x} - 1}{\mathrm {e} ^ {3 x} - 1} \xlongequal {\text {分 子 有 理 化}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x) \sin 2 x}{\left[ \sqrt {1 + f (x) \sin 2 x} + 1 \right]\left(\mathrm {e} ^ {3 x} - 1\right)} \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x) \sin 2 x}{2 \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {3 x} - 1\right)} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x) \cdot 2 x}{2 \cdot 3 x} = \frac {1}{3} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} f (x), \\ \end{array}$即$\lim_{x\to 0}f(x) = 6.$

questionText: 求极限$\lim_{x\to 0}(\cos 2x+2x\sin x)^{\frac{1}{x^{4}}}.$
analysisRich:
记原极限为 I.

（法一）凑重要极限$\lim_{x\to 0}(1+x)^{\frac{1}{x}}=e.$由于$x\to0$时，$\cos 2x+2x\sin x-1\to0$，故$\lim_{x\to0}\left(1+\cos 2x+2x\sin x-1\right)^{\frac{1}{\cos 2x+2x\sin x-1}}=e.$$I = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left(1 + \cos 2 x + 2 x \sin x - 1\right) ^ {\frac {1}{\cos 2 x + 2 x \sin x - 1}} \cdot \frac {\cos 2 x + 2 x \sin x - 1}{x ^ {4}}.$下面求$\lim_{x\rightarrow0}\frac{\cos 2x+2x\sin x-1}{x^{4}}.$$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\cos 2 x + 2 x \sin x - 1}{x ^ {4}} \xlongequal {\cos 2 x - 1 = - 2 \sin^ {2} x} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {2 x \sin x - 2 \sin^ {2} x}{x ^ {4}} &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {2 \sin x (x - \sin x)}{x ^ {4}} \\ \frac {\sin x - x}{x} 2 \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \sin x}{x ^ {3}} &= 2 \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - x + \frac {x ^ {3}}{3 !} - o \left(x ^ {3}\right)}{x ^ {3}} = \frac {1}{3}. \end{aligned}$因此，$I=\mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{3}}.$下面我们用另外两种方法计算$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\cos 2x+2x\sin x-1}{x^{4}}.$(1) 利用泰勒公式.$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\cos 2 x + 2 x \sin x - 1}{x ^ {4}} &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - \frac {(2 x) ^ {2}}{2 !} + \frac {(2 x) ^ {4}}{4 !} + o \left(x ^ {4}\right) + 2 x \left[x - \frac {x ^ {3}}{3 !} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right)\right]}{x ^ {4}} - 1 \\ &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\frac {1}{3} x ^ {4} + o \left(x ^ {4}\right)}{x ^ {4}} = \frac {1}{3}. \end{aligned}$(2) 利用洛必达法则.$\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\cos 2 x + 2 x \sin x - 1}{x ^ {4}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {- \sin 2 x + \sin x + x \cos x}{2 x ^ {3}} \\ \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {- 2 \cos 2 x + 2 \cos x - x \sin x}{6 x ^ {2}} \\ \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {4 \sin 2 x - 3 \sin x - x \cos x}{1 2 x} \\ \end{array}$$\frac {\mathrm {洛 必 达}}{\mathrm {}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {8 \cos 2 x - 4 \cos x + x \sin x}{1 2} = \frac {1}{3}.$（法二）因为$\lim_{x\to 0} \left(\cos 2x+2x\sin x\right)=1$，从而我们可以对$\cos 2x+2x\sin x$取对数，所以$I=\mathrm{e}^{\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\ln(\cos 2x+2x\sin x)}{x^{4}}}.$下面求$\lim_{x\rightarrow0}\frac{\ln(\cos 2x+2x\sin x)}{x^{4}}.$$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\ln (\cos 2 x + 2 x \sin x)}{x ^ {4}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\frac {1}{\cos 2 x + 2 x \sin x} \cdot (- 2 \sin 2 x + 2 \sin x + 2 x \cos x)}{4 x ^ {3}} \\ &= - \frac {1}{2} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\sin 2 x - \sin x - x \cos x}{x ^ {3}} \\ &= - \frac {1}{2} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {2 x - \frac {(2 x) ^ {3}}{3 !} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right) - x + \frac {x ^ {3}}{3 !} - o \left(x ^ {3}\right) - x \left[ 1 - \frac {1}{2} x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right)\right]}{x ^ {3}} \\ &= - \frac {1}{2} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\left(- \frac {8}{6} + \frac {1}{6} + \frac {1}{2}\right) x ^ {3} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right)}{x ^ {3}} = \frac {1}{3}. \end{aligned}$因此，$I=\mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{3}}.$
