questionText: 求 $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to0^+}\frac{\int_0^x\sqrt{x-t}\,e^t\,dt}{\sqrt{x^3}}$。
analysisRich: 解（法一）令$u=x-t$，则$t=x-u,\mathrm{d}u=-\mathrm{d}t,$$\int_ {0} ^ {x} \sqrt {x - t} \mathrm {e} ^ {t} \mathrm {d} t = - \int_ {x} ^ {0} \sqrt {u} \mathrm {e} ^ {x - u} \mathrm {d} u = \mathrm {e} ^ {x} \int_ {0} ^ {x} \sqrt {u} \mathrm {e} ^ {- u} \mathrm {d} u.$于是，$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \int_ {0} ^ {x} \sqrt {u} \mathrm {e} ^ {- u} \mathrm {d} u}{\sqrt {x ^ {3}}} \xlongequal {\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \mathrm {e} ^ {x} = 1} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x} \sqrt {u} \mathrm {e} ^ {- u} \mathrm {d} u}{\sqrt {x ^ {3}}} \xlongequal {\text {洛 必 达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\sqrt {x} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x}}{\frac {3}{2} \sqrt {x}} = \frac {2}{3}.$因此，原极限$= \frac{2}{3}.$（法二）由于$\mathrm{e}^{t}$和$\sqrt{x-t}$均为关于 t的连续函数，且$\sqrt{x-t}$在[0,x]上不变号，故由积分中值定理可得，存在$\xi_{x}\in[0,x]$，使得$\int_ {0} ^ {x} \sqrt {x - t} \mathrm {e} ^ {t} \mathrm {d} t = \mathrm {e} ^ {\xi_ {x}} \int_ {0} ^ {x} \sqrt {x - t} \mathrm {d} t.$因此，$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x} \sqrt {x - t} \mathrm {e} ^ {t} \mathrm {d} t}{\sqrt {x ^ {3}}} &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {\xi_ {x}} \int_ {0} ^ {x} \sqrt {x - t} \mathrm {d} t}{\sqrt {x ^ {3}}} = \lim _ {\substack {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+} \\ 0 \leqslant \xi_ {x} \leqslant x}} \mathrm {e} ^ {\xi_ {x}} \cdot \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {- \frac {2}{3} (x - t) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \Big| _ {0} ^ {x}}{\sqrt {x ^ {3}}} \\ &= 1 \cdot \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\frac {2}{3} x ^ {\frac {3}{2}}}{\sqrt {x ^ {3}}} = \frac {2}{3}. \end{aligned}$

questionText: 设数列$\{x_{n}\}$收敛，则（    )
analysisRich:
解（法一）记$\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n = a$，则由$\sin x$是连续函数以及$\lim_{n\to \infty}(x_n + \sin x_n) = 0$可知，$\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \left(x _ {n} + \sin x _ {n}\right) = a + \sin a = 0.$x=a是函数$f ( x )=x+\sin x$的零点.

注意到$f(0)=0$，又因为$f^{\prime}(x)=1+\cos x\geqslant 0$，所以 f(x)单调增加.于是 x=0是 f(x)的唯一零点，a=0.因此，$\lim_{n\to \infty}x_{n}=0.$应选D.

（法二）记$f ( x )=x+\sin x$，则$f ( 0 )=0$$f^{\prime}(x)=1+\cos x\geqslant0.$于是 f(x)是单调增加的可导函数，$f^{-1}$存在且连续.

由于$\lim_{n\to \infty} \left(x_{n}+\sin x_{n}\right)=0$，故$\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} x _ {n} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} f ^ {- 1} \left(f \left(x _ {n}\right)\right) = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} f ^ {- 1} \left(x _ {n} + \sin x _ {n}\right) = f ^ {- 1} \left(\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \left(x _ {n} + \sin x _ {n}\right)\right) = f ^ {- 1} (0) = 0.$（法三）排除法.

对选项A：考虑$x_{n}=\pi +\frac{1}{n}$，则$\lim_{n\to \infty}\sin x_{n}=0$，但$\lim_{n\to \infty}x_{n}=\pi.$对选项B和选项C：考虑$x_{n}\equiv-1$，则$\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \left(x _ {n} + \sqrt {\left| x _ {n} \right|}\right) = 0, \quad \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \left(x _ {n} + x _ {n} ^ {2}\right) = 0,$但$\lim_{n\to \infty}x_{n}=-1.$由排除法知，应选D.

questionText: $\lim x^{2}[\arctan(x+1)-\arctan x]=$
analysisRich:
解（法一）由拉格朗日中值定理可得，存在$\xi_{x}\in(x,x+1)$，使得$\arctan (x + 1) - \arctan x = \frac {1}{1 + \xi_ {x} ^ {2}}.$于是，原极限$= \lim_{x\to +\infty}\frac{x^{2}}{1 + \xi_{x}^{2}}.$由于当 x > 0时，$\frac{x^{2}}{1+(x+1)^{2}}\leqslant \frac{x^{2}}{1+\xi_{x}^{2}}\leqslant \frac{x^{2}}{1+x^{2}}$，而$\lim_{x\rightarrow +\infty}\frac{x^{2}}{1+(x+1)^{2}}=\lim_{x\rightarrow +\infty}\frac{x^{2}}{1+x^{2}}=1$，故由夹逼准则可知$\lim_{x\rightarrow +\infty}\frac{x^{2}}{1+\xi_{x}^{2}}=1.$因此，原极限 = 1.

（法二）利用洛必达法则.$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} x ^ {2} [ \arctan (x + 1) - \arctan x ] &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\arctan (x + 1) - \arctan x}{\frac {1}{x ^ {2}}} \\ \underline {{\mathrm {洛 必 达}}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\frac {1}{1 + (x + 1) ^ {2}} - \frac {1}{1 + x ^ {2}}}{- 2 \cdot \frac {1}{x ^ {3}}} \\ &= - \frac {1}{2} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\left[ x ^ {2} - (x + 1) ^ {2} \right] \cdot x ^ {3}}{\left[ 1 + (x + 1) ^ {2} \right]\left(1 + x ^ {2}\right)} \\ &= - \frac {1}{2} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {- 2 x ^ {4} - x ^ {3}}{x ^ {4} + 2 x ^ {3} + 3 x ^ {2} + 2 x + 2} = 1. \end{aligned}$

questionText: 设$\lim_{x\rightarrow a}\frac{f(x)-a}{x-a}=b$，则$\lim_{x\rightarrow a}\frac{\sin f(x)-\sin a}{x-a}=$(    )
analysisRich: 解 由$\lim_{x\to a}\frac{f(x)-a}{x-a}=b$可得，$\lim_{x\to a}[f(x)-a]=0$，即$\lim_{x\to a}f(x)=a.$对$[ f ( x ) , a ]$或$[ a,f ( x ) ]$上的$\sin z$应用拉格朗日中值定理可得，$\sin f (x) - \sin a = \cos \xi_ {x} [ f (x) - a ],$其中$\xi_{x}$介于$f(x)$与$a$之间. 由于$\lim_{x\to a}f(x) = a$，故$\lim_{x\to a}\xi_x = a.$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow a} \frac {\sin f (x) - \sin a}{x - a} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow a} \frac {\cos \xi_ {x} [ f (x) - a ]}{x - a} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow a} \cos \xi_ {x} \cdot \lim _ {x \rightarrow a} \frac {f (x) - a}{x - a} = b \cos a.$因此，应选B.

questionText: 求极限 lim$\left(\frac {1 + \int_ {0} ^ {x} \mathrm {e} ^ {t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t}{\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1} - \frac {1}{\sin x}\right)$
analysisRich: 解 （法一）先整理原极限再计算.$\begin{array}{l} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1 \sim x}{\sin x \sim x} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x} \mathrm {e} ^ {t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t}{x} + \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\sin x - \mathrm {e} ^ {x} + 1}{x ^ {2}} \\ \frac {\text {洛必达}}{} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2}}}{1} + \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \frac {x ^ {3}}{6} - 1 - x - \frac {x ^ {2}}{2} + 1 + o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{x ^ {2}} \\ = 1 + \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{x ^ {2}} = 1 - \frac {1}{2} = \frac {1}{2}. \\ \end{array}$因此，原极限$= \frac{1}{2}$（法二）将原极限通分整理，化为$\frac{0}{0}$型未定式后再应用洛必达法则.$\begin{aligned} \mathrm {原 极 限} &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\sin x \left(1 + \int_ {0} ^ {x} \mathrm {e} ^ {t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t\right) - \mathrm {e} ^ {x} + 1}{\left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1\right) \sin x} \\ \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1 \sim x}{\sin x \sim x} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\sin x \left(1 + \int_ {0} ^ {x} \mathrm {e} ^ {t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t\right) - \mathrm {e} ^ {x} + 1}{x ^ {2}} \\ \underline {{\text {洛必达}}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\cos x \left(1 + \int_ {0} ^ {x} \mathrm {e} ^ {t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t\right) + \sin x \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2}} - \mathrm {e} ^ {x}}{2 x} \\ \underline {{\text {洛必达}}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {- \sin x \left(1 + \int_ {0} ^ {x} \mathrm {e} ^ {t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t\right) + \cos x \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2}} + \cos x \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2}} + 2 x \cdot \sin x \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2}} - \mathrm {e} ^ {x}}{2} &= \frac {1}{2}. \\ \mathrm {因 此 , 原 极 限} &= \frac {1}{2}. \end{aligned}$

questionText: $1. \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left(\frac {1 + \mathrm {e} ^ {x}}{2}\right) ^ {\cot x} = \underline {{}}$
analysisRich: 取对数再求极限.$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left(\frac {1 + \mathrm {e} ^ {x}}{2}\right) ^ {\cot x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \mathrm {e} ^ {\cot x \ln \frac {1 + \mathrm {e} ^ {x}}{2}} = \mathrm {e} _ {x \rightarrow 0} ^ {\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \cot x \ln \frac {1 + \mathrm {e} ^ {x}}{2}}.$下面计算$\lim_{x\to 0}\cot x\ln \frac{1 + \mathrm{e}^{x}}{2}$.$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \cot x \ln \frac {1 + e ^ {x}}{2} &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\ln \frac {1 + e ^ {x}}{2}}{\tan x} \xlongequal {\tan x \sim x} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\ln \left(1 + \frac {e ^ {x} - 1}{2}\right)}{x} \\ \frac {\ln \left(1 + \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1}{2}\right) - \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1}{2}}{\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1}{2 x}} \xlongequal {\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1 \sim x} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x}{2 x} \\ &= \frac {1}{2}. \end{aligned}$因此，原极限$= \mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{2}} = \sqrt{\mathrm{e}}.$

questionText: $\lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} x ^ {2} \left(2 - x \sin \frac {1}{x} - \cos \frac {1}{x}\right) = \underline {{}}$
analysisRich: 考虑$\sin x, \cos x$在 x=0处的泰勒公式.当 x$\to\infty$时，$\frac{1}{x}\to0,$$\sin \frac {1}{x} = \frac {1}{x} - \frac {1}{6 x ^ {3}} + o \left(\frac {1}{x ^ {3}}\right),$$\cos \frac {1}{x} = 1 - \frac {1}{2 x ^ {2}} + o \left(\frac {1}{x ^ {2}}\right).$于是，$\begin{array}{l} x ^ {2} \left(2 - x \sin \frac {1}{x} - \cos \frac {1}{x}\right) = x ^ {2} \left[ 2 - 1 + \frac {1}{6 x ^ {2}} - 1 + \frac {1}{2 x ^ {2}} + o \left(\frac {1}{x ^ {2}}\right) \right] \\ = x ^ {2} \left[ \frac {2}{3 x ^ {2}} + o \left(\frac {1}{x ^ {2}}\right) \right] = \frac {2}{3} + o (1). \\ \end{array}$因此，$\lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} x ^ {2} \left(2 - x \sin \frac {1}{x} - \cos \frac {1}{x}\right) = \frac {2}{3}.$

questionText: 函数$f(x)=\frac{x-x^{3}}{\sin \pi x}$的可去间断点的个数为（    ）
analysisRich:
解 因为当 k为整数时，$\sin k\pi=0$，所以 f(x)在 x=k（k为整数）时无定义，在其余点连续.当$k-k^{3}\neq0$时，即 k≠0，$\pm1$时，$\lim _ {x \rightarrow k} \frac {x - x ^ {3}}{\sin \pi x} = \infty .$x=k为f(x）的无穷间断点.

当$k - k^{3} = 0$时，即$k = 0,\pm 1$时，$\lim_{x\to k}f(x)$为$\frac{0}{0}$型未定式，可用洛必达法则求极限.$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - x ^ {3}}{\sin \pi x} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - 3 x ^ {2}}{\pi \cos \pi x} &= \frac {1}{\pi}, \\ \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1} \frac {x - x ^ {3}}{\sin \pi x} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1} \frac {1 - 3 x ^ {2}}{\pi \cos \pi x} &= \frac {- 2}{- \pi} = \frac {2}{\pi}, \\ \lim _ {x \rightarrow - 1} \frac {x - x ^ {3}}{\sin \pi x} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow - 1} \frac {1 - 3 x ^ {2}}{\pi \cos \pi x} &= \frac {- 2}{- \pi} = \frac {2}{\pi}. \end{aligned}$因此，$f ( x )$共有3个可去间断点，$x=0$$\pm 1.$应选C.

questionText: 函数$f ( x )=\frac{x^{2}-x}{x^{2}-1}\sqrt{1+\frac{1}{x^{2}}}$的无穷间断点的个数为（    ）
analysisRich:
解 简化 f(x).$f (x) = \frac {x (x - 1)}{(x + 1) (x - 1)} \sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{x ^ {2}}} = \frac {x}{x + 1} \sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{x ^ {2}}}.$考虑$x\to 0$时的情况.因为$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left(\frac {x}{x + 1} \sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{x ^ {2}}}\right) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left(x \sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{x ^ {2}}}\right) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left(\frac {x}{| x |} \sqrt {x ^ {2} + 1}\right),$所以，$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {-}} f (x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {-}} \left[ \frac {x}{(- x)} \sqrt {x ^ {2} + 1} \right] = - 1, \quad \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} f (x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \left(\frac {x}{x} \sqrt {x ^ {2} + 1}\right) = 1.$因此，$x = 0$为$f(x)$的跳跃间断点.

考虑 x→1时的情况.$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 1} f (x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1} \left(\frac {x}{x + 1} \sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{x ^ {2}}}\right) = \frac {\sqrt {2}}{2}.$因此，$x = 1$为$f(x)$的可去间断点.

考虑 x -> -1时的情况.$\lim _ {x \rightarrow - 1} f (x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow - 1} \left(\frac {x}{x + 1} \sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{x ^ {2}}}\right) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow - 1} \frac {- \sqrt {2}}{x + 1} = \infty .$因此，$x = -1$为$f(x)$的无穷间断点.

综上所述，$f ( x )$的无穷间断点的个数为1.应选B.

questionText: 函数$f ( x )=\frac{| x |^{x}-1}{x ( x+1 ) \ln| x |}$的可去间断点的个数为（    ）
analysisRich: 解 由于 f(x)在 x=-1,0,1处没有定义且在其他点处连续，故 f(x)的间断点为 x=-1,0,1. 由于$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} | x | ^ {x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \mathrm {e} ^ {x \ln | x |} = \mathrm {e} ^ {\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} x \ln | x |} = \mathrm {e} ^ {\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\ln | x |}{x ^ {- 1}} \xlongequal {\text {洛 必达}}} \mathrm {e} ^ {\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} (- x)} = 1,$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 1} | x | ^ {x} = 1, \quad \lim _ {x \rightarrow - 1} | x | ^ {x} = 1,$故$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\left| x \right| ^ {x} - 1}{x (x + 1) \ln | x |} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\left| x \right| ^ {x} - 1}{(x + 1) \ln (1 + \left| x \right| ^ {x} - 1)} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\left| x \right| ^ {x} - 1}{(x + 1) \left(\left| x \right| ^ {x} - 1\right)} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1}{x + 1} = 1,$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 1} \frac {\left| x \right| ^ {x} - 1}{x (x + 1) \ln | x |} \stackrel {\text {同 上}} {=} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1} \frac {1}{x + 1} = \frac {1}{2},$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow - 1} \frac {\left| x \right| ^ {x} - 1}{x (x + 1) \ln | x |} \stackrel {\text {同 上}} {=} \lim _ {x \rightarrow - 1} \frac {1}{x + 1} = \infty .$因此，$f ( x )$的可去间断点为$x=0,1. f ( x )$共有2个可去间断点.应选C.

questionText: 函数$f ( x )=\lim_{t\rightarrow 0}\left( 1+\frac{\sin t}{x}\right)^{\frac{x^{2}}{t}}$在$(-\infty, +\infty)$内（    ）
analysisRich:
解 由$f ( x )$的表达式可以看出，$f ( x )$在$x=0$处无定义.

当$x\neq 0$时，$f(x) = \lim_{t\to 0}\left(1 + \frac{\sin t}{x}\right)^{\frac{x^2}{t}}.$下面我们用两种方法计算$\lim_{t\to 0}\left(1 + \frac{\sin t}{x}\right)^{\frac{x^2}{t}}.$（法一）凑重要极限.$\lim _ {t \rightarrow 0} \left(1 + \frac {\sin t}{x}\right) ^ {\frac {x ^ {2}}{t}} = \lim _ {t \rightarrow 0} \left[ \left(1 + \frac {\sin t}{x}\right) ^ {\frac {x}{\sin t}} \right] ^ {\frac {x \sin t}{t}} = \mathrm {e} ^ {\lim _ {t \rightarrow 0} \frac {x \sin t}{t}} \xlongequal {\sin t \sim t} \mathrm {e} ^ {x}.$（法二）取对数.$\lim_{t \to 0} \left(1 + \frac{\sin t}{x}\right)^{\frac{x^{2}}{t}} = \lim_{t \to 0} \left[\left(1 + \frac{\sin t}{x}\right)^{\frac{x}{\sin t}}\right]^{\frac{x \sin t}{t}} = \mathrm{e}^{\lim_{t \to 0} \frac{x \sin t}{t}} \xlongequal{\sin t \sim t} \mathrm{e}^{x}.$于是，当$x\neq 0$时，$f(x) = \mathrm{e}^{x},\lim_{x\to 0}f(x) = \mathrm{e}^{0} = 1.$因此，$x = 0$为$f(x)$的可去间断点.应选B.

questionText: 设函数 f(x) =$\left\{\begin{array}{l l} - 1, & x < 0, \\ 1, & x \geqslant 0, \end{array} \right.$g(x) =$\left\{\begin{array}{l l} 2 - a x, & x \leqslant - 1, \\ x, & - 1 < x < 0, \\ x - b, & x \geqslant 0. \end{array} \right.$若 f(x) + g(x)在R上连续，则（    )
analysisRich:
解 当$x\leqslant -1$时，$f(x)+g(x)=-1+(2-ax)=1-ax.$当$- 1 < x < 0$时，$f ( x )+g ( x )=-1+x.$当$x\geqslant0$时，$f(x)+g(x)=1+(x-b)=1-b+x.$于是，$f ( x ) + g ( x ) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} 1 - a x, & x \leqslant - 1, \\ - 1 + x, & - 1 < x < 0, \\ 1 - b + x, & x \geqslant 0. \end{array} \right.$由于$f ( x )+g ( x )$在R上连续，故$f ( x )+g ( x )$在$x=-1$和$x=0$处均连续.

因为$\lim_{x\rightarrow -1^{+}}[f(x)+g(x)]=\lim_{x\rightarrow -1^{+}}(-1+x)=-2$，而$\left.[f(x)+g(x)]\right|_{x=-1}=1+a$，所以 1+a=-2，即 a=-3.

又因为$\lim_{x\rightarrow 0^{-}}[f(x)+g(x)]=\lim_{x\rightarrow 0^{-}}(-1+x)=-1$，而$[f(x)+g(x)]\bigg|_{x=0}=1-b$，所以 1-b=-1，即 b=2.

因此，a=-3，b=2.应选D.

questionText: 函数$f(x)=\frac{\mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{x-1}}\ln|1+x|}{(\mathrm{e}^{x}-1)(x-2)}$的第二类间断点的个数为（    )
analysisRich: 解 从 f(x)的表达式可以看出，$x=-1,x=0,x=1,x=2$为 f(x)的间断点.下面分别计算这些点处的左、右极限.$\lim _ {x \rightarrow - 1} f (x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow - 1} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{x - 1}} \ln | 1 + x |}{\left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1\right) (x - 2)} = \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}}{\left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- 1} - 1\right) \cdot (- 3)} \lim _ {x \rightarrow - 1} \ln | 1 + x | = \infty .$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} f (x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{x - 1}} \ln | 1 + x |}{\left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1\right) (x - 2)} = \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- 1}}{- 2} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\ln | 1 + x |}{\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1} \frac {\frac {\ln | 1 + x | \sim x}{\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1 \sim x}}{- \frac {1}{2 \mathrm {e}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x}{x}} = - \frac {1}{2 \mathrm {e}}.$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} f (x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{x - 1}} \ln | 1 + x |}{\left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1\right) (x - 2)} = - \frac {\ln 2}{\mathrm {e} - 1} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{x - 1}} = \infty .$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 2} f (x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 2} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{x - 1}} \ln | 1 + x |}{\left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1\right) (x - 2)} = \frac {\mathrm {e} \ln 3}{\mathrm {e} ^ {2} - 1} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 2} \frac {1}{x - 2} = \infty .$因此，$x=-1,x=1$和 x=2均为 f(x)的无穷间断点，从而也是第二类间断点. f(x)共有3个第二类间断点.应选C.

questionText: 设函数$f ( x )=\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{1+x}{1+n x^{2 n}},$则 f(x)，（    ）

textOptions.B: 在 x=1处连续，在 x=-1处不连续
textOptions.D: 在 x=1处不连续，在 x=-1处连续

analysisRich: 解 由于$\lim_{n\to \infty}x^{2n}=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}0,&|x|<1,\\ 1,&|x|=1,\text{故当}|x|<1\text{时},\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{1+x}{1+nx^{2n}}=\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{1+x}{1}=1+x,\text{当} \\ +\infty,&|x|>1,\end{array} \right.$$|x| = 1$时，$\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{1 + x}{1 + nx^{2n}} = \lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{1 + x}{1 + n} = 0$，当$|x| > 1$时，$\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{1 + x}{1 + nx^{2n}} = 0.$于是，$f (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1 + x, & | x | < 1, \\ 0, & | x | \geqslant 1. \end{array} \right.$由于$\lim_{x\to -1^{+}}f(x) = \lim_{x\to -1^{+}}(1 + x) = 0,\lim_{x\to -1^{-}}f(x) = 0 = f(-1),\lim_{x\to -1^{-}}f(x) = \lim_{x\to -1^{+}}(1 + x) = 2,$$\lim_{x\to 1^{+}}f(x) = 0$，故$f(x)$在$x = -1$处连续，$x = 1$处不连续.因此，应选D.

questionText: 函数$f ( x )=\left| x \right|^{\frac{1}{(1-x)(x-2)}}$的第一类间断点的个数是（    )
analysisRich:
解$f(x)$的间断点为$x = 0, x = 1, x = 2$，分别计算这三个点处的左、右极限.由于$f(x) = \mathrm{e}^{\frac{\ln|x|}{(1 - x)(x - 2)}}$，故$\lim f(x) = \lim \mathrm{e}^{\frac{\ln|x|}{(1 - x)(x - 2)}} = \mathrm{e}^{\lim \frac{\ln|x|}{(1 - x)(x - 2)}}$.并且，$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {-}} \frac {\ln (- x)}{(1 - x) (x - 2)} = - \frac {1}{2} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {-}} \ln (- x) = + \infty ,$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\ln x}{(1 - x) (x - 2)} = - \frac {1}{2} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \ln x = + \infty ,$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {-}} \frac {\ln x}{(1 - x) (x - 2)} = - \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {-}} \frac {\ln x}{1 - x} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} - \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {-}} \frac {1 / x}{- 1} = 1,$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\ln x}{(1 - x) (x - 2)} = - \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {\ln x}{1 - x} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} - \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {+}} \frac {1 / x}{- 1} = 1,$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 2 ^ {-}} \frac {\ln x}{(1 - x) (x - 2)} = - \ln 2 \lim _ {x \rightarrow 2 ^ {-}} \frac {1}{x - 2} = + \infty ,$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 2 ^ {+}} \frac {\ln x}{(1 - x) (x - 2)} = - \ln 2 \lim _ {x \rightarrow 2 ^ {+}} \frac {1}{x - 2} = - \infty ,$故$\lim_{x\to 0}f(x)=+\infty, \lim_{x\to 1^{-}}f(x)=\lim_{x\to 1^{+}}f(x)=\mathrm{e}, \lim_{x\to 2^{-}}f(x)=+\infty, \lim_{x\to 2^{+}}f(x)=0. x=1$为$f(x)$的可去间断点，$x=0,x=2$为$f(x)$的无穷间断点.

因此，仅有$x = 1$为$f(x)$的第一类间断点，应选C.

questionText:
I. 证明：对任意的正整数 n, 都有$\frac{1}{n+1}<\ln \left(1+\frac{1}{n}\right)<\frac{1}{n}$成立；

II. 设$a_{n}=1+\frac{1}{2}+\cdots+\frac{1}{n}-\ln n$（$n=1,2,\cdots$），证明数列$\left\{a_{n}\right\}$收敛.
analysisRich:
证（I）（法一）考虑函数$f ( x )=\ln x$，则$f^{\prime}(x)=\frac{1}{x}.$由拉格朗日中值定理，对任意的正整数n，都存在$\xi_{n}\in(n,n+1)$，使得$\ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{n}\right) = f (n + 1) - f (n) = f ^ {\prime} \left(\xi_ {n}\right) = \frac {1}{\xi_ {n}}.$又因为$\xi_{n}\in (n,n + 1)$，所以$\frac{1}{n + 1} < \frac{1}{\xi_n} < \frac{1}{n}$因此，对任意的正整数 n，都有$\frac{1}{n+1}<\ln \left(1+\frac{1}{n}\right)<\frac{1}{n}$成立.

（法二）分别证明$\frac{1}{n + 1} < \ln \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)$和$\ln \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right) < \frac{1}{n}$.

为证明$\ln \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right) < \frac{1}{n}$，可考虑函数$f(x) = \ln (1 + x) - x.$$f^{\prime}(x)=\frac{1}{1+x}-1.$当$x > 0$时，$f^{\prime}(x)<0$，故$f(x)$在$[0,+\infty)$上单调减少. 又由于$f(0)=0$故对任意的正整数n，$f\left(\frac{1}{n}\right)<f(0)=0$即$\ln \left(1+\frac{1}{n}\right)<\frac{1}{n}.$为证明$\frac{1}{n+1} < \ln \left( 1+\frac{1}{n} \right)$，可考虑函数$g(x)=\ln(1+x)-\frac{x}{1+x}.$$g ^ {\prime} (x) = \frac {1}{1 + x} - \frac {(1 + x) - x}{(1 + x) ^ {2}} = \frac {x}{(1 + x) ^ {2}}.$当 x > 0时，$g^{\prime}(x) > 0$，故 g(x)在$[0,+\infty)$上单调增加.又由于$g(0)=0$，故对任意的正整数n，$g\left(\frac{1}{n}\right)>g(0)=0$，即$\frac{1}{n+1}<\ln \left(1+\frac{1}{n}\right).$综上所述，对任意的正整数 n，都有$\frac{1}{n+1}<\ln \left(1+\frac{1}{n}\right)<\frac{1}{n}$成立.

（法三）注意到$\ln \left( 1+\frac{1}{n} \right)=\int_{n}^{n+1} \frac{1}{x}\mathrm{d}x.$由于$\int_ {n} ^ {n + 1} \frac {1}{n + 1} \mathrm {d} x < \int_ {n} ^ {n + 1} \frac {1}{x} \mathrm {d} x < \int_ {n} ^ {n + 1} \frac {1}{n} \mathrm {d} x,$故$\frac {1}{n + 1} < \ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{n}\right) < \frac {1}{n}.$（Ⅱ）若能证明数列$\left\{a_{n}\right\}$单调且有界，则由单调有界准则知其收敛先证$\left\{a_{n}\right\}$单调.

对任意的正整数$n = 1,2,3,\dots$$a _ {n + 1} - a _ {n} = \frac {1}{n + 1} + \ln \frac {n}{n + 1} = \frac {1}{n + 1} - \ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{n}\right).$由第（I）问知，$a_{n+1} - a_n < 0$，故$\left\{a_{n}\right\}$单调减少.

下面证明$\left\{a_{n}\right\}$有下界.

由第（I）问知，$\ln 2 - \ln 1 < 1,$$\ln 3 - \ln 2 < \frac {1}{2},$$\ln (n + 1) - \ln n < \frac {1}{n}.$将上述不等式左端和右端分别相加，得$\ln (n + 1) - \ln 1 < 1 + \frac {1}{2} + \dots + \frac {1}{n}.$同时减去$\ln n$，得$a _ {n} > \ln (n + 1) - \ln n > 0.$因此，$\{a_{n}\}$有下界.

综上所述，数列$\left\{a_{n}\right\}$收敛.

questionText:
设函数$f ( x )=\ln x+\frac{1}{x}.$I. 求 f(x)的最小值;

II. 设数列$\{x_{n}\}$满足$\ln x_{n}+\frac{1}{x_{n+1}}<1$，证明$\lim_{n\to\infty}x_{n}$存在，并求此极限.
analysisRich:
解（I）首先，$f ( x )$的定义域为（0，$+ \infty$）.计算$f^{\prime}(x)$得$f^{\prime}(x)=\frac{1}{x}-\frac{1}{x^{2}}=\frac{x-1}{x^{2}}.$当 x=1时，$f^{\prime}(x)=0$，故 x=1为 f(x)的驻点；当 x>1时，$f^{\prime}(x)>0$，f(x)单调增加；当 0 < x < 1时，$f^{\prime}(x)<0$，f(x)单调减少.

因此，$f ( x )$的最小值为$f ( 1 )=1.$（Ⅱ）若能证明$\{x_{n}\}$单调且有界，则能证明$\lim_{n\to \infty}x_{n}$存在.

由第（Ⅰ）问的结论及第（Ⅱ）问的条件，$f \left(x _ {n}\right) = \ln x _ {n} + \frac {1}{x _ {n}} \geqslant 1 > \ln x _ {n} + \frac {1}{x _ {n + 1}},$故$\frac{1}{x_{n}} >\frac{1}{x_{n+1}}.$由题设，$\{x_{n}\}$应为正项数列，故由$\frac{1}{x_{n}} >\frac{1}{x_{n+1}}$可得$x_{n} < x_{n+1}$即$\{x_{n}\}$单调增加.

由$\ln x_{n} + \frac{1}{x_{n + 1}} < 1$得，$\ln x_{n} < 1 - \frac{1}{x_{n + 1}}$，即$x _ {n} < \mathrm {e} ^ {\left(1 - \frac {1}{x _ {n + 1}}\right)} < \mathrm {e},$故$\left\{x_{n}\right\}$单调增加且有上界.

因此，由单调有界准则知，$\lim_{n\to\infty}x_{n}$存在.

记$\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n = a$，则$a\geqslant x_{1} > 0.$对不等式$\ln x_{n} + \frac{1}{x_{n + 1}} < 1$两端取极限得$\ln a + \frac {1}{a} \leqslant 1.$又由第（I）问得，$\ln a + \frac{1}{a}\geqslant 1$，故$\ln a + \frac{1}{a} = 1$，此时$a = 1$，即$\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n = 1.$

questionText: 设数列$\{x_{n}\}$满足：$x_{1}>0,x_{n}\mathrm{e}^{x_{n+1}}=\mathrm{e}^{x_{n}}-1(n=1,2,\cdots).$证明数列$\{x_{n}\}$收敛，并求$\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty}x_{n}.$
analysisRich:
解 由$x_{n}\mathrm{e}^{x_{n + 1}} = \mathrm{e}^{x_{n}} - 1(n = 1,2,\dots)$可得，$x _ {n + 1} = \ln \left(\frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x _ {n}} - 1}{x _ {n}}\right).$先用数学归纳法证明对所有的正整数$n$，都有$x_{n} > 0$首先，$x_{1} > 0.$假设当$n = k$时，$x_{k} > 0.$注意到当$x > 0$时，$\mathrm{e}^{x} - 1 > x$，从而$\frac{\mathrm{e}^{x} - 1}{x} > 1.$于是，$x _ {k + 1} = \ln \left(\frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x _ {k}} - 1}{x _ {k}}\right) > \ln 1 = 0.$由数学归纳法可知，对所有的正整数$n$，都有$x_{n} > 0$因此，数列$\{x_{n}\}$有下界.

下面用两种方法证明数列$\{x_{n}\}$单调减少，即$x_{n + 1} < x_n(n = 1,2,\dots)$.

（法一）由$x_{n}\mathrm{e}^{x_{n + 1}} = \mathrm{e}^{x_{n}} - 1$可知，$\mathrm {e} ^ {x _ {n + 1}} = \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x _ {n}} - 1}{x _ {n}} = \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x _ {n}} - \mathrm {e} ^ {0}}{x _ {n} - 0} \frac {\text {拉 格 朗 日}}{\text {中 值 定 理}} \mathrm {e} ^ {\xi_ {n}},$其中$\xi_{n}\in (0,x_{n})$由于$\mathrm{e}^x$单调增加，故由$\mathrm{e}^{x_{n+1}} = \mathrm{e}^{\xi_n} < \mathrm{e}^{x_n}$可得$x_{n+1} < x_n$，即数列$\{x_n\}$单调减少.

（法二）$x _ {n + 1} - x _ {n} = \ln \left(\frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x _ {n}} - 1}{x _ {n}}\right) - x _ {n} = \ln \left(\frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x _ {n}} - 1}{x _ {n} \mathrm {e} ^ {x _ {n}}}\right).$记$f(x) = \mathrm{e}^{x} - 1 - x\mathrm{e}^{x}$，则$f^{\prime}(x) = \mathrm{e}^{x} - \mathrm{e}^{x} - x\mathrm{e}^{x} = -x\mathrm{e}^{x}$.

当$x > 0$时，$f^{\prime}(x) < 0,f(x)$在$[0, + \infty)$上单调减少，于是，$f(x) < f(0) = 0.$从而，当$x > 0$时，$\frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1}{x \mathrm {e} ^ {x}} - 1 = \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1 - x \mathrm {e} ^ {x}}{x \mathrm {e} ^ {x}} < 0,$即$\frac{\mathrm{e}^x - 1}{x\mathrm{e}^x} < 1.$又因为对所有的正整数$n$，都有$x_{n} > 0$，所以$\ln \left(\frac{\mathrm{e}^{x_n} - 1}{x_n\mathrm{e}^{x_n}}\right) < \ln 1 = 0$，即$x_{n + 1} - x_n < 0.$因此，数列$\{x_{n}\}$单调减少.

由单调有界准则可知，数列$\{x_{n}\}$收敛.由于对所有的正整数$n$，都有$x_{n} > 0$，故$\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n = a\geqslant 0.$对$x_{n}\mathrm{e}^{x_{n + 1}} = \mathrm{e}^{x_{n}} - 1$两端同时令$n\to \infty$，可得$a\mathrm{e}^{a} = \mathrm{e}^{a} - 1.$由前面的结果可知，$x=0$是$f(x)=\mathrm{e}^{x}-1-x\mathrm{e}^{x}$在$[0,+\infty)$上的唯一零点.因此，$a=0$即$\lim_{n\to \infty}x_{n}=0.$

questionText:
设$a_{n}=\int_{0}^{1} x^{n}\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x(n=0,1,2,\dots).$I. 证明数列$\{a_{n}\}$单调递减，且$a_{n}=\frac{n-1}{n+2} a_{n-2}(n=2,3,\cdots)$；

II. 求$\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{a_{n}}{a_{n-1}}.$
analysisRich:
解（I）考虑$a_{n+1}-a_{n}$由于在（0，1）内，$x^{n+1}-x^{n}<0,\sqrt{1-x^{2}}>0$故由定积分的保号性可知，$a _ {n + 1} - a _ {n} = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(x ^ {n + 1} - x ^ {n}\right) \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x < 0.$因此，$\{a_{n}\}$单调递减.

下面用两种方法证明$a_{n} = \frac{n - 1}{n + 2} a_{n - 2}(n = 2,3,\dots)$.

（法一）先三角换元，再分部分分.

令$x=\sin t$，则$\mathrm{d}x=\cos t\mathrm{d}t.$$\begin{aligned} a _ {n} &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {n} \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \xlongequal {x = \sin t} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {n} t \cos t \cdot \cos t \mathrm {d} t = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {n} t \cos^ {2} t \mathrm {d} t \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \left(\sin^ {n} t - \sin^ {n + 2} t\right) \mathrm {d} t = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {n} t \mathrm {d} t + \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {n + 1} t \mathrm {d} (\cos t) \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {n} t \mathrm {d} t + \sin^ {n + 1} t \cos t \left| _ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} - \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos t \cdot (n + 1) \sin^ {n} t \cdot \cos t \mathrm {d} t \right. \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {n} t \mathrm {d} t - (n + 1) \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {n} t \cos^ {2} t \mathrm {d} t = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {n} t \mathrm {d} t - (n + 1) a _ {n}. \end{aligned}$由上可得，$(n + 2)a_{n} = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin^{n}t\mathrm{d}t.$另一方面，$\begin{aligned} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {n} t \mathrm {d} t &= - \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {n - 1} t \mathrm {d} (\cos t) = - \left[ \sin^ {n - 1} t \cos t \left| _ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} - \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos t \cdot (n - 1) \sin^ {n - 2} t \cdot \cos t \mathrm {d} t \right] \right. \\ &= (n - 1) \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {n - 2} t \cos^ {2} t \mathrm {d} t = (n - 1) a _ {n - 2}. \end{aligned}$因此，$(n + 2)a_{n} = (n - 1)a_{n - 2}$，即$a_{n} = \frac{n - 1}{n + 2} a_{n - 2}(n = 2,3,\dots)$.

（法二）直接分部积分.注意到$[ ( 1 - x^{2} )^{\frac{3}{2}} ]^{\prime} = - 3 x \sqrt{1 - x^{2}}$，故$\begin{array}{l} a _ {n} = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {n} \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x = - \frac {1}{3} \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {n - 1} \mathrm {d} \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \\ = - \frac {1}{3} \left\{\left[ x ^ {n - 1} \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \right] \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \cdot (n - 1) x ^ {n - 2} \mathrm {d} x \right\} \\ = \frac {n - 1}{3} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} x ^ {n - 2} \mathrm {d} x = \frac {n - 1}{3} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(x ^ {n - 2} - x ^ {n}\right) \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \\ = \frac {n - 1}{3} \left(\int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {n - 2} \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x - \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {n} \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x\right) \\ = \frac {n - 1}{3} \left(a _ {n - 2} - a _ {n}\right). \\ \end{array}$因此，$a_{n} = \frac{n - 1}{n + 2} a_{n - 2}(n = 2,3,\dots)$（Ⅱ）由第（I）问可知$\{a_{n}\}$单调递减，故$a_{n} < a_{n-1} < a_{n-2}$又由$a_{n}$的表达式可知$a_{n} > 0 (n= 0,1,\dots)$，故$\frac {n - 1}{n + 2} = \frac {a _ {n}}{a _ {n - 2}} < \frac {a _ {n}}{a _ {n - 1}} < \frac {a _ {n}}{a _ {n}} = 1.$对（1）式中各项同时取极限，令$n\to \infty$，可得$1 = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {n - 1}{n + 2} \leqslant \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {a _ {n}}{a _ {n - 1}} \leqslant 1.$由夹逼准则可知，$\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{a_n}{a_{n-1}} = 1.$

questionText: 已知数列$\{x_{n}\}$满足$-\frac{\pi}{2}\leqslant x_{n}\leqslant \frac{\pi}{2}$，则（    )

textOptions.C: 若$\lim_{n\to\infty}\cos(\sin x_{n})$存在，则$\lim_{n\to\infty}\sin x_{n}$存在，但$\lim_{n\to\infty}x_{n}$不一定存在
textOptions.D: 若$\lim_{n\to\infty}\sin(\cos x_{n})$存在，则$\lim_{n\to\infty}\cos x_{n}$存在，但$\lim_{n\to\infty}x_{n}$不一定存在

analysisRich:
解 若$\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty}\sin(\cos x_{n})$存在，则将其记为 a.由于$\sin x$在$\left[-\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}\right]$上存在反函数$\arcsin x$，故$\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty}\cos x_{n}=\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty}\arcsin(\sin(\cos x_{n}))=\arcsin(\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty}\sin(\cos x_{n}))=\arcsin a.$但是$\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty}\cos x_{n}$存在并不能保证$\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty}x_{n}$存在.例如取$x_{n}=(-1)^{n}\frac{\pi}{2}$，则$\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty}\cos x_{n}=0$，但$\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty}x_{n}$不存在.选项B错误，选项D正确.应选D.

由于$\cos x$在$\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]$上并不单调，故由$\lim_{n\to \infty}\cos (\sin x_n)$存在并不能保证$\lim_{n\to \infty}\sin x_n$存在。同样取$x_{n} = (-1)^{n}\frac{\pi}{2}$，则$\lim_{n\to \infty}\cos (\sin x_n) = \cos 1$，但$\lim_{n\to \infty}\sin x_n$和$\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n$均不存在。选项A、C不正确。

questionText: 已知数列$\left\{a_{n}\right\} \left(a_{n}\neq0\right)$，若$\left\{a_{n}\right\}$发散，则（    )
analysisRich:
解考虑函数$f ( x )=\mathrm{e}^{x}-\frac{1}{\mathrm{e}^{x}}$，则$f^{\prime}(x)=\mathrm{e}^{x}+\mathrm{e}^{-x}>0$，故$f ( x )$是在$(-\infty , +\infty)$上单调增加的连续函数，从而存在反函数$f^{-1}(x), f^{-1}(x)$也是在$(-\infty , +\infty)$上单调增加的连续函数.

记$b_{n} = \mathrm{e}^{a_{n}} - \frac{1}{\mathrm{e}^{a_{n}}}$，即$b_{n} = f\left(a_{n}\right)$，于是，$a_{n} = f^{-1}\left(f\left(a_{n}\right)\right) = f^{-1}\left(b_{n}\right)$. 若$\{b_{n}\}$收敛，即存在$b$，使得$\lim_{n\to \infty}b_n = b$，则$\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} a _ {n} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} f ^ {- 1} \left(b _ {n}\right) = f ^ {- 1} \left(\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} b _ {n}\right) = f ^ {- 1} (b).$由此可得，$\lim_{n\to \infty}a_n$存在.但这与$\{a_n\}$发散矛盾.

因此，$\{b_{n}\}$发散，即$\left\{\mathrm{e}^{a_n} - \frac{1}{\mathrm{e}^{a_n}}\right\}$发散，应选D.

下面说明选项 A、B、C 均不正确.

对选项A，取$a_{n} = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} 2, & n = 2k - 1, \\ \frac{1}{2}, & n = 2k, \end{array} \right.$$k = 1,2,\dots$，则$\{a_{n}\}$发散，但$a_{n} + \frac{1}{a_{n}}\equiv 2 + \frac{1}{2} = \frac{5}{2},$$\left\{a_{n} + \frac{1}{a_{n}}\right\}$收敛.

对选项B、C，取$a_{n} = (-1)^{n}$，则$\left\{a_{n}\right\}$发散，但$a_{n}-\frac{1}{a_{n}}\equiv 0,\mathrm{e}^{a_{n}}+\frac{1}{\mathrm{e}^{a_{n}}}\equiv \mathrm{e}+\frac{1}{\mathrm{e}},\left\{a_{n}-\frac{1}{a_{n}}\right\},$$\left\{\mathrm{e}^{a_{n}}+\frac{1}{\mathrm{e}^{a_{n}}}\right\}$均收敛.

questionText: $\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty}a_{n}=a$，且 a≠0，则当 n充分大时有（    ）
analysisRich:
解 由三角不等式$|a| - |b| \leqslant |a - b| \leqslant |a| + |b|$可知，$|a_{n}| - |a| \leqslant |a_{n} - a|$. 又由$\lim_{n\to \infty}a_n = a$知，对于任意给定的正数$\varepsilon$，总存在正整数$N$，使得当$n > N$时，不等式$|a_{n} - a| < \varepsilon$都成立. 因此，当$n > N$时，$|a_{n}| - |a| \leqslant |a_{n} - a| < \varepsilon$，$\lim_{n\to \infty}|a_{n}| = |a| > 0$由极限的定义可知，给定$\varepsilon = \frac{|a|}{2} > 0$，当$n$充分大时，有$|a_{n}| - |a| < \frac{|a|}{2}$，故$|a_{n}| > \frac{|a|}{2}$从而选项A正确，选项B不正确.应选A.

下面我们举例说明选项C、D不正确.

令$a_{n}=1-\frac{1}{n}$，则 a=1，可知选项C不正确；令$a_{n}=1+\frac{1}{n}$，则 a=1，可知选项D不正确.

questionText: 设$\{x_{n}\}$是数列.下列命题中不正确的是（    ）
analysisRich:
解 令$x_{k} = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}0, & k = 3n \text{或} 3n + 1,\\ 1, & k = 3n + 2. \end{array} \right.$n为正整数，则$\lim_{n\to \infty}x_{3n} = \lim_{n\to \infty}x_{3n+1} = 0, \lim_{n\to \infty}x_{3n+2} = 1$，从而$\lim_{n\to \infty}x_{n}$不存在，故选项D不正确.应选D.

若一个数列收敛于$a$，则它的任一子数列也收敛于$a$，故选项A、C均正确.

若$\lim_{n\to \infty}x_{2n} = \lim_{n\to \infty}x_{2n + 1} = a$，则由数列极限的定义可知，对任意给定的$\varepsilon > 0$，存在正整数$N_{1}, N_{2}$，使得$\left| x _ {2 n} - a \right| < \varepsilon , n > N _ {1}, \quad \left| x _ {2 n + 1} - a \right| < \varepsilon , n > N _ {2}.$令$N=\max \left\{2 N_{1},2 N_{2}+1\right\}$，则当 n > N时，$|x_{n}-a|<\varepsilon$.由数列极限的定义可知$\lim_{n\to \infty}x_{n}=a$，故选项B正确.

textOptions.D: 没有最大值，没有最小值

analysisRich:
解（法一）$\lim_{n\to \infty}a_{n}=\lim_{n\to \infty}\left[\sqrt[n]{n}-\frac{(-1)^{n}}{n}\right]=1.$由极限的定义可知，在1的附近，例如区间（0.99，1.01）内，聚集了$\left\{a_{n}\right\}$除有限项以外的所有项，即存在正整数N，对 n > N，$a_{n}\in$（0.99，1.01）.注意到$a_{1}=2>1.01, a_{2}=\sqrt{2}-\frac{1}{2}<0.99$，故$a_{1},a_{2}$为落在该区间外的有限项中的两项.$\left\{a_{n}\right\}$的最值必在没有落入该区间内的有限项中取得.

因此，$\left\{a_{n}\right\}$必能取得最大值，也能取得最小值，且最大值不小于$a_{1}$，最小值不大于$a_{2}$.应选A.

（法二）由$a_{n}$的表达式可知，$a_{n}=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}\sqrt[n]{n}+\frac{1}{n},&n=2k-1,\\ \sqrt[n]{n}-\frac{1}{n},&n=2k,\end{array}\right. k=1,2,\dots.$考虑数列$\left\{b_{n}\right\}$，其中$b_{n}=\sqrt[n]{n}.$令$f ( x )=x^{\frac{1}{x}}(x>0)$，则$f ( x )=\mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{x}\ln x}.$记$g ( x )=\frac{\ln x}{x}.$由于$\mathrm{e}^{u}$关于u单调增加，故g(x)的最大值对应f(x)的最大值.$g^{\prime}(x)=\frac{1-\ln x}{x^{2}}$当 0 < x < e时，$g^{\prime}(x)>0,g(x)$单调增加；当 x > e时，$g^{\prime}(x)<0,g(x)$单调减少.于是，$x=\mathrm{e}$为 g(x）的极大值点，也是最大值点.从而 x = e也是 f(x) 的最大值点.

当 n≥3时，$\left\{b_{n}\right\}$单调减少.于是，数列$\left\{\sqrt[n]{n}+\frac{1}{n}\right\}_{n=2k-1}^{\infty}$从 n=3开始单调减少，数列$\left\{\sqrt[n]{n}+\frac{1}{n}\right\}_{n=2k}^{\infty}$从 n=2开始单调减少.$a_{1}=1+1=2, a_{3}=\sqrt[3]{3}+\frac{1}{3}.$注意到$\sqrt[3]{\frac{27}{9}}<\sqrt[3]{\frac{27}{8}}=\frac{3}{2}$故$a_{3}<\frac{3}{2}+\frac{1}{3}<2$从而，$a_{1}=2$为$\left\{\sqrt[n]{n}+\frac{1}{n}\right\}_{n=2k-1}^{\infty}$的最大值，该数列单调减少趋于1，取不到最小值.

考虑数列$\left\{\sqrt[n]{n} -\frac{1}{n}\right\}_{n = 2k}^{\infty}$.

令 h(x）= x$^{\frac{1}{x}}-\frac{1}{x}$，则$h ^ {\prime} (x) = \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {\ln x}{x}} - \frac {1}{x}\right) ^ {\prime} = \mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {\ln x}{x}} \cdot \frac {1 - \ln x}{x ^ {2}} + \frac {1}{x ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{x ^ {2}} \left[ x ^ {\frac {1}{x}} (1 - \ln x) + 1 \right].$当 x充分大时，$h^{\prime}(x)<0,h(x)$单调减少，且$\lim_{x\rightarrow +\infty}h(x)=1$事实上，由于$8>7.84=(2.8)^{2}>\mathrm{e}^{2},$$x^{\frac{1}{x}}>1(x>1),1-\ln 8<1-\ln\mathrm{e}^{2}=-1$，故$h^{\prime}(8)<0$.于是，当 n≥4时，$\left\{a_{2n}\right\}$单调减少，且$a_{2n}$均大于1.

另一方面，$a _ {2 n} = \sqrt [ 2 n ]{2 n} - \frac {1}{2 n} < \sqrt [ 2 n ]{2 n} + \frac {1}{2 n} < \sqrt {2} + \frac {1}{2} < 2.$于是，$\left\{a_{2n}\right\}$的最大值小于2.$a_{2}=\sqrt{2}-\frac{1}{2}<1, a_{4}=\sqrt[4]{4}-\frac{1}{4}=\sqrt{2}-\frac{1}{4}>a_{2},$$a _ {6} = \sqrt [ 6 ]{6} - \frac {1}{6} = \sqrt [ 3 ]{\sqrt {6}} - \frac {1}{6} > \sqrt [ 3 ]{2} - \frac {1}{6} > \sqrt [ 4 ]{2} - \frac {1}{6} > 1.$因此，$a_{2}$为$\left\{\sqrt[n]{n}-\frac{1}{n}\right\}^{\infty}$的最小值.

综上所述，$a_{1}$为$\left\{a_{n}\right\}$的最大值，$a_{2}$为$\left\{a_{n}\right\}$的最小值.应选A.

questionText: 当$x \to0$时，用“$o(x)$”表示比 x高阶的无穷小量，则下列式子中错误的是（    )
analysisRich:
由于$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x \cdot o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{x ^ {3}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{x ^ {2}} = 0,$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {o (x) \cdot o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{x ^ {3}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {o (x)}{x} \cdot \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{x ^ {2}} = 0,$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {o \left(x ^ {2}\right) + o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{x ^ {2}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{x ^ {2}} + \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{x ^ {2}} = 0 + 0 = 0,$故选项A、B、C均正确.应选D.

对选项D，若令$f ( x )=x^{2}, g ( x )=x^{3}$，则当$x\to 0$时，$x^{2}+x^{3}$形如$o ( x )+o \left( x^{2}\right)$，但$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x^{2}+x^{3}}{x^{2}}=1.$因此，当$x\to 0$时，$x^{2}+x^{3}$不是$x^{2}$的高阶无穷小量.

questionText: 设$\cos x-1=x\sin \alpha (x)$，其中$|\alpha (x)|<\frac{\pi}{2}$，则当 x→0时，$\alpha (x)$是（    )

textOptions.A: 比 x 高阶的无穷小量
textOptions.B: 比 x 低阶的无穷小量
textOptions.C: 与 x 同阶但不等价的无穷小量
textOptions.D: 与 x 等价的无穷小量

analysisRich:
解 首先说明$\alpha(x)$是$x\rightarrow0$时的无穷小量.$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\sin \alpha (x)}{x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\cos x - 1}{x ^ {2}} \xlongequal {\cos x - 1 \sim - \frac {1}{2} x ^ {2}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {- \frac {1}{2} x ^ {2}}{x ^ {2}} = - \frac {1}{2}.$由于$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\sin \alpha (x)}{x} = -\frac{1}{2}$，而分母 x趋于零，故必有$\lim_{x\to 0}\sin \alpha (x) = 0.$又由于$|\alpha (x)| < \frac{\pi}{2},\sin x$在$\left(-\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}\right)$上有连续的反函数$arcsin x$，从而$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \alpha (x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \arcsin [ \sin \alpha (x) ] = 0.$$\alpha (x)$是$x\to 0$时的无穷小量，$\sin \alpha (x)\sim \alpha (x)(x\to 0)$.

因此，$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\alpha (x)}{x}\frac{\sin \alpha (x)\sim \alpha (x)}{=}\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\sin \alpha (x)}{x}=-\frac{1}{2},\alpha (x)$是与$x$同阶但不等价的无穷小量.应选C.

questionText: 设$\alpha_{1}=x(\cos \sqrt{x}-1),\alpha_{2}=\sqrt{x}\ln(1+\sqrt[3]{x}),\alpha_{3}=\sqrt[3]{x+1}-1$.当$x\rightarrow 0^{+}$时，以上3个无穷小量按照从低阶到高阶的排序是（    ）
analysisRich:
解 由于当$x\to 0^{+}$时，$\cos \sqrt {x} - 1 \sim - \frac {1}{2} (\sqrt {x}) ^ {2} = - \frac {x}{2}, \ln \left(1 + \sqrt [ 3 ]{x}\right) \sim \sqrt [ 3 ]{x}, \sqrt [ 3 ]{x + 1} - 1 = (x + 1) ^ {\frac {1}{3}} - 1 \sim \frac {x}{3},$故$\alpha_ {1} = x \left(\cos \sqrt {x} - 1\right) \sim x \cdot \left(- \frac {x}{2}\right) = - \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}, \quad \alpha_ {2} = \sqrt {x} \ln \left(1 + \sqrt [ 3 ]{x}\right) \sim x ^ {\frac {1}{2}} \cdot x ^ {\frac {1}{3}} = x ^ {\frac {5}{6}},$$\alpha_ {3} = \sqrt [ 3 ]{x + 1} - 1 \sim \frac {x}{3}.$比较$\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$的阶，只需要比较与$\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$等价的$-\frac{x^{2}}{2},x^{\frac{5}{6}},\frac{x}{3}$中 x的次数，次数越高，无穷小量的阶越高.

因此，正确的排序（阶从低到高）应当为$\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\alpha_{1}$应选B.

questionText: $x \rightarrow 0^{+}$时，下列无穷小量中最高阶是（    ）
analysisRich:
解 由于求一次导，无穷小量的阶数降低1，且选项A、B的积分上、下限相同，故比较这两项的无穷小量的阶的大小，可以转化为比较它们的被积函数的阶。又因为$t\to 0^{+}$时，$\mathrm{e}^{t^{2}}-1\sim t^{2},$$\ln(1+\sqrt{t^{3}})\sim t^{\frac{3}{2}}$，所以$\int_{0}^{x}\left(\mathrm{e}^{t^{2}}-1\right)\mathrm{d}t$与$x^{3}$同阶，比$\int_{0}^{x}\ln(1+\sqrt{t^{3}})\mathrm{d}t$高阶.

比较$\int_{0}^{\sin x}\sin t^{2}\mathrm{d}t$与$x^{3}$的阶.$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {\sin x} \sin t ^ {2} \mathrm {d} t}{x ^ {3}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\sin (\sin x) ^ {2} \cdot \cos x}{3 x ^ {2}} &= \frac {1}{3} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\sin (\sin x) ^ {2}}{x ^ {2}} \xlongequal {\frac {\sin u \sim u}{u \rightarrow 0}} \frac {1}{3} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {(\sin x) ^ {2}}{x ^ {2}} \\ &= \frac {1}{3} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \left(\frac {\sin x}{x}\right) ^ {2} \xlongequal {\sin x \sim x} \frac {1}{3}. \end{aligned}$于是，$\int_{0}^{\sin x}\sin t^{2}\mathrm{d}t$也与$x^{3}$同阶.

比较$\int_{0}^{1-\cos x}\sqrt{\sin^{3}t}\mathrm{d}t$与$x^{3}$的阶.$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {1 - \cos x} \sqrt {\sin^ {3} t} \mathrm {d} t}{x ^ {3}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\sqrt {\sin^ {3} (1 - \cos x)} \sin x}{3 x ^ {2}} \xlongequal {\sin x \sim x} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\sin^ {\frac {3}{2}} (1 - \cos x)}{3 x} \\ &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\sin^ {\frac {3}{2}} (1 - \cos x)}{(1 - \cos x) ^ {\frac {3}{2}}} \cdot \frac {(1 - \cos x) ^ {\frac {3}{2}}}{3 x} \\ \frac {1 - \cos x \sim \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}}{} {\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \left[ \frac {\sin (1 - \cos x)}{1 - \cos x} \right] ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \cdot \frac {\left(\frac {x ^ {2}}{2}\right) ^ {\frac {3}{2}}}{3 x}} \\ &= 1 \times 0 = 0. \end{aligned}$因此，$\int_{0}^{1-\cos x}\sqrt{\sin^{3}t}\mathrm{d}t$比$x^{3}$高阶，从而比选项A、B、C中的无穷小量均高阶.应选D.

analysisRich: 解 计算$\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{\int_{0}^{x^{2}}(\mathrm{e}^{t^{3}}-1)\mathrm{d}t}{x^{7}}$来比较这两个无穷小量的阶.$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {2}} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {t ^ {3}} - 1\right) \mathrm {d} t}{x ^ {7}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {6}} - 1\right) \cdot 2 x}{7 x ^ {6}} \xlongequal {\text {e} ^ {x ^ {6}} - 1 \sim x ^ {6}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x ^ {6} \cdot 2 x}{7 x ^ {6}} = 0.$因此，$\int_{0}^{x^{2}}(\mathrm{e}^{t^{3}}-1)\mathrm{d}t$是$x^{7}$的高阶无穷小.应选C.

questionText: 若当$x \rightarrow 0$时，$\alpha (x),\beta (x)$是非零无穷小量，则以下四个命题：$\textcircled{1}$若$\alpha (x)\sim \beta (x)$，则$\alpha^{2}(x)\sim \beta^{2}(x);$$\textcircled{2}$若$\alpha^{2}(x)\sim \beta^{2}(x)$，则$\alpha (x)\sim \beta (x);$$\textcircled{3}$若$\alpha (x)\sim \beta (x)$，则$\alpha (x)-\beta (x)=o(\alpha (x));$$\textcircled{4}$若$\alpha (x)-\beta (x)=o(\alpha (x))$，则$\alpha (x)\sim \beta (x).$其中所有真命题的序号是（    ）
analysisRich:
依次分析四个命题.

若$\alpha(x)\sim\beta(x)$，则$\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\alpha(x)}{\beta(x)}=1$，从而$\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\alpha^{2}(x)}{\beta^{2}(x)}=1$，即$\alpha^{2}(x)\sim\beta^{2}(x).$命题$\textcircled{1}$是真命题.

由$\alpha^{2}(x)\sim\beta^{2}(x)$并不能得到$\alpha(x)\sim\beta(x).$考虑$\beta(x)=-\alpha(x)$，则$\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\alpha^{2}(x)}{\beta^{2}(x)}=\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\alpha^{2}(x)}{\alpha^{2}(x)}= 1$，即$\alpha^{2}(x)\sim\beta^{2}(x)$，但$\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\alpha(x)}{\beta(x)}=\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\alpha(x)}{- \alpha(x)}=-1, \alpha(x)$与$\beta(x)$只是同阶但并不等价的无穷小量.

命题$\textcircled{2}$不是真命题.

要说明$\alpha ( x )-\beta ( x )=o( \dot{\alpha} ( x ) )$，只需说明$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\alpha ( x )-\beta ( x )}{\alpha ( x )}=0.$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\alpha (x) - \beta (x)}{\alpha (x)} = 1 - \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\beta (x)}{\alpha (x)} \frac {\alpha (x) \sim \beta (x)}{1 - 1} = 0.$命题$\textcircled{3}$是真命题.

要说明$\alpha (x)\sim \beta (x)$，只需说明$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\beta (x)}{\alpha (x)} = 1.$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\beta (x)}{\alpha (x)} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\alpha (x) - [ \alpha (x) - \beta (x) ]}{\alpha (x)} = 1 - \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\alpha (x) - \beta (x)}{\alpha (x)} = 1 - 0 = 1.$命题$\textcircled{4}$是真命题.

综上所述，应选C.

analysisRich:
解 依次分析四个命题.

若$\alpha(x)\sim\beta(x)$，则$\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\alpha(x)}{\beta(x)}=1$，从而$\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\alpha^{2}(x)}{\beta^{2}(x)}=1$，即$\alpha^{2}(x)\sim\beta^{2}(x).$命题$\textcircled{1}$是真命题由$\alpha^{2}(x)\sim\beta^{2}(x)$并不能得到$\alpha(x)\sim\beta(x).$考虑$\beta(x)=-\alpha(x)$，则$\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\alpha^{2}(x)}{\beta^{2}(x)}=\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\alpha^{2}(x)}{\alpha^{2}(x)}= 1$，即$\alpha^{2}(x)\sim\beta^{2}(x)$，但$\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\alpha(x)}{\beta(x)}=\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\alpha(x)}{- \alpha(x)}=-1, \alpha(x)$与$\beta(x)$只是同阶但并不等价的无穷小量命题$\textcircled{2}$不是真命题.

要说明$\alpha ( x )-\beta ( x )=o( \alpha ( x ) )$，只需说明$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\alpha ( x )-\beta ( x )}{\alpha ( x )}=0.$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\alpha (x) - \beta (x)}{\alpha (x)} = 1 - \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\beta (x)}{\alpha (x)} \frac {\alpha (x) \sim \beta (x)}{1 - 1} 1 - 1 = 0.$命题$\textcircled{3}$是真命题.

要说明$\alpha ( x )\sim \beta ( x )$，只需说明$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\beta ( x )}{\alpha ( x )}=1.$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\beta (x)}{\alpha (x)} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\alpha (x) - [ \alpha (x) - \beta (x) ]}{\alpha (x)} = 1 - \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\alpha (x) - \beta (x)}{\alpha (x)} = 1 - 0 = 1.$命题$\textcircled{4}$是真命题.

综上所述，应选C.

textOptions.D: 是$y_{n}$的同阶但非等价无穷小

analysisRich:
解（法一）首先证明对任意正整数$n,x_{n}\in (0,1)$.

当$n=1$时，$x_{1}=\frac{1}{2}\in(0,1).$假设$x_{n}\in(0,1)$，则$x_{n+1}=\sin x_{n}\in(0,1).$由数学归纳法可知对任意正整数 n，$x_{n}\in(0,1).$由$\sin x$的泰勒公式可知，存在$\xi_{n}\in(0,x_{n})$，使得$x _ {n + 1} = \sin x _ {n} = x _ {n} - \frac {\cos \xi_ {n}}{6} x _ {n} ^ {3} > x _ {n} - \frac {x _ {n} ^ {3}}{6} > \frac {x _ {n}}{2}.$于是，$x _ {n} > \frac {1}{2} x _ {n - 1} > \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {2} x _ {n - 2} > \dots > \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {n - 1} x _ {1} = \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {n}.$由$y_{1} = \frac{1}{2}, y_{n + 1} = y_{n}^{2}$可知$y_{n} = y_{n - 1}^{2} = y_{n - 2}^{4} = \dots = y_{1}^{2^{n - 1}} = \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{2^{n - 1}}.$因此，$0 < \frac {y _ {n}}{x _ {n}} < \frac {\left(\frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {2 ^ {n - 1}}}{\left(\frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {n}} = \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {2 ^ {n - 1} - n}.$由于$\lim_{n\to \infty}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{2^{n-1}-n}=0$，故由夹逼准则可知，$\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{y_{n}}{x_{n}}=0.$综上所述，当$n\to\infty$时，$y_{n}$是$x_{n}$的高阶无穷小，应选B.

（法二）首先我们证明，在$\left( 0, \frac{\pi}{2} \right)$内，$\sin x > \frac{2}{\pi} x$即$\frac{\sin x}{x} > \frac{2}{\pi}.$令$f ( x )=\frac{\sin x}{x}, x \in\left(0,\frac{\pi}{2}\right)$，则$f^{\prime}(x)=\frac{x\cos x-\sin x}{x^{2}}.$注意到$f^{\prime}(x)$的分母恒大于0，故考虑分子的符号.

令$g ( x )=x \cos x-\sin x,x \in\left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$，则$g^{\prime}(x)=\cos x-x \sin x-\cos x=-x \sin x<0$，于是，$g ( x )$在$\left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$内单调减少.结合$g ( 0 )=0$，可得$g ( x )<0$，从而$f^{\prime}(x)$在$\left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$内小于0，$f ( x )$在$\left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$内单调减少.因此，当$x \in\left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$时，$f ( x )>f \left( \frac{\pi}{2} \right)=\frac{2}{\pi}$即$\frac{\sin x}{x}>\frac{2}{\pi}.$由法一可知，对任意正整数 n，$x_{n}\in(0,1)\subset\left(0,\frac{\pi}{2}\right)$，从而由前面的分析可得$x _ {n + 1} = \sin x _ {n} > \frac {2}{\pi} x _ {n}.$下面我们证明，对任意正整数$n, y_{n}\in \left[0,\frac{1}{2}\right]$，从而$y_{n + 1} = y_n^2 \leqslant \frac{1}{2} y_n.$当 n=1时，$y_{1}=\frac{1}{2}\in\left[0,\frac{1}{2}\right].$假设$y_{n}\in\left[0,\frac{1}{2}\right]$，则$y_{n+1}=y_{n}^{2}\in\left[0,\frac{1}{2}\right].$由数学归纳法可知对任意正整数n，$y_{n}\in\left[0,\frac{1}{2}\right],$从而$y_{n+1}=y_{n}^{2}\leqslant \frac{1}{2} y_{n}.$因此，$0 < \frac {y _ {n}}{x _ {n}} < \frac {\frac {1}{2} y _ {n - 1}}{\frac {2}{\pi} x _ {n - 1}} = \frac {\pi}{4} \cdot \frac {y _ {n - 1}}{x _ {n - 1}} < \frac {\pi}{4} \cdot \frac {\frac {1}{2} y _ {n - 2}}{\frac {2}{\pi} x _ {n - 2}} = \left(\frac {\pi}{4}\right) ^ {2} \frac {y _ {n - 2}}{x _ {n - 2}} < \dots = \left(\frac {\pi}{4}\right) ^ {n - 1} \frac {y _ {1}}{x _ {1}} = \left(\frac {\pi}{4}\right) ^ {n - 1}.$由于$\lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)^{n-1}=0$，故由夹逼准则可知，$\lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}\frac{y_{n}}{x_{n}}=0.$综上所述，当$n\to\infty$时，$y_{n}$是$x_{n}$的高阶无穷小，应选B.

questionText: 当$x\to 0$时，$\frac {\left(1 + t ^ {2}\right) \sin t ^ {2}}{1 + \cos^ {2} t}$$\mathrm{d}t$与$x^{k}$是同阶无穷小，则$k =$___
analysisRich: 解记$f ( x )=\int_{0}^{x}\frac{(1+t^{2})\sin t^{2}}{1+\cos^{2}t}\mathrm{d} t$，则$f ( 0 )=0$，且由变限积分的求导公式可得$f^{\prime}(x)=$$\frac{(1+x^{2})\sin x^{2}}{1+\cos^{2}x}.$由于$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f ^ {\prime} (x)}{x ^ {2}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\left(1 + x ^ {2}\right) \sin x ^ {2}}{\left(1 + \cos^ {2} x\right) x ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{2} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\sin x ^ {2}}{x ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{2},$故当$x\to0$时，$f^{\prime}(x)$与$x^{2}$是同阶无穷小，且$f^{\prime}(x)\sim \frac{1}{2} x^{2}.$于是，$f (x) = f (x) - f (0) = \int_ {0} ^ {x} f ^ {\prime} (t) \mathrm {d} t \sim \int_ {0} ^ {x} \frac {t ^ {2}}{2} \mathrm {d} t = \frac {t ^ {3}}{6} \Big | _ {0} ^ {x} = \frac {x ^ {3}}{6}. \quad (x \rightarrow 0)$因此，当$x\to 0$时，$f(x)$与$x^{3}$同阶，$k = 3.$

questionText: 在$x \rightarrow 0^{+}$时，下列无穷小量中与 x等价的是（    )
analysisRich: 解分别记四个选项中的函数为$f_{i}(x)(i = 1,2,3,4)$，计算$\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{f_{i}(x)}{x}$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {f _ {1} (x)}{x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- \sin x} - 1}{x} \xlongequal {\mathrm {e} ^ {- \sin x} - 1 \sim - \sin x} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {- \sin x}{x} = - 1.$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {f _ {2} (x)}{x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\sqrt {x + 1} - \cos x}{x} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \left(\frac {1}{2 \sqrt {x + 1}} + \sin x\right) = \frac {1}{2}.$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {f _ {3} (x)}{x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {1 - \cos \sqrt {2 x}}{x} \xlongequal {\frac {1 - \cos \sqrt {2 x} \sim \frac {1}{2} (\sqrt {2 x}) ^ {2}}{x}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\frac {1}{2} (\sqrt {2 x}) ^ {2}}{x} = 1.$$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {f _ {4} (x)}{x} &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {1 - \frac {\ln (1 + x)}{x}}{x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {x - \ln (1 + x)}{x ^ {2}} \\ \frac {\ln (1 + x) = x - \frac {1}{2} x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{\hline} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\frac {1}{2} x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{x ^ {2}} &= \frac {1}{2}. \end{aligned}$由此可得，仅有选项C的函数$f_{3}(x)$满足$\lim_{x\rightarrow 0^{+}}\frac{f_{3}(x)}{x}=1$，其余选项的函数均不符合要求因此，应选C.

questionText: 设函数 f(x)，g(x)在 x=0的某去心邻域内有定义且恒不为零，若当$x \rightarrow 0$时，f(x)是 g(x)的高阶无穷小，则当$x \rightarrow 0$时（    )
analysisRich:
解 由于当$x\to 0$时，$f(x)$是$g(x)$的高阶无穷小，故$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x)}{g(x)} = 0.$于是，$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x) + g (x)}{g (x)} = 1 + \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x)}{g (x)} = 1,$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x) g (x)}{f ^ {2} (x)} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {g (x)}{f (x)} = \infty ,$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x)}{\mathrm {e} ^ {g (x)} - 1} \xrightarrow {\mathrm {e} ^ {g (x)} - 1 - g (x)} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x)}{g (x)} = 0.$由此可得，选项A、B不正确，选项C正确.

对选项D，取$f ( x )=x^{2}, g ( x )=x$，则$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x)}{g^{2}(x)}=1\neq0$，选项D不正确因此，应选C.

questionText: 当$x \to 0^{+}$时，下列无穷小量中最高阶的是（    )
analysisRich:
解 由于求一次导，无穷小量的阶数降低1，且选项A、B的积分上、下限相同，故比较这两项的无穷小量的阶的大小，可以转化为比较它们的被积函数的阶。又因为$t\to 0^{+}$时，$\mathrm{e}^{t^{2}}-1\sim t^{2},$$\ln(1+\sqrt{t^{3}})\sim t^{\frac{3}{2}}$，所以$\int_{0}^{x}\left(\mathrm{e}^{t^{2}}-1\right)\mathrm{d}t$与$x^{3}$同阶，比$\int_{0}^{x}\ln(1+\sqrt{t^{3}})\mathrm{d}t$高阶.

比较$\int_{0}^{\sin x}\sin t^{2}\mathrm{d}t$与$x^{3}$的阶.$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {\sin x} \sin t ^ {2} \mathrm {d} t}{x ^ {3}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\sin (\sin x) ^ {2} \cdot \cos x}{3 x ^ {2}} &= \frac {1}{3} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\sin (\sin x) ^ {2}}{x ^ {2}} \xlongequal {\text {s i n} u \sim u} \frac {1}{3} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {(\sin x) ^ {2}}{x ^ {2}} \\ &= \frac {1}{3} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \left(\frac {\sin x}{x}\right) ^ {2} \xlongequal {\sin x \sim x} \frac {1}{3}. \end{aligned}$于是，$\int_{0}^{\sin x}\sin t^{2}\mathrm{d}t$也与$x^{3}$同阶.

比较$\int_{0}^{1-\cos x}\sqrt{\sin^{3}t}\mathrm{d}t$与$x^{3}$的阶.$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {1 - \cos x} \sqrt {\sin^ {3} t} \mathrm {d} t}{x ^ {3}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\sqrt {\sin^ {3} (1 - \cos x)} \sin x}{3 x ^ {2}} \xlongequal {\text {s i n} x \sim x} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\sin^ {\frac {3}{2}} (1 - \cos x)}{3 x} \\ &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\sin^ {\frac {3}{2}} (1 - \cos x)}{(1 - \cos x) ^ {\frac {3}{2}}} \cdot \frac {(1 - \cos x) ^ {\frac {3}{2}}}{3 x} \\ \frac {1 - \cos x \sim \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}}{} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \left[ \frac {\sin (1 - \cos x)}{1 - \cos x} \right] ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \cdot \frac {\left(\frac {x ^ {2}}{2}\right) ^ {\frac {3}{2}}}{3 x} \\ &= 1 \times 0 = 0. \end{aligned}$因此，$\int_0^{1 - \cos x}\sqrt{\sin^3t}\mathrm{d}t$比$x^{3}$高阶，从而比选项A、B、C中的无穷小量均高阶.应选D.

questionText: 当$x\to0$时，$f(x)=x-\sin ax$与$g(x)=x^{2}\ln(1-bx)$是等价无穷小量，则（    )
analysisRich:
解（法一）由于$x\to 0$时，$f(x)$与$g(x)$是等价无穷小量，故$\begin{aligned} 1 &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x)}{g (x)} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \sin a x}{x ^ {2} \ln (1 - b x)} \xlongequal {\ln (1 - b x) \sim (- b x)} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \sin a x}{- b x ^ {3}} \\ \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - a \cos a x}{- 3 b x ^ {2}} &= I _ {1}. \end{aligned}$由于$\lim_{x\to 0}(-3bx^2) = 0$，故若$I_{1}$存在，则$\lim_{x\to 0}(1 - a\cos ax) = 0$，从而$a = 1.$代人 a=1，得$I _ {1} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - \cos x}{- 3 b x ^ {2}} \xlongequal {\text {一}} \frac {1 - \cos x \sim \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}}{\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\frac {x ^ {2}}{2}}{- 3 b x ^ {2}}} = - \frac {1}{6 b}.$当$b = -\frac{1}{6}$时，$I_{1}$存在且等于1.

因此，当$a=1,b=-\frac{1}{6}$时，$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x)}{g(x)}=1,f(x)$与g(x）是$x\to 0$时的等价无穷小量.应选A.

（法二）因为$\sin a x = a x - \frac {1}{6} a ^ {3} x ^ {3} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right), \quad \ln (1 - b x) = - b x + o (x),$所以$1 = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \sin a x}{x ^ {2} \ln (1 - b x)} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {(x - a x) + \frac {1}{6} a ^ {3} x ^ {3} - o \left(x ^ {3}\right)}{x ^ {2} \left[ - b x + o (x) \right]} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {(1 - a) x + \frac {1}{6} a ^ {3} x ^ {3} - o \left(x ^ {3}\right)}{- b x ^ {3} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right)} = I.$首先，$b\neq 0$，否则$I = \infty$.当$b\neq 0$时，若$a - 1\neq 0$，则$I = \infty$，从而可得$a = 1$代入 a=1，得$1 = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\frac {1}{6} x ^ {3} - o \left(x ^ {3}\right)}{- b x ^ {3} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right)} = - \frac {1}{6 b}.$从而$b = -\frac{1}{6}$因此，$a=1,b=-\frac{1}{6}$应选A.

questionText: 若$\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\left[ \frac{1}{x}-\left( \frac{1}{x}-a\right) \mathrm{e}^{x}\right] =1$，则 a等于（    ）
analysisRich:
（法一）由于$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left[ \frac {1}{x} - \left(\frac {1}{x} - a\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {x} \right] = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - (1 - a x) \mathrm {e} ^ {x}}{x} \xlongequal {\text {洛 必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {a \mathrm {e} ^ {x} - (1 - a x) \mathrm {e} ^ {x}}{1} = a - 1,$故由已知条件知$a - 1 = 1.$因此，$a = 2.$应选C.

（法二）由于当$x\to 0$时，$\mathrm{e}^{x} - 1\sim x$，故$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left[ \frac {1}{x} - \left(\frac {1}{x} - a\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {x} \right] = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left(\frac {1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {x}}{x} + a \mathrm {e} ^ {x}\right) = - 1 + a = 1.$解得 a=2.应选C.

questionText: 已知当$x\to0$时，函数$f(x)=3\sin x-\sin 3x$与$cx^{k}$是等价无穷小量，则（    )
analysisRich:
解 由题设知，$c\neq 0,k > 0.$记$I=\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x)}{cx^{k}}$，则由等价无穷小量的定义知，$I=1.$下面我们用两种方法讨论 k,c的值.

（法一）考虑 f(x)在 x=0处的泰勒公式.由于$\sin x=x-\frac{1}{3!} x^{3}+o\left(x^{3}\right)$，故$\sin 3x=3x-\frac{1}{3!}\left(3x\right)^{3}+o\left(x^{3}\right).$因此，$1 = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {3 \sin x - \sin 3 x}{c x ^ {k}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {3 x - \frac {1}{2} x ^ {3} - 3 x + \frac {2 7}{6} x ^ {3} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right)}{c x ^ {k}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {4 x ^ {3} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right)}{c x ^ {k}}.$下面讨论使$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{4x^{3}+o\left(x^{3}\right)}{cx^{k}}=1$成立的 k，c的值.

由于$I = \frac {4}{c} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x ^ {3}}{x ^ {k}} \left[ 1 + \frac {o \left(x ^ {3}\right)}{4 x ^ {3}} \right] = \frac {4}{c} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x ^ {3}}{x ^ {k}},$故当$c\neq 0,k < 3$时，$I = 0$；当$c\neq 0,k > 3$时，$I = \infty$；只有当$c\neq 0,k = 3$时，$I = \frac{4}{c} = 1.$因此，$k = 3,c = 4.$应选C.

（法二）对$I$使用洛必达法则可得，$I = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {3 \sin x - \sin 3 x}{c x ^ {k}} \xlongequal {\text {洛 必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {3 \cos x - 3 \cos 3 x}{k c x ^ {k - 1}}.$由于$I = 1$，而$\lim_{x\to 0}(3\cos x - 3\cos 3x) = 0$，故$k > 1$，否则$I = 0.$当$k > 1$时，继续对（1）式使用洛必达法则可得，$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {3 \cos x - 3 \cos 3 x}{k c x ^ {k - 1}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {- 3 \sin x + 9 \sin 3 x}{k (k - 1) c x ^ {k - 2}}.$由于$I = 1$，而$\lim_{x\to 0}(-3\sin x + 9\sin 3x) = 0$，故$k > 2$，否则$I = 0.$当$k > 2$时，继续对（2）式使用洛必达法则可得，$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {- 3 \sin x + 9 \sin 3 x}{k (k - 1) c x ^ {k - 2}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {- 3 \cos x + 2 7 \cos 3 x}{k (k - 1) (k - 2) c x ^ {k - 3}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {2 4}{k (k - 1) (k - 2) c x ^ {k - 3}}.$若 I=1，则 k=3，否则当 k<3时，I=0；当 k>3时，$I=\infty$.进一步可得$3\times 2\times c=2 4$从而 c=4.应选C.

questionText:
已知函数$f ( x )=\frac{1+x}{\sin x}-\frac{1}{x}$，记 a =$\lim_{x\to 0}f(x).$I. 求 a的值；

II. 若当$x\to0$时，$f(x)-a$与$x^{k}$是同阶无穷小量，求常数 k的值.
analysisRich:
解（I）$\lim_{x\to 0}f(x)$为$\infty -\infty$型未定式，可通分写成$\frac{0}{0}$型未定式.$a = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left(\frac {1 + x}{\sin x} - \frac {1}{x}\right) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x ^ {2} + x - \sin x}{x \sin x} \xlongequal {\sin x \sim x} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x ^ {2} + x - \sin x}{x ^ {2}}.$考虑$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x-\sin x}{x^{2}}.$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \sin x}{x ^ {2}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - \cos x}{2 x} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\sin x}{2} = 0.$或者，利用$\sin x=x-\frac{x^{3}}{6}+o\left(x^{3}\right)$可得$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \sin x}{x ^ {2}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\frac {x ^ {3}}{6} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right)}{x ^ {2}} = 0.$因此，$a = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x ^ {2} + x - \sin x}{x ^ {2}} = 1 + \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \sin x}{x ^ {2}} = 1 + 0 = 1.$（Ⅱ）由第（I）问得，$a=\lim_{x\to 0}f(x)=1$，故$\lim_{x\to 0}[f(x)-1] = 0.$若$f ( x ) - 1$与$x^{k}$是$x\to 0$时的同阶无穷小量，则$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x)-1}{x^k}$为一非零常数.$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x) - 1}{x ^ {k}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x ^ {2} + x - \sin x - x \sin x}{x ^ {k + 1} \sin x} \xlongequal {\sin x \sim x} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x ^ {2} + x - \sin x - x \sin x}{x ^ {k + 2}}.$下面用两种方法来求上面的极限.

（法一）利用洛必达法则.$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x ^ {2} + x - \sin x - x \sin x}{x ^ {k + 2}} &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {(1 + x) (x - \sin x)}{x ^ {k + 2}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \sin x}{x ^ {k + 2}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - \cos x}{(k + 2) x ^ {k + 1}} \\ \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\sin x}{(k + 2) (k + 1) x ^ {k}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\cos x}{(k + 2) (k + 1) k x ^ {k - 1}} \\ &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1}{(k + 2) (k + 1) k x ^ {k - 1}} = c. \end{aligned}$要使上面的极限等于非零常数$c, x^{k - 1}$必须等于1，即$k = 1$. 此时$c = \frac{1}{6}$.

（法二）利用等价无穷小替换.$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x ^ {2} + x - \sin x - x \sin x}{x ^ {k + 2}} &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {(1 + x) (x - \sin x)}{x ^ {k + 2}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \sin x}{x ^ {k + 2}} \\ \frac {x - \sin x - \frac {x ^ {3}}{6}}{\frac {1}{6}} \frac {1}{6} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x ^ {3}}{x ^ {k + 2}} &= c. \end{aligned}$若$k+2<3$，则$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x^{3}}{x^{k+2}}=0$；若$k+2>3$，则$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x^{3}}{x^{k+2}}=\infty$；若$k+2=3$，则$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x^{3}}{x^{3}}=1.$因此，$k+2=3$，$c=\frac{1}{6}$，即$k=1$，$c=\frac{1}{6}.$

questionText: 当$x\to0$时，$1-\cos x\cdot\cos 2x\cdot\cos 3x$与$ax^{n}$为等价无穷小量，求 n与 a的值.
analysisRich:
解记$I=\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{1-\cos x\cos 2x\cos 3x}{a x^{n}}.$由题设，$I=1.$（法一）分别考虑$\cos x,\cos 2x,\cos 3x$的二阶泰勒公式，$\cos x = 1 - \frac {1}{2} x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right),$$\cos 2 x = 1 - \frac {1}{2} (2 x) ^ {2} + o \left(\left(2 x\right) ^ {2}\right) = 1 - 2 x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right),$$\cos 3 x = 1 - \frac {1}{2} (3 x) ^ {2} + o \left(\left(3 x\right) ^ {2}\right) = 1 - \frac {9}{2} x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right).$由于$o\left(x^{2}\right)\cdot x^{n}$仍为$o\left(x^{2}\right)\left(n\geqslant 0\right)$，故$\begin{array}{l} \cos x \cos 2 x \cos 3 x = \left(1 - \frac {1}{2} x ^ {2}\right) \left(1 - 2 x ^ {2}\right) \left(1 - \frac {9}{2} x ^ {2}\right) + o \left(x ^ {2}\right) \\ = 1 - \frac {1}{2} x ^ {2} - 2 x ^ {2} - \frac {9}{2} x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right). \\ \end{array}$代人I，得$\begin{array}{l} I = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - \left[ 1 - \frac {1}{2} x ^ {2} - 2 x ^ {2} - \frac {9}{2} x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right)\right]}{a x ^ {n}} \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\frac {1}{2} x ^ {2} + 2 x ^ {2} + \frac {9}{2} x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{a x ^ {n}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {7 x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{a x ^ {n}}. \\ \end{array}$由于$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {7 x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{a x ^ {n}} = \frac {7}{a} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x ^ {2}}{x ^ {n}} \left[ 1 + \frac {o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{7 x ^ {2}} \right] = \frac {7}{a} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x ^ {2}}{x ^ {n}},$故当 n > 2时，$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{7x^{2}+o\left(x^{2}\right)}{ax^{n}}=\infty$；当 n < 2时，$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{7x^{2}+o\left(x^{2}\right)}{ax^{n}}=0$；而当 n = 2时，$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{7x^{2}+o\left(x^{2}\right)}{ax^{2}}$$= \frac{7}{a}$.因此，由 I = 1得，$\frac{7}{a}=1$，a=7.

综上所述，$n=2$a=7.

（法二）我们先利用三角函数的积化和差公式将$\cos x\cos 2x\cos 3x$作恒等变形，然后再利用洛必达法则来计算 I.

由积化和差公式，我们有$\begin{array}{l} \cos x \cos 2 x \cos 3 x = \frac {1}{2} (\cos 4 x + \cos 2 x) \cos 2 x = \frac {1}{2} \cos 4 x \cos 2 x + \frac {1}{2} \cos^ {2} 2 x \\ = \frac {1}{4} (\cos 6 x + \cos 2 x) + \frac {1}{4} \cos 4 x + \frac {1}{4} \\ = \frac {1}{4} (1 + \cos 2 x + \cos 4 x + \cos 6 x). \\ \end{array}$从而，$I = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\frac {3}{4} - \frac {1}{4} \left(\cos 2 x + \cos 4 x + \cos 6 x\right)}{a x ^ {n}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\frac {1}{4} \left(2 \sin 2 x + 4 \sin 4 x + 6 \sin 6 x\right)}{n a x ^ {n - 1}}.$由于$\lim_{x\to 0}(2\sin 2x+4\sin 4x+6\sin 6x)=0$，而 I=1，故$\lim_{x\to 0}nax^{n-1}=0$，于是 n > 1.否则当 n≤1时， I=0，与 I=1矛盾.

当$n > 1$时，继续使用洛必达法则可得，$I \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\cos 2 x + 4 \cos 4 x + 9 \cos 6 x}{n (n - 1) a x ^ {n - 2}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 4}{n (n - 1) a x ^ {n - 2}}.$若 I存在且等于1，则 n-2=0.否则当 n-2<0时，I=0；当 n-2>0时，$I=\infty$.当 n=2时，$I=\frac{14}{2a}=1$，a=7.

综上所述，n=2,a=7.

（法三）使用添项、减项的技巧对$I$进行恒等变形.$\begin{array}{l} I = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - \cos x + \cos x - \cos x \cos 2 x + \cos x \cos 2 x - \cos x \cos 2 x \cos 3 x}{a x ^ {n}} \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left[ \frac {1 - \cos x}{a x ^ {n}} + \frac {\cos x (1 - \cos 2 x)}{a x ^ {n}} + \frac {\cos x \cos 2 x (1 - \cos 3 x)}{a x ^ {n}} \right]. \\ \mathrm {虑} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - \cos x}{\cos x (1 - \cos 2 x)}. \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\cos x \cos 2 x (1 - \cos 3 x)}{\cos x \cos 2 x (1 - \cos 3 x)}. \\ \end{array}$分别考虑$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{1-\cos x}{ax^{n}}, \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\cos x(1-\cos 2x)}{ax^{n}}, \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\cos x\cos 2x(1-\cos 3x)}{ax^{n}}.$由于当$x\to 0$时，$\cos x\to 1,1 - \cos x\sim \frac{x^2}{2}$，故这三个极限均仅当$n = 2$时存在且不为零.当$n > 2$时，极限为$\infty$；当$n < 2$时，极限为零.

当 n=2时，$\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - \cos x}{a x ^ {2}} \xlongequal {1 - \cos x \sim \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}} \frac {1}{2 a}, \quad \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\cos x (1 - \cos 2 x)}{a x ^ {2}} \xlongequal {1 - \cos 2 x \sim \frac {(2 x) ^ {2}}{2}} \frac {2}{a}, \\ \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\cos x \cos 2 x (1 - \cos 3 x)}{a x ^ {2}} \xlongequal {1 - \cos 3 x \sim \frac {(3 x) ^ {2}}{2}} \frac {9}{2 a}. \\ I = \frac {1}{2 a} + \frac {2}{a} + \frac {9}{2 a} = \frac {7}{a} = 1. \\ \end{array}$因此，$n=2$，$a=7.$

questionText: 设 p(x)=a+bx+cx²+dx³. 当 x→0时，若 p(x)-tanx是比$x^{3}$高阶的无穷小量，则下列选项中错误的是（    )
analysisRich:
解（法一）写出$\tan x$在$x=0$处的三阶泰勒公式.$\tan x = \left(\tan x\right) ^ {\prime} \left| _ {x = 0} \cdot x + \frac {1}{2 !} \left(\tan x\right) ^ {\prime \prime} \right| _ {x = 0} \cdot x ^ {2} + \frac {1}{3 !} \left(\tan x\right) ^ {\prime \prime \prime} \left| _ {x = 0} \cdot x ^ {3} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right). \right.$又由于$(\tan x) ^ {\prime} = \sec^ {2} x, \quad (\tan x) ^ {\prime \prime} = 2 \sec x \cdot \sec x \tan x = 2 \sec^ {2} x \tan x,$$(\tan x) ^ {\prime \prime \prime} = 4 \sec x \cdot \sec x \tan x \cdot \tan x + 2 \sec^ {2} x \cdot \sec^ {2} x,$故$\tan x = x + \frac {1}{3} x ^ {3} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right).$由题设知，$p (x) - \tan x = a + (b - 1) x + c x ^ {2} + \left(d - \frac {1}{3}\right) x ^ {3} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right) = o \left(x ^ {3}\right).$从而$a = 0, \quad b - 1 = 0, \quad c = 0, \quad d - \frac {1}{3} = 0.$因此，$a = 0, \quad b = 1, \quad c = 0, \quad d = \frac {1}{3}.$（法二）由已知条件知

从而选项 D 不正确.应选 D.$\begin{array}{l} 0 = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\left(a + b x + c x ^ {2} + d x ^ {3}\right) - \tan x}{x ^ {3}} (\mathrm {分 母 趋 于 零 , 故 分 子 也 趋 于 零 , 从 而} a = 0) \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {b x + c x ^ {2} + d x ^ {3} - \tan x}{x ^ {3}} \\ \mathrm {洛必达} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {b + 2 c x + 3 d x ^ {2} - \sec^ {2} x}{3 x ^ {2}} (\mathrm {分 母 趋 于 零 , 故 分 子 也 趋 于 零 , 从 而} b = 1) \\ \mathrm {洛必达} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {2 c + 6 d x - 2 \sec^ {2} x \tan x}{6 x} (\mathrm {同 上 可 知} c = 0) \\ \mathrm {洛必达} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {6 d - 4 \sec^ {2} x \tan^ {2} x - 2 \sec^ {4} x}{6} = \frac {6 d - 2}{6}. \\ \end{array}$或者在得到$c = 0$后，利用等价无穷小替换$\tan x\sim x$，得$\text {原 式} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {6 d x - 2 \sec^ {2} x \tan x}{6 x} = d - \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {2 \sec^ {2} x \tan x}{6 x} = d - \frac {1}{3}.$解得$d = \frac{1}{3}$因此，$a=0,b=1,c=0,d=\frac{1}{3}$应选D.

questionText: 当$x \to 0^{+}$时，若$\ln^{\alpha}(1+2x),(1-\cos x)^{\frac{1}{\alpha}}$均是比 x高阶的无穷小量，则$\alpha$的取值范围是（    ）
analysisRich: 解 当$x\to0^{+}$时，$\ln(1+2x)\sim2x,1-\cos x\sim\frac{1}{2}x^{2}.$若$\ln^{\alpha}(1+2x)$和$(1-\cos x)^{\frac{1}{\alpha}}$均为比x高阶的无穷小量，则$(2x)^{\alpha}$与$\left(\frac{1}{2} x^{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{\alpha}}$也均为比x高阶的无穷小量，即$\left\{\begin{array}{l l} {\alpha>1,} \\ {\frac{2}{\alpha}>1,} \end{array} \right.$解得$1<\alpha<2.$应选B.

questionText: 设函数$f(x)=x+a\ln(1+x)+bx\sin x,g(x)=kx^{3}.$若 f(x)与 g(x)在$x\rightarrow0$时是等价无穷小，求 a,b,k的值.
analysisRich:
（法一）首先，$k\neq 0.$由于 g(x）中 x的次数为3，故可考虑写出 f(x)在 x=0处的3阶泰勒公式由$\ln (1 + x) = x - \frac {x ^ {2}}{2} + \frac {x ^ {3}}{3} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right), \quad \sin x = x - \frac {x ^ {3}}{3 !} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right),$可得$f (x) = x + a x - \frac {a x ^ {2}}{2} + \frac {a x ^ {3}}{3} + b x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right) = (a + 1) x + \left(b - \frac {a}{2}\right) x ^ {2} + \frac {a}{3} x ^ {3} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right).$记$I=\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x)}{g(x)}=\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{(a+1)x+\left(b-\frac{a}{2}\right)x^{2}+\frac{a}{3}x^{3}+o\left(x^{3}\right)}{kx^{3}}.$由等价无穷小量的定义知 I=1.

于是，$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}a+1=0,\\ b-\frac{a}{2}=0,\end{array}\right.$否则 I=$\infty$.解得 a=-1，b=-$\frac{1}{2}$.又因为 I=1，所以$\frac{a}{3}=k$，k=-$\frac{1}{3}$.

综上所述， a=-1，b=-$\frac{1}{2}$，k=-$\frac{1}{3}$（法二）记$I=\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x)}{g(x)}.$由等价无穷小量的定义知$I=1.$下面使用洛必达法则来讨论I.

首先，$k\neq 0$当$k\neq 0$时，$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x)}{g(x)}$是$\frac{0}{0}$型未定式.由洛必达法则得，$I = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x + a \ln (1 + x) + b x \sin x}{k x ^ {3}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 + \frac {a}{1 + x} + b \sin x + b x \cos x}{3 k x ^ {2}}.$由于$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left(1 + \frac {a}{1 + x} + b \sin x + b x \cos x\right) = 1 + a,$故若$1 + a\neq 0$，则$I = \infty$，与题设矛盾.因此，$a = -1.$代入$a = -1$，继续对（1）式使用洛必达法则，

(1)$\text {式} \stackrel {\text {洛必达}} {=} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\frac {1}{(1 + x) ^ {2}} + b \cos x + b \cos x - b x \sin x}{6 k x}.$由于$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left[ \frac {1}{(1 + x) ^ {2}} + 2 b \cos x - b x \sin x \right] = 1 + 2 b,$故若$1 + 2b\neq 0$，则$I = \infty$，与题设矛盾.因此，$b = -\frac{1}{2}$代入 b=-$\frac{1}{2}$，继续对（2）式使用洛必达法则，

(2)$\text {式} \stackrel {\text {洛必达}} {=} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {- \frac {2}{(1 + x) ^ {3}} + \sin x + \frac {1}{2} \sin x + \frac {1}{2} x \cos x}{6 k} = \frac {- 2}{6 k} = 1.$因此，$k = -\frac{1}{3}$综上所述，$a=-1$$b=-\frac{1}{2}$$k=-\frac{1}{3}.$

questionText: 若$\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\left(\frac{1-\tan x}{1+\tan x}\right)^{\frac{1}{\sin k x}}=\mathrm{e}$，则 k= ___
analysisRich: 解（法一）对原极限进行恒等变形，再凑重要极限.$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left(\frac {1 - \tan x}{1 + \tan x}\right) ^ {\frac {1}{\sin k x}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left(1 - \frac {2 \tan x}{1 + \tan x}\right) ^ {\frac {1}{\sin k x}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left(1 - \frac {2 \tan x}{1 + \tan x}\right) ^ {\frac {1 + \tan x}{- 2 \tan x} \cdot \frac {- 2 \tan x}{1 + \tan x} \cdot \frac {1}{\sin k x}}.$因为$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left(\frac {- 2 \tan x}{1 + \tan x} \cdot \frac {1}{\sin k x}\right) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {- 2 \tan x}{\sin k x} \frac {\tan x \sim x}{\sin k x \sim k x} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {- 2 x}{k x} = - \frac {2}{k},$所以原极限$= \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{2}{k}} = \mathrm{e}.$因此，$-\frac{2}{k} = 1,k = -2.$（法二）取对数，再求极限.$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left(\frac {1 - \tan x}{1 + \tan x}\right) ^ {\frac {1}{\sin k x}} &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{\sin k x} \cdot \ln \left(\frac {1 - \tan x}{1 + \tan x}\right)} = \mathrm {e} ^ {\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1}{\sin k x} \cdot \ln \left(1 - \frac {2 \tan x}{1 + \tan x}\right)} \\ \frac {\ln \left(1 - \frac {2 \tan x}{1 + \tan x}\right) \sim \frac {- 2 \tan x}{1 + \tan x}}{\frac {\tan x \sim x}{\sin k x \sim k x}} \mathrm {e} ^ {\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {- 2 x}{k x}} &= \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {2}{k}}. \end{aligned}$由于原极限$= \mathrm{e}$，故$-\frac{2}{k} = 1$，即$k = -2.$

questionText: 已知实数 a,b满足$\lim_{x\rightarrow +\infty}[(ax+b)\mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{x}}-x]=2$，求 a,b.
analysisRich:
解（法一）令$t=\frac{1}{x}$，则$\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} [ (a x + b) \mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{x}} - x ] = \lim _ {t \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \left[ \left(\frac {a}{t} + b\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {t} - \frac {1}{t} \right] = \lim _ {t \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {(a + b t) \mathrm {e} ^ {t} - 1}{t} = 2.$由于$t\to 0^{+}$，而$\lim_{t\to 0^{+}}\frac{(a+bt)\mathrm{e}^{t}-1}{t}=2$，故$\lim_{t\to 0^{+}}[(a+bt)\mathrm{e}^{t}-1]=a-1=0.$，$a=1.$将 a=1 代入$\lim_{t\to 0^{+}}\frac{(a+bt)\mathrm{e}^{t}-1}{t}$，可得$\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {t \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {(a + b t) \mathrm {e} ^ {t} - 1}{t} = \lim _ {t \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {(1 + b t) \mathrm {e} ^ {t} - 1}{t} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {t \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} [ (1 + b t) \mathrm {e} ^ {t} + b \mathrm {e} ^ {t} ] \\ = \lim _ {t \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} (1 + b + b t) \mathrm {e} ^ {t} = 1 + b = 2. \\ \end{array}$于是，$b=1.$因此，$a=1$$b=1.$（法二）利用泰勒公式.

当$x\to +\infty$时，$\frac{1}{x}\to 0^{+}$.于是，$\mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{x}}=1+\frac{1}{x}+o\left(\frac{1}{x}\right).$$\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} [ (a x + b) \mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {1}{x}} - x ] = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \left\{(a x + b) \left[ 1 + \frac {1}{x} + o \left(\frac {1}{x}\right)\right] - x \right\} \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \left[ a x + b + a + \frac {b}{x} + o (1) + o \left(\frac {1}{x}\right) - x \right] \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} [ (a - 1) x + a + b ]. \\ \end{array}$当且仅当$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}a-1=0,\\ a+b=2,\end{array}\right.$即$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}a=1,\\ b=1\end{array}\right.$时，$\lim_{x\to +\infty}[(a-1)x+a+b]=2.$因此，$a=1$$b=1.$

questionText: 若$\lim_{x\rightarrow 0} \left( \mathrm{e}^{x}+a x^{2}+b x\right)^{\frac{1}{x^{2}}}=1$，则（    ）
analysisRich:
解 记$I = \lim_{x\to 0}\left(\mathrm{e}^{x} + ax^{2} + bx\right)^{\frac{1}{x^{2}}}$.

对原极限进行恒等变形，再凑重要极限.$\begin{aligned} I &= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left(1 + \mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1 + a x ^ {2} + b x\right) ^ {\frac {1}{x ^ {2}}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left(1 + \mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1 + a x ^ {2} + b x\right) ^ {\frac {1}{\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1 + a x ^ {2} + b x}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1 + a x ^ {2} + b x}{x ^ {2}} \\ &= \mathrm {e} ^ {\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1 + a x ^ {2} + b x}{x ^ {2}}}. \end{aligned}$由于$I = 1$，故$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\mathrm{e}^{x}-1+ax^{2}+bx}{x^{2}}=0.$又因为$\mathrm{e}^{x}$在 x=0处的二阶泰勒公式为$\mathrm{e}^{x}=1+x+\frac{x^{2}}{2}+o\left(x^{2}\right)$，所以$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 1 + a x ^ {2} + b x}{x ^ {2}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {(1 + b) x + \left(\frac {1}{2} + a\right) x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{x ^ {2}}.$当且仅当$1 + b = 0, \frac{1}{2} + a = 0$，即$b = -1$，$a = -\frac{1}{2}$时，$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\mathrm{e}^{x} - 1 + ax^{2} + bx}{x^{2}} = 0.$因此，$a=-\frac{1}{2}$$b=-1$应选B.

questionText: 当 x→0时，若 x-tanx与$x^{k}$是同阶无穷小，则 k=（    ）
analysisRich:
解 首先，由于当 x→0时，$x-\tan x\to 0$，而$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x-\tan x}{x^{k}}$为非零常数，故 k > 0.下面用两种方法讨论$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x-\tan x}{x^{k}}.$（法一）由于$\tan x=x+\frac{x^{3}}{3}+o\left(x^{3}\right)$，故$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \tan x}{x ^ {k}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {- \frac {x ^ {3}}{3} + o \left(x ^ {3}\right)}{x ^ {k}}.$当 k > 3时，该极限为$\infty$；当 0 < k < 3时，该极限为0；当 k=3时，该极限为$-\frac{1}{3}.$于是，$x-\tan x$与$x^{3}$是同阶无穷小，k=3.

因此，应选C.

（法二）利用洛必达法则讨论$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x-\tan x}{x^{k}}.$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - \tan x}{x ^ {k}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - \sec^ {2} x}{k x ^ {k - 1}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {- \tan^ {2} x}{k x ^ {k - 1}} \xlongequal {\tan x \sim x} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {- x ^ {2}}{k x ^ {k - 1}}.$当 k > 3时，该极限为$\infty$；当 0 < k < 3时，该极限为0；当 k=3时，该极限为$-\frac{1}{3}.$于是，$x-\tan x$与$x^{3}$是同阶无穷小， k=3.

因此，应选C.

questionText: 已知 a,b为常数，若$\left( 1+\frac{1}{n}\right)^{n}-\mathrm{e}$与$\frac{b}{n^{a}}$在 n$\to\infty$时是等价无穷小，求 a,b.
analysisRich: 解 由$\left( 1+\frac{1}{n}\right)^{n}-\mathrm{e}$与$\frac{b}{n^{a}}$在$n\to \infty$时是等价无穷小可知，$a > 0,b\neq 0.$并且，$\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {\left(1 + \frac {1}{n}\right) ^ {n} - e}{\frac {b}{n ^ {a}}} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {n \ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{n}\right)} - \mathrm {e}}{\frac {b}{n ^ {a}}} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {\mathrm {e} \left[ \mathrm {e} ^ {n \ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{n}\right)} - 1 \right]}{\frac {b}{n ^ {a}}} \\ \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {n \ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{n}\right) - 1} - 1 \sim n \ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{n}\right) - 1}{\mathrm {e} \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {n \ln \left(1 + \frac {1}{n}\right) - 1}{\frac {b}{n ^ {a}}}} \\ \frac {t = \frac {1}{n}}{\mathrm {e} \lim _ {t \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\ln (1 + t)}{t} - 1} = \mathrm {e} \lim _ {t \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\ln (1 + t) - t}{b t ^ {a + 1}} \\ \frac {\ln (1 + t) = t - \frac {t ^ {2}}{2} + o \left(t ^ {2}\right)}{\mathrm {e} \lim _ {t \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \frac {- \frac {t ^ {2}}{2} + o \left(t ^ {2}\right)}{b t ^ {a + 1}}} = 1. \\ \end{array}$当 a < 1时，$\lim_{t\rightarrow 0^{+}}\frac{-\frac{t^{2}}{2}+o\left(t^{2}\right)}{b t^{a+1}}=0$；当 a > 1时，$\lim_{t\rightarrow 0^{+}}\frac{-\frac{t^{2}}{2}+o\left(t^{2}\right)}{b t^{a+1}}=\infty$；当且仅当 a = 1时，$\lim_{t\rightarrow 0^{+}}\frac{-\frac{t^{2}}{2}+o\left(t^{2}\right)}{b t^{2}}$为非零常数.此时，e$\lim_{t\rightarrow 0^{+}}\frac{-\frac{t^{2}}{2}+o\left(t^{2}\right)}{b t^{2}}=-\frac{\mathrm{e}}{2}\cdot \frac{1}{b}=1.$解得 b = -$\frac{\mathrm{e}}{2}.$因此，a = 1,b = -$\frac{\mathrm{e}}{2}.$

questionText: 已知$\lim_{x\to 0}\left[a\arctan \frac{1}{x}+(1+|x|)^{\frac{1}{x}}\right]$存在，求 a的值.
analysisRich: 解分别计算$\lim_{x\to 0^{-}}\left[\alpha\arctan \frac{1}{x}+(1+|x|)^{\frac{1}{x}}\right]$和$\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\left[\alpha\arctan \frac{1}{x}+(1+|x|)^{\frac{1}{x}}\right].$$\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {-}} \left[ \alpha \arctan \frac {1}{x} + (1 + | x |) ^ {\frac {1}{x}} \right] = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {-}} \alpha \arctan \frac {1}{x} + \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {-}} (1 + | x |) ^ {\frac {1}{x}} \\ = - \frac {\pi}{2} \alpha + \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {-}} (1 - x) ^ {\frac {1}{x}} \\ = - \frac {\pi}{2} \alpha + \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {-}} (1 - x) ^ {- \frac {1}{x} \cdot (- 1)} \\ = - \frac {\pi}{2} \alpha + \frac {1}{\mathrm {e}}. \\ \end{array}$$\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \left[ \alpha \arctan \frac {1}{x} + (1 + | x |) ^ {\frac {1}{x}} \right] = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \alpha \arctan \frac {1}{x} + \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} (1 + | x |) ^ {\frac {1}{x}} \\ = \frac {\pi}{2} \alpha + \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} (1 + x) ^ {\frac {1}{x}} \\ = \frac {\pi}{2} \alpha + \mathrm {e}. \\ \end{array}$由于极限$\lim_{x\to 0}\left[ \alpha \arctan \frac{1}{x}+(1+|x|)^{\frac{1}{x}} \right]$存在，故$- \frac {\pi}{2} \alpha + \frac {1}{\mathrm {e}} = \frac {\pi}{2} \alpha + \mathrm {e}.$解得$\alpha =\frac{1}{\pi}\left(\frac{1}{e}-e\right).$

questionText: 当$x \to0$时，函数$f(x)=ax+bx^{2}+\ln(1+x)$与$g(x)=\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}-\cos x$是等价无穷小，则 ab=___
analysisRich: 解分别写出$f ( x )$与$g ( x )$在$x=0$处的二阶泰勒公式.当$x\to0$时，$f (x) = a x + b x ^ {2} + x - \frac {1}{2} x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right) = (a + 1) x + \left(b - \frac {1}{2}\right) x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right),$$g (x) = 1 + x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right) - \left[ 1 - \frac {1}{2} x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right) \right] = \frac {3}{2} x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right).$由于$f(x)$与$g(x)$是$x\to 0$时的等价无穷小，故$1 = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x)}{g (x)} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {(a + 1) x + \left(b - \frac {1}{2}\right) x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}{\frac {3}{2} x ^ {2} + o \left(x ^ {2}\right)}.$由（1）式成立可得$a+1=0,b-\frac{1}{2}=\frac{3}{2}.$解得$a=-1,b=2.$因此，$ab=-2.$

questionText: 设$z=(x+\mathrm{e}^{y})^{x}$，则$\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(1,0)}=$___
analysisRich: （法一）在点（1，0）附近，$x > 0$，从而$x+\mathrm{e}^{y}>0, z>0.$对$z=(x+\mathrm{e}^{y})^{x}$两端取对数得到$\ln z = x \ln \left(x + \mathrm {e} ^ {y}\right).$对上式两端关于 x求导得，$\frac {1}{z} \cdot \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = \ln \left(x + \mathrm {e} ^ {y}\right) + \frac {x}{x + \mathrm {e} ^ {y}}.$当$x = 1$，$y = 0$时，$z = 2.$因此，$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(1,0)} = 2\left(\ln 2 + \frac{1}{2}\right) = 2\ln 2 + 1.$（法二）将$y = 0$代入$z = (x + \mathrm{e}^{y})^{x}$中得到$z(x,0) = (x + 1)^{x}$.于是，$\left. \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} \right| _ {(1, 0)} = \frac {\mathrm {d} \left[ (x + 1) ^ {x} \right]}{\mathrm {d} x} \Bigg | _ {x = 1} = \left[ \mathrm {e} ^ {x \ln (x + 1)} \right] ^ {\prime} \Bigg | _ {x = 1} = \mathrm {e} ^ {x \ln (x + 1)} \left[ \ln (x + 1) + \frac {x}{x + 1} \right] \Bigg | _ {x = 1} = 2 \ln 2 + 1.$

解 下面的$f_{i}^{\prime}, f_{ij}^{\prime \prime}(i,j = 1,2,3)$分别表示$f_{i}^{\prime}(x + y,x - y,xy),f_{ij}^{\prime \prime}(x + y,x - y,$（法一）将中间变量$x + y,x - y,xy$依次记为1，2，3号.利用链式法则，计算$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x},\frac{\partial z}{\partial y},\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}$$\frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = f _ {1} ^ {\prime} \frac {\partial (x + y)}{\partial x} + f _ {2} ^ {\prime} \frac {\partial (x - y)}{\partial x} + f _ {3} ^ {\prime} \frac {\partial (x y)}{\partial x} = f _ {1} ^ {\prime} + f _ {2} ^ {\prime} + y f _ {3} ^ {\prime},$$\frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = f _ {1} ^ {\prime} \frac {\partial (x + y)}{\partial y} + f _ {2} ^ {\prime} \frac {\partial (x - y)}{\partial y} + f _ {3} ^ {\prime} \frac {\partial (x y)}{\partial y} = f _ {1} ^ {\prime} - f _ {2} ^ {\prime} + x f _ {3} ^ {\prime}.$因为$\mathrm{d}z = \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\mathrm{d}x + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\mathrm{d}y$，所以$\mathrm {d} z = \left(f _ {1} ^ {\prime} + f _ {2} ^ {\prime} + y f _ {3} ^ {\prime}\right) \mathrm {d} x + \left(f _ {1} ^ {\prime} - f _ {2} ^ {\prime} + x f _ {3} ^ {\prime}\right) \mathrm {d} y.$$\begin{aligned} \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x \partial y} &= \frac {\partial \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial x}\right)}{\partial y} = \frac {\partial f _ {1} ^ {\prime}}{\partial y} + \frac {\partial f _ {2} ^ {\prime}}{\partial y} + \frac {\partial \left(y f _ {3} ^ {\prime}\right)}{\partial y} \\ &= f _ {1 1} ^ {\prime \prime} \frac {\partial (x + y)}{\partial y} + f _ {1 2} ^ {\prime \prime} \frac {\partial (x - y)}{\partial y} + f _ {2 3} ^ {\prime \prime} \frac {\partial (x y)}{\partial y} \\ + y f _ {3 1} ^ {\prime \prime} \frac {\partial (x + y)}{\partial y} + y f _ {3 2} ^ {\prime \prime} \frac {\partial (x - y)}{\partial y} + y f _ {3 3} ^ {\prime \prime} \frac {\partial (x y)}{\partial y} + f _ {3} ^ {\prime} \\ &= f _ {1 1} ^ {\prime \prime} - f _ {1 2} ^ {\prime \prime} + x f _ {1 3} ^ {\prime \prime} + f _ {2 1} ^ {\prime \prime} - f _ {2 2} ^ {\prime \prime} + x f _ {2 3} ^ {\prime \prime} + y f _ {3 1} ^ {\prime \prime} - y f _ {3 2} ^ {\prime \prime} + x y f _ {3 3} ^ {\prime \prime} + f _ {3} ^ {\prime} \end{aligned}$由于$f$的二阶偏导数连续，故$f_{12}^{\prime \prime} = f_{21}^{\prime \prime}, f_{13}^{\prime \prime} = f_{31}^{\prime \prime}, f_{23}^{\prime \prime} = f_{32}^{\prime \prime}$. 因此，$\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x \partial y} = f _ {3} ^ {\prime} + f _ {1 1} ^ {\prime \prime} + (x + y) f _ {1 3} ^ {\prime \prime} - f _ {2 2} ^ {\prime \prime} + (x - y) f _ {2 3} ^ {\prime \prime} + x y f _ {3 3} ^ {\prime \prime}.$（法二）利用全微分形式的不变性.

由于$f$具有二阶连续偏导数，故$z,\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}$均可微.$\begin{aligned} \mathrm {d} z &= f _ {1} ^ {\prime} \mathrm {d} (x + y) + f _ {2} ^ {\prime} \mathrm {d} (x - y) + f _ {3} ^ {\prime} \mathrm {d} (x y) = f _ {1} ^ {\prime} \mathrm {d} x + f _ {1} ^ {\prime} \mathrm {d} y + f _ {2} ^ {\prime} \mathrm {d} x - f _ {2} ^ {\prime} \mathrm {d} y + y f _ {3} ^ {\prime} \mathrm {d} x + x f _ {3} ^ {\prime} \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \left(f _ {1} ^ {\prime} + f _ {2} ^ {\prime} + y f _ {3} ^ {\prime}\right) \mathrm {d} x + \left(f _ {1} ^ {\prime} - f _ {2} ^ {\prime} + x f _ {3} ^ {\prime}\right) \mathrm {d} y. \end{aligned}$因此，$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f_1^{\prime} + f_2^{\prime} + yf_3^{\prime}$.

questionText: 设函数 z=z(x,y)由方程$F\left( \frac{y}{x},\frac{z}{x} \right)=0$确定，其中 F为可微函数，且$F_{2}^{\prime}\neq0$，则$x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=$(    )
analysisRich: 解 对方程$F\left(\frac{y}{x},\frac{z}{x}\right)=0$两端同时关于x，y求偏导数，可得$- \frac {y}{x ^ {2}} F _ {1} ^ {\prime} + \left(- \frac {z}{x ^ {2}} + \frac {1}{x} \cdot \frac {\partial z}{\partial x}\right) F _ {2} ^ {\prime} = 0, \quad \frac {F _ {1} ^ {\prime}}{x} + \frac {F _ {2} ^ {\prime}}{x} \cdot \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = 0.$由上面两个方程解得，$\frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac {\frac {y}{x} F _ {1} ^ {\prime} + \frac {z}{x} F _ {2} ^ {\prime}}{F _ {2} ^ {\prime}}, \quad \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = - \frac {F _ {1} ^ {\prime}}{F _ {2} ^ {\prime}}.$因此，$x \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac {y F _ {1} ^ {\prime} + z F _ {2} ^ {\prime} - y F _ {1} ^ {\prime}}{F _ {2} ^ {\prime}} = z.$应选B.
