questionText: 设函数 u=f(x,y)具有二阶连续偏导数，且满足等式$4\frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial x^{2}}+1 2 \frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial x \partial y}+5 \frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial y^{2}}=0$. 确定 a,b的值，使等式在变换$\xi=x+a y,\eta=x+b y$下简化为$\frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=0.$
answerRich: (19)$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} a = - 2, \\ b = - \frac {2}{5}, \end{array} \right. \text {或} \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} a = - \frac {2}{5}, \\ b = - 2. \end{array} \right.$
analysisRich: 解 由$\left\{\begin{array}{l l} {\xi=x+ay,} \\ {\eta=x+by,} \end{array} \right.$得$\left\{\begin{array}{l l} {x=\frac{a\eta-b\xi}{a-b},} \\ {y=\frac{\xi-\eta}{a-b}.} \end{array} \right.$注意到$u=f(x,y)$具有二阶连续偏导数.由链式法则，当 a≠b时，$u=f(x(\xi,\eta),y(\xi,\eta))$仍具有关于$\xi,\eta$的二阶连续偏导数，从而$\frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=\frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}.$由链式法则可得，$\frac {\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac {\partial u}{\partial \xi} \frac {\partial \xi}{\partial x} + \frac {\partial u}{\partial \eta} \frac {\partial \eta}{\partial x} = \frac {\partial u}{\partial \xi} + \frac {\partial u}{\partial \eta},$$\frac {\partial u}{\partial y} = \frac {\partial u}{\partial \xi} \frac {\partial \xi}{\partial y} + \frac {\partial u}{\partial \eta} \frac {\partial \eta}{\partial y} = a \frac {\partial u}{\partial \xi} + b \frac {\partial u}{\partial \eta},$$\begin{aligned} \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial x ^ {2}} &= \frac {\partial \left(\frac {\partial u}{\partial \xi} + \frac {\partial u}{\partial \eta}\right)}{\partial x} = \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi^ {2}} \frac {\partial \xi}{\partial x} + \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} \frac {\partial \eta}{\partial x} + \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \eta \partial \xi} \frac {\partial \xi}{\partial x} + \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \eta^ {2}} \frac {\partial \eta}{\partial x} \\ &= \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi^ {2}} + 2 \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} + \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \eta^ {2}}, \end{aligned}$$\begin{aligned} \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial x \partial y} &= \frac {\partial \left(\frac {\partial u}{\partial \xi} + \frac {\partial u}{\partial \eta}\right)}{\partial y} = \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi^ {2}} \frac {\partial \xi}{\partial y} + \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} \frac {\partial \eta}{\partial y} + \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \eta \partial \xi} \frac {\partial \xi}{\partial y} + \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \eta^ {2}} \frac {\partial \eta}{\partial y} \\ &= a \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi^ {2}} + (a + b) \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} + b \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \eta^ {2}}, \end{aligned}$$\begin{aligned} \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial y ^ {2}} &= \frac {\partial \left(a \frac {\partial u}{\partial \xi} + b \frac {\partial u}{\partial \eta}\right)}{\partial y} = a \left(\frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi^ {2}} \frac {\partial \xi}{\partial y} + \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} \frac {\partial \eta}{\partial y}\right) + b \left(\frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \eta \partial \xi} \frac {\partial \xi}{\partial y} + \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \eta^ {2}} \frac {\partial \eta}{\partial y}\right) \\ &= a ^ {2} \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi^ {2}} + 2 a b \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} + b ^ {2} \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \eta^ {2}}. \end{aligned}$代入$4\frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial x^{2}}+1 2\frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial x \partial y}+5\frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial y^{2}}=0$，整理得$\left(5 a ^ {2} + 1 2 a + 4\right) \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi^ {2}} + \left(5 b ^ {2} + 1 2 b + 4\right) \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \eta^ {2}} + \left[ 8 + 1 2 (a + b) + 1 0 a b \right] \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} = 0.$由上可得，$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 5 a ^ {2} + 1 2 a + 4 = 0, \\ 5 b ^ {2} + 1 2 b + 4 = 0, \\ 8 + 1 2 (a + b) + 1 0 a b \neq 0. \end{array} \right.$解得$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} a = - 2, \\ b = - \frac {2}{5}, \end{array} \right. \quad \text {或} \quad \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} a = - \frac {2}{5}, \\ b = - 2. \end{array} \right.$

questionText: 设函数 F(x,y)$= \int_{0}^{x y}\frac{\sin t}{1+t^{2}}\mathrm{d}t$，则$\left.\frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}}\right|_{x=0,y=2}$ =___
analysisRich:
因此，$\frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}}\bigg|_{x=0 \atop y=2}=4.$解（法一）令$f ( u )=\int_{0}^{u} \frac{\sin t}{1+t^{2}} \mathrm{d} t$，则$f^{\prime}(u)=\frac{\sin u}{1+u^{2}}$，且$F(x,y)=f(xy)$.于是$\frac{\partial F(x,y)}{\partial x}=f^{\prime}(xy)\cdot \frac{\partial(xy)}{\partial x}=\frac{\sin(xy)}{1+x^{2}y^{2}}\cdot y,$$\frac{\partial^{2}F(x,y)}{\partial x^{2}}=y\cdot \frac{y\cos(xy)\cdot(1+x^{2}y^{2})-\sin(xy)\cdot 2xy^{2}}{(1+x^{2}y^{2})^{2}}.$因此，$\left. \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}} \right|_{x=0, y=2}=4.$（法二）先代值再求导.

由于$F ( x, 2 ) = \int_{0}^{2 x} \frac{\sin t}{1 + t^{2}} \mathrm{d} t$，故$\left. \frac {\partial F}{\partial x} \right| _ {y = 2} = 2 \cdot \frac {\sin (2 x)}{1 + 4 x ^ {2}}, \quad \left. \frac {\partial^ {2} F}{\partial x ^ {2}} \right| _ {y = 2} = 2 \cdot \frac {2 \cos (2 x) \cdot \left(1 + 4 x ^ {2}\right) - \sin (2 x) \cdot 8 x}{\left(1 + 4 x ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}}.$

questionText: 已知函数 f(u,v)具有二阶连续偏导数，$f(1,1)=2$是 f(u,v)的极值，$z=f(x+y,f(x,y))$.求$\left.\frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x \partial y}\right|_{(1,1)}.$
analysisRich: 对$z = f(x + y,f(x,y))$两端关于$x$求偏导数得$\frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = f _ {1} ^ {\prime} (x + y, f (x, y)) + f _ {2} ^ {\prime} (x + y, f (x, y)) \cdot f _ {1} ^ {\prime} (x, y).$继续对上式两端关于 y求偏导数得$\begin{array}{l} \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x \partial y} = f _ {1 1} ^ {\prime \prime} (x + y, f (x, y)) + f _ {1 2} ^ {\prime \prime} (x + y, f (x, y)) f _ {2} ^ {\prime} (x, y) \\ + \left[ f _ {2 1} ^ {\prime \prime} (x + y, f (x, y)) + f _ {2 2} ^ {\prime \prime} (x + y, f (x, y)) f _ {2} ^ {\prime} (x, y) \right] f _ {1} ^ {\prime} (x, y) \\ + f _ {2} ^ {\prime} (x + y, f (x, y)) f _ {1 2} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y). \\ \end{array}$由极值的必要条件可知$f_1^{\prime}(1,1) = f_2^{\prime}(1,1) = 0.$将$f(1,1) = 2,f_1^{\prime}(1,1) = f_2^{\prime}(1,1) = 0$代入上式可得$\left. \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x \partial y} \right| _ {(1, 1)} = f _ {1 1} ^ {\prime \prime} (2, 2) + f _ {2} ^ {\prime} (2, 2) f _ {1 2} ^ {\prime \prime} (1, 1).$

questionText: 设函数 f(x,y)可微，且对任意的 x,y都有$\frac{\partial f(x,y)}{\partial x}>0,\frac{\partial f(x,y)}{\partial y}<0$，则使不等式$f(x_{1},y_{1})<f(x_{2},y_{2})$成立的一个充分条件是（    ）
analysisRich: 解 将$f \left(x_{2}, y_{2}\right)-f \left(x_{1}, y_{1}\right)$看作两部分的和，即$f \left(x _ {2}, y _ {2}\right) - f \left(x _ {1}, y _ {1}\right) = f \left(x _ {2}, y _ {2}\right) - f \left(x _ {1}, y _ {2}\right) + f \left(x _ {1}, y _ {2}\right) - f \left(x _ {1}, y _ {1}\right).$$f ( x, y_{2} )$为关于$x$的一元函数.由于$\frac{\partial f(x,y)}{\partial x} > 0$，故当$x_{2} > x_{1}$时，$f \left(x _ {2}, y _ {2}\right) - f \left(x _ {1}, y _ {2}\right) > 0.$$f ( x_{1}, y )$为关于y的一元函数.由于$\frac{\partial f ( x,y)}{\partial y} < 0$，故当$y_{2} < y_{1}$时，$f \left(x _ {1}, y _ {2}\right) - f \left(x _ {1}, y _ {1}\right) > 0.$因此，当$x_{1} < x_{2}, y_{1} > y_{2}$时，$f \left(x _ {2}, y _ {2}\right) - f \left(x _ {1}, y _ {1}\right) = f \left(x _ {2}, y _ {2}\right) - f \left(x _ {1}, y _ {2}\right) + f \left(x _ {1}, y _ {2}\right) - f \left(x _ {1}, y _ {1}\right) > 0.$应选 D.

questionText: 设$z=f\left(\ln x+\frac{1}{y}\right)$，其中函数 f(u)可微，则$x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y^{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=$___
analysisRich: 利用链式法则，$\frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = f ^ {\prime} \left(\ln x + \frac {1}{y}\right) \cdot \frac {1}{x}, \quad \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = f ^ {\prime} \left(\ln x + \frac {1}{y}\right) \cdot \left(- \frac {1}{y ^ {2}}\right).$因此，$x \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + y ^ {2} \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = f ^ {\prime} \left(\ln x + \frac {1}{y}\right) - f ^ {\prime} \left(\ln x + \frac {1}{y}\right) = 0.$

questionText: 设函数$z=z(x,y)$由方程$( z+y )^{x}= x y$确定，则$\left. \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \right|_{(1,2)}=$___
analysisRich: 解 将方程$( z+y)^{x}=xy$化为$\mathrm{e}^{x\ln(z+y)}=xy$，对所得方程两端关于 x求偏导数，可得$\mathrm {e} ^ {x \ln (z + y)} \left[ \ln (z + y) + \frac {x \cdot \frac {\partial z}{\partial x}}{z + y} \right] = y.$当 x=1，y=2时，由原方程可知 z=0，从而由上式可得$\mathrm{e}^{\ln 2}\left(\ln 2+\frac{\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(1,2)}}{2}\right)=2$即$\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(1,2)}= 2(1-\ln 2).$

questionText: 设$z=\frac{y}{x} f(xy)$，其中函数 f可微，则$\frac{x}{y}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=(\quad)$
analysisRich:
解（法一）用链式法则分别求$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x},\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}$$\frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = - \frac {y}{x ^ {2}} f (x y) + \frac {y}{x} f ^ {\prime} (x y) \cdot y = - \frac {y}{x ^ {2}} f (x y) + \frac {y ^ {2}}{x} f ^ {\prime} (x y),$$\frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac {1}{x} f (x y) + \frac {y}{x} f ^ {\prime} (x y) \cdot x = \frac {1}{x} f (x y) + y f ^ {\prime} (x y).$因此，$\frac {x}{y} \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = - \frac {1}{x} f (x y) + y f ^ {\prime} (x y) + \frac {1}{x} f (x y) + y f ^ {\prime} (x y) = 2 y f ^ {\prime} (x y).$应选A.

（法二）利用全微分形式的不变性.$\begin{aligned} \mathrm {d} z &= f (x y) \mathrm {d} \left(\frac {y}{x}\right) + \frac {y}{x} \mathrm {d} [ f (x y) ] \\ &= - \frac {y}{x ^ {2}} f (x y) \mathrm {d} x + \frac {1}{x} f (x y) \mathrm {d} y + \frac {y}{x} f ^ {\prime} (x y) \cdot y \mathrm {d} x + \frac {y}{x} f ^ {\prime} (x y) \cdot x \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \left[ \frac {y ^ {2}}{x} f ^ {\prime} (x y) - \frac {y}{x ^ {2}} f (x y) \right] \mathrm {d} x + \left[ y f ^ {\prime} (x y) + \frac {1}{x} f (x y) \right] \mathrm {d} y. \end{aligned}$因此，$\frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = - \frac {y}{x ^ {2}} f (x y) + \frac {y ^ {2}}{x} f ^ {\prime} (x y), \quad \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac {1}{x} f (x y) + y f ^ {\prime} (x y).$其余同法一.

questionText: 设函数 f（u,v）满足$f \left( x+y, \frac{y}{x} \right)=x^{2}-y^{2}$，则$\left. \frac{\partial f}{\partial u} \right|_{u=1},\left. \frac{\partial f}{\partial v} \right|_{u=1}$依次是（    )
analysisRich:
解（法一）由$u=x+y,v=\frac{y}{x}$解出x，y关于u，v的表达式，从而将$f\left(x+y,\frac{y}{x}\right)$写成关于 u,v的表达式，进而求得$\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\bigg|_{u=1}\,,\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\bigg|_{u=1}.$由$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}u=x+y,\\ v=\frac{y}{x},\end{array}\right.$解得$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}x=\frac{u}{1+v},\\ y=\frac{uv}{1+v},\end{array}\right.$故$f (u, v) = \left(\frac {u}{1 + v}\right) ^ {2} - \left(\frac {u v}{1 + v}\right) ^ {2} = \frac {u ^ {2} \left(1 - v ^ {2}\right)}{\left(1 + v\right) ^ {2}} = u ^ {2} \left(\frac {1 - v}{1 + v}\right) = u ^ {2} \left(\frac {2}{1 + v} - 1\right).$因此，$\left. \frac {\partial f}{\partial u} \right| _ {u = 1 \atop v = 1} = 2 u \left(\frac {2}{1 + v} - 1\right) \Bigg | _ {u = 1 \atop v = 1} = 0, \quad \left. \frac {\partial f}{\partial v} \right| _ {u = 1 \atop v = 1} = u ^ {2} \cdot \frac {- 2}{(1 + v) ^ {2}} \Bigg | _ {u = 1 \atop v = 1} = - \frac {1}{2}.$应选 D.

（法二）一方面，$\mathrm {d} f \left(x + y, \frac {y}{x}\right) = \frac {\partial \left(x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}\right)}{\partial x} \mathrm {d} x + \frac {\partial \left(x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}\right)}{\partial y} \mathrm {d} y = 2 x \mathrm {d} x - 2 y \mathrm {d} y;$另一方面，$\begin{aligned} \mathrm {d} f \left(x + y, \frac {y}{x}\right) \frac {u = x + y}{v = \frac {y}{x}} \frac {\partial f}{\partial u} \mathrm {d} u + \frac {\partial f}{\partial v} \mathrm {d} v &= \frac {\partial f}{\partial u} (\mathrm {d} x + \mathrm {d} y) + \frac {\partial f}{\partial v} \left(- \frac {y}{x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x + \frac {1}{x} \mathrm {d} y\right) \\ &= \left(\frac {\partial f}{\partial u} - \frac {y}{x ^ {2}} \frac {\partial f}{\partial v}\right) \mathrm {d} x + \left(\frac {\partial f}{\partial u} + \frac {1}{x} \frac {\partial f}{\partial v}\right) \mathrm {d} y. \end{aligned}$比较 dx，dy的系数可得$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \frac {\partial f}{\partial u} - \frac {y}{x ^ {2}} \frac {\partial f}{\partial v} = 2 x, \\ \frac {\partial f}{\partial u} + \frac {1}{x} \frac {\partial f}{\partial v} = - 2 y. \end{array} \right.$当 u=1，v=1时，由$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}x+y=u,\\ \frac{y}{x}=v\end{array}\right.$解得 x =$\frac{1}{2}$, y =$\frac{1}{2}$. 代入上面的方程组，可得$\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\bigg|_{u=1} = 0,$$\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\bigg|_{u=1} = -\frac{1}{2}$. 应选D.

questionText: 设函数$f ( u,v )$具有2阶连续偏导数，$y=f(\mathrm{e}^{x},\cos x)$，求$\left.\frac{\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x}\right|_{x=0},\left.\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2} y}{\mathrm{d} x^{2}}\right|_{x=0}.$
analysisRich: 解分别记 f（u,v）关于第一个变量、第二个变量的偏导数为$f_{1}^{\prime}, f_{2}^{\prime}. f_{1}^{\prime}, f_{2}^{\prime}$具有与 f相同的复合结构.根据链式法则，$\frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} x} = f _ {1} ^ {\prime} \frac {\mathrm {d} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x}\right)}{\mathrm {d} x} + f _ {2} ^ {\prime} \frac {\mathrm {d} (\cos x)}{\mathrm {d} x} = f _ {1} ^ {\prime} \mathrm {e} ^ {x} - f _ {2} ^ {\prime} \sin x.$代入 x=0，得$\left. \frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} x} \right| _ {x = 0} = f _ {1} ^ {\prime} (1, 1) - 0 = f _ {1} ^ {\prime} (1, 1).$对（1）式两端关于 x求导，得$\frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm {d} x ^ {2}} = f _ {1} ^ {\prime} \mathrm {e} ^ {x} + \mathrm {e} ^ {x} \left(f _ {1 1} ^ {\prime \prime} \mathrm {e} ^ {x} - f _ {1 2} ^ {\prime \prime} \sin x\right) - f _ {2} ^ {\prime} \cos x - \sin x \left(f _ {2 1} ^ {\prime \prime} \mathrm {e} ^ {x} - f _ {2 2} ^ {\prime \prime} \sin x\right).$代入 x=0，得$\left. \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm {d} x ^ {2}} \right| _ {x = 0} = f _ {1} ^ {\prime} (1, 1) + f _ {1 1} ^ {\prime \prime} (1, 1) - f _ {2} ^ {\prime} (1, 1).$

analysisRich: 解固定变量 y=0，则 f(x,0)是关于 x的一元函数.由于$\frac{\partial f(x,y)}{\partial x}>0$，故 f(x,0)是关于 x的单调增加函数.于是，$f (1, 0) - f (0, 0) > 0.$固定变量 x=0，则 f（0,y）是关于 y的一元函数.由于$\frac{\partial f(x,y)}{\partial y}<0$，故 f（0,y）是关于 y的单调减少函数.于是，$f (0, 1) - f (0, 0) < 0.$因此，$f ( 1, 0 ) > f ( 0, 0 ) > f ( 0, 1 )$.应选D.

questionText: 设函数$z=z(x,y)$由方程$\ln z+\mathrm{e}^{z-1}=xy$确定，则$\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(2,\frac{1}{2})}=$___
analysisRich:
解（法一）对已知方程两端关于 x求导，可得$\frac {1}{z} \cdot \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + \mathrm {e} ^ {z - 1} \cdot \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = y.$将 x=2，$y=\frac{1}{2}$代入已知方程可得，$\ln z+\mathrm{e}^{z-1}=1.$解得 z=1.

将$x = 2, y = \frac{1}{2}, z = 1$代入（1）式可得，$2\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(2,\frac{1}{2})} = \frac{1}{2}$，即$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(2,\frac{1}{2})} = \frac{1}{4}$.

（法二）记$F ( x,y,z)=\ln z+\mathrm{e}^{z-1}-x y$，则$F_{x}^{\prime}(x,y,z)=-y,F_{z}^{\prime}(x,y,z)=\frac{1}{z}+\mathrm{e}^{z-1}.$将 x=2，y$=\frac{1}{2}$代入已知方程可得，$\ln z+\mathrm{e}^{z-1}=1.$解得 z=1.

根据隐函数存在定理，$\left. \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} \right| _ {\left(2, \frac {1}{2}\right)} = - \frac {F _ {x} ^ {\prime} \left(2 , \frac {1}{2} , 1\right)}{F _ {z} ^ {\prime} \left(2 , \frac {1}{2} , 1\right)} = - \frac {- \frac {1}{2}}{2} = \frac {1}{4}.$

questionText: 设函数 f(u)可导，$z=y f\left(\frac{y^{2}}{x}\right)$，则$2 x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=$___
analysisRich: 分别计算$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x},\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}.$$\frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = y f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {y ^ {2}}{x}\right) \cdot \left(- \frac {y ^ {2}}{x ^ {2}}\right) = - \frac {y ^ {3}}{x ^ {2}} f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {y ^ {2}}{x}\right).$$\frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = f \left(\frac {y ^ {2}}{x}\right) + y \cdot f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {y ^ {2}}{x}\right) \cdot \frac {2 y}{x} = f \left(\frac {y ^ {2}}{x}\right) + \frac {2 y ^ {2}}{x} f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {y ^ {2}}{x}\right).$代入$2 x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}$可得，$2 x \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = - \frac {2 y ^ {3}}{x} f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {y ^ {2}}{x}\right) + \frac {2 y ^ {3}}{x} f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {y ^ {2}}{x}\right) + y f \left(\frac {y ^ {2}}{x}\right) = y f \left(\frac {y ^ {2}}{x}\right).$

questionText: 已知函数 u(x,y)满足$2\frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial y^{2}}+3\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+3\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=0$，求 a,b的值，使得在变换$u(x,y)=v(x,y)\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}$下，上述等式可化为 v(x,y)不含一阶偏导数的等式.
analysisRich: 由$u ( x,y)=v ( x,y)\mathrm{e}^{a x+b y}$可得，$\frac {\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac {\partial v}{\partial x} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {a x + b y} + \mathrm {e} ^ {a x + b y} \cdot a v = \mathrm {e} ^ {a x + b y} \left(\frac {\partial v}{\partial x} + a v\right).$$\frac {\partial u}{\partial y} = \frac {\partial v}{\partial y} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {a x + b y} + \mathrm {e} ^ {a x + b y} \cdot b v = \mathrm {e} ^ {a x + b y} \left(\frac {\partial v}{\partial y} + b v\right).$$\frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial x ^ {2}} = a \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {a x + b y} \left(\frac {\partial v}{\partial x} + a v\right) + \mathrm {e} ^ {a x + b y} \left(\frac {\partial^ {2} v}{\partial x ^ {2}} + a \frac {\partial v}{\partial x}\right) = \mathrm {e} ^ {a x + b y} \left(2 a \frac {\partial v}{\partial x} + a ^ {2} v + \frac {\partial^ {2} v}{\partial x ^ {2}}\right).$$\frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial y ^ {2}} = b \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {a x + b y} \left(\frac {\partial v}{\partial y} + b v\right) + \mathrm {e} ^ {a x + b y} \left(\frac {\partial^ {2} v}{\partial y ^ {2}} + b \frac {\partial v}{\partial y}\right) = \mathrm {e} ^ {a x + b y} \left(2 b \frac {\partial v}{\partial y} + b ^ {2} v + \frac {\partial^ {2} v}{\partial y ^ {2}}\right).$代入已知等式可得，$\mathrm {e} ^ {a x + b y} \left[ 2 \left(2 a \frac {\partial v}{\partial x} + a ^ {2} v + \frac {\partial^ {2} v}{\partial x ^ {2}}\right) - 2 \left(2 b \frac {\partial v}{\partial y} + b ^ {2} v + \frac {\partial^ {2} v}{\partial y ^ {2}}\right) + 3 \left(\frac {\partial v}{\partial x} + a v\right) + 3 \left(\frac {\partial v}{\partial y} + b v\right) \right] = 0.$整理上式，可得$2 \frac {\partial^ {2} v}{\partial x ^ {2}} - 2 \frac {\partial^ {2} v}{\partial y ^ {2}} + (4 a + 3) \frac {\partial v}{\partial x} + (- 4 b + 3) \frac {\partial v}{\partial y} + \left(2 a ^ {2} v - 2 b ^ {2} v + 3 a v + 3 b v\right) = 0.$要使得（1）式中不含有 v(x,y) 的一阶偏导数，需使$4 a+3=0,-4 b+3=0$.解得 a=-$\frac{3}{4},$$b=\frac{3}{4}.$因此，$a=-\frac{3}{4}, b=\frac{3}{4}.$

questionText: 设函数$f(x,y)=\int_{0}^{xy}\mathrm{e}^{xt^{2}}\mathrm{d}t$，则$\left.\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{(1,1)}=$___
analysisRich:
解（法一）注意到 f(x,y)的二阶偏导数连续，故可以交换求导次序.先对 y求偏导，再对 x求偏导.

根据变限积分求导公式，$\frac {\partial f}{\partial y} = \mathrm {e} ^ {x (x y) ^ {2}} \cdot x = x \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {3} y ^ {2}},$$\frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial y \partial x} = \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {3} y ^ {2}} + x \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {3} y ^ {2}} \cdot 3 x ^ {2} y ^ {2} = \left(3 x ^ {3} y ^ {2} + 1\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {3} y ^ {2}}.$代入$x = 1,y = 1$，可得$\frac{\partial^2f}{\partial x\partial y}\bigg|_{(1,1)} = \frac{\partial^2f}{\partial y\partial x}\bigg|_{(1,1)} = 4\mathrm{e}.$（法二）若直接对$x$求偏导，则需先对变限积分换元，将$x$移出积分号.令$\sqrt{x} t = u$，则$\mathrm{d}t = \frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\sqrt{x}}.$$\int_ {0} ^ {x y} \mathrm {e} ^ {x t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t \xlongequal {\sqrt {x} t = u} \int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {\frac {3}{2}} y} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {u ^ {2}}}{\sqrt {x}} \mathrm {d} u = \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} \int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {\frac {3}{2}} y} \mathrm {e} ^ {t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t.$依次计算$\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}, \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x \partial y}$.$\frac {\partial f}{\partial x} = - \frac {1}{2} x ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {\frac {3}{2}} y} \mathrm {e} ^ {t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t + \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {3} y ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {3}{2} \sqrt {x} y = - \frac {1}{2} x ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \int_ {0} ^ {x ^ {\frac {3}{2}} y} \mathrm {e} ^ {t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t + \frac {3}{2} y \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {3} y ^ {2}}.$$\frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial x \partial y} = - \frac {1}{2} x ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {3} y ^ {2}} \cdot x ^ {\frac {3}{2}} + \frac {3}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {3} y ^ {2}} + 3 x ^ {3} y ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {3} y ^ {2}} = \left(3 x ^ {3} y ^ {2} + 1\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {3} y ^ {2}}.$代入$x = 1,y = 1$，可得$\frac{\partial^2f}{\partial x\partial y}\bigg|_{(1,1)} = 4\mathrm{e}.$

questionText: 关于函数$f ( x, y )=\left\{\begin{array}{l l}x y,&x y\neq 0\\ x,&y=0\\ y,&x=0\end{array} \right.$给出以下结论：$\textcircled{1} \left. \frac{\partial f}{\partial x} \right|_{(0,0)}=1;$$\textcircled{2} \left. \frac{\partial^{2} f}{\partial x \partial y} \right|_{(0,0)}=1;$$\textcircled{3} \lim_{(x,y)\to(0,0)}f(x,y)=0;$$\textcircled{4} \lim_{y\to0}\lim_{x\to0}f(x,y)=0$其中正确的个数是（    ）
analysisRich:
解 根据偏导数的定义，$\left. \frac {\partial f}{\partial x} \right| _ {(0, 0)} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x , 0) - f (0 , 0)}{x - 0} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x - 0}{x} = 1.$$\textcircled{1}$正确.

根据偏导数的定义，$\left. \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial x \partial y} \right| _ {(0, 0)} = \lim _ {y \rightarrow 0} \frac {\left. \frac {\partial f (x , y)}{\partial x} \right| _ {x = 0} - \left. \frac {\partial f (x , y)}{\partial x} \right| _ {x = 0}}{y - 0}.$但是根据定义，当 y≠0时，$\left. \frac {\partial f (x , y)}{\partial x} \right| _ {x = 0 \atop y \neq 0} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x , y) - f (0 , y)}{x - 0} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x y - y}{x} = \infty .$$\frac{\partial f(x,y)}{\partial x}\bigg|_{x=0}$不存在，$\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial x\partial y}\bigg|_{(0,0)}$当然也不存在.$\textcircled{2}$不正确.

根据 f(x,y）的定义，

- 当 xy≠0时，$0\leqslant|f(x,y)-0|=|xy|\leqslant\frac{x^{2}+y^{2}}{2}<x^{2}+y^{2}$，当 0 < x²+y² < 1时，$x^{2}+y^{2}<\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}};$- 当$x = 0$时，$0\leqslant |f(x,y) - 0| = |y| \leqslant \sqrt{x^2 + y^2};$- 当$y = 0$时，$0\leqslant |f(x,y) - 0| = |x|\leqslant \sqrt{x^2 + y^2}.$而$\lim_{(x,y)\to (0,0)}\sqrt{x^2 + y^2} = 0$，故$\lim_{(x,y)\to (0,0)}f(x,y) = 0.$$\textcircled{3}$正确.

按照累次极限的顺序，先计算$\lim_{x\to 0}f(x,y)$，再计算$\lim_{y\to 0}\lim_{x\to 0}f(x,y).$根据累次极限的定义，只需考虑 x≠0，y≠0的情况.$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} f (x, y) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} x y = 0, \quad \lim _ {y \rightarrow 0} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} f (x, y) = \lim _ {y \rightarrow 0} 0 = 0.$$\textcircled{4}$正确.

因此，共有3个结论正确，应选B.

questionText: 设函数$z=z(x,y)$由方程$( x+1 ) z+y \ln z-\arctan ( 2 x y )=1$确定，则$\left. \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,2)}=$___
analysisRich:
解 对方程两端关于 x求偏导，可得$z + (x + 1) \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + y \cdot \frac {1}{z} \cdot \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} - \frac {2 y}{1 + 4 x ^ {2} y ^ {2}} = 0.$解得$\left(x + 1 + \frac {y}{z}\right) \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac {2 y}{1 + 4 x ^ {2} y ^ {2}} - z.$将 x=0,y=2代入方程（x+1）z+y$\ln z-\arctan(2 x y)=1$可得 z+2$\ln z=1$.观察可得 z=1 是该方程的一个实根.计算函数 f（z）=z+2$\ln z-1$的导数可得$f^{\prime}(z)=1+\frac{2}{z}>0.$于是，函数$f(z)=z+2\ln z-1$单调增加，z=1是该方程的唯一实根.

将 x=0,y=2,z=1代入（1）式可得$3\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,2)}=3.$解得$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,2)}=1.$

questionText: 设函数$z=xyf\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)$，其中 f(u)可导，若$x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=y^{2}(\ln y-\ln x)$，则（    )
analysisRich: 解分别求$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}$和$\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}$利用链式法则，$\frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = y f \left(\frac {y}{x}\right) + x y f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {y}{x}\right) \cdot \left(- \frac {y}{x ^ {2}}\right) = y f \left(\frac {y}{x}\right) - \frac {y ^ {2}}{x} f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {y}{x}\right),$$\frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = x f \left(\frac {y}{x}\right) + x y f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {y}{x}\right) \cdot \frac {1}{x} = x f \left(\frac {y}{x}\right) + y f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {y}{x}\right).$于是，$x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=2xyf\left(\frac{y}{x}\right).$与$x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=y^{2}(\ln y-\ln x)=y^{2}\ln \frac{y}{x}$比较可得，$f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)=\frac{y}{2x}\ln \frac{y}{x}.$从而，$f(u)=\frac{1}{2} u \ln u,$$f^{\prime}(u)=\frac{1}{2}(\ln u+1).$因此，$f ( 1 ) = 0$$f^{\prime}(1)=\frac{1}{2}$应选B.

questionText: 已知 $f(t)$ 连续，令 $F(x,y)=\int_0^{x-y}(x-y-t)f(t)\,dt$，则（　）。

textOptions.A: $\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial F}{\partial y},\frac{\partial^2F}{\partial x^2}=\frac{\partial^2F}{\partial y^2}$
textOptions.B: $\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial F}{\partial y},\frac{\partial^2F}{\partial x^2}=-\frac{\partial^2F}{\partial y^2}$
textOptions.C: $\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}=-\frac{\partial F}{\partial y},\frac{\partial^2F}{\partial x^2}=\frac{\partial^2F}{\partial y^2}$
textOptions.D: $\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}=-\frac{\partial F}{\partial y},\frac{\partial^2F}{\partial x^2}=-\frac{\partial^2F}{\partial y^2}$

analysisRich: 解 整理 F(x,y）的表达式.$F (x, y) = \int_ {0} ^ {x - y} (x - y - t) f (t) \mathrm {d} t = (x - y) \int_ {0} ^ {x - y} f (t) \mathrm {d} t - \int_ {0} ^ {x - y} t f (t) \mathrm {d} t.$分别计算$\frac{\partial F}{\partial x},\frac{\partial^{2} F}{\partial x^{2}},\frac{\partial F}{\partial y},\frac{\partial^{2} F}{\partial y^{2}}.$$\frac {\partial F}{\partial x} = (x - y) f (x - y) + \int_ {0} ^ {x - y} f (t) \mathrm {d} t - (x - y) f (x - y) = \int_ {0} ^ {x - y} f (t) \mathrm {d} t,$$\frac {\partial^ {2} F}{\partial x ^ {2}} = \frac {\partial \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {x - y} f (t) \mathrm {d} t \right]}{\partial x} = f (x - y),$$\frac {\partial F}{\partial y} = - (x - y) f (x - y) - \int_ {0} ^ {x - y} f (t) \mathrm {d} t + (x - y) f (x - y) = - \int_ {0} ^ {x - y} f (t) \mathrm {d} t,$$\frac {\partial^ {2} F}{\partial y ^ {2}} = \frac {\partial \left[ - \int_ {0} ^ {x - y} f (t) \mathrm {d} t \right]}{\partial y} = f (x - y).$因此，$\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}=-\frac{\partial F}{\partial y},\frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}.$应选C.

questionText: 已知函数$f ( x,y)=\ln ( y+| x \sin y | )$，则（    ）
analysisRich: 由$f ( x,y )$的表达式可知，$f ( 0,1 )=0.$根据偏导数的定义，$\left. \frac {\partial f}{\partial x} \right| _ {(0, 1)} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x , 1) - f (0 , 1)}{x - 0} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\ln (1 + | x \sin 1 |)}{x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {| x | \sin 1}{x}.$由于$\lim_{x\to 0^{-}}\frac{|x|}{x} = -1,$$\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{|x|}{x} = 1,$故$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{|x|}{x}$不存在，从而$\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,1)}$不存在.$\left. \frac {\partial f}{\partial y} \right| _ {(0, 1)} = \lim _ {y \rightarrow 1} \frac {f (0 , y) - f (0 , 1)}{y - 1} = \lim _ {y \rightarrow 1} \frac {\ln y}{y - 1} = \lim _ {y \rightarrow 1} \frac {\ln (1 + y - 1)}{y - 1} = \lim _ {y \rightarrow 1} \frac {y - 1}{y - 1} = 1.$因此，$\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(0,1)}=1.$综上所述，$\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,1)}$不存在，$\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(0,1)}$存在，应选A.

questionText: 设函数$z=z(x,y)$由$\mathrm{e}^{z}+xz=2x-y$确定，则$\left.\frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x^{2}}\right|_{(1,1)}=$___
analysisRich: 解 将 x=1，y=1 代入已知方程，可得$\mathrm{e}^{z}+z=1.$考虑$f ( z )=\mathrm{e}^{z}+z-1.$由于$f^{\prime}(z)=\mathrm{e}^{z}+1>0,f(0)=0$，故 f(z)单调增加，z=0是f(z)的唯一零点.于是，$z ( 1,1 )=0.$对方程$\mathrm{e}^{z}+xz=2x-y$两端关于 x求偏导数，可得$\mathrm {e} ^ {z} \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + z + x \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = 2.$将$x=1,y=1,z=0$代入（1）式可得$2\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=2.$因此，$\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(1,1)}=1.$对（1）式两端继续关于 x求偏导数，可得$\mathrm {e} ^ {z} \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial x}\right) ^ {2} + \mathrm {e} ^ {z} \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} + \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + x \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} = 0.$整理可得$\mathrm {e} ^ {z} \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial x}\right) ^ {2} + 2 \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {z} + x\right) \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} = 0.$将$x = 1,y = 1,z = 0,\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(1,1)} = 1$代入（2）式可得$3 + 2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}} = 0.$因此，$\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}\bigg|_{(1,1)} = -\frac{3}{2}.$

questionText: 设函数 f(u,v)具有2阶连续偏导数，且$\mathrm{d} f|_{(1,1)}=3 \mathrm{d} u+4 \mathrm{d} v$. 令 y=f（$\cos x,1+x^{2}$），则$\left.\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2} y}{\mathrm{d} x^{2}}\right|_{x=0}=$___.
analysisRich: 解 由全微分的定义以及$\mathrm{d}f|_{(1,1)}=3\mathrm{d}u+4\mathrm{d}v$可知，$f_{1}^{\prime}(1,1)=3,f_{2}^{\prime}(1,1)=4.$根据链式法则，$\begin{aligned} \frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} x} &= f _ {1} ^ {\prime} (\cos x, 1 + x ^ {2}) \cdot (- \sin x) + f _ {2} ^ {\prime} (\cos x, 1 + x ^ {2}) \cdot 2 x, \\ \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm {d} x ^ {2}} &= f _ {1 1} ^ {\prime \prime} (\cos x, 1 + x ^ {2}) \cdot (- \sin x) ^ {2} + f _ {1 2} ^ {\prime \prime} (\cos x, 1 + x ^ {2}) \cdot 2 x \cdot (- \sin x) \\ + f _ {1} ^ {\prime} (\cos x, 1 + x ^ {2}) \cdot (- \cos x) + f _ {2 1} ^ {\prime \prime} (\cos x, 1 + x ^ {2}) \cdot 2 x \cdot (- \sin x) + f _ {2 2} ^ {\prime \prime} (\cos x, 1 + x ^ {2}) \cdot (2 x) ^ {2} \\ + f _ {2} ^ {\prime} (\cos x, 1 + x ^ {2}) \cdot 2. \end{aligned}$将$x=0$代入$\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2} y}{\mathrm{d} x^{2}}$的表达式可得$\left. \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm {d} x ^ {2}} \right| _ {x = 0} = - f _ {1} ^ {\prime} (1, 1) + 2 f _ {2} ^ {\prime} (1, 1) = - 3 + 2 \times 4 = 5.$

questionText: 设函数$z=z(x,y)$由方程$z+\mathrm{e}^{x}-y\ln(1+z^{2})=0$确定，求$\left.\left(\frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial y^{2}}\right)\right|_{(0,0)}$
analysisRich: 解 将 x=0,y=0代入方程$z+{\mathrm{e}}^{x}-y\ln(1+z^{2})=0$可得，$z(0,0)+1=0$即$z(0,0)=-1.$对方程$z+{\mathrm{e}}^{x}-y\ln(1+z^{2})=0$两端同时关于 x求偏导数可得，$\frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + \mathrm {e} ^ {x} - y \cdot \frac {2 z \frac {\partial z}{\partial x}}{1 + z ^ {2}} = 0, \quad \text {即} \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + \mathrm {e} ^ {x} - \frac {2 y z}{1 + z ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = 0.$将$x = 0,y = 0,z = -1$代人（1）式可得，$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,0)} + 1 = 0$，即$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,0)} = -1.$对$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} +\mathrm{e}^{x} -\frac{2yz}{1+z^{2}}\cdot \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = 0$两端关于$x$求偏导数可得，$\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} + \mathrm {e} ^ {x} - 2 y \cdot \frac {1 + z ^ {2} - 2 z ^ {2}}{\left(1 + z ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}} \cdot \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial x}\right) ^ {2} - \frac {2 y z}{1 + z ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} = 0.$将$x = 0,y = 0,z = -1,\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,0)} = -1$代人(2）式可得，$\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x^2}\bigg|_{(0,0)} + 1 = 0$，即$\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x^2}\bigg|_{(0,0)} = -1.$对方程$z + \mathrm{e}^{x} - y\ln (1 + z^{2}) = 0$两端同时关于 y求偏导数可得，$\frac {\partial z}{\partial y} - \ln \left(1 + z ^ {2}\right) - y \cdot \frac {2 z \frac {\partial z}{\partial y}}{1 + z ^ {2}} = 0, \quad \text {即} \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} - \ln \left(1 + z ^ {2}\right) - \frac {2 y z}{1 + z ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = 0.$将$x = 0,y = 0,z = -1$代人（3）式可得，$\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(0,0)} - \ln 2 = 0$，即$\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(0,0)} = \ln 2.$对$\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}-\ln(1+z^{2})-\frac{2yz}{1+z^{2}}\cdot \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=0$两端关于 y求偏导数可得，$\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} - \frac {2 z \frac {\partial z}{\partial y}}{1 + z ^ {2}} - \frac {2 z \frac {\partial z}{\partial y}}{1 + z ^ {2}} - 2 y \cdot \frac {1 + z ^ {2} - 2 z ^ {2}}{\left(1 + z ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}} \cdot \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial y}\right) ^ {2} - \frac {2 y z}{1 + z ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} = 0.$将$x = 0,y = 0,z = -1,\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(0,0)} = \ln 2$代入(4)式可得，$\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}\bigg|_{(0,0)} + 2\ln 2 = 0$，即$\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}\bigg|_{(0,0)} = -2\ln 2.$因此，$\left(\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}\right)\bigg|_{(0,0)} = -1 - 2\ln 2.$

questionText: 已知函数$f ( x,y)=\left\{\begin{array}{ll} \left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)\sin \frac{1}{xy},& xy\neq 0\\ 0,& xy=0 \end{array} \right.$则在点（0，0）处（    ）
analysisRich:
解 当$y = 0$时，根据偏导数的定义，$\frac{\partial f(x,y)}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(x,0)} = \lim_{\Delta x\to 0}\frac{f(x + \Delta x,0) - f(x,0)}{\Delta x} = \lim_{\Delta x\to 0}\frac{0 - 0}{\Delta x} = 0,$即$f_x^{\prime}(x,0) = 0.$同理可得$\frac{\partial f(x,y)}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(0,y)} = 0,$即$f_y^{\prime}(0,y) = 0.$特别地，$f_x^{\prime}(0,0) = f_y^{\prime}(0,0) = 0.$$- 0 -$当 xy≠0时，由链式法则可得$\frac {\partial f (x , y)}{\partial x} = 2 x \sin \frac {1}{x y} + \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) \cdot \cos \frac {1}{x y} \cdot \left(- \frac {1}{x ^ {2} y}\right) = 2 x \sin \frac {1}{x y} - \frac {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}{x ^ {2} y} \cos \frac {1}{x y}.$取$x_{n} = y_{n} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2n\pi}}$，则$\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n = \lim_{n\to \infty}y_n = 0,\sin \frac{1}{x_n y_n}\equiv 0,\cos \frac{1}{x_n y_n}\equiv 1$，而$\frac {x _ {n} ^ {2} + y _ {n} ^ {2}}{x _ {n} ^ {2} y _ {n}} = \frac {\frac {1}{2 n \pi} + \frac {1}{2 n \pi}}{\frac {1}{2 n \pi \sqrt {2 n \pi}}} = 2 \sqrt {2 n \pi},$从而$\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \left(2 x _ {n} \sin \frac {1}{x _ {n} y _ {n}} - \frac {x _ {n} ^ {2} + y _ {n} ^ {2}}{x _ {n} ^ {2} y _ {n}} \cos \frac {1}{x _ {n} y _ {n}}\right) = - \infty .$由此可得，$\lim_{(x,y)\to(0,0)} \left( 2x\sin \frac{1}{xy}-\frac{x^{2}+y^{2}}{x^{2}y}\cos \frac{1}{xy}\right)$不存在.进一步可得$\frac{\partial f(x,y)}{\partial x}$在点（0,0）处不连续另一方面，$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {(x, y) \rightarrow (0, 0)} \frac {f (x , y) - f (0 , 0) - f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (0 , 0) x - f _ {y} ^ {\prime} (0 , 0) y}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} &= \lim _ {(x, y) \rightarrow (0, 0)} \frac {f (x , y) - 0 - 0 \cdot x - 0 \cdot y}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \\ &= \lim _ {(x, y) \rightarrow (0, 0)} \frac {f (x , y)}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}}. \end{aligned}$当 xy≠0时，$\left|\sin \frac{1}{xy}\right|\leqslant 1$，故$0 \leqslant \frac {\left| f (x , y) \right|}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} = \left| \sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} \sin \frac {1}{x y} \right| \leqslant \sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}},$当$xy = 0$时，$\frac{|f(x,y)|}{\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}} = 0\leqslant \sqrt{x^2 + y^2}.$进一步由$\lim_{(x,y)\to(0,0)}\sqrt{x^2 + y^2} = 0$以及夹逼准则可得$\lim_{(x,y)\to(0,0)}\frac{|f(x,y)|}{\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}} = 0$，从而$\lim_{(x,y)\to(0,0)}\frac{f(x,y)}{\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}} = 0.$于是，由可微的定义可知，$f(x,y)$在点(0,0)处可微.

综上所述，应选C.

questionText:
已知函数 f(u,v)具有二阶连续偏导数，且函数 g(x,y)=f(2x+y,3x-y)满足$\frac{\partial^{2} g}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2} g}{\partial x \partial y}-6 \frac{\partial^{2} g}{\partial y^{2}}=1.$I. 求$\frac{\partial^{2} f}{\partial u \partial v}$；

II. 若$\frac{\partial f(u,0)}{\partial u}=u e^{-u}$，且 f(0,v)$= \frac{1}{50} v^{2}-1$，求 f(u,v)的表达式.
answerRich: (1)$\frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial v \partial v} = \frac {1}{2 5}$(2)$f (u, v) = - (u + 1) e ^ {- u} + \frac {1}{2 5} u v + \frac {1}{5 0} v ^ {2}$
analysisRich:
解（I）根据链式法则，并结合$f(u,v)$具有2阶连续偏导数，从而$\frac{\partial^{2} f}{\partial u \partial v}=\frac{\partial^{2} f}{\partial v \partial u}$可得$\frac {\partial g}{\partial x} = 2 \frac {\partial f}{\partial u} + 3 \frac {\partial f}{\partial v},$$\frac {\partial g}{\partial y} = \frac {\partial f}{\partial u} - \frac {\partial f}{\partial v},$$\frac {\partial^ {2} g}{\partial x ^ {2}} = 2 \left(2 \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial u ^ {2}} + 3 \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial u \partial v}\right) + 3 \left(2 \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial v \partial u} + 3 \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial v ^ {2}}\right) = 4 \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial u ^ {2}} + 1 2 \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial u \partial v} + 9 \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial v ^ {2}},$$\frac {\partial^ {2} g}{\partial x \partial y} = 2 \left(\frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial u ^ {2}} - \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial u \partial v}\right) + 3 \left(\frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial v \partial u} - \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial v ^ {2}}\right) = 2 \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial u ^ {2}} + \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial u \partial v} - 3 \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial v ^ {2}},$$\frac {\partial^ {2} g}{\partial y ^ {2}} = \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial u ^ {2}} - \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial u \partial v} - \left(\frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial v \partial u} - \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial v ^ {2}}\right) = \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial u ^ {2}} - 2 \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial u \partial v} + \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial v ^ {2}}.$将上述结果代入$\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}-6\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=1$可得$4 \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial u ^ {2}} + 1 2 \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial u \partial v} + 9 \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial v ^ {2}} + 2 \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial u ^ {2}} + \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial u \partial v} - 3 \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial v ^ {2}} - 6 \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial u ^ {2}} + 1 2 \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial u \partial v} - 6 \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial v ^ {2}} = 1.$整理可得$25\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v} = 1$，即$\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u\partial v} = \frac{1}{25}$（Ⅱ）对$\frac{\partial^{2} f}{\partial u \partial v}$关于$v$积分可得，$\frac {\partial f}{\partial u} = \int \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial u \partial v} \mathrm {d} v = \int \frac {1}{2 5} \mathrm {d} v = \frac {v}{2 5} + C _ {1} (u),$其中$C_{1}(u)$是关于$u$的一元函数.

由于$\frac{\partial f(u,0)}{\partial u}=u\mathrm{e}^{-u}$，故在$\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}=\frac{v}{25}+C_{1}(u)$中令$v=0$可得$C_{1}(u)=u\mathrm{e}^{-u}.$于是，$\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}=\frac{v}{25}+$$u\mathrm{e}^{-u}.$对$\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}$关于 u积分可得，$\begin{aligned} f (u, v) &= \int \frac {\partial f}{\partial u} \mathrm {d} u = \int \left(\frac {v}{2 5} + u \mathrm {e} ^ {- u}\right) \mathrm {d} u = \frac {u v}{2 5} - \int u \mathrm {d} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- u}\right) \\ &= \frac {u v}{2 5} - \left(u \mathrm {e} ^ {- u} - \int \mathrm {e} ^ {- u} \mathrm {d} u\right) = \frac {u v}{2 5} - u \mathrm {e} ^ {- u} - \mathrm {e} ^ {- u} + C _ {2} (v), \end{aligned}$其中$C_{2}(v)$是关于$v$的一元函数.

由于$f(0,v) = \frac{1}{50} v^{2} - 1$，故在$f(u,v) = \frac{uv}{25} - u\mathrm{e}^{-u} - \mathrm{e}^{-u} + C_{2}(v)$中令$u = 0$可得，$\frac{v^2}{50} - 1 = -1$$+C_{2}(v)$，即$C_{2}(v) = \frac{v^{2}}{50}$.

因此，$f ( u,v) = \frac{u v}{2 5} +\frac{v^{2}}{5 0} -(u + 1) \mathrm{e}^{-u}.$

questionText: 已知函数$z=z(x,y)$由$z+\ln z-\int_{y}^{x}x\mathrm{e}^{-t^{2}}\mathrm{d}t=1$确定，则$\left.\frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x^{2}}\right|_{(1,1)}=$___
analysisRich: 解 将$x = 1,y = 1$代入方程$z + \ln z - \int_{y}^{x}x\mathrm{e}^{-t^{2}}\mathrm{d}t = 1$可得，$z(1,1) + \ln z(1,1) = 1.$注意到$z = 1$是方程$z + \ln z = 1$的一个解，且$(z + \ln z)^{\prime} = 1 + \frac{1}{z} > 0$，函数$z + \ln z$单调增加，故1是该方程的唯一解，$z(1,1) = 1.$已知方程可写为$z+\ln z-x\int_{y}^{x}\mathrm{e}^{-t^{2}}\mathrm{d} t=1$，对该方程两端关于 x求偏导数可得$\frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac {1}{z} \cdot \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} - \int_ {y} ^ {x} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} t - x \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2}} = 0.$在(1)式中代入$x = 1,y = 1,z = 1$可得$2\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(1,1)} = \mathrm{e}^{-1}$，解得$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(1,1)} = \frac{1}{2\mathrm{e}}.$对（1）式两端关于 x求偏导数可得$\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} + \frac {1}{z} \cdot \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} - \frac {1}{z ^ {2}} \cdot \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial x}\right) ^ {2} - \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2}} - \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2}} + 2 x ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2}} = 0.$在（2）式中代入$x=1,y=1,z=1,\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(1,1)}=\frac{1}{2\mathrm{e}}$可得$2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}\bigg|_{(1,1)}-\frac{1}{4\mathrm{e}^{2}}-2\mathrm{e}^{-1}+2\mathrm{e}^{-1}=0$解得$\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}\bigg|_{(1,1)}=\frac{1}{8\mathrm{e}^{2}}.$

questionText: 设函数$z=z(x,y)$由$z+\ln z-\int_{y}^{x}\mathrm{e}^{-t^{2}}\mathrm{d}t=0$确定，则$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=$(    )

解 对已知方程两端关于 x求偏导数可得$\frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac {1}{z} \cdot \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} - \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2}} = 0.$整理可得$\frac{z + 1}{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \mathrm{e}^{-x^2}$，解得$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{z}{z + 1}\mathrm{e}^{-x^2}$.

同理，对已知方程两端关于 y 求偏导数可得$\frac {\partial z}{\partial y} + \frac {1}{z} \cdot \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} + \mathrm {e} ^ {- \gamma^ {2}} = 0.$整理可得$\frac{z + 1}{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -\mathrm{e}^{-y^2}$，解得$\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -\frac{z}{z + 1}\mathrm{e}^{-y^2}$.

因此，$\frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac {z}{z + 1} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2}} - \mathrm {e} ^ {- y ^ {2}}\right).$应选A.

questionText: 设函数$z=\left(1+\frac{x}{y}\right)^{\frac{x}{y}}$，则$\mathrm{d}z|_{(1,1)}=$___
analysisRich: 解$z = \mathrm{e}^{\frac{x}{y}\ln(1 + \frac{x}{y})}$.根据链式法则，$\begin{array}{l} \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = \left(1 + \frac {x}{y}\right) ^ {\frac {x}{y}} \left[ \frac {1}{y} \ln \left(1 + \frac {x}{y}\right) + \frac {x}{y (x + y)} \right], \\ \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = - \left(1 + \frac {x}{y}\right) ^ {\frac {x}{y}} \left[ \frac {x}{y ^ {2}} \ln \left(1 + \frac {x}{y}\right) + \frac {x ^ {2}}{y ^ {2} (x + y)} \right]. \\ \mathrm {n} 2, \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} \Big | _ {(1, 1)} = - (1 + 2 \ln 2), \mathrm {d} z \Big | _ {(1, 1)} = (1 + 2 \ln 2) \\ \end{array}$因此，$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(1,1)} = 1 + 2\ln 2,\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(1,1)} = -(1 + 2\ln 2),\mathrm{d}z\bigg|_{(1,1)} = (1 + 2\ln 2)(\mathrm{d}x - \mathrm{d}y).$

questionText: 如果函数 f(x,y)在点(0,0)处连续，那么下列命题正确的是（    )

textOptions.A: 若极限$\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{f(x,y)}{|x|+|y|}$存在，则 f(x,y)在点(0,0)处可微
textOptions.B: 若极限$\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{f(x,y)}{x^{2}+y^{2}}$存在，则 f(x,y)在点(0,0)处可微
textOptions.C: 若 f(x,y)在点(0,0)处可微，则极限$\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{f(x,y)}{|x|+|y|}$存在
textOptions.D: 若 f(x,y)在点(0,0)处可微，则极限$\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{f(x,y)}{x^{2}+y^{2}}$存在

analysisRich:
解 对于选项A，取$f ( x,y)=| x |+| y |$，则$f ( x,y)$在点（0,0）处连续，且$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x,y)}{|x|+|y|}=1$但$f ( x,y)$在点（0,0）处的偏导数都不存在，故$f ( x,y)$在点（0,0）处不可微，从而选项A不正确.

对于选项C、D，取$f ( x,y)\equiv 1$，可知选项C、D不正确.

由排除法选B.下面证明选项B.

设$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x,y)}{x^2 + y^2} = a$，由于$f(x,y)$在（0,0）处连续，故$f (0, 0) = \lim _ {\substack {x \rightarrow 0 \\ y \rightarrow 0}} f (x, y) = \lim _ {\substack {x \rightarrow 0 \\ y \rightarrow 0}} \left[ \frac {f (x , y)}{x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} \cdot \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right)\right] = a \cdot 0 = 0,$从而$\lim _ {\Delta x \rightarrow 0 \atop \Delta y \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (\Delta x , \Delta y) - f (0 , 0)}{\sqrt {(\Delta x) ^ {2} + (\Delta y) ^ {2}}} = \lim _ {\Delta x \rightarrow 0 \atop \Delta y \rightarrow 0} \left[ \frac {f (\Delta x , \Delta y)}{(\Delta x) ^ {2} + (\Delta y) ^ {2}} \cdot \sqrt {(\Delta x) ^ {2} + (\Delta y) ^ {2}} \right] = a \lim _ {\Delta x \rightarrow 0 \atop \Delta y \rightarrow 0} \sqrt {(\Delta x) ^ {2} + (\Delta y) ^ {2}} = 0,$即有$f \left(\Delta x, \Delta y\right) - f (0, 0) = 0 \cdot \Delta x + 0 \cdot \Delta y + o \left(\sqrt {\left(\Delta x\right) ^ {2} + \left(\Delta y\right) ^ {2}}\right).$由可微的定义知，$f(x,y)$在点（0,0）处可微.

questionText: 设连续函数$z=f(x,y)$满足$\lim_{ \begin{array}{l} x\to 0 \\ y\to 1 \end{array} } \frac{f(x,y)-2x+y-2} {\sqrt{x^{2}+(y-1)^{2}}}=0$，则$\mathrm{d} z|_{(0,1)}=$___
analysisRich:
解 由于$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x,y)-2x+y-2}{\sqrt{x^2+(y-1)^2}} = 0$，故$\lim_{y\to 0}\left[f(x,y)-2x+y-2\right] = 0.$又由$f ( x,y )$在点（0,1）处连续可知，$f ( 0,1 )=\lim_{x\to 0}\lim_{y\to 1} f ( x,y)=\lim_{x\to 0}\lim_{y\to 1} ( 2 x-y+2 )=1$，故$f ( 0,1 )=1.$代入题给条件，可得$\lim _ {\substack {x \rightarrow 0 \\ y \rightarrow 1}} \frac {f (x , y) - f (0 , 1) - 2 x + (y - 1)}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + (y - 1) ^ {2}}} = 0.$因此，由函数$f ( x,y )$可微的定义可知，$f ( x,y )$在点(0,1)处可微且$\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,1)} = 2,\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(0,1)} = -1,$$\mathrm{d}z\mid_{(0,1)} = 2\mathrm{d}x - \mathrm{d}y.$本题也可以直接计算$\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,1)}, \frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(0,1)}$.

在等式$\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x,y)-2x+y-2}{\sqrt{x^2+(y-1)^2}} = 0$中分别令$y = 1$，$x = 0$可得，$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x , 1) - 2 x - 1}{| x |} = 0, \quad \lim _ {y \rightarrow 1} \frac {f (0 , y) + y - 2}{| y - 1 |} = 0.$于是，$\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x , 1) - 2 x - 1}{x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x , 1) - 2 x - 1}{| x |} \cdot \frac {| x |}{x} = 0.$同理可得$\lim_{y\rightarrow 1}\frac{f(0,y)+y-2}{y-1}=0.$从而$\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{f(x,1)-1}{x}=2, \lim_{y\rightarrow 1}\frac{f(0,y)-1}{y-1}=-1.$又因为 f(0,1)=1，所以$\left. \frac {\partial f}{\partial x} \right| _ {(0, 1)} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x , 1) - 1}{x} = 2, \quad \left. \frac {\partial f}{\partial y} \right| _ {(0, 1)} = \lim _ {y \rightarrow 1} \frac {f (0 , y) - 1}{y - 1} = - 1.$

questionText: 设$z=z(x,y)$是由方程$\mathrm{e}^{2 y z}+x+y^{2}+z=\frac{7}{4}$确定的函数，则$\mathrm{d} z|_{\left(\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2}\right)}=$___
analysisRich:
解（法一）将$x=\frac{1}{2}, y=\frac{1}{2}$代入原方程得$z=0.$对方程两端微分，可得$\mathrm{d}\left(\mathrm{e}^{2yz}\right) + \mathrm{d}x + \mathrm{d}\left(y^{2}\right) + \mathrm{d}z = 0.$进一步得$\mathrm {e} ^ {2 y z} \mathrm {d} (2 y z) + \mathrm {d} x + 2 y \mathrm {d} y + \mathrm {d} z = 0,$即$2 z \mathrm {e} ^ {2 y z} \mathrm {d} y + 2 y \mathrm {e} ^ {2 y z} \mathrm {d} z + \mathrm {d} x + 2 y \mathrm {d} y + \mathrm {d} z = 0.$代入$x=y=\frac{1}{2}, z=0$，可得$\mathrm {d} z + \mathrm {d} x + \mathrm {d} y + \mathrm {d} z = 0,$即$\mathrm{d}z\bigg|_{\left(\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2}\right)} = -\frac{1}{2} (\mathrm{d}x + \mathrm{d}y).$（法二）由$\mathrm{d}z = \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\mathrm{d}x + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\mathrm{d}y$知，需求$\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{\left(\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2}\right)}$和$\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{\left(\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2}\right)}$.

对方程两端分别关于$x$，y求导，得$\mathrm {e} ^ {2 y z} \cdot 2 y \cdot \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + 1 + \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = 0, \quad \mathrm {e} ^ {2 y z} \cdot 2 z + \mathrm {e} ^ {2 y z} \cdot 2 y \cdot \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} + 2 y + \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = 0.$当$x=y=\frac{1}{2}$时，代入原方程解得$z=0$将$x=y=\frac{1}{2}$$z=0$代入（1）式，可分别求得$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{1}{2},\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{1}{2}.$因此，$\mathrm{d}z\Big|_{\left(\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2}\right)} = -\frac{1}{2} (\mathrm{d}x + \mathrm{d}y).$

questionText: 若函数$z = z(x,y)$由方程$\mathrm{e}^{z} + xyz + x + \cos x = 2$确定，则$\mathrm{d}z|_{(0,1)} =$___
analysisRich:
$\mathrm {e} ^ {z} \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} + x z + x y \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = 0.$将$( x,y)=(0,1)$代入原方程，得到$z ( 0,1 )=0.$再将$( x,y,z)=(0,1,0)$代入方程（1）、（2），得到$\left. \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,1)}=-1,\left. \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{(0,1)}=0.$于是$\mathrm {d} z \mid_ {(0, 1)} = \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} \Big | _ {(0, 1)} \mathrm {d} x + \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} \Big | _ {(0, 1)} \mathrm {d} y = - \mathrm {d} x.$（法二）对方程$\mathrm{e}^{z}+xyz+x+\cos x=2$两端微分，得到$\mathrm {e} ^ {z} \mathrm {d} z + x y \mathrm {d} z + x z \mathrm {d} y + y z \mathrm {d} x + \mathrm {d} x - \sin x \mathrm {d} x = 0,$整理得$\left(\mathrm {e} ^ {z} + x y\right) \mathrm {d} z = (\sin x - 1 - y z) \mathrm {d} x - x z \mathrm {d} y.$将$(x,y) = (0,1)$代入原方程，得到$z(0,1) = 0$，再代入上式得到$\mathrm{d}z|_{(0,1)} = -\mathrm{d}x.$## （法三）利用隐函数存在定理.

令$F ( x,y,z) = \mathrm{e}^{z}+ x y z+x+\cos x-2.$将（x,y）=（0,1）代入原方程，得到$z ( 0,1 )=0$从而$F ( 0,1,0 )=0.$又$F _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, y, z) = y z + 1 - \sin x, \quad F _ {y} ^ {\prime} (x, y, z) = x z, \quad F _ {z} ^ {\prime} (0, 1, 0) = \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {z} + x y\right) | _ {(0, 1, 0)} = 1 \neq 0,$故由隐函数存在定理知，$\left. \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} \right| _ {(0, 1)} = - \frac {F _ {x} ^ {\prime} (0 , 1 , 0)}{F _ {z} ^ {\prime} (0 , 1 , 0)} = - 1, \quad \left. \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} \right| _ {(0, 1)} = - \frac {F _ {y} ^ {\prime} (0 , 1 , 0)}{F _ {z} ^ {\prime} (0 , 1 , 0)} = 0,$从而$\mathrm{d}z\mid_{(0,1)} = \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,1)}\mathrm{d}x + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(0,1)}\mathrm{d}y = -\mathrm{d}x.$解（法一）对方程$\mathrm{e}^{z}+xyz+x+\cos x=2$两端分别关于 x,y求偏导数，得到$\mathrm {e} ^ {z} \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + y z + x y \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + 1 - \sin x = 0,$

questionText: 若函数$z = z(x,y)$由方程$\mathrm{e}^{x+2y+3z} + xyz = 1$确定，则$\mathrm{d}z|_{(0,0)} =$___
analysisRich:
解下面我们分别用上述三种方法解本题.

（法一）对原方程两端分别关于 x,y求偏导数，可得$\mathrm {e} ^ {x + 2 y + 3 z} \left(1 + 3 \frac {\partial z}{\partial x}\right) + y z + x y \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = 0.$$\mathrm {e} ^ {x + 2 y + 3 z} \left(2 + 3 \frac {\partial z}{\partial y}\right) + x z + x y \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = 0.$当$x=0,y=0$时，由原方程知$\mathrm{e}^{3 z}=1$，故$z(0,0)=0$代入（1）式得$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{1}{3}$代入（2）式得$\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{2}{3}.$因此，$\mathrm{d}z\mid_{(0,0)} = -\frac{1}{3}\mathrm{d}x - \frac{2}{3}\mathrm{d}y.$（法二）对原方程两端微分，可得$\mathrm{d}\left(\mathrm{e}^{x + 2y + 3z} + xyz\right) = 0$，展开得$\mathrm {e} ^ {x + 2 y + 3 z} \left(\mathrm {d} x + 2 \mathrm {d} y + 3 \mathrm {d} z\right) + y z \mathrm {d} x + x z \mathrm {d} y + x y \mathrm {d} z = 0.$当$x = 0, y = 0$时，由原方程知$\mathrm{e}^{3z} = 1$，故$z(0,0) = 0.$代入（3）式得$\mathrm {d} x + 2 \mathrm {d} y + 3 \mathrm {d} z = 0,$即$\mathrm{d}z\mid_{(0,0)} = -\frac{1}{3}\mathrm{d}x - \frac{2}{3}\mathrm{d}y.$（法三）当$x = 0, y = 0$时，由原方程知$\mathrm{e}^{3z} = 1$，故$z(0,0) = 0.$令$F ( x, y, z) = \mathrm{e}^{x+2 y+3 z} + x y z - 1$，则由隐函数存在定理知，$\left. \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} \right| _ {(0, 0)} = - \left. \frac {F _ {x} ^ {\prime}}{F _ {z} ^ {\prime}} \right| _ {(0, 0, 0)} = - \left. \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x + 2 y + 3 z} + y z}{3 \mathrm {e} ^ {x + 2 y + 3 z} + x y} \right| _ {(0, 0, 0)} = - \frac {1}{3},$$\left. \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} \right| _ {(0, 0)} = - \left. \frac {F _ {y} ^ {\prime}}{F _ {z} ^ {\prime}} \right| _ {(0, 0, 0)} = - \left. \frac {2 \mathrm {e} ^ {x + 2 y + 3 z} + x z}{3 \mathrm {e} ^ {x + 2 y + 3 z} + x y} \right| _ {(0, 0, 0)} = - \frac {2}{3}.$因此，$\mathrm{d}z\mid_{(0,0)} = -\frac{1}{3}\mathrm{d}x - \frac{2}{3}\mathrm{d}y.$

questionText: 设函数 f(u,v) 可微，z=z(x,y) 由方程$( x+1 ) z-y^{2}=x^{2} f ( x-z,y )$确定，则$\mathrm{d} z |_{(0,1)}=$___
analysisRich: （法一）对已知方程两端分别关于 x，y求偏导数，可得$z + (x + 1) \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = 2 x f (x - z, y) + x ^ {2} \left[ f _ {1} ^ {\prime} (x - z, y) \cdot \left(1 - \frac {\partial z}{\partial x}\right) \right].$$(x + 1) \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} - 2 y = x ^ {2} \left[ f _ {1} ^ {\prime} (x - z, y) \cdot \left(- \frac {\partial z}{\partial y}\right) + f _ {2} ^ {\prime} (x - z, y) \right].$将（x,y）=（0,1）代入已知方程，可得 z-1=0，从而 z(0,1)=1.再将（x,y,z）=（0,1,1）代入（1）、（2）两式，可得$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,1)}=-1, \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(0,1)}=2.$因此，$\mathrm{d} z \bigg|_{(0,1)}=-\mathrm{d} x+2 \mathrm{d} y$$\mathrm {d} z \mid_ {(0, 1)} = - \mathrm {d} x + 2 \mathrm {d} y.$（法二）对已知方程两端微分，可得$\mathrm{d}[(x+1)z]-\mathrm{d}(y^{2})=\mathrm{d}[x^{2}f(x-z,y)]$.进一步可得，$\begin{aligned} (x + 1) \mathrm {d} z + z \mathrm {d} x - 2 y \mathrm {d} y &= f (x - z, y) \mathrm {d} \left(x ^ {2}\right) + x ^ {2} \mathrm {d} \left[ f (x - z, y) \right] \\ &= 2 x f (x - z, y) \mathrm {d} x + x ^ {2} \mathrm {d} \left[ f (x - z, y) \right]. \end{aligned}$将（x,y）=（0,1）代入已知方程，可得 z-1=0，从而 z（0,1）=1.代入上式可得$\mathrm {d} z + \mathrm {d} x - 2 \mathrm {d} y = 0,$即$\mathrm{d}z\mid_{(0,1)} = -\mathrm{d}x + 2\mathrm{d}y.$

questionText: 设函数$f(x,y)$具有一阶连续偏导数，且$\mathrm{d} f(x,y)=y \mathrm{e}^{y} \mathrm{d} x+x(1+y) \mathrm{e}^{y} \mathrm{d} y,f(0,0)=0$，则$f(x,y)=$___
analysisRich:
由于$\mathrm {d} f (x, y) = y \mathrm {e} ^ {y} \mathrm {d} x + x (1 + y) \mathrm {e} ^ {y} \mathrm {d} y,$故$f_x^{\prime}(x,y) = y\mathrm{e}^{y}, f_y^{\prime}(x,y) = x(1 + y)\mathrm{e}^{y}.$对$f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)$关于 x积分，得$f (x, y) = \int f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, y) \mathrm {d} x = \int y \mathrm {e} ^ {y} \mathrm {d} x = x y \mathrm {e} ^ {y} + \varphi (y),$其中$\varphi(y)$为关于 y的一元函数.

对$x y \mathrm{e}^{y}+\varphi(y)$关于y求偏导数，得$\frac {\partial \left[ x y \mathrm {e} ^ {y} + \varphi (y) \right]}{\partial y} = x \mathrm {e} ^ {y} + x y \mathrm {e} ^ {y} + \varphi^ {\prime} (y) = x (1 + y) \mathrm {e} ^ {y} + \varphi^ {\prime} (y).$与$f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)$比较，得$\varphi^{\prime}(y) = 0$，故$\varphi(y)\equiv C$，其中C为常数.

代入$x = 0$，$y = 0$，得$f(0,0) = 0 + C.$于是，$C = 0.$因此，$f ( x,y)= x y \mathrm{e}^{y}.$

questionText: 设$z=\arctan[xy+\sin(x+y)]$，则$\mathrm{d}z|_{(0,\pi)}=$___.
analysisRich: 根据链式法则，$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{y+\cos(x+y)}{1+\left[ x y+\sin(x+y)\right]^{2}},$$\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{x+\cos(x+y)}{1+\left[ x y+\sin(x+y)\right]^{2}}.$代入$x=0,y=\pi$，可得$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,\pi)}=\pi-1, \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(0,\pi)}=-1.$因此，$\mathrm{d}z\bigg|_{(0,\pi)}=(\pi-1)\mathrm{d}x-\mathrm{d}y.$

questionText: 设函数 f(x,y)可微，且$f \left( x+1, \mathrm{e}^{x} \right)=x \left( x+1 \right)^{2}, f \left( x, x^{2} \right)=2 x^{2} \ln x$，则$\mathrm{d} f \left( 1, 1 \right)=$(    )
analysisRich: 根据全微分的定义，$\mathrm {d} f (1, 1) = f _ {1} ^ {\prime} (1, 1) \mathrm {d} x + f _ {2} ^ {\prime} (1, 1) \mathrm {d} y.$对$f ( x+1,\mathrm{e}^{x} )=x ( x+1 )^{2}, f ( x,x^{2} )=2 x^{2} \ln x$两端均关于 x求导，可得$f _ {1} ^ {\prime} \left(x + 1, \mathrm {e} ^ {x}\right) + f _ {2} ^ {\prime} \left(x + 1, \mathrm {e} ^ {x}\right) \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {x} = (x + 1) ^ {2} + x \cdot 2 (x + 1) = (x + 1) (3 x + 1).$$f _ {1} ^ {\prime} \left(x, x ^ {2}\right) + f _ {2} ^ {\prime} \left(x, x ^ {2}\right) \cdot 2 x = 4 x \ln x + 2 x ^ {2} \cdot \frac {1}{x} = 2 x \left(2 \ln x + 1\right).$在（1）式中令$x=0$，可得$f_{1}^{\prime}(1,1)+f_{2}^{\prime}(1,1)=1.$在（2）式中令$x=1$，可得$f_{1}^{\prime}(1,1)+ 2 f_{2}^{\prime}(1,1)=2.$联立两式解得$f_{1}^{\prime}(1,1)=0,f_{2}^{\prime}(1,1)=1.$因此，$\mathrm{d}f(1,1)=\mathrm{d}y.$应选C.

questionText: 已知函数 f(x,y)满足$\mathrm{d} f(x,y)=\frac{x\mathrm{d} y-y\mathrm{d} x}{x^{2}+y^{2}}, f(1,1)=\frac{\pi}{4}$，则 f$(\sqrt{3},3)=$___.
analysisRich:
解 由$\mathrm{d}f(x,y)=\frac{x\mathrm{d}y-y\mathrm{d}x}{x^{2}+y^{2}}$可知，$f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)=\frac{-y}{x^{2}+y^{2}},f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)=\frac{x}{x^{2}+y^{2}}.$于是，当$y > 0$时，$f (x, y) = \int f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, y) \mathrm {d} x = \int \frac {- y}{x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x = - \int \frac {\mathrm {d} \left(\frac {x}{y}\right)}{1 + \left(\frac {x}{y}\right) ^ {2}} = - \arctan \frac {x}{y} + \varphi (y),$其中$\varphi(y)$为关于 y的一元函数.实际上，$\varphi(y)=f(0,y).$对 f(x,y）=-arctan$\frac{x}{y}+\varphi(y)$关于 y求偏导数可得$f _ {y} ^ {\prime} (x, y) = - \frac {- \frac {x}{y ^ {2}}}{1 + \left(\frac {x}{y}\right) ^ {2}} + \varphi^ {\prime} (y) = \frac {x}{x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} + \varphi^ {\prime} (y).$比较可得$\varphi^{\prime}(y)=0$，从而当 y > 0时，$\varphi(y)=C,f(x,y)=-\arctan \frac{x}{y}+C$，其中 C为待定常数.

由$f(1,1)=\frac{\pi}{4}$可得，$\frac{\pi}{4}=-\frac{\pi}{4}+C$，解得 C$=\frac{\pi}{2}.$因此，$f(x,y)=-\arctan \frac{x}{y}+\frac{\pi}{2}.$进一步可得$f (\sqrt {3}, 3) = - \arctan \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} + \frac {\pi}{2} = \frac {\pi}{2} - \frac {\pi}{6} = \frac {\pi}{3}.$

questionText: 求函数$u=xy+2yz$在约束条件$x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}=1 0$下的最大值和最小值.
analysisRich: 作拉格朗日函数$L ( x,y,z,\lambda) = x y+2 y z+\lambda \left( x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}-1 0 \right)$，其中$\lambda$为参数.令$\left[ L _ {x} ^ {\prime} = y + 2 \lambda x = 0, \right.$$\left| L _ {y} ^ {\prime} = x + 2 z + 2 \lambda y = 0, \right.$$L _ {z} ^ {\prime} = 2 y + 2 \lambda z = 0,$$\left[ L _ {\lambda} ^ {\prime} = x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} + z ^ {2} - 1 0 = 0. \right.$解得所有可能的最值点为$(1, -\sqrt{5}, 2), (1, \sqrt{5}, 2), (-1, \sqrt{5}, -2), (-1, -\sqrt{5}, -2), (-2\sqrt{2}, 0, \sqrt{2}), (2\sqrt{2}, 0, -\sqrt{2})$.代入$u$的表达式中得，$u (1, - \sqrt {5}, 2) = u (- 1, \sqrt {5}, - 2) = - 5 \sqrt {5},$$u (1, \sqrt {5}, 2) = u (- 1, - \sqrt {5}, - 2) = 5 \sqrt {5},$$u \left(- 2 \sqrt {2}, 0, \sqrt {2}\right) = u \left(2 \sqrt {2}, 0, - \sqrt {2}\right) = 0.$因此，所求最大值为$5\sqrt{5}$，最小值为$-5\sqrt{5}$.

questionText:
某企业为生产甲、乙两种型号的产品投入的固定成本为10000(万元).设该企业生产甲、乙两种产品的产量分别为 x (件)和 y (件)，且这两种产品的边际成本分别为$2 0+\frac { x } { 2 }$(万元/件)与$6+y$(万元/件).

I. 求生产甲、乙两种产品的总成本函数 C(x,y) (万元).

II. 当总产量为50件时，甲、乙两种产品的产量各为多少时可使总成本最小？求最小总成本.

III. 求总产量为50件且总成本最小时甲产品的边际成本，并解释其经济意义.
answerRich:
(17) ( I )$C ( x,y)=2 0 x+\frac{x^{2}}{4}+6 y+\frac{y^{2}}{2}+1 0 0 0 0.$（Ⅱ）若总产量为50件，则当甲种产品的产量为24件，乙种产品的产量为26件时，总成本最小，最小成本为$C ( 2 4, 2 6 ) = 1 1 1 1 8$万元.

（Ⅲ）当总产量为50件且总成本最小时，甲种产品的边际成本为32万元。其经济意义为，当甲、乙两种产品的产量分别为24件，26件时，若甲种产品的产量再增加1件，则总成本增加32万元，即当乙种产品的产量为26件时，生产第25件甲种产品需要32万元.
analysisRich:
（I）由边际成本的定义及题设知$\frac {\partial C (x , y)}{\partial x} = 2 0 + \frac {x}{2},$$\frac {\partial C (x , y)}{\partial y} = 6 + y.$由（1）式知$C ( x,y)=2 0 x+\frac{x^{2}}{4}+f ( y )$，其中$f ( y )$为关于y的待定函数.将$C ( x,y)$的表达式代入（2）式得$f^{\prime}(y)=6+y.$于是$f ( y ) = 6 y + \frac{y^{2}}{2} + a$其中a为待定常数.因此，$C (x, y) = 2 0 x + \frac {x ^ {2}}{4} + 6 y + \frac {y ^ {2}}{2} + a.$又由题设知$C(0,0) = 10000$，代入上式得到$a = 10000$，故$C (x, y) = 2 0 x + \frac {x ^ {2}}{4} + 6 y + \frac {y ^ {2}}{2} + 1 0 0 0 0.$（Ⅱ）（法一）由题设知$x+y=50$，于是$\begin{array}{l} C (x, y) = C (x, 5 0 - x) = 2 0 x + \frac {x ^ {2}}{4} + 6 (5 0 - x) + \frac {(5 0 - x) ^ {2}}{2} + 1 0 0 0 0 \\ = \frac {3}{4} x ^ {2} - 3 6 x + 1 1 5 5 0 = \frac {3}{4} (x - 2 4) ^ {2} + 1 1 1 1 8. \\ \end{array}$从而当$x = 24$时，$C(x,y)$取值最小且最小值为11118，此时$y = 26.$因此，若总产量为50件，则当甲种产品的产量为24件，乙种产品的产量为26件时，总成本最小，最小成本为11118万元.

（法二）由题设知，要求$C(x,y)$在$x + y = 50$的条件下的最值，我们可以采用拉格朗日乘数法.

作拉格朗日函数$L(x,y,\lambda) = C(x,y) + \lambda (x + y - 50)$，令$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} L _ {x} ^ {\prime} = \frac {\partial C (x , y)}{\partial x} + \lambda = 2 0 + \frac {x}{2} + \lambda = 0, \\ L _ {y} ^ {\prime} = \frac {\partial C (x , y)}{\partial y} + \lambda = 6 + y + \lambda = 0, \\ L _ {\lambda} ^ {\prime} = x + y - 5 0 = 0. \end{array} \right.$解得 x=24，y=26，这是唯一可能的极值点.因为由问题本身可知最小值一定存在，所以最小值在这个可能的极值点处取得.

因此，若总产量为50件，则当甲种产品的产量为24件，乙种产品的产量为26件时，总成本最小，最小成本为$C (2 4, 2 6) = 1 1 1 1 8 (\text {万 元}).$（Ⅲ）由边际成本的定义知，当总产量为50件且总成本最小时，甲种产品的边际成本为$\left. \frac {\partial C}{\partial x} \right| _ {(2 4, 2 6)} = \left(2 0 + \frac {x}{2}\right) \Big | _ {(2 4, 2 6)} = 2 0 + \frac {2 4}{2} = 3 2 (\text {万 元}).$其经济意义为，当甲、乙两种产品的产量分别为24件，26件时，若甲种产品的产量再增加1件，则总成本增加32万元，即当乙种产品的产量为26件时，生产第25件甲种产品需要32万元.

questionText: 二元函数 z=xy（3-x-y）的极值点是（    ）
analysisRich: 解 先求驻点坐标.计算$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}$与$\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}.$$\frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = - y ^ {2} - 2 x y + 3 y = y (3 - 2 x - y),$$\frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = - x ^ {2} - 2 x y + 3 x = x (3 - x - 2 y).$解$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}y(3-2x-y)=0,\\ x(3-x-2y)=0,\end{array} \right.$得4组解：$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} x = 0, \\ y = 0, \end{array} \right. \quad \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} x = 0, \\ y = 3, \end{array} \right. \quad \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} x = 3, \\ y = 0, \end{array} \right. \quad \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} x = 1, \\ y = 1. \end{array} \right.$计算 z的二阶偏导数得$\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} = - 2 y, \quad \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} = - 2 x, \quad \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x \partial y} = 3 - 2 x - 2 y.$当（x,y）=（0,0）或（3,0）或（0,3）时，$\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}-\left(\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right)^{2}<0$，故这三个点都不是极值点当（x,y）=（1,1）时，$\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} - \left(\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x \partial y}\right) ^ {2} = 4 - 1 = 3 > 0, \quad \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} = - 2 < 0.$因此，点（1，1）是极大值点.应选D.

analysisRich:
解（法一）记$F ( x,y,z) = z - x^{2} - y^{2}$，则曲面$z = x^{2} + y^{2}$的方程为$F ( x,y,z) = 0.$根据曲面的切平面的定义，曲面$F ( x,y,z) = 0$在点（x,y,z）处的切平面的一个法向量为$(-2x,-2y,1)$（也可以取作（2x,2y，-1）).于是，该点处的切平面的点法式方程为$- 2 x (X - x) - 2 y (Y - y) + (Z - z) = 0.$由于所求切平面过点（1，0，0），（0，1，0），故将这两点的坐标分别代入（1）式可得，$- 2 x (1 - x) + 2 y ^ {2} - z \frac {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} = z}{- 2 x + z} - 2 x + z = 0,$$2 x ^ {2} - 2 y (1 - y) - z \xlongequal {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} = z} - 2 y + z = 0.$联立$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} z = 2x, \\ z = 2y, \\ z = x^{2} + y^{2}. \end{array} \right.$由前两个方程可得$x = y$，代入第三个方程可得$2x = 2x^{2}$，解得$x = 0$或$x = 1$. 当$x = 0$时，$y = 0, z = 0$；当$x = 1$时，$y = 1, z = 2$. 从而切点坐标为（0,0,0）或（1,1,2）.

将这两个切点的坐标分别代入（1）式，可得所求切平面的方程分别为 Z=0与$2 X+2 Y-Z=2$因此，应选B.

（法二）排除法.

由于点（1，0，0）和点（0，1，0）均位于所求切平面上，而这两点均不满足方程 x=y，故可排除选项C和选项D.

另一方面，曲面$z=x^{2}+y^{2}$上点（x,y,z）处的切平面的法向量应与（2x，2y，-1）共线.平面$x+y-z=1$的一个法向量为（1，1，-1).若其为切平面，则$\frac{2x}{1}=\frac{2y}{1}=\frac{-1}{-1}$，切点坐标应满足$x=\frac{1}{2}$$y=\frac{1}{2}$.代入$z=x^{2}+y^{2}$得$z=\frac{1}{2}$.但是$\left(\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2}\right)$并不满足方程$x+y-z=1$.于是，选项A也不正确.

由排除法可知，应选B.

answerRich: （-1,0）为 f(x,y)的极小值点，极小值为 f(-1,0) = 2.$\left(\frac{1}{2},0\right)$为 f(x,y)的极小值点，极小值为$f\left(\frac{1}{2},0\right)=-2\ln 2+\frac{1}{2}.$
analysisRich: 解 先求驻点坐标. 计算$f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)$与$f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y).$$\begin{array}{l} f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, y) = \frac {2}{x} + \frac {2 (x - 1) \cdot 2 x ^ {2} - [ (x - 1) ^ {2} + y ^ {2} ] \cdot 4 x}{4 x ^ {4}} \\ = \frac {2}{x} + \frac {(x - 1) \cdot x - (x - 1) ^ {2} - y ^ {2}}{x ^ {3}} \\ = \frac {2 x ^ {2} + x - 1 - y ^ {2}}{x ^ {3}}. \\ \end{array}$$f _ {y} ^ {\prime} (x, y) = \frac {2 y}{2 x ^ {2}} = \frac {y}{x ^ {2}}.$令$\left\{\begin{array}{l l} {\frac{2x^{2}+x-1-y^{2}}{x^{3}}=0,} \\ {\frac{y}{x^{2}}=0,} \\ \end{array} \right.$解得 y=0,x=$\frac{1}{2}$或 x=-1.于是，f(x,y)有两个驻点 (-1,0),$\left(\frac{1}{2},0\right).$分别计算 f（x,y）的二阶偏导数.$\begin{array}{l} f _ {x x} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) = \frac {(4 x + 1) \cdot x ^ {3} - \left(2 x ^ {2} + x - 1 - y ^ {2}\right) \cdot 3 x ^ {2}}{x ^ {6}} \\ = \frac {(4 x + 1) \cdot x - 3 \left(2 x ^ {2} + x - 1 - y ^ {2}\right)}{x ^ {4}} \\ = \frac {- 2 x ^ {2} - 2 x + 3 + 3 y ^ {2}}{x ^ {4}}. \\ \end{array}$$f _ {x y} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) = - \frac {2 y}{x ^ {3}}.$$f _ {y y} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) = \frac {1}{x ^ {2}}.$(1) 对驻点（-1，0），计算得 A=3,B=0,C=1. 从而$A C-B^{2}>0$，且 A > 0 ，故（-1，0）为$f(x,y)$的极小值点，极小值为$f(-1,0)=2.$(2) 对驻点$\left(\frac{1}{2},0\right)$，计算得 A=24,B=0,C=4.从而$AC-B^{2}>0$，且 A>0，故$\left(\frac{1}{2},0\right)$为$f(x,y)$的极小值点，极小值为$f\left(\frac{1}{2},0\right)=-2\ln 2+\frac{1}{2}.$

questionText: 曲面$z=x+2y+\ln(1+x^2+y^2)$在点$(0,0,0)$处的切平面方程为 ___
analysisRich: 解记曲面$z = x + 2y + \ln (1 + x^{2} + y^{2})$为$\varSigma, F(x,y,z) = x + 2y + \ln (1 + x^{2} + y^{2}) - z$，则曲面$\varSigma$的方程为$F(x,y,z) = 0$，其在点（x,y,z）处的一个法向量为$\left(\frac {\partial F}{\partial x}, \frac {\partial F}{\partial y}, \frac {\partial F}{\partial z}\right) = \left(1 + \frac {2 x}{1 + x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}, 2 + \frac {2 y}{1 + x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}, - 1\right).$代入点（0，0，0）的坐标可得曲面$\varSigma$在点（0，0，0）处的法向量为（1，2，-1）.因此，曲面$\varSigma$在点 （0，0，0）处的切平面方程为$(x - 0) + 2 (y - 0) - (z - 0) = 0,$即$x+2y-z=0.$

解 计算 f(x,y) 的驻点.

整理$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)=6x^{2}-18x+12=0\\ f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)=-24y^{3}+24=0\end{array}\right.$可得$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}x^{2}-3x+2=0\\ y^{3}-1=0,\end{array}\right.$解得$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}x=1,\\ y=1,\end{array}\right.$或$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}x=2,\\ y=1,\end{array}\right.$即$f(x,y)$的全部驻点为点（1，1），（2，1）.

计算 f（x,y）的二阶偏导数.$f _ {x x} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) = 1 2 x - 1 8, f _ {x y} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) = 0, f _ {y y} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) = - 7 2 y ^ {2}.$对点（1,1），$A=f_{x x}^{\prime \prime}(1,1)=-6,B=f_{x y}^{\prime \prime}(1,1)=0,C=f_{y y}^{\prime \prime}(1,1)=-72,AC-B^{2}=(-6)\times$（-72）-0>0，且$A<0$，故由二元函数极值存在的充分条件可知，点（1,1）是$f(x,y)$的极大值点.

对点（2,1），$A=f_{xx}^{\prime \prime}(2,1)=6,B=f_{xy}^{\prime \prime}(2,1)=0,C=f_{yy}^{\prime \prime}(2,1)=-72,AC-B^{2}=6\times(-72)$$- 0 < 0$，故由二元函数极值存在的充分条件可知，点（2,1）不是$f(x,y)$的极值点.

因此，$f(x,y)$的唯一极值点为（1，1）.

questionText: 求二元函数$f ( x,y)=x^{2}\left( 2+y^{2}\right)+y\ln y$的极值.
analysisRich: 解 令$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)=2 x(2+y^{2})=0, \\ f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)=2 x^{2} y+\ln y+1=0, \end{array} \right.$解得驻点为$\left( 0, \frac{1} {\mathrm{e}} \right). f(x,y)$的二阶偏导数为$f_{xx}^{\prime \prime}(x,y)=2(2+y^{2}),$$f_{xy}^{\prime \prime}(x,y)=4 x y,$$f_{yy}^{\prime \prime}(x,y)=2 x^{2}+\frac{1}{y}.$于是$A=f_{xx}^{\prime \prime}\left( 0, \frac{1} {\mathrm{e}} \right)=2\left( 2+\frac{1} {\mathrm{e}^{2}} \right),$$B=f_{xy}^{\prime \prime}\left( 0, \frac{1} {\mathrm{e}} \right)=0,$$C=f_{yy}^{\prime \prime}\left( 0, \frac{1} {\mathrm{e}} \right)=\mathrm{e}.$由于$AC-B^{2}>0, A>0,$故$f(x,y)$在点$\left( 0, \frac{1} {\mathrm{e}} \right)$处取得极小值$f\left( 0, \frac{1} {\mathrm{e}} \right)=-\frac{1} {\mathrm{e}}.$

analysisRich: 解 由全微分的表达式知，$f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)=x,f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)=y$，从而点（0，0）为 f(x,y)的驻点.根据二元函数极值存在的充分条件，计算$f_{xx}^{\prime\prime},f_{xy}^{\prime\prime},f_{yy}^{\prime\prime}$，得$f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}\equiv 1,f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}\equiv 0,f_{yy}^{\prime\prime}\equiv 1.$从而$f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}(0,0)f_{yy}^{\prime\prime}(0,0)-[f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}(0,0)]^{2}=1>0, f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}(0,0)>0.$因此，$f(x,y)$在点（0，0）处取极小值.应选D.

questionText: 设函数 f(x)具有二阶连续导数，且 f(x) > 0，$f^{\prime}(0)=0$，则函数 z=f(x)$\ln f(y)$在点 (0,0)处取得极小值的一个充分条件是（    ）
analysisRich: 由题设知，$\left. \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} \right| _ {(0, 0)} = f ^ {\prime} (x) \ln f (y) \Big | _ {(0, 0)} = f ^ {\prime} (0) \ln f (0) = 0,$$\left. \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} \right| _ {(0, 0)} = \frac {f (x) f ^ {\prime} (y)}{f (y)} \Bigg | _ {(0, 0)} = \frac {f (0) f ^ {\prime} (0)}{f (0)} = 0.$从而点（0，0）为函数$z ( x,y)$的驻点.又$A = \left. \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} \right| _ {(0, 0)} = f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) \ln f (y) \Big | _ {(0, 0)} = f ^ {\prime \prime} (0) \ln f (0),$$B = \left. \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x \partial y} \right| _ {(0, 0)} = \left. \frac {f ^ {\prime} (x) f ^ {\prime} (y)}{f (y)} \right| _ {(0, 0)} = \frac {f ^ {\prime} (0) f ^ {\prime} (0)}{f (0)} = 0,$$C = \left. \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} \right| _ {(0, 0)} = f (x) \cdot \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (y) f (y) - \left[ f ^ {\prime} (y) \right] ^ {2}}{f ^ {2} (y)} \Bigg | _ {(0, 0)} = \frac {f ^ {2} (0) f ^ {\prime \prime} (0) - f (0) \left[ f ^ {\prime} (0) \right] ^ {2}}{f ^ {2} (0)} = f ^ {\prime \prime} (0).$令$A=f^{\prime \prime}(0)\ln f(0)>0, A C-B^{2}=[f^{\prime \prime}(0)]^{2}\ln f(0)>0$，解得$f(0)>1,f^{\prime \prime}(0)>0.$因此，$f(0)>1,f^{\prime \prime}(0)>0$为函数$z(x,y)$在点（0,0）处取得极小值的一个充分条件.应选A.

questionText: 设函数 f(x)，g(x)均有二阶连续导数，满足 f(0)>0,g(0)<0，且$f^{\prime}(0)=g^{\prime}(0)=0$，则函数 z=f(x)g(y)在点 (0,0)处取得极小值的一个充分条件是（    ）
analysisRich:
解分别求出$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x},\frac{\partial z}{\partial y},\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}},\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}$以及$\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}.$由$z = f(x)g(y)$得$\frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = f ^ {\prime} (x) g (y), \quad \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = f (x) g ^ {\prime} (y),$$\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} = f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) g (y), \quad \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} = f (x) g ^ {\prime \prime} (y), \quad \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x \partial y} = f ^ {\prime} (x) g ^ {\prime} (y).$根据二元函数取极小值的充分条件，若在点（0，0）处，$\left. \left(\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}}\right) \right| _ {(0, 0)} - \left. \left(\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x \partial y}\right) ^ {2} \right| _ {(0, 0)} > 0,$且$\left.\frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x^2}\right|_{(0,0)} > 0$，则二元函数$z = f(x)g(y)$在点（0，0）处有极小值.

首先，$\left. \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} \right| _ {(0, 0)} > 0 \Leftrightarrow f ^ {\prime \prime} (0) g (0) > 0 \xleftrightarrow {g (0) < 0} f ^ {\prime \prime} (0) < 0.$又由于$f^{\prime}(0)=g^{\prime}(0)=0$，故$\left. \frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x \partial y}\right|_{(0,0)}=0.$（1）式成立当且仅当$\left. \left(\frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x^{2}}\frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial y^{2}}\right)\right|_{(0,0)}>0.$因为$\left. \frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x^{2}}\right|_{(0,0)}>0$，所以必有$\left. \frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial y^{2}}\right|_{(0,0)}>0$，而$\left. \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} \right| _ {(0, 0)} > 0 \Leftrightarrow f (0) g ^ {\prime \prime} (0) > 0 \Longleftrightarrow \frac {f (0) > 0}{g ^ {\prime \prime} (0)} g ^ {\prime \prime} (0) > 0.$因此，$z=f(x)g(y)$在点（0，0）处取得极小值的一个充分条件是$f^{\prime \prime}(0)<0,g^{\prime \prime}(0)>0.$应选A.

questionText: 求函数$f ( x,y)=x \mathrm{e}^{- \frac{x^{2}+y^{2}}{2}}$的极值.
analysisRich:
解$\textcircled{1}$先找到$f(x,y)$的全部驻点.

记$g ( x,y)=\mathrm{e}^{- \frac{x^{2}+y^{2}}{2}}.$由于$f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, y) = \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}{2}} + x \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}{2}} \cdot (- x) = \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}{2}} = \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) g (x, y),$$f _ {y} ^ {\prime} (x, y) = - x y \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}{2}} = (- x y) g (x, y).$由于 g(x,y) > 0，故满足$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}1-x^{2}=0\\-xy=0\end{array}\right.$的点（x，y）为 f(x，y）的驻点.解该方程组得（x，y）= （$\pm1,0).$因此，点（1，0）和点（-1，0）为$f(x,y)$的全部驻点.$\textcircled{2}$计算二阶偏导数.$f _ {x x} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) = (- 2 x) g (x, y) + \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) g _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, y),$$f _ {x y} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) = \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) g _ {y} ^ {\prime} (x, y),$$f _ {y y} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) = (- x) g (x, y) + (- x y) g _ {y} ^ {\prime} (x, y).$$\textcircled{3}$计算$A C-B^{2}.$由于$f ( x, y )$的驻点$\left(x_{0}, y_{0}\right)$均满足$1-x_{0}^{2}=0,-x_{0}y_{0}=0$，而$g ( x, y )$恒大于零，故在驻点 (1,0)处，$f_{xx}^{\prime \prime}(1,0)=-2g(1,0)<0,f_{xy}^{\prime \prime}(1,0)=0,f_{yy}^{\prime \prime}(1,0)=-g(1,0).$因此，$f _ {x x} ^ {\prime \prime} (1, 0) f _ {y y} ^ {\prime \prime} (1, 0) - \left[ f _ {x y} ^ {\prime \prime} (1, 0) \right] ^ {2} = 2 g ^ {2} (1, 0) > 0.$由于$f_{xx}^{\prime \prime}(1,0)=-2 g(1,0)<0$，故点（1，0）为$f(x,y)$的极大值点，$f(1,0)=\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{1}{2}}$为$f(x,y)$的极大值.同理可得，点（-1，0）为$f(x,y)$的极小值点，$f(-1,0)=-\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{1}{2}}$为$f(x,y)$的极小值.

因此，函数$f ( x, y ) = x \mathrm{e}^{- \frac{x^{2}+y^{2}}{2}}$的极大值为$\mathrm{e}^{- \frac{1}{2}}$，极小值为$- \mathrm{e}^{- \frac{1}{2}}.$

questionText: 求函数$f ( x,y)=\left(y+\frac{x^{3}}{3}\right)\mathrm{e}^{x+y}$的极值.
analysisRich:
解 由题设知，$f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, y) = x ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {x + y} + \left(y + \frac {x ^ {3}}{3}\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {x + y} = \left(x ^ {2} + y + \frac {x ^ {3}}{3}\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {x + y},$$f _ {y} ^ {\prime} (x, y) = \mathrm {e} ^ {x + y} + \left(y + \frac {x ^ {3}}{3}\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {x + y} = \left(1 + y + \frac {x ^ {3}}{3}\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {x + y}.$令$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} f_x^{\prime}(x,y) = 0, \\ f_y^{\prime}(x,y) = 0, \end{array} \right.$即$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x^{2} + y + \frac{x^{3}}{3} = 0, \\ 1 + y + \frac{x^{3}}{3} = 0, \end{array} \right.$解得驻点为$\left(1, - \frac{4}{3}\right), \left(-1, - \frac{2}{3}\right).$计算 f(x,y)的二阶偏导数.$f _ {x x} ^ {\prime \prime} = \left(\frac {x ^ {3}}{3} + 2 x ^ {2} + 2 x + y\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {x + y},$$f _ {x y} ^ {\prime \prime} = \left(\frac {x ^ {3}}{3} + x ^ {2} + y + 1\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {x + y},$$f _ {y y} ^ {\prime \prime} = \left(\frac {x ^ {3}}{3} + y + 2\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {x + y}.$在驻点$\left( 1,-\frac{4}{3} \right)$处，$A = f _ {x x} ^ {\prime \prime} \left(1, - \frac {4}{3}\right) = 3 \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {1}{3}}, \quad B = f _ {x y} ^ {\prime \prime} \left(1, - \frac {4}{3}\right) = \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {1}{3}}, \quad C = f _ {y y} ^ {\prime \prime} \left(1, - \frac {4}{3}\right) = \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {1}{3}},$于是$AC - B^{2} = 2\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{2}{3}} > 0,A > 0$，故点$\left(1, - \frac{4}{3}\right)$为$f(x,y)$的极小值点，极小值为$f\left(1, - \frac{4}{3}\right) = -\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{1}{3}}.$在驻点$\left(-1,-\frac{2}{3}\right)$处，$A = f _ {x x} ^ {\prime \prime} \left(- 1, - \frac {2}{3}\right) = - \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {5}{3}}, \quad B = f _ {x y} ^ {\prime \prime} \left(- 1, - \frac {2}{3}\right) = \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {5}{3}}, \quad C = f _ {y y} ^ {\prime \prime} \left(- 1, - \frac {2}{3}\right) = \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {5}{3}},$于是$AC-B^{2}=-2\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{10}{3}}<0$，故点$\left(-1,-\frac{2}{3}\right)$不是极值点.

综上所述，$f ( x,y)$只在点$\left( 1,-\frac{4}{3} \right)$处取得极值$f\left( 1,-\frac{4}{3}\right)=-\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{1}{3}}$，且为极小值.

questionText: 设函数 u(x,y)在有界闭区域 D上连续，在 D的内部具有2阶连续偏导数，且满足$\frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial x \partial y}\neq0$及$\frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial y^{2}}=0$则（    )

textOptions.A: u(x,y)的最大值和最小值都在 D的边界上取得
textOptions.B: u(x,y)的最大值和最小值都在 D的内部取得
textOptions.C: u(x,y)的最大值在 D的内部取得，最小值在 D的边界上取得
textOptions.D: u(x,y)的最小值在 D的内部取得，最大值在 D的边界上取得

analysisRich:
解 由于$u ( x, y )$是有界闭区域D上的连续函数，故$u ( x, y )$在D上必有最大值和最小值.若$u ( x, y )$在区域D的内部取得最大值或最小值，则该最值点是$u ( x, y )$的驻点.

由题设，对区域 D内的任何一点，都有$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} +\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2} = 0$，故$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}\cdot \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}\leqslant 0$，而$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x\partial y}\neq 0$，从而$\left(\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x\partial y}\right)^2 > 0$，因此$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2} -\left(\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x\partial y}\right)^2 < 0.$特别地，该不等式对区域 D内的驻点也成立.

由二元函数极值存在的充分条件知，区域 D内的驻点都不是 u（x，y）的极值点.因此 u（x,y）的最大值和最小值都在 D的边界上取得.应选A.

questionText: 已知函数$f ( x,y)=x+y+ x y$，曲线 C：$x^{2}+y^{2}+ x y=3$，求 f(x,y)在曲线 C上的最大方向导数.
analysisRich: 解 由于函数在一点处的方向导数的最大值等于函数在该点的梯度的模，故求$f ( x,y )$在曲线 C上的最大方向导数等价于求$f ( x,y )$在曲线C上梯度的模的最大值.为了计算方便，考虑梯度模的平方函数.令$g ( x,y ) = f_{x}^{\prime 2}+f_{y}^{\prime 2}=(1+y)^{2}+(1+x)^{2}$，下面求$g ( x,y )$在条件$x^{2}+y^{2}+xy=3$下的最值.作拉格朗日函数$L (x, y, \lambda) = (1 + y) ^ {2} + (1 + x) ^ {2} + \lambda \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} + x y - 3\right).$令$\left[ L _ {x} ^ {\prime} = 2 (1 + x) + \lambda (2 x + y) = 0, \right.$$\left\{L _ {y} ^ {\prime} = 2 (1 + y) + \lambda (2 y + x) = 0, \right.$$L _ {\lambda} ^ {\prime} = x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} + x y - 3 = 0.$由（1）、(2）消去$\lambda$得到$(x - y)(x + y - 1) = 0$，从而$x = y$或$x + y = 1$若 x = y，代入（3）式，解得 x = y =$\pm 1$；若 x+y=1，代入（3）式，解得 x=2，y=-1或 x=-1， y=2.于是（1，1），（-1，-1），（2，-1），（-1，2）都是可能的最值点.又$g (1, 1) = 8, \quad g (- 1, - 1) = 0, \quad g (2, - 1) = g (- 1, 2) = 9,$故$g ( x,y )$在条件$x^{2}+y^{2}+xy=3$下的最大值为9，从而$f ( x,y )$在曲线C上的最大方向导数为3.

questionText: 已知函数 f(x,y)满足$f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)=2(y+1)\mathrm{e}^{x},f_{x}^{\prime}(x,0)=(x+1)\mathrm{e}^{x},f(0,y)=y^{2}+2y$，求 f(x,y)的极值.
analysisRich:
解 利用题给条件，我们来逐步求 f（x，y）.

由于$f_{xy}^{\prime \prime}(x,y)=2(y+1)\mathrm{e}^{x}$，故$f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, y) = \int f _ {x y} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) \mathrm {d} y = \int 2 (y + 1) \mathrm {e} ^ {x} \mathrm {d} y = \mathrm {e} ^ {x} \left(y ^ {2} + 2 y\right) + g (x),$其中$g(x)$是以$x$为变量的一元函数.当$y = 0$时，$f_x^{\prime}(x,0) = g(x) = (x + 1)\mathrm{e}^x$，故$f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, y) = \left(y ^ {2} + 2 y\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {x} + (x + 1) \mathrm {e} ^ {x} = \left(y + 1\right) ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {x} + x \mathrm {e} ^ {x}.$从而，$f (x, y) = \int f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, y) \mathrm {d} x = \int \left[ (y + 1) ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {x} + x \mathrm {e} ^ {x} \right] \mathrm {d} x = (y + 1) ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {x} + (x - 1) \mathrm {e} ^ {x} + h (y),$其中 h(y)是以y为变量的一元函数.代入 x=0，得 f（0，y）=（y+1）²-1+h(y）=y²+2y，故 h(y)=0.

因此，$f ( x, y ) = ( y + 1 )^{2} \mathrm{e}^{x} + ( x - 1 ) \mathrm{e}^{x}.$计算 f（x，y）的偏导数得，$f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, y) = (y + 1) ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {x} + x \mathrm {e} ^ {x}, \quad f _ {y} ^ {\prime} (x, y) = 2 (y + 1) \mathrm {e} ^ {x}.$由于 f(x,y)的驻点满足$f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)=f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)=0$，故解$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} (y+1)^{2}\mathrm{e}^{x}+x\mathrm{e}^{x}=0, \\ 2(y+1)\mathrm{e}^{x}=0 \end{array} \right.$得 x=0，y=-1. 因此，点（0，-1）为 f(x,y)的驻点.

根据二元函数极值存在的充分条件，分别计算$f_{xx}^{\prime \prime}(0, - 1), f_{yy}^{\prime \prime}(0, - 1), f_{xy}^{\prime \prime}(0, - 1)$.$f _ {x x} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) = (y + 1) ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {x} + (x + 1) \mathrm {e} ^ {x}, f _ {x x} ^ {\prime \prime} (0, - 1) = 1,$$f _ {y y} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) = 2 \mathrm {e} ^ {x}, \quad f _ {y y} ^ {\prime \prime} (0, - 1) = 2,$$f _ {x y} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) = 2 (y + 1) \mathrm {e} ^ {x}, f _ {x y} ^ {\prime \prime} (0, - 1) = 0.$由于$f_{xx}^{\prime \prime}(0,-1)f_{yy}^{\prime \prime}(0,-1)-[f_{xy}^{\prime \prime}(0,-1)]^{2}=2>0$，且$f_{xx}^{\prime \prime}(0,-1)=1>0$，故点（0，-1）为$f(x,y)$的极小值点，$f(0,-1)=-1$为$f(x,y)$的极小值.

questionText: 已知函数$z=z(x,y)$由方程$( x^{2}+y^{2}) z+\ln z+2(x+y+1)=0$确定，求$z=z(x,y)$的极值.
analysisRich:
对方程两端分别关于 x和关于 y求偏导数，得$2 x z + \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac {1}{z} \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + 2 = 0,$$2 y z + \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} + \frac {1}{z} \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} + 2 = 0.$当$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=0$时，$2 x z+2=0,x=-\frac{1}{z}.$同理，当$\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=0$时，$2 y z+2=0,y=-\frac{1}{z}.$将（x，y）$= \left(-\frac{1}{z}, -\frac{1}{z}\right)$代入原方程求 x，y.$\frac {2}{z ^ {2}} \cdot z + \ln z + 2 \left(- \frac {2}{z} + 1\right) = 0.$化简（3）式得$\ln z=\frac{2}{z}-2$. 通过观察 y=$\ln z$以及 y=$\frac{2}{z}-2$的图像，可知这两条曲线交于点 (1,0). 考虑函数$f(z)=\ln z-\frac{2}{z}+2.$$f^{\prime}(z)=\frac{1}{z}+\frac{2}{z^{2}}>0$，从而 f(z)在（0，$+\infty$）上单调增加，于是 z=1是 f(z)=0的唯一解. 因此，驻点坐标为（-1，-1）.

下面计算驻点（-1，-1）处的二阶偏导数.

对（1）式两端关于 x求导，得$2 z + 2 x \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + 2 x \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} - \frac {1}{z ^ {2}} \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial x}\right) ^ {2} + \frac {1}{z} \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} = 0.$对（2）式两端关于 y求导，得$2 z + 2 y \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} + 2 y \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} + \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} - \frac {1}{z ^ {2}} \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial y}\right) ^ {2} + \frac {1}{z} \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} = 0.$对（1）式两端关于 y求导，得$2 x \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} + 2 y \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} + \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x \partial y} - \frac {1}{z ^ {2}} \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} + \frac {1}{z} \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x \partial y} = 0.$将$x=-1, y=-1, z=1$代入（4）式，（5）式，（6）式，并注意到$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(-1,-1)}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(-1,-1)}=0$可得，$\begin{aligned} 2 + 2 \left. \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} \right| _ {(- 1, - 1)} + \left. \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} \right| _ {(- 1, - 1)} &= 0, \quad 2 + 2 \left. \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} \right| _ {(- 1, - 1)} + \left. \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} \right| _ {(- 1, - 1)} = 0. \\ 2 \left. \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x \partial y} \right| _ {(- 1, - 1)} + \left. \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x \partial y} \right| _ {(- 1, - 1)} &= 0. \end{aligned}$从而，$\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}\bigg|_{(-1,-1)}=\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}\bigg|_{(-1,-1)}=-\frac{2}{3},\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\bigg|_{(-1,-1)}=0.$因此，$\left[ \frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x^{2}}\frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial y^{2}}-\left(\frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x \partial y}\right)^{2} \right] \Bigg|_{(-1,-1)}>0, \frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x^{2}} \Bigg|_{(-1,-1)}<0.$由二元函数极值存在的充分条件可知，点（-1，-1）是函数$z=z(x,y)$的极大值点，极大值为1.
