questionText: 已知平面有界区域$D=\{(x,y)\mid y^{2}\leqslant x,x^{2}\leqslant y\}$，计算二重积分$\iint_{D}(x-y+1)^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y.$
analysisRich:
分析 本题主要考查二重积分的计算.

区域 D由两条抛物线围成，且关于直线 y=x对称，故可以考虑使用轮换对称性.

解如图所示，区域D由曲线$y=x^{2}$与$x=y^{2}$围成.由于区域D位于第一象限，故$x=y^{2}$可写成$y=\sqrt{x}.$注意到区域 D关于直线 y=x对称.记$D_{1}$为区域 D位于直线 y=x下方的部分，则由轮换对称性的结论可得$\begin{aligned} \iint_ {D} (x - y + 1) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y &= \iint_ {D _ {1}} (x - y + 1) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y + \iint_ {D \backslash D _ {1}} (x - y + 1) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \iint_ {D _ {1}} \left[ (x - y + 1) ^ {2} + (y - x + 1) ^ {2} \right] \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = 2 \iint_ {D _ {1}} \left[ (x - y) ^ {2} + 1 \right] \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y. \end{aligned}$将$D_{1}$写成X型区域.$D _ {1} = \left\{(x, y) \mid x ^ {2} \leqslant y \leqslant x, 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1 \right\}.$分别计算$\iint_{D_1}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y,\iint_{D_1}(x - y)^2\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y.$$\iint_ {D _ {1}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {x ^ {2}} ^ {x} \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(x - x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x = \left(\frac {x ^ {2}}{2} - \frac {x ^ {3}}{3}\right) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{3} = \frac {1}{6}.$$\begin{aligned} \iint_ {D _ {1}} (x - y) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {x ^ {2}} ^ {x} (x - y) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {x ^ {2}} ^ {x} \left(x ^ {2} - 2 x y + y ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(x ^ {2} y - x y ^ {2} + \frac {y ^ {3}}{3}\right) \Big | _ {x ^ {2}} ^ {x} \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(\frac {x ^ {3}}{3} - x ^ {4} + x ^ {5} - \frac {x ^ {6}}{3}\right) \mathrm {d} x \\ &= \left. \left(- \frac {x ^ {7}}{2 1} + \frac {x ^ {6}}{6} - \frac {x ^ {5}}{5} + \frac {x ^ {4}}{1 2}\right) \right| _ {0} ^ {1} = - \frac {1}{2 1} + \frac {1}{6} - \frac {1}{5} + \frac {1}{1 2} = \frac {1}{4 2 0}. \end{aligned}$因此，$\iint_ {D} (x - y + 1) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = 2 \iint_ {D _ {1}} \left[ (x - y) ^ {2} + 1 \right] \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = 2 \left(\frac {1}{4 2 0} + \frac {1}{6}\right) = \frac {7 1}{2 1 0}.$

解如图所示，区域D由两个圆围成，计算两圆的交点。联立两圆方程可得$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} x^{2} + y^{2} = 4x, \\ x^{2} + y^{2} = 4y, \end{array} \right.$两式相减可得$x = y$，代入第一个方程可得$2x^{2}$$-4x = 0$，解得$x = 0$或$x = 2$.于是，两圆的交点为（0,0），（2,2）.连接两交点的直线方程为$y = x$.进一步可得区域D关于直线$y = x$对称.

y) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \iint_ {D _ {1}} (x - y) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y + \iint_ {D _ {1}} (y - x) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = 2 \iint_ {D _ {1}} (x - y) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y. \end{aligned}$$D_{1}$的极坐标表示为$D_{1} = \left\{(r,\theta)\mid 0 \leqslant r \leqslant 4 \sin \theta ,0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac{\pi}{4}\right\}$.$\begin{aligned} \iint_ {D _ {1}} (x - y) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \stackrel {\text {极 坐 标}} {=} \iint_ {D _ {1}} \left(r ^ {2} - 2 r ^ {2} \cos \theta \sin \theta\right) \cdot r \mathrm {d} r \mathrm {d} \theta &= \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \left(1 - 2 \sin \theta \cos \theta\right) \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {4 \sin \theta} r ^ {3} \mathrm {d} r \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \left(1 - 2 \sin \theta \cos \theta\right) \cdot \frac {r ^ {4}}{4} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {4 \sin \theta} \mathrm {d} \theta = 6 4 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \left(1 - 2 \sin \theta \cos \theta\right) \sin^ {4} \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \\ &= 6 4 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \sin^ {4} \theta \mathrm {d} \theta - 1 2 8 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \sin^ {5} \theta \cos \theta \mathrm {d} \theta . \end{aligned}$分别计算$64\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin^{4}\theta \mathrm{d}\theta$与$128\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin^{5}\theta \cos \theta \mathrm{d}\theta .$$\begin{aligned} 6 4 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \sin^ {4} \theta \mathrm {d} \theta &= 6 4 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \left(\frac {1 - \cos 2 \theta}{2}\right) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} \theta = 1 6 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \left(1 - 2 \cos 2 \theta + \cos^ {2} 2 \theta\right) \mathrm {d} \theta \\ &= 1 6 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \left(1 - 2 \cos 2 \theta + \frac {1 + \cos 4 \theta}{2}\right) \mathrm {d} \theta \\ &= 6 \pi - 3 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \cos 2 \theta \mathrm {d} \theta + 8 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \cos 4 \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \\ &= 6 \pi - 3 2 \cdot \frac {\sin 2 \theta}{2} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} + 8 \cdot \frac {\sin 4 \theta}{4} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} = 6 \pi - 1 6. \end{aligned}$$128\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin^{5}\theta \cos \theta \mathrm{d}\theta = 128\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin^{5}\theta \mathrm{d}(\sin \theta) = 128\cdot \frac{\sin^{6}\theta}{6}\bigg|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} = 128\cdot \frac{1}{6}\cdot \frac{1}{8} = \frac{8}{3}.$因此，$\iint_{D}(x - y)^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y = 2\cdot \left(6\pi - 16 - \frac{8}{3}\right) = 12\pi - \frac{112}{3}.$

由于$0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac{\pi}{2}$，故区域D如图（a）所示. D在直角坐标系下可表示为$D = \left\{(x, y) \mid \sqrt {2 x - x ^ {2}} \leqslant y \leqslant \sqrt {4 - x ^ {2}}, 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 2 \right\}.$将$f(r^{2})$换成$f(x^{2}+y^{2})$，将$r\mathrm{d}r\mathrm{d}\theta$换成$\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$，得$\int_{0}^{2}\mathrm{d}x\int_{\sqrt{2x-x^{2}}}^{\sqrt{4-x^{2}}}f(x^{2}+y^{2})\mathrm{d}y.$应选B.

下面我们说明选项 A、C、D不正确.

选项A中的积分区域表示与选项B一样，但是被积函数多了一个因子$\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}$注意到，极坐标与直角坐标的相互转化中，$\mathrm{r} \mathrm{d} r \mathrm{d} \theta=\mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y$原积分中的$\mathrm{r} \mathrm{d} r \mathrm{d} \theta$转化为$\mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y$被积函数变为$f \left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)$在新积分中，没有因子r.选项A不正确.

被积函数与选项A一样.选项C不正确.

选项D中的积分区域为$D^{\prime}=\{(x,y)\mid 1+\sqrt{1-y^{2}}\leqslant x\leqslant \sqrt{4-y^{2}},0\leqslant y\leqslant 2\}$$D^{\prime}$如图（b）所示.选项D不正确.

questionText: 设 f(x,y)是连续函数，则$\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}y\int_{-\sqrt{1-y^{2}}}^{1-y}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x=$(    )
analysisRich:
分析本题主要考查二次积分的积分次序交换和换元法.观察选项A、B，是将先x后y的二次积分化为先y后x的二次积分，结合积分区域的图形来转化会比较方便；观察选项C、D，是将原二次积分化为极坐标系下的二次积分，需要用到换元公式$\iint_{D} f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint_{D} f(r\cos \theta ,r\sin \theta )r\mathrm{d}r\mathrm{d}\theta.$解题设中二次积分的积分区域为$D=\{(x,y)\mid 0\leqslant y\leqslant 1,-\sqrt{1-y^{2}}\leqslant x\leqslant 1-y\}$，将区域D分成两部分$D_{1}$和$D_{2}$（如上图所示），其中$\begin{array}{l} D _ {1} = \left\{(x, y) \mid 0 \leqslant y \leqslant \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}, - 1 \leqslant x \leqslant 0 \right\}, \\ D _ {2} = \left\{(x, y) \mid 0 \leqslant y \leqslant 1 - x, 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1 \right\}. \\ \end{array}$于是$\int_0^1\mathrm{d}y\int_{- \sqrt{1 - y^2}}^{1 - y}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x = \int_{-1}^0\mathrm{d}x\int_0^{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}y + \int_0^1\mathrm{d}x\int_0^{1 - x}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}y$，从而选项A、B均不正确.

在极坐标变换下，区域$D_{1}$的边界方程为$\theta = \frac{\pi}{2},\theta = \pi,r = 1$；区域$D_{2}$的边界方程为$\theta = 0,\theta = \frac{\pi}{2},r = \frac{1}{\cos \theta + \sin \theta}$设区域$D_{1},D_{2}$在极坐标变换下对应于直角坐标平面$rO\theta$上的区域为$D_{1}^{\prime},D_{2}^{\prime}$，则$D _ {1} ^ {\prime} = \left\{(r, \theta) \mid 0 \leqslant r \leqslant 1, \frac {\pi}{2} \leqslant \theta \leqslant \pi \right\},$$D _ {2} ^ {\prime} = \left\{(r, \theta) \mid 0 \leqslant r \leqslant \frac {1}{\cos \theta + \sin \theta}, 0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac {\pi}{2} \right\}.$从而$\int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} y \int_ {- \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}}} ^ {1 - y} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {1}{\cos \theta + \sin \theta}} f (r \cos \theta , r \sin \theta) r \mathrm {d} r + \int_ {\frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\pi} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (r \cos \theta , r \sin \theta) r \mathrm {d} r.$应选 D.

选项C错误的原因是少了雅可比式$r$

questionText: 二次积分$\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}y\int_{y}^{1}\left(\frac{\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}}{x}-\mathrm{e}^{y^{2}}\right)\mathrm{d}x=$___
analysisRich: $\begin{aligned} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} y \int_ {y} ^ {1} \left(\frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2}}}{x} - \mathrm {e} ^ {y ^ {2}}\right) \mathrm {d} x &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} y \int_ {y} ^ {1} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2}}}{x} \mathrm {d} x - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} y \int_ {y} ^ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {y ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {0} ^ {x} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2}}}{x} \mathrm {d} y - \int_ {0} ^ {1} (1 - y) \mathrm {e} ^ {y ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {y ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} y + \int_ {0} ^ {1} y \mathrm {e} ^ {y ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {y ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} \left(y ^ {2}\right) = \frac {1}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {y ^ {2}} \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {\mathrm {e} - 1}{2}. \end{aligned}$

questionText: 设 D是第一象限中的曲线$2 x y=1, 4 x y=1$与直线 y=x,y=$\sqrt{3} x$围成的平面区域，函数 f(x,y)在 D上连续，则$\iint \limits_{D} f(x,y)\mathrm{d} x\mathrm{d} y=$(    )
analysisRich: 解 将曲线$2 x y=1$，$4 x y=1$，直线$y=x$，$y=\sqrt{3} x$改写为极坐标形式.积分区域如图所示.$2 x y = 1 \Rightarrow r ^ {2} \sin 2 \theta = 1 \Rightarrow r = \frac {1}{\sqrt {\sin 2 \theta}},$$4 x y = 1 \Rightarrow 2 r ^ {2} \sin 2 \theta = 1 \Rightarrow r = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \sin 2 \theta}},$$y = x \Rightarrow \theta = \frac {\pi}{4},$$y = \sqrt {3} x \Rightarrow \theta = \frac {\pi}{3},$$\mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = r \mathrm {d} r \mathrm {d} \theta .$于是，积分区域$D$在极坐标系下表示为$D = \left\{(r, \theta) \mid \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \sin 2 \theta}} \leqslant r \leqslant \frac {1}{\sqrt {\sin 2 \theta}}, \frac {\pi}{4} \leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac {\pi}{3} \right\}.$因此，$\iint_ {D} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {\frac {\pi}{4}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {\frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \sin 2 \theta}}} ^ {\frac {1}{\sqrt {\sin 2 \theta}}} f (r \cos \theta , r \sin \theta) r \mathrm {d} r.$应选B.

questionText: 设$D=\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant 2x,x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant 2y\}$，函数 f(x,y)在 D上连续，则$\iint_{D}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=$(    )
analysisRich:
解 圆$x^{2}+y^{2}=2x$的极坐标方程为$r=2\cos \theta$，圆$x^{2}+y^{2}=2y$的极坐标方程为$r=2\sin \theta.$由图可知，当$0\leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac{\pi}{4}$时，D的边界为$r=2\sin \theta$；当$\frac{\pi}{4}\leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac{\pi}{2}$时，D的边界为$r=2\cos \theta$于是，$D = \left\{(r, \theta) \mid 0 \leqslant r \leqslant 2 \sin \theta , 0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac {\pi}{4} \right\} \cup \left\{(r, \theta) \mid 0 \leqslant r \leqslant 2 \cos \theta , \frac {\pi}{4} \leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac {\pi}{2} \right\}.$因此，$\iint_ {D} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2 \sin \theta} f (r \cos \theta , r \sin \theta) r \mathrm {d} r + \int_ {\frac {\pi}{4}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2 \cos \theta} f (r \cos \theta , r \sin \theta) r \mathrm {d} r.$应选B.

由上述论证可知选项A不正确.

若在直角坐标系下计算，则区域 D 可表示为$D = \left\{(x, y) \mid 1 - \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} \leqslant y \leqslant \sqrt {2 x - x ^ {2}}, 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1 \right\}.$于是，$\iint_ {D} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {1 - \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}} ^ {\sqrt {2 x - x ^ {2}}} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} y.$因此，选项C、D均不正确.

questionText: 设 f(x,y)是连续函数，则$\int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \mathrm{d} x \int_{\sin x}^{1} f(x,y) \mathrm{d} y=$(    )
analysisRich: 解二次积分$\int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \mathrm{d} x \int_{\sin x}^{1} f(x,y)\mathrm{d} y$对应的二重积分的积分区域为$D = \left\{(x, y) \mid \sin x \leqslant y \leqslant 1, \frac {\pi}{6} \leqslant x \leqslant \frac {\pi}{2} \right\}.$由于$\arcsin y$的值域为$\left[-\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}\right]$，而$\left[\frac{\pi}{6},\frac{\pi}{2}\right]\subset\left[-\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}\right]$，故曲线$y=\sin x \left(x\in\left[\frac{\pi}{6},\frac{\pi}{2}\right]\right)$上的点（x,y）可写为（$\arcsin y,y).$由此可将 D改写成Y型区域，$D = \left\{(x, y) \mid \frac {\pi}{6} \leqslant x \leqslant \arcsin y, \frac {1}{2} \leqslant y \leqslant 1 \right\}.$因此，$\int_ {\frac {\pi}{6}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {\sin x} ^ {1} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {\frac {1}{2}} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} y \int_ {\frac {\pi}{6}} ^ {\arcsin y} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x.$应选A.

questionText: 设函数 f(x,y) 连续，则$\int_{-2}^{2}\mathrm{d}x\int_{4-x^{2}}^{4}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}y=$(    )
analysisRich:
解如图所示，二次积分$\int_{-2}^{2}\mathrm{d}x\int_{4-x^{2}}^{4}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}y$对应的二重积分的积分区域 D为图中灰色区域.$D = \left\{(x, y) \mid 4 - x ^ {2} \leqslant y \leqslant 4, - 2 \leqslant x \leqslant 2 \right\}.$当 x < 0时，解$y=4-x^{2}$可得$x=-\sqrt{4-y}$当 x > 0时，解$y=4-x^{2}$可得$x=\sqrt{4-y}$于是，将D写成Y型区域需要将其分块，$D = \left\{(x, y) \mid - 2 \leqslant x \leqslant - \sqrt {4 - y}, 0 \leqslant y \leqslant 4 \right\} \cup \left\{(x, y) \mid \sqrt {4 - y} \leqslant x \leqslant 2, 0 \leqslant y \leqslant 4 \right\}.$从而，$\int_ {- 2} ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {4 - x ^ {2}} ^ {4} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} y = \iint_ {D} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {4} \left[ \int_ {- 2} ^ {- \sqrt {4 - y}} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x + \int_ {\sqrt {4 - y}} ^ {2} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x \right] \mathrm {d} y.$选项A正确，选项B、C不正确.

对选项D，该选项正确意味着$\iint \limits_{D} f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=2\iint \limits_{D_{1}} f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$，其中$D_{1}$为D位于y轴右边的部分，而该式成立需要$f(x,y)$是关于x的偶函数，但题干条件中并没有这一信息，故该选项不正确。例如，取$f(x,y)=x$，则$\iint \limits_{D} f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=0$，而$\iint \limits_{D_{1}} f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y>0.$因此，应选A.

questionText: 设 L为球面$x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}=1$与平面$x+y+z=0$的交线，则$\oint_{L} xy\mathrm{d}s=$___
analysisRich:
本题中，曲线$L$具有轮换对称性，故应利用轮换对称性来简化计算.

解 曲线 L如图所示.

由曲线$L$的方程可知，该曲线对变量$x, y, z$具有轮换对称性.于是，$\oint_ {L} x y \mathrm {d} s = \oint_ {L} y z \mathrm {d} s = \oint_ {L} z x \mathrm {d} s = \frac {1}{3} \oint_ {L} (x y + y z + z x) \mathrm {d} s.$又因为$x y+y z+z x=\frac{1}{2} \left[ \left(x+y+z\right)^{2}-\left(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\right) \right]$，所以$\begin{aligned} \oint_ {L} x y \mathrm {d} s &= \frac {1}{3} \oint_ {L} \left(x y + y z + z x\right) \mathrm {d} s = \frac {1}{6} \oint_ {L} \left[ \left(x + y + z\right) ^ {2} - \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} + z ^ {2}\right) \right] \mathrm {d} s \\ \frac {x + y + z = 0}{x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} + z ^ {2} = 1} \frac {1}{6} \oint_ {L} (0 - 1) \mathrm {d} s &= - \frac {1}{6} \oint_ {L} \mathrm {d} s. \end{aligned}$由于 L为单位球面上的一个大圆，即以球心为圆心，且半径等于球半径的一个圆，故$\oint_{L}\mathrm{d}s=L$的周长$= 2\pi.$因此，原积分$= -\frac{1}{6}\times 2\pi = -\frac{\pi}{3}.$

questionText: 设 P为椭球面 S：$x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}-yz=1$上的动点，若 S在点 P处的切平面与 xOy面垂直，求点 P的轨迹 C，并计算曲面积分 I =$\iint\limits_{\Sigma}\frac{(x+\sqrt{3})|y-2z|}{\sqrt{4+y^{2}+z^{2}-4yz}} \mathrm{d} S$，其中$\varSigma$是椭球面 S位于曲线 C上方的部分.
answerRich: (19) 点P的轨迹C为$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}-yz=1\\ y=2z,\end{array}\right.$或者$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}x^{2}+\frac{3}{4} y^{2}=1\\ y=2z,\end{array}\right.$曲面积分为$I=2\pi.$
analysisRich:
解设点 P的坐标为（x,y,z），则椭球面 S在点 P处的法向量为（2x，2y-z，2z-y）.又 xOy面的法向量可取为（0,0,1），故由 S在点 P处的切平面与 xOy面垂直知，$(2 x, 2 y - z, 2 z - y) \cdot (0, 0, 1) = 0,$即有$y = 2z$. 由于点$P$在椭球面$S$上，故点$P$的轨迹$C$为$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} + z ^ {2} - y z = 1, \\ y = 2 z, \end{array} \right. \text {或 者} \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} x ^ {2} + \frac {3}{4} y ^ {2} = 1, \\ y = 2 z. \end{array} \right.$下面用两种方法求曲面积分 I.

（法一）$\varSigma$在xOy面上的投影区域为$D_{xy}=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+\frac{3}{4} y^{2}\leqslant 1\right\}$，其面积为$\pi \cdot 1\cdot \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}=\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\pi.$对方程$x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}-yz=1$两边关于x,y分别求偏导数，得$2 x + 2 z \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} - y \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = 0, \quad 2 y + 2 z \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} - z - y \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = 0,$解得$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{2x}{y - 2z},\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{2y - z}{y - 2z}$. 在$\varSigma$上，$x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}-yz=1$，故$\begin{aligned} \sqrt {1 + \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial x}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial y}\right) ^ {2}} &= \frac {\sqrt {4 x ^ {2} + 5 y ^ {2} + 5 z ^ {2} - 8 y z}}{| y - 2 z |} = \frac {\sqrt {4 \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} + z ^ {2} - y z\right) + y ^ {2} + z ^ {2} - 4 y z}}{| y - 2 z |} \\ &= \frac {\sqrt {4 + y ^ {2} + z ^ {2} - 4 y z}}{| y - 2 z |}. \end{aligned}$从而$\begin{aligned} I &= \iint_ {\Sigma} \frac {\left(x + \sqrt {3}\right) \mid y - 2 z \mid}{\sqrt {4 + y ^ {2} + z ^ {2}} - 4 y z} \mathrm {d} S = \iint_ {D _ {x y}} \frac {\left(x + \sqrt {3}\right) \mid y - 2 z \mid}{\sqrt {4 + y ^ {2} + z ^ {2}} - 4 y z} \cdot \sqrt {1 + \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial x}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial y}\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \iint_ {D _ {x y}} \left(x + \sqrt {3}\right) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \stackrel {\text {对 称 性}} {=} 0 + \iint_ {D _ {x y}} \sqrt {3} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \sqrt {3} \cdot \frac {2}{\sqrt {3}} \pi = 2 \pi . \end{aligned}$（法二）$\varSigma$在 xOy面上的投影区域为$D_{xy}=\left\{(x,y)\left|x^{2}+\frac{3}{4} y^{2}\leqslant 1\right.\right\}$，其面积为$\pi\cdot1\cdot\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}=\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\pi.$$\varSigma$上任一点的法向量为（2x，2y-z，2z-y），其方向余弦$\cos \gamma$满足$| \cos \gamma | = \frac {\left| 2 z - y \right|}{\sqrt {\left(2 x\right) ^ {2} + \left(2 y - z\right) ^ {2} + \left(2 z - y\right) ^ {2}}} = \frac {\left| 2 z - y \right|}{\sqrt {4 x ^ {2} + 5 y ^ {2} + 5 z ^ {2} - 8 y z}}.$又$\Sigma$上的点满足$x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}-yz=1$，故有$|\cos \gamma |=\frac{|2z-y|}{\sqrt{4+y^{2}+z^{2}-4yz}}$，从而$\begin{aligned} I &= \iint_ {\Sigma} \frac {(x + \sqrt {3}) | y - 2 z |}{\sqrt {4 + y ^ {2} + z ^ {2}} - 4 y z} \mathrm {d} S = \iint_ {\Sigma} (x + \sqrt {3}) | \cos \gamma | \mathrm {d} S \\ &= \iint_ {D _ {x y}} (x + \sqrt {3}) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \xlongequal {\text {对称性}} 0 + \iint_ {D _ {x y}} \sqrt {3} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \sqrt {3} \cdot \frac {2}{\sqrt {3}} \pi = 2 \pi . \end{aligned}$

questionText: 设$\Sigma=\{(x,y,z)\mid x+y+z=1,x\geqslant0,y\geqslant0,z\geqslant0\}$，则$\iint\limits_{\Sigma}y^{2}\mathrm{d}S=$___
analysisRich:
分析 本题主要考查第一类曲面积分的计算. 一般将其化为重积分后再计算.

若曲面$\Sigma$的方程为$z = z(x,y),(x,y)\in D_{xy}$，且$z(x,y)$在$D_{xy}$上有连续偏导数，$f(x,y,z)$在$\Sigma$上连续，则$\iint_ {\Sigma} f (x, y, z) \mathrm {d} S = \iint_ {D _ {x y}} f (x, y, z (x, y)) \sqrt {1 + \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial x}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial y}\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y.$解 曲面$\varSigma=\{(x,y,z)\mid z=1-x-y,x\geqslant0,y\geqslant0,z\geqslant0\}$在 xOy平面上的投影区域为$D_{xy}=\{(x,y)\mid 0\leqslant y\leqslant1,0\leqslant x\leqslant1-y\}$，于是$\begin{aligned} \iint_ {\Sigma} y ^ {2} \mathrm {d} S &= \iint_ {D _ {x y}} y ^ {2} \sqrt {1 + \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial x}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial y}\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \iint_ {D _ {x y}} y ^ {2} \sqrt {1 + 1 + 1} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \sqrt {3} \iint_ {D _ {x y}} y ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \sqrt {3} \int_ {0} ^ {1} y ^ {2} \mathrm {d} y \int_ {0} ^ {1 - y} \mathrm {d} x = \sqrt {3} \int_ {0} ^ {1} y ^ {2} (1 - y) \mathrm {d} y = \frac {\sqrt {3}}{1 2}. \end{aligned}$

questionText:
设薄片型物体 S是圆雉面$z=\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}$被柱面$z^{2}=2 x$割下的有限部分，其上任一点的密度为$\mu(x,y,z)=$$9 \sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}}.$记圆雉面与柱面的交线为 C.

I. 求 C在 xOy平面上的投影曲线的方程；

II. 求 S的质量 M.
analysisRich:
解（I）由题设知，圆锥面与柱面的交线 C的方程为$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}z=\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}},\\ z^{2}=2 x, \end{array} \right.$消去 z得到$x^{2}+y^{2}= 2 x$，于是 C在 xOy平面上的投影曲线的方程为$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} = 2 x, \\ z = 0. \end{array} \right.$（Ⅱ）设$D_{xy}=\{(x,y)|x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant 2x\}$，则曲面 S的方程为$z=\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}},(x,y)\in D_{xy}$，从而 S的质量为$\begin{aligned} M &= \iint_ {S} \mu (x, y, z) \mathrm {d} S = \iint_ {S} 9 \sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} + z ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} S \xlongequal {z = \sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \iint_ {S} 9 \sqrt {2 \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right)} \mathrm {d} S \\ &= \iint_ {D _ {x y}} 9 \sqrt {2 \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right)} \cdot \sqrt {1 + \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial x}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial y}\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \iint_ {D _ {x y}} 9 \sqrt {2 \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right)} \cdot \sqrt {1 + \left(\frac {x}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {y}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}}\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ &= 1 8 \iint_ {D _ {x y}} \sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y. \end{aligned}$令$x = r\cos \theta ,y = r\sin \theta$，由$x^{2} + y^{2}\leqslant 2x$知，$r^{2}\leqslant 2r\cos \theta$，即$r\leqslant 2\cos \theta$.如下图，$D_{xy}$在极坐标

变换下对应区域$D = \left\{(r,\theta)\mid 0\leqslant r\leqslant 2\cos \theta , - \frac{\pi}{2}\leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac{\pi}{2}\right\}$，从而$\begin{aligned} M &= 1 8 \iint_ {D _ {x y}} \sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = 1 8 \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2 \cos \theta} r \cdot r \mathrm {d} r \\ &= 4 8 \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos^ {3} \theta \mathrm {d} \theta = 9 6 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos^ {3} \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \\ &= 9 6 \times \frac {2}{3} = 6 4. \end{aligned}$

\frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {\sin^ {3} \theta}{3} \Big | _ {0} ^ {2 \pi} + \frac {\cos^ {3} \theta}{3} \Big | _ {0} ^ {2 \pi} + \frac {1}{2} \left(\cos \theta - \frac {\cos^ {3} \theta}{3}\right) \Big | _ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \\ &= \pi - 0 + 0 + 0 = \pi . \end{aligned}$（法二）如图所示，记$\Sigma$为$L$围成的平面区域的上侧，即$\Sigma = \{(x,y,z) \mid z = x + y, x^2 + y^2 \leqslant 1\}$，则$\Sigma$在$xOy$面上的投影区域为$D_{xy} = \{(x,y) \mid x^2 + y^2 \leqslant 1\}$，$\Sigma$的单位法向量为$(\cos \alpha ,\cos \beta ,\cos \gamma) =$$\left(-\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}},-\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}},\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right).$由斯托克斯公式知$\begin{aligned} \oint_ {L} x z \mathrm {d} x + x \mathrm {d} y + \frac {y ^ {2}}{2} \mathrm {d} z &= \iint_ {\Sigma} \left| \begin{array}{c c c} - \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} & - \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} \\ \frac {\partial}{\partial x} & \frac {\partial}{\partial y} & \frac {\partial}{\partial z} \\ x z & x & \frac {y ^ {2}}{2}  \right| \mathrm {d} S &= \iint_ {\Sigma} \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} (1 - x - y) \mathrm {d} S \\ &= \iint_ {\Sigma} (1 - x - y) \cos \gamma \mathrm {d} S = \iint_ {D _ {x y}} (1 - x - y) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ \frac {\text {对称 性}}{} \iint_ {D _ {x y}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y - 0 - 0 \\ &= \pi . \end{aligned}$

questionText: 已知 L是第一象限中从点（0,0）沿圆周$x^{2}+y^{2}=2 x$到点（2,0），再沿圆周$x^{2}+y^{2}=4$到点（0,2）的曲线段，计算曲线积分$I=\int_{L}3x^{2}y\mathrm{d}x+(x^{3}+x-2y)\mathrm{d}y.$
analysisRich: 解记$L_{3}$为y轴上从点（0,2）到点（0,0）的有向线段.$D = \{(x,y) \mid 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 2, \sqrt{2x - x^2} \leqslant y \leqslant \sqrt{4 - x^2}\}$，则由格林公式知，$\begin{aligned} \int_ {L + L _ {3}} 3 x ^ {2} y \mathrm {d} x + \left(x ^ {3} + x - 2 y\right) \mathrm {d} y &= \iint_ {D} \left(3 x ^ {2} + 1 - 3 x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \iint_ {D} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \frac {\pi \cdot 2 ^ {2}}{4} - \frac {\pi \cdot 1 ^ {2}}{2} = \frac {\pi}{2}. \end{aligned}$$I = \frac {\pi}{2} - 4.$

analysisRich:
解（法一）题设中所给的积分弧段均为闭曲线，由格林公式可知，$\begin{aligned} I _ {i} &= \oint_ {L _ {i}} \left(y + \frac {y ^ {3}}{6}\right) \mathrm {d} x + \left(2 x - \frac {x ^ {3}}{3}\right) \mathrm {d} y = \iint_ {D _ {i}} \left(1 - x ^ {2} - \frac {y ^ {2}}{2}\right) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \frac {1}{2} \iint_ {D _ {i}} \left(2 - 2 x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y, \end{aligned}$其中$D_{i}$为$L_{i}$围成的区域.显然在$D_{4}$内$2-2 x^{2}-y^{2}>0$，在$D_{4}$外$2-2 x^{2}-y^{2}<0$，由重积分对积分区域的可加性及重积分的保号性知，$\begin{array}{l} I _ {4} - I _ {1} = \frac {1}{2} \iint_ {D _ {4} - D _ {1}} \left(2 - 2 x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y > 0 \quad \left(D _ {4} \supset D _ {1}\right), \\ I _ {4} - I _ {2} = - \frac {1}{2} \iint_ {D _ {2} - D _ {4}} \left(2 - 2 x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y > 0 \quad \left(D _ {2} \supset D _ {4}\right), \\ I _ {4} - I _ {3} = \frac {1}{2} \left[ \iint_ {D _ {4} - D _ {3}} \left(2 - 2 x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y - \iint_ {D _ {3} - D _ {4}} \left(2 - 2 x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \right] > 0 \quad (\text {第一 项 大 于} 0, \text {第二 项 小 于} 0). \\ \text {因此}, \max \left\{I _ {1}, I _ {2}, I _ {3}, I _ {4} \right\} = I _ {4}, \text {选} D. \\ \end{array}$（法二）利用圆与椭圆的参数方程将第二类曲线积分直接化为定积分后再计算，其中$L_{1}$的参数方程为$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} x = \cos \theta , \\ y = \sin \theta \end{array} \right.$$(0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant 2\pi), L_{2}$的参数方程为$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} x = \sqrt{2}\cos \theta , \\ y = \sqrt{2}\sin \theta \end{array} \right.$$(0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant 2\pi), L_{3}$的参数方程为$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} x = \sqrt{2}\cos \theta , \\ y = \sin \theta \end{array} \right.$$(0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant 2\pi), L_{4}$的参数方程为$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} x = \cos \theta , \\ y = \sqrt{2}\sin \theta \end{array} \right.$$(0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant 2\pi)$.

将参数方程代入曲线积分，计算得到$I_{1}=\frac{5}{8}\pi, I_{2}=\frac{1}{2}\pi, I_{3}=\frac{3\sqrt{2}}{8}\pi, I_{4}=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\pi.$故$\max \left\{ I_{1}, I_{2}, I_{3}, I_{4} \right\}=I_{4}$，选D.

questionText: 设 L是柱面$x^{2}+y^{2}=1$与平面 y+z=0的交线，从 z轴正向往 z轴负向看去为逆时针方向，则曲线积分$\oint_{L} z \mathrm{d} x+y \mathrm{d} z=$___
analysisRich: 解（法一）$L$的方程为$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} x^{2} + y^{2} = 1, \\ y + z = 0, \end{array} \right.$其参数方程为$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} x = \cos \theta , \\ y = \sin \theta , \theta \text {从} 0 \text {变到} 2 \pi . \text {于是} \\ z = -\sin \theta , \end{array} \right.$$\begin{aligned} \oint_ {L} z \mathrm {d} x + y \mathrm {d} z &= \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \left[ (- \sin \theta) \cdot (- \sin \theta) + \sin \theta \cdot (- \cos \theta) \right] \mathrm {d} \theta \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \left(\sin^ {2} \theta - \sin \theta \cos \theta\right) \mathrm {d} \theta = \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \left(\frac {1 - \cos 2 \theta}{2} - \frac {\sin 2 \theta}{2}\right) \mathrm {d} \theta = \pi . \end{aligned}$（法二）设曲面$\varSigma$是平面$y+z=0$上由L围成的区域的内侧，即$\varSigma=\{(x,y,z)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant1,$$y+z=0\}$$\varSigma$的单位法向量为$(\cos \alpha ,\cos \beta ,\cos \gamma)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}(0,1,1),\varSigma$在xOy面上的投影区域为$D_{xy}=\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant 1\}$，其面积为$\pi$.由斯托克斯公式知，$\oint_ {L} z \mathrm {d} x + y \mathrm {d} z = \iint_ {\Sigma} \left| \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \\ \frac {\partial}{\partial x} & \frac {\partial}{\partial y} & \frac {\partial}{\partial z} \\ z & 0 & y \end{array} \right| \mathrm {d} S = \iint_ {\Sigma} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \mathrm {d} S = \iint_ {\Sigma} \cos \gamma \mathrm {d} S = \iint_ {D _ {x y}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \pi .$

questionText: 已知曲线 L的方程为$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}z=\sqrt{2-x^{2}-y^{2}},\\ z=x, \end{array} \right.$起点为 A(0,$\sqrt{2},0)$，终点为 B(0，$-\sqrt{2},0)$，请计算曲线积分 I=$\int_{L}(y+z)\mathrm{d}x+(z^{2}-x^{2}+y)\mathrm{d}y+x^{2}y^{2}\mathrm{d}z.$
analysisRich:
解（法一）$L$的方程$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}z=\sqrt{2-x^{2}-y^{2}},\\ z=x\end{array}\right.$可化为$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}x^{2}+\frac{y^{2}}{2}=1,\\ z=x\geqslant 0, \end{array}\right.$于是参数方程为$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}x=\cos \theta ,\\ y=\sqrt{2}\sin \theta ,\\ z=\cos \theta , \end{array}\right.$$\theta \in\left[-\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}\right]$且L的起点A对应$\theta =\frac{\pi}{2}$终点对应参数$\theta=-\frac{\pi}{2}$从而$\begin{aligned} I &= \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} \left[ (\sqrt {2} \sin \theta + \cos \theta) \cdot (- \sin \theta) + \sqrt {2} \sin \theta \cdot \sqrt {2} \cos \theta + 2 \sin^ {2} \theta \cos^ {2} \theta \cdot (- \sin \theta) \right] d \theta \\ &= \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \left(\sqrt {2} \sin^ {2} \theta - \sin \theta \cos \theta + 2 \sin^ {3} \theta \cos^ {2} \theta\right) d \theta \\ \underline {{\text {对称性}}} 2 \sqrt {2} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {2} \theta \mathrm {d} \theta - 0 + 0 \\ &= \sqrt {2} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} (1 - \cos 2 \theta) \mathrm {d} \theta = \frac {\sqrt {2}}{2} \pi . \end{aligned}$（法二）利用斯托克斯公式.

设$L_{1}$是从点B到点A的直线段，$\Sigma$为平面$z=x$上由L与$L_{1}$围成的半圆面下侧，其面积为$\pi$单位法向量为$\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}},0,-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right).$由斯托克斯公式知，$\begin{aligned} \oint_ {L + L _ {1}} (y + z) \mathrm {d} x + \left(z ^ {2} - x ^ {2} + y\right) \mathrm {d} y + x ^ {2} y ^ {2} \mathrm {d} z &= \iint_ {\Sigma} \left| \begin{array}{c c c} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & 0 & - \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \\ \frac {\partial}{\partial x} & \frac {\partial}{\partial y} & \frac {\partial}{\partial z} \\ y + z & z ^ {2} - x ^ {2} + y & x ^ {2} y ^ {2}  \right| \mathrm {d} S \\ &= \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \iint_ {\Sigma} \left(2 x ^ {2} y + 1\right) \mathrm {d} S. \end{aligned}$由于曲面$\varSigma$关于 xOz平面对称，且函数$2x^{2}y$是关于 y的奇函数，故$\iint\limits_{S}2x^{2}y\mathrm{d}S=0$从而$\oint_ {L + L _ {1}} (y + z) \mathrm {d} x + \left(z ^ {2} - x ^ {2} + y\right) \mathrm {d} y + x ^ {2} y ^ {2} \mathrm {d} z = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \iint_ {\Sigma} \mathrm {d} S = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \cdot \Sigma \text {的 面 积} = \frac {\sqrt {2}}{2} \pi .$又在$L_{1}$上，$x = 0,z = 0,y$从$-\sqrt{2}$变到$\sqrt{2}$，故$\int_ {L _ {1}} (y + z) \mathrm {d} x + \left(z ^ {2} - x ^ {2} + y\right) \mathrm {d} y + x ^ {2} y ^ {2} \mathrm {d} z = \int_ {- \sqrt {2}} ^ {\sqrt {2}} y \mathrm {d} y = 0.$因此，$I=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\pi -0=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\pi.$

questionText: 设函数 f(x,y)满足$\frac{\partial f(x,y)}{\partial x}=(2 x+1) \mathrm{e}^{2 x-y}$，且 f(0,y)=y+1，$L_{t}$是从点（0，0）到点（1,t）的光滑曲线.计算曲线积分$I(t)=\int_{L_{t}} \frac{\partial f(x,y)}{\partial x} \mathrm{d} x+\frac{\partial f(x,y)}{\partial y} \mathrm{d} y$，并求 I(t)的最小值.
answerRich: $I ( t ) = \mathrm {e} ^ {2 - t} + t, I ( t )$的最小值为3.
analysisRich:
解由$\frac{\partial f(x,y)}{\partial x} = (2x+1)\mathrm{e}^{2x-y}$知，$\begin{aligned} f (x, y) &= \int (2 x + 1) \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x - y} \mathrm {d} x = \mathrm {e} ^ {- y} \int (2 x + 1) \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= \mathrm {e} ^ {- y} \left[ \frac {1}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x} (2 x + 1) - \int \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x} \mathrm {d} x \right] \\ &= \mathrm {e} ^ {- y} \left[ \frac {1}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x} (2 x + 1) - \frac {1}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x} + \varphi_ {1} (y) \right] \\ &= x \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x - y} + \varphi_ {2} (y), \end{aligned}$这里$\varphi_{1}(y),\varphi_{2}(y)$都是以$y$为自变量的待定函数，且$\varphi_{2}(y) = \mathrm{e}^{-y}\varphi_{1}(y)$. 由$f(0,y) = y + 1$得到$\varphi_{2}(y) = y + 1$，从而$f (x, y) = x \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x - y} + y + 1.$下面用两种方法求$I ( t )$（法一）$\frac{\partial f}{\partial x} = (2x + 1)\mathrm{e}^{2x - y},\frac{\partial f}{\partial y} = -x\mathrm{e}^{2x - y} + 1$在整个平面上都连续，故由定理1知，$I (t) = \int_ {L _ {t}} \frac {\partial f (x , y)}{\partial x} \mathrm {d} x + \frac {\partial f (x , y)}{\partial y} \mathrm {d} y = f (1, t) - f (0, 0) = \mathrm {e} ^ {2 - t} + t.$（法二）$\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial x\partial y} = \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial y\partial x} = -(2x + 1)\mathrm{e}^{2x - y}$在整个平面上连续，故由定理2知，曲线积分$I(t)$与路径无关.下面我们选择两条不同的路径来计算$I(t)$.

（a）如图，令$L_{1}$是从点（0,0）到点（1,0），再到点（1,t）的折线段，于是$\begin{aligned} I (t) &= \int_ {L _ {1}} \frac {\partial f (x , y)}{\partial x} \mathrm {d} x + \frac {\partial f (x , y)}{\partial y} \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\partial f (x , 0)}{\partial x} \mathrm {d} x + \int_ {0} ^ {t} \frac {\partial f (1 , y)}{\partial y} \mathrm {d} y \\ &= f (x, 0) \left| _ {x = 0} ^ {x = 1} + f (1, y) \right| _ {y = 0} ^ {y = t} \\ &= f (1, 0) - f (0, 0) + f (1, t) - f (1, 0) \\ &= f (1, t) - f (0, 0) = \mathrm {e} ^ {2 - t} + t. \end{aligned}$（b）如图，令$L_{2}$是从点$(0,0)$到点$(0,t)$，再到点$(1,t)$的折线段，于是$\begin{aligned} I (t) &= \int_ {L _ {2}} \frac {\partial f (x , y)}{\partial x} \mathrm {d} x + \frac {\partial f (x , y)}{\partial y} \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {t} \frac {\partial f (0 , y)}{\partial y} \mathrm {d} y + \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\partial f (x , t)}{\partial x} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= f (0, y) \left| _ {y = 0} ^ {y = t} + f (x, t) \right| _ {x = 0} ^ {x = 1} \\ &= f (0, t) - f (0, 0) + f (1, t) - f (0, t) \\ &= f (1, t) - f (0, 0) = \mathrm {e} ^ {2 - t} + t. \end{aligned}$下面求 I（t）的最小值.$I^{\prime}(t) = 1 - \mathrm{e}^{2 - t}.$令$I^{\prime}(t) = 0$，解得$t = 2$当$t > 2$时，$I^{\prime}(t) > 0$，于是$I(t)$在$[2, +\infty)$上单调增加；当$t < 2$时，$I^{\prime}(t) < 0$，于是$I(t)$在$(-\infty ,2]$上单调减少，从而$t = 2$为$I(t)$的最小值点，最小值为$I (2) = \mathrm {e} ^ {2 - 2} + 2 = 3.$

questionText: 若曲线积分$\int_ {L} \frac {x \mathrm {d} x - a y \mathrm {d} y}{x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} - 1}$在区域$D=\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}<1\}$内与路径无关，则 a=___
analysisRich: 解 令$P=\frac{x}{x^{2}+y^{2}-1}, Q=\frac{-ay}{x^{2}+y^{2}-1}$，则$\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=\frac{-2xy}{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}-1\right)^{2}},$$\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=\frac{2axy}{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}-1\right)^{2}}.$又 D为单连通区域，且曲线积分与路径无关，故$\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}$即$\frac{-2xy}{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}-1\right)^{2}}=\frac{2axy}{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}-1\right)^{2}}$从而 a=-1.

questionText: 设函数$Q ( x,y )=\frac{x}{y^{2}}$. 如果对上半平面（$y>0$）内的任意有向光滑封闭曲线 C都有$\oint_{C}P(x,y)\mathrm{d}x+Q(x,y)\mathrm{d}y=0$，那么函数 P(x,y)可取为（    ）
analysisRich:
解 由 Q(x,y)的表达式可知该函数在上半平面 y > 0内具有一阶连续偏导数，故若 P(x,y)满足在上半平面内具有一阶连续偏导数且$\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}\equiv \frac{\partial P}{\partial y}$，则曲线积分$\oint_{C}P(x,y)\mathrm{d}x+Q(x,y)\mathrm{d}y$在单连通区域 y > 0内与路径无关，即对上半平面 y > 0内的任意分段光滑闭曲线 C都有$\oint_{C}P(x,y)\mathrm{d}x+$$Q(x,y)\mathrm{d}y=0.$由于$\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=\frac{1}{y^{2}}$，故$\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}$应等于$\frac{1}{y^{2}}$. 选项C与选项D的函数均满足该要求. 但是选项C的函数$\frac{1}{x}-\frac{1}{y}$在 x = 0处无定义，从而也就不满足曲线积分与路径无关的条件.

因此，应选D.

questionText: 计算曲线积分$I=\oint_{L}\frac{4x-y}{4x^{2}+y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x+\frac{x+y}{4x^{2}+y^{2}}\mathrm{d}y$，其中 L为$x^{2}+y^{2}=2$，方向为逆时针方向.
analysisRich:
解记 L围成的封闭区域为 D.记$P ( x,y)=\frac{4 x-y}{4 x^{2}+y^{2}}, Q ( x,y)=\frac{x+y}{4 x^{2}+y^{2}}$，则当（x,y）$\neq$（0,0）时，$\frac {\partial Q}{\partial x} = \frac {4 x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} - (x + y) 8 x}{\left(4 x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}} = \frac {y ^ {2} - 4 x ^ {2} - 8 x y}{\left(4 x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}},$$\frac {\partial P}{\partial y} = \frac {- \left(4 x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) - (4 x - y) 2 y}{\left(4 x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}} = \frac {y ^ {2} - 4 x ^ {2} - 8 x y}{\left(4 x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}}.$于是，$\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial P}{\partial y}$原点为被积函数的奇点，且包含在由 L围成的封闭区域 D内.

作辅助曲线$L^{\prime}:4x^{2} + y^{2} = \varepsilon^{2}$，并使$\varepsilon$足够小，使$L^{\prime}$围成的椭圆包含在$L$围成的圆中，其参数方程为$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} x = \frac{\varepsilon}{2}\cos t, t \text{ 从} 0 \\ y = \varepsilon \sin t, \end{array} \right.$变到$2\pi$.如图所示，$L^{\prime}$的正向为逆时针方向，$L^{\prime}$所围成的区域记为$D^{\prime}, L + L^{\prime}^{-}$围成区域$D\backslash D^{\prime}$.被积函数在$D\backslash D^{\prime}$上没有奇点.

由格林公式，$\oint_ {L + L ^ {\prime} -} \frac {4 x - y}{4 x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x + \frac {x + y}{4 x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} y \xlongequal {\text {格 林 公 式}} \iint_ {D \backslash D ^ {\prime}} 0 \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = 0,$因此，$\begin{aligned} I &= \oint_ {L} \frac {4 x - y}{4 x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x + \frac {x + y}{4 x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} y = \oint_ {L ^ {\prime}} \frac {4 x - y}{4 x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x + \frac {x + y}{4 x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} y \\ \frac {4 x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} = \varepsilon^ {2}}{\varepsilon^ {2}} \frac {1}{\varepsilon^ {2}} \oint_ {L ^ {\prime}} (4 x - y) \mathrm {d} x + (x + y) \mathrm {d} y \xlongequal {\text {格 林 公 式}} \frac {1}{\varepsilon^ {2}} \iint_ {D ^ {\prime}} 2 \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \frac {2}{\varepsilon^ {2}} \cdot D ^ {\prime} \text {的 面 积} = \frac {2}{\varepsilon^ {2}} \times \pi \times \frac {\varepsilon}{2} \times \varepsilon = \pi . \end{aligned}$

questionText:
设$D\subset \mathbf{R}^{2}$是有界单连通闭区域，$I(D)=\iint_{D}(4-x^{2}-y^{2})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$取得最大值的积分区域为$D_{1}.$I. 求$I ( D_{1} )$的值；

II. 计算$\int_{\partial D_1}\frac{(x\mathrm{e}^{x^2 + 4y^2} + y)\mathrm{d}x + (4y\mathrm{e}^{x^2 + 4y^2} - x)\mathrm{d}y}{x^2 + 4y^2}$，其中$\partial D_{1}$是$D_{1}$的正向边界.
analysisRich:
解（I）取区域$D_{1}$，使其包含所有使得被积函数非负的点，且不包含使得被积函数小于零的点，则在$D_{1}$上$I(D)$取得最大值. 可取$D_{1}$为$4 - x^{2} - y^{2}\geqslant 0$的区域，即圆盘域$D_{1} = \{(x,y)|x^{2} + y^{2}\leqslant 4\}$.$\begin{aligned} I \left(D _ {1}\right) &= \iint_ {D _ {1}} \left(4 - x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \xlongequal {\text {极 坐 标}} \iint_ {D _ {1}} \left(4 - r ^ {2}\right) r \mathrm {d} r \mathrm {d} \theta = \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2} \left(4 r - r ^ {3}\right) \mathrm {d} r \\ &= 2 \pi \left(2 r ^ {2} - \frac {r ^ {4}}{4}\right) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {2} = 2 \pi \times (8 - 4) = 8 \pi . \end{aligned}$（Ⅱ）记所求积分为$I, P(x,y) = \frac{x\mathrm{e}^{x^2 + 4y^2} + y}{x^2 + 4y^2}, Q(x,y) = \frac{4y\mathrm{e}^{x^2 + 4y^2} - x}{x^2 + 4y^2}$，则当$(x,y)\neq (0,0)$时，$\begin{aligned} \frac {\partial Q}{\partial x} &= \frac {\left(8 x y \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}} - 1\right) \left(x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}\right) - \left(4 y \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}} - x\right) \cdot 2 x}{\left(x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}} \\ &= \frac {8 x y \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}} \left(x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2} - 1\right) + x ^ {2} - 4 y ^ {2}}{\left(x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}}, \end{aligned}$$\begin{aligned} \frac {\partial P}{\partial y} &= \frac {\left(8 x y \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}} + 1\right) \left(x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}\right) - \left(x \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}} + y\right) \cdot 8 y}{\left(x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}} \\ &= \frac {8 x y \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}} \left(x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2} - 1\right) + x ^ {2} - 4 y ^ {2}}{\left(x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}}. \end{aligned}$于是，$\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial P}{\partial y}$原点为被积函数的奇点，且包含在$D_{1}$内.

记$\partial D_{1}=L$作辅助曲线$L^{\prime}:x^{2}+4y^{2}=\varepsilon^{2}$并使$\varepsilon$足够小，使$L^{\prime}$围成的椭圆包含在 L围成的圆中，其参数方程为$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} x=\varepsilon\cos t, \\ y=\frac{\varepsilon}{2}\sin t, \end{array} \right.$t从0变到$2\pi$如图所示，$L^{\prime}$的正向为逆时针方向，$L^{\prime}$所围成的区域记为$D_{0}, L+L^{\prime}-$围成区域$D_{1}\backslash D_{0}$被积函数在$D_{1}\backslash D_{0}$上没有奇点.

由格林公式，$\oint_ {L + L ^ {\prime} -} \frac {\left(x \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}} + y\right) \mathrm {d} x + \left(4 y \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}} - x\right) \mathrm {d} y}{x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}} \xlongequal {\text {格 林 公 式}} \iint_ {D _ {1} \backslash D _ {0}} 0 \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = 0,$因此，$\begin{aligned} I &= \oint_ {L} \frac {\left(x \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}} + y\right) \mathrm {d} x + \left(4 y \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}} - x\right) \mathrm {d} y}{x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}} = \oint_ {L ^ {\prime}} \frac {\left(x \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}} + y\right) \mathrm {d} x + \left(4 y \mathrm {e} ^ {x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}} - x\right) \mathrm {d} y}{x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2}} \\ \xlongequal {x ^ {2} + 4 y ^ {2} = \varepsilon^ {2}} \frac {1}{\varepsilon^ {2}} \oint_ {L ^ {\prime}} \left(x \mathrm {e} ^ {\varepsilon^ {2}} + y\right) \mathrm {d} x + \left(4 y \mathrm {e} ^ {\varepsilon^ {2}} - x\right) \mathrm {d} y \\ \xlongequal {\text {格 林 公 式}} \frac {1}{\varepsilon^ {2}} \iint_ {D _ {0}} \left[ \frac {\partial \left(4 y \mathrm {e} ^ {\varepsilon^ {2}} - x\right)}{\partial x} - \frac {\partial \left(x \mathrm {e} ^ {\varepsilon^ {2}} + y\right)}{\partial y} \right] \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y &= \frac {1}{\varepsilon^ {2}} \iint_ {D _ {0}} (- 1 - 1) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ &= - \frac {2}{\varepsilon^ {2}} \cdot D _ {0} \text {的 面 积} = - \frac {2}{\varepsilon^ {2}} \times \pi \times \varepsilon \times \frac {\varepsilon}{2} = - \pi . \end{aligned}$

questionText: 已知曲线 L是曲面$\Sigma: 4 x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}=1, x\geqslant0, y\geqslant0, z\geqslant0$的边界，曲面$\Sigma$方向朝上，曲线 L的方向和曲面$\Sigma$的方向符合右手法则，计算$I=\oint_{L}(y z^{2}-\cos z) \mathrm{d} x+2 x z^{2} \mathrm{d} y+(2 x y z+x \sin z) \mathrm{d} z.$
analysisRich:

(a)

如图（a）所示，记$L_{1}, L_{2}, L_{3}$分别为 L在 xOy面，yOz面，zOx面的部分在$L_{1}$上，$z=0,\int_{L_{1}}\mathrm{d}z=0.$起点为$\left(\frac{1}{2},0,0\right)$终点为（0，1，0）.在$L_{2}$上，$x=0,\int_{L_{2}}\mathrm{d}x=0.$起点为（0，1，0），终点为（0，0，1）.在$L_{3}$上，$y=0,\int_{L_{3}}\mathrm{d}y=0.$起点为（0，0，1），终点为$\left(\frac{1}{2},0,0\right).$因此，$\begin{aligned} I &= \oint_ {L} \left(y z ^ {2} - \cos z\right) \mathrm {d} x + 2 x z ^ {2} \mathrm {d} y + \left(2 x y z + x \sin z\right) \mathrm {d} z \\ &= \int_ {L _ {1}} (- \cos 0) \mathrm {d} x + 0 + \int_ {L _ {3}} (- \cos z) \mathrm {d} x + x \sin z \mathrm {d} z \\ &= (- 1) \times \left(0 - \frac {1}{2}\right) + \int_ {L _ {3}} \mathrm {d} (- x \cos z) = \frac {1}{2} + (- x \cos z) \Big | _ {(0, 0, 1)} ^ {\left(\frac {1}{2}, 0, 0\right)} \\ &= \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{2} = 0. \end{aligned}$由于曲线$L$的方向和曲面$\Sigma$的方向符合右手法则，故根据斯托克斯公式，$\begin{aligned} I &= \iint_ {\Sigma} \left| \begin{array}{c c c} \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z & \mathrm {d} z \mathrm {d} x & \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ \frac {\partial}{\partial x} & \frac {\partial}{\partial y} & \frac {\partial}{\partial z} \\ y z ^ {2} - \cos z & 2 x z ^ {2} & 2 x y z + x \sin z  \right| \\ &= \iint_ {\Sigma} \left(2 x z - 4 x z\right) \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + (- 1) \left(2 y z + \sin z - 2 y z - \sin z\right) \mathrm {d} z \mathrm {d} x + \left(2 z ^ {2} - z ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \iint_ {\Sigma} (- 2 x z) \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + z ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y. \end{aligned}$如图（b）所示，添加平面$\varSigma_{1}:z=0(4x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant 1)$，取下侧，$\varSigma_{2}:x=0(y^{2}+z^{2}\leqslant 1)$，取后侧，$\varSigma_{3}:y=0(4x^{2}+z^{2}\leqslant 1)$，取左侧，则$\varSigma_{1},\varSigma_{2},\varSigma_{3}$与$\varSigma$共同围成一个空间封闭区域$\varOmega$，且法向量指向外侧.$\oiint_ {\Sigma + \Sigma_ {1} + \Sigma_ {2} + \Sigma_ {3}} (- 2 x z) \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + z ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \iiint_ {\Omega} (- 2 z + 2 z) \mathrm {d} v = 0.$另一方面，由于$\varSigma_{1}$和$\varSigma_{3}$均垂直于yOz面，故在这两个面上关于坐标y,z的积分为0.由于$\varSigma_{2}$和$\varSigma_{3}$均垂直于xOy面，故在这两个面上关于坐标x,y的积分为0.从而在$\varSigma_{3}$上，关于坐标y,z和关于坐标x,y的积分均为0.于是，$\iint_ {\Sigma_ {3}} (- 2 x z) \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + z ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = 0.$再分别代入$\varSigma_{1}$和$\varSigma_{2}$的方程可得$\begin{aligned} \iint_ {\Sigma_ {1}} (- 2 x z) \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + z ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \stackrel {z = 0} {=} 0. \\ \iint_ {\Sigma_ {2}} (- 2 x z) \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + z ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \stackrel {x = 0} {=} 0. \end{aligned}$因此，$I = \oiint_ {\Sigma + \Sigma_ {1} + \Sigma_ {2} + \Sigma_ {3}} (- 2 x z) \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + z ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y - \oiint_ {\Sigma_ {1} + \Sigma_ {2} + \Sigma_ {3}} (- 2 x z) \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + z ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = 0 - 0 = 0.$

questionText: 已知有向曲线 L为球面$x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}=2x$与平面 2x-z-1=0的交线，从z轴正向往z轴负向看去为逆时针方向，计算曲线积分$\int_{L}(6xyz-yz^{2})\mathrm{d}x+2x^{2}z\mathrm{d}y+xyz\mathrm{d}z.$
analysisRich:
分析 本题主要考查第二类曲线积分的计算.

本题中的曲线 L是一条封闭曲线，可以考虑利用斯托克斯公式将曲线积分转化为曲面积分.

解 曲线$L$的方程为$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2} = 2x, \\ 2x - z - 1 = 0. \end{array} \right.$如图所示，$L$为封闭曲线，其所围平面$2x - z - 1 = 0$上的有界部分为$\Sigma$，取上侧.

记所求曲线积分为$I$，由于曲线$L$的方向和曲面$\Sigma$的方向符合右手法则，故根据斯托克斯公式，$\begin{aligned} I &= \oint_ {L} \left(6 x y z - y z ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x + 2 x ^ {2} z \mathrm {d} y + x y z \mathrm {d} z = \iint_ {\Sigma} \left| \begin{array}{c c c} \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z & \mathrm {d} z \mathrm {d} x & \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ \frac {\partial}{\partial x} & \frac {\partial}{\partial y} & \frac {\partial}{\partial z} \\ 6 x y z - y z ^ {2} & 2 x ^ {2} z & x y z  \right| \\ &= \iint_ {\Sigma} \left(x z - 2 x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + \left(6 x y - 3 y z\right) \mathrm {d} z \mathrm {d} x + \left(z ^ {2} - 2 x z\right) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \iint_ {\Sigma} (2 x - z) \cdot (- x) \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + (2 x - z) \cdot 3 y \mathrm {d} z \mathrm {d} x + (2 x - z) \cdot (- z) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ \frac {2 x - z = 1}{\sim} \iint_ {\Sigma} (- x) \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + 3 y \mathrm {d} z \mathrm {d} x + (- z) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y. \end{aligned}$利用两类曲面积分之间的联系将$\iint_{\Sigma} (-x)\mathrm{d}y\mathrm{d}z + 3y\mathrm{d}z\mathrm{d}x + (-z)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$转化为关于坐标$x,y$的积分再计算

令$F ( x,y,z) = z - 2 x + 1$，则曲面$\varSigma$的方程为$F ( x,y,z) = 0$，法向量 n可取为$\left(F_{x}^{\prime},F_{y}^{\prime},F_{z}^{\prime}\right) =$（-2,0,1).于是，$\varSigma$的法向量 n的方向余弦为$\cos \alpha = \frac {- 2}{\sqrt {5}}, \quad \cos \beta = 0, \quad \cos \gamma = \frac {1}{\sqrt {5}}.$由此可得$\mathrm{d}y\mathrm{d}z = \frac{\cos \alpha}{\cos \gamma}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y = -2\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y,\mathrm{d}z\mathrm{d}x = 0\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y = 0.$进一步可得$I = \iint_{\Sigma} (-x)\mathrm{d}y\mathrm{d}z + 3y\mathrm{d}z\mathrm{d}x + (-z)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y = \iint_{\Sigma} [(-x)\cdot(-2) + (-z)\cdot 1]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y = \iint_{D}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y,$其中$D$为$\varSigma$在$xOy$面上的投影区域.于是，$I$的值等于区域D的面积.

将$z = 2x - 1$代入$x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2} = 2x$可得$x^{2} + y^{2} + (2x - 1)^{2} - 2x = 0$，整理可得$5x^{2} - 6x + y^{2} + 1 = 0$，即$5\left(x - \frac{3}{5}\right)^{2} + y^{2} = \frac{4}{5}$，也即$\frac{\left(x - \frac{3}{5}\right)^{2}}{\frac{4}{25}} + \frac{y^{2}}{\frac{4}{5}} = 1.$这是$xOy$面上以点$\left(\frac{3}{5},0\right)$为中心，长半轴长为$\sqrt{\frac{4}{5}}$，短半轴长为$\sqrt{\frac{4}{25}}$的椭圆，从而区域 D为由该椭圆所围成的椭圆盘，其面积为$\pi \cdot \sqrt{\frac{4}{5}}\cdot \sqrt{\frac{4}{25}} = \frac{4\pi}{5\sqrt{5}} = \frac{4\sqrt{5}\pi}{25}.$因此，$I=\frac{4\sqrt{5}\pi}{25}.$

questionText: 已知有向曲线 L是沿抛物线$y=1-x^{2}$从点（1,0）到点（-1,0）的一段，则曲线积分$\int_{L}(y+\cos x)\mathrm{d}x+(2x+\cos y)\mathrm{d}y=$___
analysisRich:
解（法一）如图所示，添加一条有向线段$L_{1}$，使之起点为$(-1,0)$，终点为（1，0），则$L + L_{1}$围成一个平面封闭区域$D,L + L_{1}$为$D$的正向边界.

注意到区域 D关于 y轴对称，记$D_{1}$为 D位于 y轴右边的部分.将$D_{1}$写成 X型区域.$D _ {1} = \left\{(x, y) \mid 0 \leqslant y \leqslant 1 - x ^ {2}, 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1 \right\}.$记$P ( x,y)=y+\cos x, Q ( x,y)=2 x+\cos y$，则$\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=2-1=1.$根据格林公式，$\begin{aligned} \oint_ {L + L _ {1}} (y + \cos x) \mathrm {d} x + (2 x + \cos y) \mathrm {d} y &= \iint_ {D} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = 2 \iint_ {D _ {1}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {0} ^ {1 - x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} y \\ &= 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x = 2 \left(1 - \frac {x ^ {3}}{3} \Big | _ {0} ^ {1}\right) = \frac {4}{3}. \end{aligned}$另一方面，$\int_ {L _ {1}} \left(y + \cos x\right) \mathrm {d} x + \left(2 x + \cos y\right) \mathrm {d} y \stackrel {y = 0} {=} \int_ {L _ {1}} \cos x \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {- 1} ^ {1} \cos x \mathrm {d} x = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \cos x \mathrm {d} x = 2 \sin 1.$因此，$\int_{L}(y + \cos x)\mathrm{d}x + (2x + \cos y)\mathrm{d}y = \frac{4}{3} - 2\sin 1.$（法二）曲线 L的参数方程为$\left\{\begin{array}{l}x=x,\\ y=1-x^{2},\end{array}\right.$x从1变到-1.将参数方程代入曲线积分可得$\int_{L}(y+\cos x)\mathrm{d}x+(2x+\cos y)\mathrm{d}y=\int_{1}^{-1}\left\{(1-x^{2}+\cos x)+[2x+\cos(1-x^{2})]\cdot(-2x)\right\}\mathrm{d}x$$= \int_{1}^{-1}\left[1-5x^{2}+\cos x-2x\cos \left(1-x^{2}\right)\right]\mathrm{d}x$$\frac{\mathrm{对称性}}{}2\int_{0}^{1}\left(5x^{2}-1-\cos x\right)\mathrm{d}x=2\left(\frac{5x^{3}}{3}-x-\sin x\right)\Bigg|_{0}^{1}$$= 2\left(\frac{2}{3}-\sin 1\right)=\frac{4}{3}-2\sin 1.$

questionText: 设有界区域$\Omega$由平面$2x+y+2z=2$与三个坐标平面围成，$\Sigma$为$\Omega$整个表面的外侧，计算曲面积分 I =$\iint\limits_{\Sigma} ( x^{2}+1 ) \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z-2 y \mathrm{d} z \mathrm{d} x+3 z \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y.$
analysisRich: 解 由题设知，$\varOmega=\left\{(x,y,z)\mid0\leqslant z\leqslant\frac{2-2x-y}{2},0\leqslant y\leqslant 2-2x,0\leqslant x\leqslant 1\right\}$，则$\varOmega$的体积为$V_{\varOmega}=\frac{1}{3}\times \frac{1\times 2}{2}\times 1=\frac{1}{3}$.再由高斯公式知，$\begin{aligned} I &= \iint_ {\Sigma} \left(x ^ {2} + 1\right) \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z - 2 y \mathrm {d} z \mathrm {d} x + 3 z \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \iiint_ {\Omega} \left(2 x - 2 + 3\right) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z \\ &= 2 \iiint_ {\Omega} x \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + \iiint_ {\Omega} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {0} ^ {2 - 2 x} \mathrm {d} y \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {2 - 2 x - y}{2}} x \mathrm {d} z + V _ {\Omega} \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {0} ^ {2 - 2 x} x (2 - 2 x - y) \mathrm {d} y + \frac {1}{3} = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \left[ (2 - 2 x) ^ {2} - \frac {(2 - 2 x) ^ {2}}{2} \right] \mathrm {d} x + \frac {1}{3} \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} 2 \left(x - 2 x ^ {2} + x ^ {3}\right) \mathrm {d} x + \frac {1}{3} = \left(x ^ {2} - \frac {4}{3} x ^ {3} + \frac {x ^ {4}}{2}\right) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} + \frac {1}{3} = \frac {1}{2}. \end{aligned}$

questionText: 设$\Sigma$是曲面$x=\sqrt{1-3 y^{2}-3 z^{2}}$的前侧，计算曲面积分$I=\iint_{\Sigma} x \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z+(y^{3}+2) \mathrm{d} z \mathrm{d} x+z^{3} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y.$
analysisRich:
解如图所示，添加辅助平面$\varSigma^{\prime}$：$x=0(3y^{2}+3z^{2}\leqslant 1)$，取后侧，即法向量指向 x轴负向，则$\varSigma$与$\varSigma^{\prime}$围成一个半椭球体$\varOmega$，且法向量指向外侧.

根据高斯公式，

根据高斯公式，$\iint_{\Sigma+\Sigma^{\prime}}x\mathrm{d}y\mathrm{d}z+(y^{3}+2)\mathrm{d}z\mathrm{d}x+z^{3}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iiint_{\Omega}(1+3y^{2}+3z^{2})\mathrm{d}v.$采用先重后单的积分次序计算$\iiint_{\Omega}(1+3y^{2}+3z^{2})\mathrm{d}v.$沿平行于 yOz面的方向作$\varOmega$的横截面，得$D _ {x} = \left\{(y, z) \mid 3 y ^ {2} + 3 z ^ {2} \leqslant 1 - x ^ {2} \right\}.$$D_{x}$是半径为$\sqrt{\frac{1-x^{2}}{3}}$的圆盘.于是，$\Omega = \left\{(x, y, z) \mid (y, z) \in D _ {x}, 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1 \right\}.$$\begin{aligned} \iiint_ {\Omega} \left(1 + 3 y ^ {2} + 3 z ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} v &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \iint_ {D _ {x}} \left(1 + 3 y ^ {2} + 3 z ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z \stackrel {\text {极 坐 标}} {=} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {\frac {1 - x ^ {2}}{3}}} \left(1 + 3 r ^ {2}\right) \cdot r \mathrm {d} r \\ &= 2 \pi \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(\frac {r ^ {2}}{2} + \frac {3 r ^ {4}}{4}\right) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\sqrt {\frac {1 - x ^ {2}}{3}}} \mathrm {d} x = 2 \pi \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left[ \frac {1 - x ^ {2}}{6} + \frac {3}{4} \cdot \frac {\left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}}{3 ^ {2}} \right] \mathrm {d} x \\ &= \frac {\pi}{6} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(x ^ {4} - 4 x ^ {2} + 3\right) \mathrm {d} x = \frac {\pi}{6} \times \left(\frac {1}{5} - \frac {4}{3} + 3\right) = \frac {1 4 \pi}{4 5}. \end{aligned}$因为$\Sigma^{\prime}$垂直于$zOx$面与$xOy$面，且$\Sigma^{\prime}$的方程为$x = 0(3y^{2} + 3z^{2}\leqslant 1)$，所以$\iint_ {\Sigma^ {\prime}} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + \left(y ^ {3} + 2\right) \mathrm {d} z \mathrm {d} x + z ^ {3} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \iint_ {\Sigma^ {\prime}} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z \stackrel {x = 0} {=} \iint_ {\Sigma^ {\prime}} 0 \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z = 0.$因此，$I=\frac{14\pi}{45}-0=\frac{14\pi}{45}.$

questionText: 设$\Sigma$设为曲面$x^{2}+y^{2}+4 z^{2}=4 ( z \geqslant0 )$的上侧，则$\iint\limits_{\Sigma} \sqrt{4-x^{2}-4 z^{2}} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y=$___
analysisRich: 解 将曲面方程代入被积函数，可得$\iint\limits_{\Sigma}\sqrt{4-x^{2}-4z^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint\limits_{\Sigma}\sqrt{y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint\limits_{\Sigma}|y|\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y.$如图所示，令$z = 0$，可得曲面$\Sigma$在$xOy$面上的投影区域为$D_{xy} = \{(x,y)|x^2 + y^2\leqslant 4\}$.注意到$D_{xy}$关于$x$轴对称，记$D$为$D_{xy}$位于$x$轴上方的部分.$D$在极坐标系下的表示为$D = \left\{(r, \theta) \mid 0 \leqslant r \leqslant 2, 0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \pi \right\}.$又因为$\sum$取上侧，所以$\begin{aligned} \iint_ {\Sigma} | y | \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y &= \iint_ {D _ {x y}} | y | \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \xlongequal {\text {对称性}} 2 \iint_ {D} y \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ \xlongequal {\text {极 坐 标}} 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2} r \sin \theta \cdot r \mathrm {d} r \\ &= 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2} r ^ {2} \mathrm {d} r \\ &= 2 \cdot 2 \cdot \left. \frac {r ^ {3}}{3} \right| _ {0} ^ {2} = \frac {3 2}{3}. \end{aligned}$

questionText: 设$\Sigma$为曲面$z=\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}$$(1\leqslant x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant 4)$的下侧，f(x)是连续函数，计算$I=\iint\limits_{\Sigma}[xf(xy)+2x-y]\mathrm{d}y\mathrm{d}z+[yf(xy)+2y+x]\mathrm{d}z\mathrm{d}x+[zf(xy)+z]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y.$
analysisRich:
解$\varSigma$如图（a）所示.由于曲面$\varSigma$取下侧，故$\varSigma$的法向量n与z轴正向成钝角.记$F(x,y,z)=$$\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}-z$，可得$n=(F_{x}^{\prime},F_{y}^{\prime},F_{z}^{\prime})=\left(\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}},\frac{y}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}},-1\right)=\left(\frac{x}{z},\frac{y}{z},-1\right).$由此可知，$\frac{\cos \alpha}{\cos \gamma}=-\frac{x}{z},\frac{\cos \beta}{\cos \gamma}=-\frac{y}{z}.$(a)

(b)

记$D$为$\Sigma$在$xOy$面的投影区域. 利用两类曲面积分之间的联系，可得$\begin{array}{l} I = \iint_ {\Sigma} \left\{\left[ x f (x y) + 2 x - y \right] \cdot \frac {\cos \alpha}{\cos \gamma} \cdot \cos \gamma + \left[ y f (x y) + 2 y + x \right] \cdot \frac {\cos \beta}{\cos \gamma} \cdot \cos \gamma + \left[ z f (x y) + z \right] \cos \gamma \right\} d S \\ \underline {{\cos \gamma \mathrm {d} S = \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y}} \iint_ {\Sigma} \left\{\left[ x f (x y) + 2 x - y \right] \cdot \left(- \frac {x}{z}\right) + \left[ y f (x y) + 2 y + x \right] \cdot \left(- \frac {y}{z}\right) + \left[ z f (x y) + z \right] \right\} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ = \iint_ {\Sigma} \left[ \left(- \frac {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}{z} + z\right) f (x y) - \frac {2 \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right)}{z} + z \right] \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \underline {{= \frac {z = \sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}}{\Sigma}}} \iint_ {\Sigma} (z - 2 z) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ = - \iint_ {\Sigma} z \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \underline {{\underline {{\Sigma}} \text {取 下 侧}}} \iint_ {D} \sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y. \\ \end{array}$如图（b）所示，$D$为一个圆环区域.$D=\{(x,y)\mid 1\leqslant x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant 4\}$在极坐标系下计算$\iint_{D}\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y.$$\iint_ {D} \sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \xlongequal {\text {极 坐 标}} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {1} ^ {2} r ^ {2} \mathrm {d} r = 2 \pi \cdot \frac {r ^ {3}}{3} \Big | _ {1} ^ {2} = \frac {1 4 \pi}{3}.$因此，$I=\frac{14\pi}{3}$

analysisRich:
解空间区域$\varOmega=\left\{(x,y,z)\mid x^{2}+4 y^{2}\leqslant 4,0\leqslant z\leqslant 2\right\}$为椭圆柱面$x^{2}+4 y^{2}=4$，平面z=0以及z=2围成的区域，是一个椭圆柱体.该柱体的底面为椭圆区域$\left\{(x,y)\left| \frac{x^{2}}{4}+y^{2}\leqslant 1\right.\right\}$，面积为$2\pi$，柱体的高为2.$\varSigma$为$\varOmega$的外侧边界.

对曲面积分$\iint_{\Sigma} x^{2}\mathrm{d}y\mathrm{d}z + y^{2}\mathrm{d}z\mathrm{d}x + z\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$使用高斯公式可得，$\iint_ {\Sigma} x ^ {2} \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + y ^ {2} \mathrm {d} z \mathrm {d} x + z \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \iiint_ {\Omega} (2 x + 2 y + 1) \mathrm {d} v.$由于$\varOmega$关于$yOz$面，$zOx$面均对称，故$\iiint_{\varOmega} x\mathrm{d}v = 0,$$\iiint_{\varOmega} y\mathrm{d}v = 0.$$\iiint_ {\Omega} (2 x + 2 y + 1) \mathrm {d} v = \iiint_ {\Omega} \mathrm {d} v = \Omega \text {的 体 积} = 2 \pi \times 2 = 4 \pi .$

questionText: 设空间有界区域$\Omega$由柱面$x^{2}+y^{2}=1$与平面 z=0和 x+z=1围成，$\Sigma$为$\Omega$边界曲面的外侧，计算曲面积分$I=\iint_{\Sigma}2xz\mathrm{d}y\mathrm{d}z+xz\cos y\mathrm{d}z\mathrm{d}x+3yz\sin x\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y.$
analysisRich:
由于$\varSigma$为封闭曲面，且被积函数在$\varOmega$上具有一阶连续偏导数，故可以考虑直接利用高斯公式将第二类曲面积分转化为三重积分.

解 由高斯公式可知，$I = \iiint_ {\Omega} \left(2 z - x z \sin y + 3 y \sin x\right) \mathrm {d} v.$区域$\varOmega$如图所示.注意到$\varOmega$关于zOx面对称，而$xz\sin y$和3ysin x均为关于y的奇函数，故由对称性的结论可知，$\iiint_ {\Omega} \left(2 z - x z \sin y + 3 y \sin x\right) \mathrm {d} v \xlongequal {\text {对称性}} \iiint_ {\Omega} 2 z \mathrm {d} v.$采用先单后重的积分次序.由于$\varOmega$在 xOy面上的投影区域$D=\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant 1\}$，D关于坐标轴均对称，且关于变量x,y具有轮换对称性，故$\begin{aligned} \iiint_ {\Omega} 2 z \mathrm {d} v &= \iint_ {D} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \int_ {0} ^ {1 - x} 2 z \mathrm {d} z = \iint_ {D} (1 - x) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \xlongequal {\text {对称性}} \iint_ {D} \left(1 + x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \pi + \iint_ {D} x ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \xlongequal {\text {轮换对称性}} \pi + \frac {1}{2} \iint_ {D} \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ \xlongequal {\text {极 坐 标}} \pi + \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {1} r ^ {2} \cdot r \mathrm {d} r &= \pi + \frac {\pi}{4} = \frac {5 \pi}{4}. \end{aligned}$

questionText: 设$P=P(x,y,z), Q=Q(x,y,z)$均为连续函数，$\Sigma$为曲面$z=\sqrt{1-x^{2}-y^{2}}$$( x \leqslant0, y \geqslant0)$的上侧，则$\iint\limits_{\Sigma} P\mathrm{d}y\mathrm{d}z+ Q\mathrm{d}z\mathrm{d}x=$(    )
analysisRich: 解 由于曲面$\varSigma$取上侧，故$\varSigma$的法向量与z轴正向成锐角，从而$\varSigma$的法向量$n=(-z_{x}^{\prime},-z_{y}^{\prime},1)$的方向余弦为$\cos \alpha = \frac {- z _ {x} ^ {\prime}}{\sqrt {1 + z _ {x} ^ {\prime 2} + z _ {y} ^ {\prime 2}}}, \quad \cos \beta = \frac {- z _ {y} ^ {\prime}}{\sqrt {1 + z _ {x} ^ {\prime 2} + z _ {y} ^ {\prime 2}}}, \quad \cos \gamma = \frac {1}{\sqrt {1 + z _ {x} ^ {\prime 2} + z _ {y} ^ {\prime 2}}}.$由方向余弦的表达式可得，$\cos \alpha=-z_{x}^{\prime}\cos \gamma, \cos \beta=-z_{y}^{\prime}\cos \gamma$，从而$\mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z = \cos \alpha \mathrm {d} S = - z _ {x} ^ {\prime} \cos \gamma \mathrm {d} S = - z _ {x} ^ {\prime} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y, \mathrm {d} z \mathrm {d} x = \cos \beta \mathrm {d} S = - z _ {y} ^ {\prime} \cos \gamma \mathrm {d} S = - z _ {y} ^ {\prime} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y.$计算得$z _ {x} ^ {\prime} = \frac {- x}{\sqrt {1 - x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}}} = - \frac {x}{z}, \quad z _ {y} ^ {\prime} = \frac {- y}{\sqrt {1 - x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}}} = - \frac {y}{z}.$于是，$\iint_ {\Sigma} P \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + Q \mathrm {d} z \mathrm {d} x = \iint_ {\Sigma} \left[ P \cdot \left(- z _ {x} ^ {\prime}\right) + Q \cdot \left(- z _ {y} ^ {\prime}\right) \right] \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \iint_ {\Sigma} \left(\frac {x}{z} P + \frac {y}{z} Q\right) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y.$因此，应选A.

questionText: 设$\Sigma$是由直线$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}x=0\\ y=0\end{array}\right.$，绕直线$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}x=t\\ y=t\\ z=t\end{array}\right.$（t为参数）旋转一周得到的曲面，$\Sigma_{1}$是$\Sigma$介于平面 x+y+z=0与平面 x+y+z=1之间部分的外侧，计算曲面积分$I=\iint_{\Sigma_{1}}x\mathrm{d}y\mathrm{d}z+(y+1)\mathrm{d}z\mathrm{d}x+(z+2)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y.$
analysisRich:
解直线$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}x=0\\ y=0\end{array}\right.$可视为z轴，直线$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}x=t,\\ y=t,\\ z=t\end{array}\right.$（t为参数）是以（1，1，1）为方向向量且过原点的直

线，故$\varSigma$是以原点为顶点，直线$\frac{x}{1}=\frac{y}{1}=\frac{z}{1}$为轴（圆锥底面上的高所在直线），且过点（1，0，0），（0，1，0），（0，0，1）的圆锥面.

如图所示，记$\Sigma_{2}$为平面$x + y + z = 1$被$\Sigma$所截得的有限部分，取上侧，则$\Sigma_{1}$与$\Sigma_{2}$共同围成一个圆锥体$\Omega ,\Sigma_{1}\cup \Sigma_{2}$构成$\Omega$的外侧.

圆锥体的底面圆心为平面$x + y + z = 1$与直线$x = y = z$的交点，解得$x = y = z = \frac{1}{3}$，即底面圆心为$\left(\frac{1}{3}, \frac{1}{3}, \frac{1}{3}\right)$. 底面圆的半径为点(0,0,1)

到点$\left(\frac{1}{3},\frac{1}{3},\frac{1}{3}\right)$的距离，即$\sqrt{\frac{1}{9} + \frac{1}{9} + \frac{4}{9}} = \sqrt{\frac{2}{3}}.$圆锥体的高为点（0,0,0）到点$\left(\frac{1}{3},\frac{1}{3},\frac{1}{3}\right)$的距离，即$\sqrt{\frac{1}{9} + \frac{1}{9} + \frac{1}{9}} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{3}}.$于是，$\varOmega$的体积$V = \frac{1}{3}\cdot \frac{2\pi}{3}\cdot \sqrt{\frac{1}{3}} = \frac{2\sqrt{3}\pi}{27}.$根据高斯公式，$\iint_ {\Sigma_ {1} \cup \Sigma_ {2}} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + (y + 1) \mathrm {d} z \mathrm {d} x + (z + 2) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = 3 \iiint_ {\Omega} \mathrm {d} v = \frac {2 \sqrt {3} \pi}{9}.$于是，$\iint_ {\Sigma_ {1}} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + (y + 1) \mathrm {d} z \mathrm {d} x + (z + 2) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \frac {2 \sqrt {3} \pi}{9} - \iint_ {\Sigma_ {2}} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + (y + 1) \mathrm {d} z \mathrm {d} x + (z + 2) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y.$下面计算$\iint\limits_{\Sigma_{2}}x\mathrm{d}y\mathrm{d}z+(y+1)\mathrm{d}z\mathrm{d}x+(z+2)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y.$由于$\varSigma_{2}$的法向量（1，1，1）的方向余弦$\cos \alpha=\cos \beta=\cos \gamma=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$，故$\mathrm{d}y\mathrm{d}z=\mathrm{d}z\mathrm{d}x=\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$$\begin{aligned} \iint_ {\Sigma_ {2}} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + (y + 1) \mathrm {d} z \mathrm {d} x + (z + 2) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \xlongequal {z = 1 - x - y} \iint_ {\Sigma_ {2}} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + (y + 1) \mathrm {d} z \mathrm {d} x + (3 - x - y) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ &= \iint_ {\Sigma_ {2}} 4 \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \frac {4}{\sqrt {3}} \iint_ {\Sigma_ {2}} \mathrm {d} S = \frac {4}{\sqrt {3}} \Sigma_ {2} \text {的 面 积}. \end{aligned}$又因为$\varSigma_{2}$的面积即圆锥体的底面圆面积，所以$\iint_ {\Sigma_ {2}} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + (y + 1) \mathrm {d} z \mathrm {d} x + (z + 2) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \frac {4}{\sqrt {3}} \cdot \frac {2 \pi}{3} = \frac {8 \sqrt {3} \pi}{9}.$因此，$\iint_ {\Sigma_ {1}} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z + (y + 1) \mathrm {d} z \mathrm {d} x + (z + 2) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \frac {2 \sqrt {3} \pi}{9} - \frac {8 \sqrt {3} \pi}{9} = - \frac {2 \sqrt {3} \pi}{3}.$

questionText: 设$\varOmega = \{(x,y,z) \mid x^2 + y^2 \leqslant z \leqslant 1\}$, 则$\varOmega$的形心的坚坐标$\bar{z} =$___
analysisRich: 解（法一）由题设知，$\varOmega=\{(x,y,z)\mid(x,y)\in D_{z},0\leqslant z\leqslant 1\}$，其中$D_{z}=\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant z\}$且$D_{z}$的面积为$\pi z$，从而$\bar {z} = \frac {\iiint_ {\Omega} z \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z}{\iiint_ {\Omega} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z} = \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {1} z \mathrm {d} z \iint_ {D _ {z}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y}{\int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} z \iint_ {D _ {z}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y} = \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(z \cdot \pi z\right) \mathrm {d} z}{\int_ {0} ^ {1} \pi z \mathrm {d} z} = \frac {\frac {\pi}{3}}{\frac {\pi}{2}} = \frac {2}{3}.$（法二）由题设知，$\varOmega=\{(x,y,z)\mid(x,y)\in D_{xy},x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant z\leqslant 1\}$，其中$D_{xy}=\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant 1\}$，从而$\begin{aligned} \bar {z} &= \frac {\iiint_ {\Omega} z \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z}{\iiint_ {\Omega} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z} = \frac {\iint_ {D _ {x y}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \int_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} ^ {1} z \mathrm {d} z}{\iint_ {D _ {x y}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \int_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} z} = \frac {\frac {1}{2} \iint_ {D _ {x y}} \left[ 1 - \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) ^ {2} \right] \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y}{\iint_ {D _ {x y}} \left(1 - x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y} \\ \frac {x = r \cos \theta}{y = r \sin \theta} \frac {\frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(1 - r ^ {4}\right) r \mathrm {d} r}{\int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(1 - r ^ {2}\right) r \mathrm {d} r} &= \frac {\frac {\pi}{3}}{\frac {\pi}{2}} = \frac {2}{3}. \end{aligned}$

questionText:
19. (本题满分10分)

设直线 L过 A(1,0,0),B(0,1,1)两点，将 L绕 z轴旋转一周得到曲面$\Sigma$$\Sigma$与平面$z=0,z=2$所围成的立体为$\Omega$.

I. 求曲面$\Sigma$的方程;

II. 求$\Omega$的形心坐标.
analysisRich: 解（I）直线 L的方程为$\frac{x-1}{-1}=\frac{y}{1}=\frac{z}{1}$即$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x = 1 - z, \\ y = z, \end{array} \right.$从而曲面$\Sigma$的方程为$x^{2} + y^{2} = (1 - z)^{2} + z^{2}$，即$x^{2} + y^{2} = 2z^{2} - 2z + 1.$（Ⅱ）设$\varOmega$的形心坐标为$(\bar{x},\bar{y},\bar{z})$.由曲面$\Sigma$的方程知，$\varOmega$关于$xOz,yOz$面对称，从而$\bar {x} = \frac {\iiint_ {\Omega} x \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z}{\iiint_ {\Omega} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z} = 0, \quad \bar {y} = \frac {\iiint_ {\Omega} y \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z}{\iiint_ {\Omega} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z} = 0.$记$D_{z} = \{(x,y)\mid x^{2} + y^{2}\leqslant 2z^{2} - 2z + 1\}$，则$\iiint_ {\Omega} z \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z = \int_ {0} ^ {2} z \mathrm {d} z \iint_ {D _ {z}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {2} z \cdot \pi \left(2 z ^ {2} - 2 z + 1\right) \mathrm {d} z = \frac {1 4}{3} \pi ,$$\iiint_ {\Omega} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z = \int_ {0} ^ {2} \mathrm {d} z \iint_ {D _ {z}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {2} \pi \left(2 z ^ {2} - 2 z + 1\right) \mathrm {d} z = \frac {1 0}{3} \pi .$于是$\bar{z} = \frac{\iiint \Omega z\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\mathrm{d}z}{\iiint \Omega \mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\mathrm{d}z} = \frac{7}{5}$. 因此$\varOmega$的形心坐标为$\left(0,0,\frac{7}{5}\right)$.

questionText: 设$\Omega$是由锥面$x^{2}+(y-z)^{2}=(1-z)^{2}(0\leqslant z\leqslant 1)$与平面 z=0围成的锥体，求$\Omega$的形心坐标.
analysisRich:
解 由锥面方程可知，$\varOmega$是一个介于 xOy面与平面 z=1之间的锥体，且$\varOmega$关于 yOz面对称，故由对称性可知，$\overline{x}=0.$下面计算$\varOmega$的体积V.

令$z = 0$，可得锥面与$xOy$面的交线为$x^{2} + y^{2} = 1$，故$\varOmega$的底面为一个圆心在原点、半径为1的圆，面积为$\pi$.又因为$0\leqslant z\leqslant 1,\varOmega$的高为1，所以由锥体的体积公式可知，$\varOmega$的体积$V = \frac{1}{3}\pi$下面分别计算$\bar{z},\bar{y}。$沿平行于$x O y$面的方向作$\varOmega$的截面，即以平面$Z=z$截$\varOmega$，所得截面记为$D_{z}.$$D_{z}$为圆心在（0，z，z）、半径为1-z的圆盘区域.写出$Z=z$上的$D_{z}$的表示.$D _ {z} = \left\{(x, y) \mid x ^ {2} + (y - z) ^ {2} \leqslant (1 - z) ^ {2} \right\}.$于是，$\Omega = \left\{(x, y, z) \mid (x, y) \in D _ {z}, 0 \leqslant z \leqslant 1 \right\}.$利用“先重后单”的次序计算积分.$\begin{aligned} \iiint_ {\Omega} z \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} z \mathrm {d} z \iint_ {D _ {z}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} z \cdot \left(D _ {z} \text {的 面 积}\right) \mathrm {d} z = \pi \int_ {0} ^ {1} z (1 - z) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} z \\ &= \pi \cdot \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(z ^ {3} - 2 z ^ {2} + z\right) \mathrm {d} z = \pi \cdot \left(\frac {1}{4} - \frac {2}{3} + \frac {1}{2}\right) = \frac {\pi}{1 2}. \end{aligned}$$\begin{aligned} \iiint_ {\Omega} y \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} z \iint_ {D _ {z}} y \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \frac {x = r \cos \theta}{y = z + r \sin \theta} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} z \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {1 - z} (z + r \sin \theta) \cdot r \mathrm {d} r \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} z \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \left(z \cdot \frac {r ^ {2}}{2} + \frac {r ^ {3}}{3} \cdot \sin \theta\right) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1 - z} \mathrm {d} \theta = \int_ {0} ^ {1} 2 \pi \cdot z \cdot \frac {(1 - z) ^ {2}}{2} \mathrm {d} z \\ &= \pi \int_ {0} ^ {1} z (1 - z) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} z = \frac {\pi}{1 2}. \end{aligned}$因此，$\bar{y} = \frac{\frac{\pi}{12}}{\frac{\pi}{3}} = \frac{1}{4},\bar{z} = \frac{\frac{\pi}{12}}{\frac{\pi}{3}} = \frac{1}{4}.$综上所述，$\varOmega$的形心坐标为$\left(0,\frac{1}{4},\frac{1}{4}\right)$

questionText: 如图，正方形$\{(x,y)\mid|x|\leqslant1,|y|\leqslant1\}$被其对角线划分为四个区域$D_{k}(k=1,2,3,4),I_{k}=\iint_{D_{k}}y\cos x\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$则$\max_{1\leqslant k\leqslant4}\{I_{k}\}=$（    ）
analysisRich: 解 令$f ( x,y)=y \cos x$，由于$D_{4}$关于x轴对称，且$f ( x,y)=-f ( x,-y)$，故$I_{4}=0$.同理得到$I_{2}=0$.又$f ( x,y)$在$D_{1}$内部恒大于0，在$D_{3}$内部恒小于0，故由重积分的保号性知，$I_{1}>0, I_{3}<0.$综上所述，$\max_{1\leq k\leq 4}\left\{I_{k}\right\}=I_{1}$应选A.

questionText: $\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\sum_{j=1}^{n}\frac{n}{(n+i)(n^{2}+j^{2})}=$(    )
analysisRich:
解 （法一）考虑将原极限写成二重积分.

令$\Delta \sigma_{ij} = \left[\frac{i - 1}{n},\frac{i}{n}\right]\times \left[\frac{j - 1}{n},\frac{j}{n}\right](i,j = 1,2,\dots ,n)$，则$\{\Delta \sigma_{ij}\}_{1\leqslant i,j\leqslant n}$为$D = [0,1]\times [0,1]$上的一个划分，$\Delta \sigma_{ij}$的面积为$\frac{1}{n^2}$.取$\Delta \sigma_{ij}$上的一点$\left(\frac{i}{n},\frac{j}{n}\right)$.

由于$\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {n} \frac {n}{(n + i) \left(n ^ {2} + j ^ {2}\right)} = \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {n} \frac {1}{\left(1 + \frac {i}{n}\right) \left(1 + \frac {j ^ {2}}{n ^ {2}}\right)} \cdot \frac {1}{n ^ {2}},$故$\begin{aligned} \text {原 极 限} &= \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \left[ \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {n} \frac {1}{\left(1 + \frac {i}{n}\right)\left(1 + \frac {j ^ {2}}{n ^ {2}}\right)} \right] = \iint_ {D} \frac {1}{(1 + x) \left(1 + y ^ {2}\right)} \mathrm {d} \sigma \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{(1 + x) \left(1 + y ^ {2}\right)} \mathrm {d} y. \end{aligned}$应选 D.

（法二）由于所求极限的表达式中 i，j无关，故可以考虑将原极限写成定积分的乘积.由于$\begin{aligned} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {n} \frac {n}{(n + i) \left(n ^ {2} + j ^ {2}\right)} &= \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {n} \left(\frac {1}{1 + \frac {i}{n}} \cdot \frac {1}{n}\right) \left(\frac {1}{1 + \frac {j ^ {2}}{n ^ {2}}} \cdot \frac {1}{n}\right) \\ \underline {{i , j \text {无关}}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left(\frac {1}{1 + \frac {i}{n}} \cdot \frac {1}{n}\right) \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {n} \left(\frac {1}{1 + \frac {j ^ {2}}{n ^ {2}}} \cdot \frac {1}{n}\right), \end{aligned}$故$\begin{aligned} &= \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left(\frac {1}{1 + \frac {i}{n}} \cdot \frac {1}{n}\right) \cdot \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {n} \left(\frac {1}{1 + \frac {j ^ {2}}{n ^ {2}}} \cdot \frac {1}{n}\right) = \left(\int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{1 + x} \mathrm {d} x\right)\left(\int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{1 + y ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} y\right) \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{(1 + x) \left(1 + y ^ {2}\right)} \mathrm {d} y. \end{aligned}$应选 D.

questionText: 设$\Omega=\{(x,y,z)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\leqslant1\}$，则$\iiint\limits_{\Omega}z^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\mathrm{d}z=$___
analysisRich: 解 （法一）由轮换对称性知，$\iiint_ {\Omega} z ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z = \iiint_ {\Omega} y ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z = \iiint_ {\Omega} x ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z,$于是$\begin{aligned} \iiint_ {\Omega} z ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z &= \frac {1}{3} \iiint_ {\Omega} \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} + z ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z \\ &= \frac {1}{3} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \mathrm {d} \varphi \int_ {0} ^ {1} r ^ {2} \cdot r ^ {2} \sin \varphi \mathrm {d} r \quad \mathrm {注 意 这里 利用 换 元 公 式 时}, \\ &= \frac {2 \pi}{3} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin \varphi \mathrm {d} \varphi \int_ {0} ^ {1} r ^ {4} \mathrm {d} r = \frac {2 \pi}{3} \cdot 2 \cdot \frac {1}{5} = \frac {4}{1 5} \pi . \end{aligned}$（法二）令$\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = r\sin \varphi \cos \theta ,\\ y = r\sin \varphi \sin \theta ,0\leqslant \varphi \leqslant \pi ,0\leqslant \theta \leqslant 2\pi ,0\leqslant r\leqslant 1,\\ z = r\cos \varphi , \end{array} \right.$则$\begin{aligned} \iiint_ {\Omega} z ^ {2} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z &= \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \mathrm {d} \varphi \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(r ^ {2} \cos^ {2} \varphi \cdot r ^ {2} \sin \varphi\right) \mathrm {d} r \\ &= 2 \pi \cdot \left[ - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \cos^ {2} \varphi \mathrm {d} (\cos \varphi) \right] \cdot \int_ {0} ^ {1} r ^ {4} \mathrm {d} r \\ &= 2 \pi \cdot \left(\left. - \frac {\cos^ {3} \varphi}{3} \right| _ {0} ^ {\pi}\right) \cdot \frac {1}{5} = \frac {4}{1 5} \pi . \end{aligned}$

questionText: 已知函数 f(x,y)具有二阶连续偏导数，且$f ( 1, y )=0, f ( x, 1 )=0, \iint_{D} f ( x, y ) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y=a$，其中 D={（x,y）|0≤x≤ 1,0≤y≤1}，计算二重积分$I=\iint_{D} x y f_{xy}^{\prime \prime}(x,y)\mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y.$
analysisRich: 由于$f_{xy}^{\prime \prime}(x,y)$是$f_x^{\prime}(x,y)$对$y$的偏导数，故对每个固定的$x,f_{xy}^{\prime \prime}(x,y)\mathrm{d}y = \mathrm{d}[f_x^{\prime}(x,y)]$$\begin{aligned} I &= \iint_ {D} x y f _ {x y} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \mathrm {d} x \int_ {0} ^ {1} y f _ {x y} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \mathrm {d} x \int_ {0} ^ {1} y \mathrm {d} \left[ f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, y) \right] \\ \underline {{\text {分 部 积 分}}} \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \left[ y f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, y) \right| _ {y = 0} ^ {y = 1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, y) \mathrm {d} y \Bigg ] \mathrm {d} x &= \int_ {0} ^ {1} x f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, 1) \mathrm {d} x - \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \mathrm {d} x \int_ {0} ^ {1} f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, y) \mathrm {d} y. \end{aligned}$由于$f ( x, 1 ) = 0$，即一元函数$f ( x, 1 )$是关于 x的常函数，故$f_{x}^{\prime}(x,1)=0.$又由于 D为矩形区域，故交换二次积分的积分次序可得，$\int_ {0} ^ {1} x \mathrm {d} x \int_ {0} ^ {1} f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, y) \mathrm {d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} y \int_ {0} ^ {1} x f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, y) \mathrm {d} x.$从而，$\begin{aligned} I &= 0 - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} y \int_ {0} ^ {1} x f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (x, y) \mathrm {d} x = - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} y \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \mathrm {d} [ f (x, y) ] \\ \frac {\mathrm {分 部 积 分}}{} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left[ x f (x, y) \mid_ {x = 0} ^ {x = 1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x \right] \mathrm {d} y &= - \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (1, y) \mathrm {d} y + \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} y \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x \\ \frac {f (1 , y) = 0}{\mathrm {一}} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} y \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x &= \iint_ {D} f (x, y) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = a. \end{aligned}$

questionText: 设$\Omega$是由平面$x+y+z=1$与三个坐标平面所围成的空间区域，则$\iiint\limits_{\Omega} ( x+2 y+3 z ) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z=$___
analysisRich: 解 （法一）由轮换对称性知，$\iiint_ {\Omega} x \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z = \iiint_ {\Omega} y \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z = \iiint_ {\Omega} z \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z.$又$\varOmega=\{(x,y,z)\mid(y,z)\in D_{x},0\leqslant x\leqslant 1\}$，其中$D_{x}=\{(y,z)\mid y+z\leqslant 1-x,y\geqslant 0,z\geqslant 0\}$，其面积为$\frac{(1-x)^{2}}{2}$，故$\begin{aligned} \iiint_ {\Omega} (x + 2 y + 3 z) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z &= 6 \iiint_ {\Omega} x \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z = 6 \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \mathrm {d} x \iint_ {D _ {x}} \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z \\ &= 6 \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \cdot \frac {(1 - x) ^ {2}}{2} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= 3 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(x ^ {3} - 2 x ^ {2} + x\right) \mathrm {d} x = \frac {1}{4}. \end{aligned}$（法二）由题设知，$\Omega = \left\{(x, y, z) \mid 0 \leqslant z \leqslant 1 - x - y, 0 \leqslant y \leqslant 1 - x, 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1 \right\}.$因此，$\begin{aligned} \iiint_ {\Omega} (x + 2 y + 3 z) \mathrm {d} v \xlongequal {\text {轮 换 对称 性}} 6 \iiint_ {\Omega} z \mathrm {d} v &= 6 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {0} ^ {1 - x} \mathrm {d} y \int_ {0} ^ {1 - x - y} z \mathrm {d} z \\ &= 6 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} x \int_ {0} ^ {1 - x} \frac {\left(1 - x - y\right) ^ {2}}{2} \mathrm {d} y = 6 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\left(y + x - 1\right) ^ {3}}{6} \Big | _ {0} ^ {1 - x} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= 6 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\left(1 - x\right) ^ {3}}{6} \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} (1 - x) ^ {3} \mathrm {d} x \xlongequal {t = 1 - x} \int_ {0} ^ {1} t ^ {3} \mathrm {d} t = \frac {1}{4}. \end{aligned}$

analysisRich: $x=r\cos \theta ,y=r\sin \theta$则$\begin{aligned} \iint_ {D} x \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y &= \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {2} ^ {2 (1 + \cos \theta)} r ^ {2} \cos \theta \mathrm {d} r = \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos \theta \cdot \frac {8 (1 + \cos \theta) ^ {3} - 8}{3} \mathrm {d} \theta \\ &= \frac {8}{3} \int_ {- \frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \left(\cos^ {4} \theta + 3 \cos^ {3} \theta + 3 \cos^ {2} \theta\right) \mathrm {d} \theta \\ &= \frac {1 6}{3} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos^ {4} \theta \mathrm {d} \theta + 1 6 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos^ {3} \theta \mathrm {d} \theta + 1 6 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos^ {2} \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \\ \frac {\text {华 里 士公 式}}{} \frac {1 6}{3} \times \frac {3}{4} \times \frac {1}{2} \times \frac {\pi}{2} + 1 6 \times \frac {2}{3} + 1 6 \times \frac {1}{2} \times \frac {\pi}{2} \\ &= 5 \pi + \frac {3 2}{3}. \end{aligned}$

questionText: 已知平面区域 D = {（x,y）| y-2≤x≤$\sqrt{4-y^{2}}$, 0≤y≤2} ，计算 I =$\iint_{D} \frac{(x-y)^{2}}{x^{2}+y^{2}} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y.$
analysisRich:
解 在极坐标系下计算.

由 D的表达式可知，如图（a）所示，D是由直线$y=x+2$，圆$x^{2}+y^{2}=4$以及 x轴围成的部分.直线$y=x+2$在极坐标系下的表示为$r=\frac{2}{\sin \theta -\cos \theta}$，圆$x^{2}+y^{2}=4$在极坐标系下的表示为$r=2.$(a)

(b)

如图（b）所示，将 D分为两部分$D_{1}$和$D_{2}.$$D _ {1} = \left\{(r, \theta) \mid 0 \leqslant r \leqslant 2, 0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac {\pi}{2} \right\}.$$D _ {2} = \left\{(r, \theta) \mid 0 \leqslant r \leqslant \frac {2}{\sin \theta - \cos \theta}, \frac {\pi}{2} \leqslant \theta \leqslant \pi \right\}.$因此，$\begin{aligned} \iint_ {D} \frac {\left(x - y\right) ^ {2}}{x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \stackrel {\text {极 坐 标}} {=} \iint_ {D} \frac {r ^ {2} \left(\cos \theta - \sin \theta\right) ^ {2}}{r ^ {2}} \cdot r \mathrm {d} r \mathrm {d} \theta &= \iint_ {D} \left(\cos \theta - \sin \theta\right) ^ {2} \cdot r \mathrm {d} r \mathrm {d} \theta \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \left(\cos \theta - \sin \theta\right) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2} r \mathrm {d} r + \int_ {\frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\pi} \left(\cos \theta - \sin \theta\right) ^ {2} \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {2}{\sin \theta - \cos \theta}} r \mathrm {d} r \\ &= 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \left(1 - 2 \sin \theta \cos \theta\right) \mathrm {d} \theta + \int_ {\frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\pi} \left(\cos \theta - \sin \theta\right) ^ {2} \cdot \frac {r ^ {2}}{2} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\frac {2}{\sin \theta - \cos \theta}} \mathrm {d} \theta \\ &= 2 \left(\frac {\pi}{2} - \sin^ {2} \theta \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}}\right) + \int_ {\frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {\pi} \left(\cos \theta - \sin \theta\right) ^ {2} \cdot \frac {2}{\left(\sin \theta - \cos \theta\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} \theta \\ &= \pi - 2 + 2 \times \left(\pi - \frac {\pi}{2}\right) = 2 \pi - 2. \end{aligned}$
