questionText: 已知平面区域$D=\{(x,y)\mid \sqrt{1-y^{2}}\leqslant x\leqslant 1,-1\leqslant y\leqslant 1\}$，计算$\iint_{D}\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y.$
analysisRich:
解（法一）如图（a）所示，区域 D关于 x轴对称，而$\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}$为关于 y的偶函数，故$\iint_{D}\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=$$2\iint_{D_{1}}\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$，其中$D_{1}$为D位于x轴上方的部分.

注意到$D_{1}$关于直线$y=x$对称，如图（b）所示，记$D_{0}$为$D_{1}$位于直线$y=x$下方的部分，则由轮换对称性的结论可知，

(a)

(b)$\iint_ {D _ {1}} \frac {x}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \iint_ {D _ {0}} \frac {x}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y + \iint_ {D _ {1} \backslash D _ {0}} \frac {x}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = \iint_ {D _ {0}} \frac {x + y}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y.$$D_{0}$在极坐标系下的表示为$D_{0} = \left\{(r,\theta)\mid 1\leqslant r\leqslant \sec \theta ,0\leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac{\pi}{4}\right\}$. 因此，$\begin{aligned} \iint_ {D} \frac {x}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y &= 2 \iint_ {D _ {1}} \frac {x}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = 2 \iint_ {D _ {0}} \frac {x + y}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \\ \xlongequal {\text {极 坐 标}} 2 \iint_ {D _ {0}} (\cos \theta + \sin \theta) \cdot r \mathrm {d} r \mathrm {d} \theta &= 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} (\cos \theta + \sin \theta) \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {1} ^ {\sec \theta} r \mathrm {d} r \\ &= 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} (\cos \theta + \sin \theta) \cdot \frac {1}{2} \left(\sec^ {2} \theta - 1\right) \mathrm {d} \theta = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} (\cos \theta + \sin \theta) \left(\sec^ {2} \theta - 1\right) \mathrm {d} \theta \\ &= \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \left(\sec \theta - \cos \theta + \frac {\sin \theta}{\cos^ {2} \theta} - \sin \theta\right) \mathrm {d} \theta = \left[ \ln \left(\sec \theta + \tan \theta\right) - \sin \theta + \frac {1}{\cos \theta} + \cos \theta \right] \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \\ &= \ln (\sqrt {2} + 1) + \sqrt {2} - 2. \end{aligned}$（法二）也可以在直角坐标系下计算$\iint_{D} \frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}} \mathrm{d}x \mathrm{d}y.$$\begin{aligned} \iint_ {D} \frac {x}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y &= 2 \iint_ {D _ {1}} \frac {x}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm {d} y \int_ {\sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}}} ^ {1} \frac {x}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} \Big | _ {x = \sqrt {1 - y ^ {2}}} ^ {x = 1} \mathrm {d} y = 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(\sqrt {1 + y ^ {2}} - 1\right) \mathrm {d} y \\ \underline {{\underline {{y = \tan u}}}} 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \sec^ {3} u \mathrm {d} u - 2. \end{aligned}$下面计算$\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sec^{3}u\mathrm{d}u.$$\begin{aligned} \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \sec^ {3} u \mathrm {d} u &= \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \sec u \mathrm {d} (\tan u) = \sec u \tan u \left| _ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} - \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \tan u \cdot \sec u \tan u \mathrm {d} u \right. \\ &= \sqrt {2} - \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \left(\sec^ {2} u - 1\right) \sec u \mathrm {d} u = \sqrt {2} - \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \sec^ {3} u \mathrm {d} u + \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \sec u \mathrm {d} u \\ &= \sqrt {2} - \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \sec^ {3} u \mathrm {d} u + \ln (\sec u + \tan u) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \\ &= \sqrt {2} - \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{4}} \sec^ {3} u \mathrm {d} u + \ln (\sqrt {2} + 1). \end{aligned}$由此可得$2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \sec^{3} u \mathrm{d} u=\ln(\sqrt{2}+1)+\sqrt{2}.$因此，$\iint_{D}\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\ln(\sqrt{2}+1)+\sqrt{2}-2.$

questionText: 设函数 y=f(x)由参数方程$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}x=2 t+t^{2}\\ y=\psi(t)\end{array}\right.$（t>-1）所确定，其中$\psi(t)$具有2阶导数，且$\psi(1)=\frac{5}{2},\psi^{\prime}(1)=6$已知$\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2} y}{\mathrm{d} x^{2}}=\frac{3}{4(1+t)}$，求函数$\psi(t).$
analysisRich:
解 由参数方程，可得$\frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} x} = \frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} t} / \frac {\mathrm {d} x}{\mathrm {d} t} = \frac {\psi^ {\prime} (t)}{2 t + 2},$$\frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm {d} x ^ {2}} = \frac {\mathrm {d} \left[ y ^ {\prime} (x) \right]}{\mathrm {d} x} = \frac {\mathrm {d} \left[ \frac {\psi^ {\prime} (t)}{2 t + 2} \right]}{\mathrm {d} t} / \frac {\mathrm {d} x}{\mathrm {d} t} = \frac {(t + 1) \psi^ {\prime \prime} (t) - \psi^ {\prime} (t)}{4 (t + 1) ^ {3}}.$由$\frac{\mathrm{d}^2y}{\mathrm{d}x^2} = \frac{3}{4(t + 1)}$得，$(t + 1) \psi^ {\prime \prime} (t) - \psi^ {\prime} (t) = 3 (t + 1) ^ {2}.$这是一个可降阶二阶微分方程.令$p = \psi^{\prime}(t)$，对该方程降阶并整理，得$p ^ {\prime} - \frac {p}{t + 1} = 3 (t + 1).$由一阶非齐次线性微分方程的求解公式得，$p = \mathrm {e} ^ {- \int \frac {- 1}{t + 1} \mathrm {d} t} \left[ \int 3 (t + 1) \mathrm {e} ^ {\int \frac {- 1}{t + 1} \mathrm {d} t} \mathrm {d} t + C \right] = (t + 1) (3 t + C),$其中 C为待定常数.

由$\psi^{\prime}(1) = 6$得，$p(1) = 2(3 + C) = 6$，得$C = 0.$从而$\psi^{\prime}(t) = 3t^{2} + 3t.$对$\psi^{\prime}(t)$积分，得$\psi (t) = \int \left(3 t ^ {2} + 3 t\right) \mathrm {d} t = t ^ {3} + \frac {3}{2} t ^ {2} + C ^ {\prime}.$代入$\psi (1) = \frac{5}{2}$，得$C^{\prime} = 0.$因此，$\psi (t) = t ^ {3} + \frac {3}{2} t ^ {2} (t > - 1).$

questionText: 微分方程$y \mathrm{d} x+(x-3 y^{2}) \mathrm{d} y=0$满足条件$y|_{x=1}=1$的解为 y= ___.
analysisRich:
解 整理原微分方程，得$\frac{\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{d} y}+\frac{x}{y}=3 y$这是一个以 y为自变量，x为因变量的一阶非齐次线性微分方程.

根据求解公式，$x = C \mathrm {e} ^ {- \int \frac {1}{y} \mathrm {d} y} + \mathrm {e} ^ {- \int \frac {1}{y} \mathrm {d} y} \int 3 y \mathrm {e} ^ {\int \frac {1}{y} \mathrm {d} y} \mathrm {d} y = \frac {C}{| y |} + \frac {1}{| y |} \int 3 y \cdot | y | \mathrm {d} y = \frac {C}{| y |} + y ^ {2},$其中 C为待定常数.

代入初始值 x=1，y=1，得 C=0，故 x=y².又因为当 x=1时，y=1，所以 y=$\sqrt{x}.$

questionText: 以$y=x^{2}-\mathrm{e}^{x}$和$y=x^{2}$为特解的一阶非齐次线性微分方程为 ___
analysisRich:
解（法一）设原方程为$y^{\prime}+p(x)y=q(x)$，则其对应的一阶齐次线性微分方程为$y^{\prime}+p(x)y=0.$记$y_{1}=x^{2}-\mathrm{e}^{x},$$y_{2}=x^{2}$，则$y_{2}-y_{1}=\mathrm{e}^{x}$是原方程对应的一阶齐次线性微分方程的解.将$y=\mathrm{e}^{x}$代入，可得$p(x)=-1.$再将$y=x^{2}$代入$y^{\prime}-y=q(x)$，得$q(x)=2x-x^{2}.$因此，原方程为$y^{\prime} - y = 2x - x^{2}$.

（法二）由于已知原方程的两个特解，而一阶非齐次线性微分方程形如$y^{\prime}+p(x)y=q(x)$，故可以用待定系数法来确定 p(x），q(x).

由已知条件，得$2 x - \mathrm {e} ^ {x} + x ^ {2} p (x) - \mathrm {e} ^ {x} p (x) = q (x),$$2 x + x ^ {2} p (x) = q (x).$(2) 式减去（1）式得，$\mathrm{e}^{x}+\mathrm{e}^{x}p(x)=0$.于是$p(x)=-1$.再代回（2）式得，$q(x)=2x-x^{2}.$因此，原方程为$y^{\prime}-y=2x-x^{2}.$

questionText:
设函数 y=y(x)(x>0)满足微分方程$x y^{\prime}-6 y=-6$，且满足$y(\sqrt{3})=10$I. 求 y(x);

II. P为曲线 y=y(x)上的一点，曲线 y=y(x)在点 P的法线在 y轴上的截距为$I_{P}$，当$I_{P}$最小时，求 P的坐标.
answerRich: （ I ）$y ( x )=\frac{x^{6}}{3}+1;$（ II ）点 P的坐标为$\left( 1,\frac{4}{3} \right)$时，$I_{P}$有最小值$\frac{11}{6}.$
analysisRich: 解（I）整理$x y^{\prime}-6 y=-6$得，$y^{\prime}-\frac{6 y}{x}=-\frac{6}{x}.$由求解公式，可得$\begin{aligned} y &= \mathrm {e} ^ {\int \frac {6}{x} \mathrm {d} x} \left[ \int \left(- \frac {6}{x}\right) \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {- \int \frac {6}{x} \mathrm {d} x} \mathrm {d} x + C \right] = \mathrm {e} ^ {6 \ln x} \left[ \int \left(- \frac {6}{x}\right) \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {- 6 \ln x} \mathrm {d} x + C \right] \\ &= x ^ {6} \left[ \int \left(- \frac {6}{x}\right) \cdot \frac {1}{x ^ {6}} \mathrm {d} x + C \right] = x ^ {6} \left[ \int (- 6) x ^ {- 7} \mathrm {d} x + C \right] = x ^ {6} \left(x ^ {- 6} + C\right) = C x ^ {6} + 1. \end{aligned}$代入$y(\sqrt{3})=10$，可得$1 0=1+C(\sqrt{3})^{6}$，即$1 0=1+2 7 C$.解得$C=\frac{1}{3}.$因此，$y ( x )=\frac{x^{6}}{3}+1,x>0.$（Ⅱ）根据导数的几何意义，曲线$y=\frac{x^{6}}{3}+1$上的点P（x，y）处的切线斜率为$2x^{5}.$由同一点处的切线与法线相互垂直，斜率乘积为-1可得点P处的法线斜率为$-\frac{1}{2x^{5}}.$于是，点P处的法线方程为$Y - y = - \frac {1}{2 x ^ {5}} (X - x).$令$X=0$，可得$Y=y+\frac{1}{2x^{4}}=\frac{x^{6}}{3}+1+\frac{1}{2x^{4}}$，即$I_{P}(x)=\frac{x^{6}}{3}+\frac{1}{2x^{4}}+1.$计算$I_{P}^{\prime}(x)$$I _ {P} ^ {\prime} (x) = \left(\frac {x ^ {6}}{3} + \frac {1}{2 x ^ {4}} + 1\right) ^ {\prime} = 2 x ^ {5} - 2 x ^ {- 5} = \frac {2 \left(x ^ {1 0} - 1\right)}{x ^ {5}}, x > 0.$令$I_{P}^{\prime}(x) = 0$，可得$x=1.$当$0 < x < 1$时，$I_{P}^{\prime}(x) < 0, I_{P}(x)$单调减少；当$x > 1$时，$I_{P}^{\prime}(x) > 0, I_{P}(x)$单调增加.故$I_{P}(1)$为$I_{P}(x)$在（0，$+ \infty$）上的最小值.$I_{P}(1) = \frac{1}{3} +\frac{1}{2} +1 = \frac{11}{6}.$因此，当$x=1,y=\frac{4}{3}$时，$I_{P}(x)$有最小值$\frac{11}{6}.$

questionText: 设函数 y(x)是微分方程$2 x y^{\prime}-4 y=2 \ln x-1$满足条件$y ( 1 )=\frac{1} {4}$的解，求曲线 y=y(x)（1≤x≤e）的弧长.
analysisRich: 解 整理原方程可得$y^{\prime}-\frac{2 y}{x}=\frac{2 \ln x-1}{2 x}.$这是一个一阶非齐次线性微分方程，由求解公式可得，$\begin{aligned} y &= \mathrm {e} ^ {\int \frac {2}{x} \mathrm {d} x} \left(\int \frac {2 \ln x - 1}{2 x} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {- \int \frac {2}{x} \mathrm {d} x} \mathrm {d} x + C _ {0}\right) = x ^ {2} \left[ \int (2 \ln x - 1) \cdot \frac {1}{2} x ^ {- 3} \mathrm {d} x + C _ {0} \right] \\ &= x ^ {2} \left(\int \ln x \cdot x ^ {- 3} \mathrm {d} x - \int \frac {1}{2} x ^ {- 3} \mathrm {d} x + C _ {0}\right) = x ^ {2} \left[ \int \ln x \mathrm {d} \left(- \frac {1}{2} x ^ {- 2}\right) - \int \frac {1}{2} x ^ {- 3} \mathrm {d} x + C _ {0} \right] \\ &= x ^ {2} \left(- \frac {1}{2} x ^ {- 2} \ln x + \int \frac {1}{2} x ^ {- 2} \cdot \frac {1}{x} \mathrm {d} x - \int \frac {1}{2} x ^ {- 3} \mathrm {d} x + C _ {0}\right) \\ &= C x ^ {2} - \frac {\ln x}{2}. \end{aligned}$代入$y ( 1 )=\frac{1}{4}$可得，$C=\frac{1}{4}.$因此，$y ( x )=\frac{x^{2}}{4}-\frac{\ln x}{2}.$计算得$y^{\prime}=\frac{x}{2}-\frac{1}{2x}=\frac{1}{2}\left(x-\frac{1}{x}\right).$代入曲线弧长的计算公式可得$\begin{aligned} s &= \int_ {1} ^ {\mathrm {e}} \sqrt {1 + \left[ y ^ {\prime} (x) \right] ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {1} ^ {\mathrm {e}} \sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{4} \left(x - \frac {1}{x}\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x = \int_ {1} ^ {\mathrm {e}} \sqrt {\frac {1}{4} \left(x + \frac {1}{x}\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \\ &= \frac {1}{2} \int_ {1} ^ {\mathrm {e}} \left(x + \frac {1}{x}\right) \mathrm {d} x = \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {x ^ {2}}{2} + \ln x\right) \Bigg | _ {1} ^ {\mathrm {e}} = \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {2} + 1}{4}. \end{aligned}$

questionText: 微分方程$y' + y = \mathrm{e}^{-x}\cos x$满足条件$y(0) = 0$的解为$y = \underline{\quad}$
analysisRich:
解（法一）原方程是一阶非齐次线性微分方程，故$y = C \mathrm {e} ^ {- \int 1 \mathrm {d} x} + \mathrm {e} ^ {- \int 1 \mathrm {d} x} \int \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \cos x \mathrm {e} ^ {\int 1 \mathrm {d} x} \mathrm {d} x = C \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} + \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \sin x.$当$y(0) = 0$时，解得$C = 0$，故原方程的解为$y = \mathrm{e}^{-x}\sin x.$（法二）方程两端同乘以$\mathrm{e}^{x}$得$\mathrm{e}^{x} y^{\prime}+\mathrm{e}^{x} y=\cos x.$方程左端等于$\frac{\mathrm{d}\left(y\mathrm{e}^{x}\right)}{\mathrm{d}x}$，方程可化为$\mathrm{d}\left(y\mathrm{e}^{x}\right)=\cos x\mathrm{d}x$，两端同时积分，$\int \mathrm {d} \left(y \mathrm {e} ^ {x}\right) = \int \cos x \mathrm {d} x,$得$y\mathrm{e}^{x} = \sin x + C$，其中C为待定常数.

代入$y(0) = 0$，得$C = 0.$因此，原方程的解为$y = \mathrm{e}^{-x}\sin x.$

questionText: 设函数 f(u)具有连续导数，且$z=f(\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y)$满足$\cos y\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}-\sin y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=(4z+\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y)\mathrm{e}^{x}.$若 f(0)=0，求 f(u)的表达式.
analysisRich:
由链式法则知，$\frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = f ^ {\prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right) \cdot \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right), \quad \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = f ^ {\prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right) \cdot \left(- \mathrm {e} ^ {x} \sin y\right).$代入题设等式中可得，$\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos^ {2} y f ^ {\prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right) + \mathrm {e} ^ {x} \sin^ {2} y f ^ {\prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right) = \left(4 z + \mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {x}.$化简得$f ^ {\prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right) = 4 f \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right) + \mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y.$令$u=\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y$，得$f ^ {\prime} (u) - 4 f (u) = u.$此为一阶非齐次线性微分方程，由求解公式知，$f (u) = \mathrm {e} ^ {- \int (- 4) \mathrm {d} u} \left[ \int u \mathrm {e} ^ {\int (- 4) \mathrm {d} u} \mathrm {d} u + C \right] = \mathrm {e} ^ {4 u} \left(\frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 u}}{- 4} u - \int \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 u}}{- 4} \mathrm {d} u + C\right) = - \frac {1}{4} u - \frac {1}{1 6} + C \mathrm {e} ^ {4 u},$其中 C为待定常数.

将$f ( 0 )=0$代入上式得$C=\frac{1}{1 6}.$因此，$f (u) = \frac {1}{1 6} \mathrm {e} ^ {4 u} - \frac {1}{4} u - \frac {1}{1 6}.$

（Ⅱ）下面证明方程$y^{\prime} + y = f(x)$的以$T$为周期的解存在.

根据求解公式，可得已知方程的通解为$y (x) = \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \left[ \int f (x) \mathrm {e} ^ {x} \mathrm {d} x + C ^ {\prime} \right] = \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t) \mathrm {e} ^ {t} \mathrm {d} t + C \right],$其中 C为任意常数.

于是，$\begin{aligned} y (x + T) &= \mathrm {e} ^ {- x - T} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {x + T} f (t) \mathrm {e} ^ {t} \mathrm {d} t + C \right] = \mathrm {e} ^ {- x - T} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {T} f (t) \mathrm {e} ^ {t} \mathrm {d} t + \int_ {T} ^ {x + T} f (t) \mathrm {e} ^ {t} \mathrm {d} t + C \right] \\ \underline {{= u = t - T}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x - T} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {T} f (t) \mathrm {e} ^ {t} \mathrm {d} t + \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (u + T) \mathrm {e} ^ {u + T} \mathrm {d} u + C \right] \\ \underline {{= \frac {f (u + T) = f (u)}{2}}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x - T} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {T} f (t) \mathrm {e} ^ {t} \mathrm {d} t + \mathrm {e} ^ {T} \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (u) \mathrm {e} ^ {u} \mathrm {d} u + C \right] \\ &= \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \left[ \mathrm {e} ^ {- T} \int_ {0} ^ {T} f (t) \mathrm {e} ^ {t} \mathrm {d} t + \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (u) \mathrm {e} ^ {u} \mathrm {d} u + C \mathrm {e} ^ {- T} \right]. \end{aligned}$比较 y(x)与 y(x+T).若$\mathrm{e}^{-x}\left[ \mathrm{e}^{-T}\int_{0}^{T}f(t)\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t+\int_{0}^{x}f(u)\mathrm{e}^{u}\mathrm{d}u+C\mathrm{e}^{-T}\right]=\mathrm{e}^{-x}\left[ \int_{0}^{x}f(t)\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t+C\right]$即$\mathrm {e} ^ {- T} \int_ {0} ^ {T} f (t) \mathrm {e} ^ {t} \mathrm {d} t + G \mathrm {e} ^ {- T} = C,$则$y ( x+T)=y ( x ), y ( x )$是以T为周期的解.解（1）式得$C=\frac{\int_{0}^{T} f ( t ) \mathrm{e}^{t} \mathrm{d} t}{\mathrm{e}^{T}-1}.$由于T为一常数，故C为一确定常数.

因此，若$f(x)$是周期为$T$的函数，则方程$y^{\prime} + y = f(x)$存在以$T$为周期的解.

下面证明方程$y^{\prime} + y = f(x)$的以$T$为周期的解唯一.

假设$y_{1}, y_{2}$是方程$y^{\prime} + y = f(x)$的两个不同的以$T$为周期的解，则$y_{1} - y_{2}$为齐次线性微分方程$y^{\prime} + y = 0$的解，且$y_{1} - y_{2}$也是以$T$为周期的函数. 解$y^{\prime} + y = 0$可得$y = C_{0}\mathrm{e}^{-x}$，其中$C_{0}$为任意常数. 于是，$y_{1} - y_{2} = C_{0}\mathrm{e}^{-x}$，但是该函数不是以$T$为周期的函数. 矛盾.

综上所述，若$f ( x )$是周期为$T$的函数，则方程$y^{\prime}+y=f ( x )$存在唯一的以$T$为周期的解.

questionText: 设函数 y(x)是微分方程$y^{\prime}+\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}} y=2+\sqrt{x}$的满足条件 y(1)=3的解，求曲线 y=y(x)的渐近线.
answerRich: $y=2 x$为曲线$y=2 x+\mathrm{e}^{1-\sqrt{x}}$的斜渐近线，也是唯一的渐近线.
analysisRich:
解 根据求解公式，$y = \mathrm {e} ^ {- \int \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {x}} \mathrm {d} x} \left[ \int (2 + \sqrt {x}) \mathrm {e} ^ {\int \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {x}} \mathrm {d} x} \mathrm {d} x + C _ {0} \right] = \mathrm {e} ^ {- \sqrt {x}} \left[ \int (2 + \sqrt {x}) \mathrm {e} ^ {\sqrt {x}} \mathrm {d} x + C _ {0} \right].$下面计算$\int (2 + \sqrt{x})\mathrm{e}^{\sqrt{x}}\mathrm{d}x.$令$u=\sqrt{x}$，则$x=u^{2}$，$\mathrm{d}x=2u\mathrm{d}u.$$\begin{aligned} \int (2 + \sqrt {x}) \mathrm {e} ^ {\sqrt {x}} \mathrm {d} x \xlongequal {u = \sqrt {x}} 2 \int (2 + u) u \mathrm {e} ^ {u} \mathrm {d} u &= 2 \left(\int u ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {u} \mathrm {d} u + \int 2 u \mathrm {e} ^ {u} \mathrm {d} u\right) \\ &= 2 \left[ \int u ^ {2} \mathrm {d} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {u}\right) + \int 2 u \mathrm {e} ^ {u} \mathrm {d} u \right] = 2 \left(u ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {u} - \int 2 u \mathrm {e} ^ {u} \mathrm {d} u + \int 2 u \mathrm {e} ^ {u} \mathrm {d} u\right) \\ &= 2 u ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {u} + C _ {1} = 2 x \mathrm {e} ^ {\sqrt {x}} + C _ {1}. \end{aligned}$将该结果代入（1）式，可得$y = \mathrm {e} ^ {- \sqrt {x}} \left(2 x \mathrm {e} ^ {\sqrt {x}} + C\right) = 2 x + C \mathrm {e} ^ {- \sqrt {x}},$其中$C$为待定常数. 代入$y(1) = 3$，可得$3 = 2 + C \cdot \mathrm{e}^{-1}$，解得$C = \mathrm{e}$.

因此，$y ( x ) = 2 x + \mathrm {e} ^ {1 - \sqrt {x}} , x \in ( 0, + \infty).$由于函数$y(x) = 2x + \mathrm{e}^{1 - \sqrt{x}}$在$(0, +\infty)$内连续，且$\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}y(x) = \mathrm{e}$，故曲线$y = 2x + \mathrm{e}^{1 - \sqrt{x}}$没有铅直渐近线.

又因为$\lim_{x\to +\infty}y(x) = \lim_{x\to +\infty}\left(2x + \mathrm{e}^{1 - \sqrt{x}}\right) = +\infty$，所以曲线$y = 2x + \mathrm{e}^{1 - \sqrt{x}}$没有水平渐近线.

下面计算斜渐近线.$\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {y (x)}{x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {2 x + \mathrm {e} ^ {1 - \sqrt {x}}}{x} = 2,$$\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} [ y (x) - 2 x ] = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {1 - \sqrt {x}} = 0.$因此，$y=2x$为曲线$y=2x+\mathrm{e}^{1-\sqrt{x}}$的斜渐近线，也是唯一的渐近线.

questionText: 已知函数 f(u)在区间 （0，$+ \infty$）内具有2阶导数，记$g ( x,y)=f\left(\frac{x}{y}\right)$，若 g(x,y)满足$x ^ {2} \frac {\partial^ {2} g}{\partial x ^ {2}} + x y \frac {\partial^ {2} g}{\partial x \partial y} + y ^ {2} \frac {\partial^ {2} g}{\partial y ^ {2}} = 1,$且$g ( x,x)=1,\frac{\partial g}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(x,x)}=\frac{2}{x}$，求 f(u).
analysisRich:
解 根据链式法则，$\frac {\partial g}{\partial x} = f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {x}{y}\right) \cdot \frac {1}{y}, \quad \frac {\partial g}{\partial y} = f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {x}{y}\right) \cdot \left(- \frac {x}{y ^ {2}}\right),$$\frac {\partial^ {2} g}{\partial x ^ {2}} = f ^ {\prime \prime} \left(\frac {x}{y}\right) \cdot \frac {1}{y ^ {2}},$$\frac {\partial^ {2} g}{\partial x \partial y} = f ^ {\prime \prime} \left(\frac {x}{y}\right) \cdot \left(- \frac {x}{y ^ {2}}\right) \cdot \frac {1}{y} - \frac {1}{y ^ {2}} f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {x}{y}\right) = - \frac {x}{y ^ {3}} f ^ {\prime \prime} \left(\frac {x}{y}\right) - \frac {1}{y ^ {2}} f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {x}{y}\right),$$\frac {\partial^ {2} g}{\partial y ^ {2}} = f ^ {\prime \prime} \left(\frac {x}{y}\right) \cdot \left(- \frac {x}{y ^ {2}}\right) \cdot \left(- \frac {x}{y ^ {2}}\right) + \frac {2 x}{y ^ {3}} f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {x}{y}\right) = \frac {x ^ {2}}{y ^ {4}} f ^ {\prime \prime} \left(\frac {x}{y}\right) + \frac {2 x}{y ^ {3}} f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {x}{y}\right).$代入$x^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}+xy\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+y^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=1$可得$\frac {x ^ {2}}{y ^ {2}} f ^ {\prime \prime} \left(\frac {x}{y}\right) - \frac {x ^ {2}}{y ^ {2}} f ^ {\prime \prime} \left(\frac {x}{y}\right) - \frac {x}{y} f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {x}{y}\right) + \frac {x ^ {2}}{y ^ {2}} f ^ {\prime \prime} \left(\frac {x}{y}\right) + \frac {2 x}{y} f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {x}{y}\right) = 1.$整理可得$\frac{x^2}{y^2} f^{\prime \prime}\left(\frac{x}{y}\right) + \frac{x}{y} f^{\prime}\left(\frac{x}{y}\right) = 1.$令$u=\frac{x}{y}$，可得$u^{2}f^{\prime \prime}(u)+u f^{\prime}(u)=1.$下面用两种方法解该方程

（法一）整理$u^{2}f^{\prime \prime}(u)+u f^{\prime}(u)=1$可得$f^{\prime \prime}(u)+\frac{1}{u} f^{\prime}(u)=\frac{1}{u^{2}}.$这是一个可降阶微分方程.令$p=f^{\prime}(u)$，则该方程化为$p^{\prime}+\frac{p}{u}=\frac{1}{u^{2}}.$由一阶非齐次线性微分方程的通解公式可得$p = \mathrm {e} ^ {\int \left(- \frac {1}{u}\right) \mathrm {d} u} \left(\int \frac {1}{u ^ {2}} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {\int \frac {1}{u} \mathrm {d} u} \mathrm {d} u + C _ {1}\right) = \frac {1}{u} \left(\int \frac {1}{u} \mathrm {d} u + C _ {1}\right) = \frac {1}{u} \left(\ln u + C _ {1}\right),$其中$C_{1}$为待定常数.

由$\frac{\partial g}{\partial x}=f^{\prime}\left(\frac{x}{y}\right)\cdot \frac{1}{y}$可得$\frac{\partial g}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(x,x)}=\frac{1}{x} f^{\prime}(1),$结合$\frac{\partial g}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(x,x)}=\frac{2}{x}$可得$f^{\prime}(1)=2.$代入$f^{\prime}(u)$$= \frac{1}{u} (\ln u + C_1)$可得$C_{1}=2.$于是，$f^{\prime}(u)=\frac{1}{u}(\ln u+2).$进一步积分可得$f (u) = \int \frac {1}{u} (\ln u + 2) \mathrm {d} u = \int \ln u \mathrm {d} (\ln u) + \int \frac {2}{u} \mathrm {d} u = \frac {1}{2} (\ln u) ^ {2} + 2 \ln u + C _ {2},$其中$C_{2}$为待定常数.

由$g(x,x) = 1$可得$f(1) = 1$，代入$f(u) = \frac{1}{2} (\ln u)^{2} + 2\ln u + C_{2}$可得$C_{2} = 1.$因此，$f(u)=\frac{1}{2} (\ln u)^{2}+2\ln u+1.$（法二）注意到$u^{2} f^{\prime \prime}(u) + uf^{\prime}(u) = 1$是欧拉方程

令$u=\mathrm{e}^{\prime}.$于是，$\frac {\mathrm {d} f}{\mathrm {d} t} = \frac {\mathrm {d} f}{\mathrm {d} u} \cdot \frac {\mathrm {d} u}{\mathrm {d} t} = \frac {\mathrm {d} f}{\mathrm {d} u} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {t}.$$\frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} f}{\mathrm {d} t ^ {2}} = \frac {\mathrm {d} \left(\frac {\mathrm {d} f}{\mathrm {d} u} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {t}\right)}{\mathrm {d} t} = \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} f}{\mathrm {d} u ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm {d} u}{\mathrm {d} t} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {t} + \frac {\mathrm {d} f}{\mathrm {d} u} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {t} = \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} f}{\mathrm {d} u ^ {2}} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {2 t} + \frac {\mathrm {d} f}{\mathrm {d} u} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {t} = \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} f}{\mathrm {d} u ^ {2}} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {2 t} + \frac {\mathrm {d} f}{\mathrm {d} t}.$由此可得$\frac{\mathrm{d}f}{\mathrm{d}u} = \mathrm{e}^{-t}\frac{\mathrm{d}f}{\mathrm{d}t},\frac{\mathrm{d}^2f}{\mathrm{d}u^2} = \mathrm{e}^{-2t}\left(\frac{\mathrm{d}^2f}{\mathrm{d}t^2} -\frac{\mathrm{d}f}{\mathrm{d}t}\right)$，于是$u^{2}f^{\prime \prime}(u) = \frac{\mathrm{d}^2f}{\mathrm{d}t^2} -\frac{\mathrm{d}f}{\mathrm{d}t},uf^{\prime}(u) = \frac{\mathrm{d}f}{\mathrm{d}t}$代入$u^{2}f^{\prime \prime}(u)$$+uf^{\prime}(u) = 1$可得$\frac{\mathrm{d}^2f}{\mathrm{d}t^2} = 1.$这是一个二阶常系数非齐次线性微分方程，其对应的齐次方程的特征方程为$\lambda^2 = 0$，特征根为$\lambda_{1,2} = 0$.于是，该齐次方程的解为$y = C_{1} + C_{2} t$，其中$C_{1}, C_{2}$为待定常数.

由于0是特征方程的二重根，故可设$\frac{\mathrm{d}^2f}{\mathrm{d}t^2} = 1$的特解$y^{*} = At^{2}$. 将$y^{*} = At^{2}$代入$\frac{\mathrm{d}^2f}{\mathrm{d}t^2} = 1$可得2A$= 1$，即$A = \frac{1}{2}$.由此可得$y^{*} = \frac{1}{2} t^{2}$，进一步可得$\frac{\mathrm{d}^2f}{\mathrm{d}t^2} = 1$的解为$y = C_{1} + C_{2}t + \frac{1}{2} t^{2}$.由$u = \mathrm{e}^{t}$可得$t = \ln u$，从而$f(u) = C_{1} + C_{2}\ln u + \frac{1}{2}(\ln u)^{2}$.计算可得$f^{\prime}(u) = \frac{1}{u}(\ln u + C_{2})$同法一可得$f(1) = 1,f^{\prime}(1) = 2$，代入$f(u),f^{\prime}(u)$的表达式解得$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} C_{1} = 1, \\ C_{2} = 2 \end{array} \right.$因此，$f ( u ) = \frac { 1 } { 2 } \left( \ln u \right)^{2}+2 \ln u+1.$

questionText: 微分方程$x y^{\prime}-y+x^{2} \mathrm{e}^{x}=0$满足条件$y(1)=- \mathrm{e}$的解为 y=___
analysisRich: 解 整理原方程可得$y^{\prime}-\frac{y}{x}=-x\mathrm{e}^{x}.$由一阶非齐次线性微分方程的通解公式可得$y=\mathrm{e}^{\int \frac{1}{x}\mathrm{d}x}\left[\int(-x\mathrm{e}^{x})\cdot\mathrm{e}^{\int(-\frac{1}{x})\mathrm{d}x}\mathrm{d}x+C\right]=\mid x\mid\left[\int(-x\mathrm{e}^{x})\cdot\frac{1}{\mid x\mid}\mathrm{d}x+C\right]$$=-x\int\mathrm{e}^{x}\mathrm{d}x+C\mid x\mid=-x\mathrm{e}^{x}+C\mid x\mid.$将 y（1）=-e代入$y=-x\mathrm{e}^{x}+C\left| x\right|$可得$-\mathrm{e}=-\mathrm{e}+C$，解得 C=0.因此，$y=-x\mathrm{e}^{x}.$

questionText: 微分方程$y^{\prime \prime}-\lambda^{2} y=\mathrm{e}^{\lambda x}+\mathrm{e}^{-\lambda x} (\lambda>0)$的特解形式为（    )
analysisRich:
解 先写出$y^{\prime \prime}-\lambda^{2} y=\mathrm{e}^{\lambda x}$与$y^{\prime \prime}-\lambda^{2} y=\mathrm{e}^{-\lambda x}$的特解形式.

由于$y^{\prime \prime}-\lambda^{2} y=0$的特征方程为$r^{2}-\lambda^{2}=0$，故$\pm \lambda$为特征方程的单根.对于方程$y^{\prime \prime}-\lambda^{2} y=\mathrm{e}^{\lambda x}$由于$\lambda$是其特征方程的单根，故它的特解形如$y_{1}^{*} = a x \mathrm{e}^{\lambda x}$；同理，方程$y^{\prime \prime}-\lambda^{2} y=\mathrm{e}^{- \lambda x}$的特解形如$y_{2}^{*} = b x \mathrm{e}^{- \lambda x}.$因此，根据线性微分方程的解的叠加原理，$y^{\prime \prime} - \lambda^{2} y = \mathrm{e}^{\lambda x} + \mathrm{e}^{- \lambda x} (\lambda > 0)$的特解形式为$y _ {1} ^ {*} + y _ {2} ^ {*} = x \left(a \mathrm {e} ^ {\lambda x} + b \mathrm {e} ^ {- \lambda x}\right).$应选C.

questionText: 已知$y_{1}=\mathrm{e}^{3 x}-x \mathrm{e}^{2 x}, y_{2}=\mathrm{e}^{x}-x \mathrm{e}^{2 x}, y_{3}=-x \mathrm{e}^{2 x}$是某二阶常系数非齐次线性微分方程的3个解，则该方程满足条件$y |_{x=0}=0, y^{\prime} |_{x=0}=1$的解为 y=___
analysisRich:
解 对题设方程的3个解$y_{i}\left(i=1,2,3\right), y_{i}-y_{j}\left(i,j=1,2,3,i\neq j\right)$均为原方程对应的齐次线性微分方程的解.由于$y_{1}-y_{3}=\mathrm{e}^{3x}, y_{2}-y_{3}=\mathrm{e}^{x}$故$y_{1}-y_{3}$与$y_{2}-y_{3}$线性无关，从而$C_{1}\left(y_{1}-y_{3}\right)$$+ C_{2}\left(y_{2}-y_{3}\right)$为原方程对应的齐次线性微分方程的解，其中$C_{1}, C_{2}$为常数.

原方程的通解可表示为$y=C_{1}\mathrm{e}^{3x}+C_{2}\mathrm{e}^{x}-x\mathrm{e}^{2x}$由$y(0)=0, y^{\prime}(0)=1$可得，$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} C_{1}+C_{2}=0, \\ 3 C_{1}+C_{2}=2. \end{array} \right.$解得$C_{1}=1, C_{2}=-1$，故所求解为$y=\mathrm{e}^{3x}-\mathrm{e}^{x}-x\mathrm{e}^{2x}.$

questionText: 已知$y_{1}(x)=\mathrm{e}^{x}, y_{2}(x)=u(x)\mathrm{e}^{x}$是二阶微分方程$(2x-1)y^{\prime \prime}-(2x+1)y^{\prime}+2y=0$的两个解.若$u(-1)=\mathrm{e}, u(0)=-1$求 u(x),并写出该微分方程的通解.
answerRich: $u ( x )=-( 2 x+1 ) \mathrm{e}^{-x}$，原方程的通解为$y=k_{1}\mathrm{e}^{x}-k_{2}(2 x+1)$，其中$k_{1}, k_{2}$为任意常数.
analysisRich:
计算$y_{2}^{\prime}(x), y_{2}^{\prime\prime}(x).$$\left(u \mathrm {e} ^ {x}\right) ^ {\prime} = \left(u + u ^ {\prime}\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {x}, \quad \left(u \mathrm {e} ^ {x}\right) ^ {\prime \prime} = \left(u ^ {\prime \prime} + 2 u ^ {\prime} + u\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {x}.$将$y_{2}^{\prime}(x), y_{2}^{\prime\prime}(x)$代入（2x-1）$y^{\prime\prime}-(2x+1)y^{\prime}+2y=0$并整理，得$(2 x - 1) u ^ {\prime \prime} \mathrm {e} ^ {x} + (2 x - 3) u ^ {\prime} \mathrm {e} ^ {x} = 0.$由于$\mathrm{e}^{x} > 0$，故$(2 x - 1) u ^ {\prime \prime} + (2 x - 3) u ^ {\prime} = 0.$(1) 式为可降阶微分方程.令$u^{\prime}=p$，则得$(2x-1)p^{\prime}=(3-2x)p.$由分离变量法，得$\frac {\mathrm {d} p}{p} = \left(- 1 + \frac {2}{2 x - 1}\right) \mathrm {d} x.$上式两端同时积分，得$\ln | p |=-x+\ln | 2 x-1 |+C_{0},| p |=C_{1}| 2 x-1 | \mathrm{e}^{-x},$其中$C_{0}, C_{1}$为待定常数，$C_{1}=\mathrm{e}^{C_{0}}.$我们不妨去掉绝对值符号，记$p=C(2 x-1)\mathrm{e}^{-x}$，从而$u ^ {\prime} = p = C (2 x - 1) \mathrm {e} ^ {- x},$其中 C为待定常数，可能为正值，也可能为负值.

(2) 式两端同时关于 x积分得，$\begin{aligned} u (x) &= C \int (2 x - 1) \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \mathrm {d} x = C \int - (2 x - 1) \mathrm {d} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- x}\right) = C \left[ \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} (1 - 2 x) - \int \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \mathrm {d} (1 - 2 x) \right] \\ &= C \left[ \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} (1 - 2 x) - 2 \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \right] + C ^ {\prime} = - C \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} (2 x + 1) + C ^ {\prime}, \end{aligned}$其中 C，C'为待定常数.

由题目条件，$u(0)=-1$$u(-1)=\mathrm{e}$，代入$u(x)$的表达式得$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} C^{\prime}-C=-1, \\ C\mathrm{e}+C^{\prime}=\mathrm{e}. \end{array} \right.$解得 C=1，$C^{\prime}=0.$于是，$u(x)=-(2x+1)\mathrm{e}^{-x}, y_{2}(x)=u(x)\mathrm{e}^{x}=-(2x+1).$$y_{1}(x), y_{2}(x)$为二阶齐次线性微分方程$( 2 x-1 ) y^{\prime \prime}-( 2 x+1 ) y^{\prime}+2 y=0$的两个线性无关的解因此，由齐次线性微分方程的解的结构知，原方程的通解为$y=k_{1}\mathrm{e}^{x}-k_{2}(2 x+1)$其中$k_{1}, k_{2}$为任意常数.

questionText: 微分方程$y^{\prime \prime}-4 y^{\prime}+8 y=\mathrm{e}^{2 x}(1+\cos 2 x)$的特解可设为$y^{*}$=（    )
analysisRich: 解 原微分方程对应的齐次方程的特征方程为$r^{2}-4 r+8=0$，有一对共轭复根$r_{1,2}=2\pm 2 \mathrm{i}.$原微分方程的非齐次项$f(x)=\mathrm{e}^{2 x}+\mathrm{e}^{2 x}\cos 2 x.$对$f_{1}(x)=\mathrm{e}^{2 x}$，由于2不是特征方程的根，故$y^{\prime \prime}-4 y^{\prime}+8 y=\mathrm{e}^{2 x}$的特解形式应为$y^{*} = A\mathrm{e}^{2 x}.$对$f_{2}(x)=\mathrm{e}^{2 x}\cos 2 x$，由于$2\pm 2\mathrm{i}$是特征方程的根，故$y^{\prime \prime}-4 y^{\prime}+8 y=\mathrm{e}^{2 x}\cos 2 x$的特解形式应为$y^{*} = x\mathrm{e}^{2 x} ( B\cos 2 x+C\sin 2 x).$根据线性微分方程的解的叠加原理，原微分方程的特解可设为$y = A \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x} + x \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x} \left(B \cos 2 x + C \sin 2 x\right).$应选C.

questionText: 已知微分方程$y^{\prime \prime}+ay^{\prime}+by=c\mathrm{e}^{x}$的通解为$y=(C_{1}+C_{2}x)\mathrm{e}^{-x}+\mathrm{e}^{x}$，则 a,b,c依次为（    )
analysisRich: 解 由原方程的通解形式可知，$y = ( C_{1} + C_{2} x ) \mathrm{e}^{-x}$是原方程对应的齐次线性微分方程的通解，故$r=-1$为该齐次方程的特征方程的二重根.于是，特征方程为$( r+1 )^{2}=0$即$r^{2}+2 r+1=0.$从而，$a=2,b=1.$由原方程的通解形式可知，$y=\mathrm{e}^{x}$是原方程的一个特解.将$y=\mathrm{e}^{x}$代入$y^{\prime \prime}+2y^{\prime}+y=c\mathrm{e}^{x}$可得，$4\mathrm{e}^{x}=c\mathrm{e}^{x}.$于是，$c=4.$因此，$a=2,b=1,c=4.$应选D.

questionText: 欧拉方程$x^{2} y^{\prime \prime}+x y^{\prime}-4 y=0$满足条件$y(1)=1, y^{\prime}(1)=2$的解为$y=$___.
analysisRich:
解 由初始条件$y ( 1 ) = 1, y^{\prime} ( 1 ) = 2$可知应在$x > 0$的范围内求解.

令$x = \mathrm{e}^{t}$. 于是，$\frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} t} = \frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} x} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {t}.$$\frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm {d} t ^ {2}} = \frac {\mathrm {d} \left(\frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} x} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {t}\right)}{\mathrm {d} t} = \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm {d} x ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm {d} x}{\mathrm {d} t} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {t} + \frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} x} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {t} = \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm {d} x ^ {2}} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {2 t} + \frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} x} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {t} = \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm {d} x ^ {2}} \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {2 t} + \frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} t}.$从而，$y^{\prime} = \mathrm{e}^{-t}\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t}, y^{\prime \prime} = \mathrm{e}^{-2t}\left(\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}y}{\mathrm{d}t^{2}} - \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t}\right).$因此，$xy^{\prime} = \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t}, x^{2}y^{\prime \prime} = \frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}y}{\mathrm{d}t^{2}} - \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t}.$代入$x^{2} y^{\prime \prime}+x y^{\prime}-4 y=0$可得$\frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm {d} t ^ {2}} - \frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} t} + \frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} t} - 4 y = \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm {d} t ^ {2}} - 4 y = 0.$$\frac{\mathrm{d}^2y}{\mathrm{d}t^2} - 4y = 0$是一个二阶常系数齐次线性微分方程，其特征方程为$r^2 - 4 = 0$，特征根为$r_{1,2} = \pm 2.$于是，该方程的解为$y = C_{1}\mathrm{e}^{2t} + C_{2}\mathrm{e}^{-2t} = C_{1}x^{2} + C_{2}x^{-2}$，其中$C_{1},C_{2}$为待定常数. 从而，$y^{\prime} = 2C_{1}x - 2C_{2}x^{-3}.$代入 y（1）=1可得$1=C_{1}+C_{2}$代入$y^{\prime}(1)=2$可得$2=2 C_{1}-2 C_{2}$解得$C_{1}=1,C_{2}=0.$综上所述，原方程的解为$y=x^{2}.$

questionText: 微分方程$y^{\prime}=\frac{1}{(x+y)^{2}}$满足条件 y(1)=0的解为 ___
analysisRich: 解 令$u=x+y$，则$\frac{\mathrm{d} u}{\mathrm{d} x}=1+\frac{\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x}$，原方程化为$\frac{\mathrm{d} u}{\mathrm{d} x}-1=\frac{1}{u^{2}}$，即$\frac{\mathrm{d} u}{\mathrm{d} x}=\frac{1+u^{2}}{u^{2}}.$这是一个可分离变量的微分方程，分离变量可得$\left(1-\frac{1}{1+u^{2}}\right)\mathrm{d} u=\mathrm{d} x.$方程两端同时积分可得$u-\arctan u=x+C.$由$y(1)=0$可得，$u(1)=1.$代入$u-\arctan u=x+C$可得$1-\frac{\pi}{4}=1+C,$解得$C=-\frac{\pi}{4}.$于是，$u-\arctan u=x-\frac{\pi}{4}.$将$u=x+y$代回$u-\arctan u=x-\frac{\pi}{4}$并整理可得$y-\arctan (x+y)+\frac{\pi}{4}=0.$

questionText:
设函数 y(x)为微分方程$x^{2} y^{\prime \prime}+ x y^{\prime}-9 y=0$满足条件$y \mid_{x=1}=2, y^{\prime} \mid_{x=1}=6$的解.

I. 利用变换$x=\mathrm{e}^{t}$将上述方程化为常系数线性方程，并求 y(x)；

II. 计算$\int_{1}^{2} y(x)\sqrt{4-x^{2}} \mathrm{d} x.$
analysisRich:
解（I）令$x=\mathrm{e}^{t}$，则$t=\ln x,$$\frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} x} = \frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} t} \cdot \frac {\mathrm {d} t}{\mathrm {d} x} = \frac {1}{x} \cdot \frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} t},$$\frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm {d} x ^ {2}} = \frac {\mathrm {d} \left(\frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} x}\right)}{\mathrm {d} x} = \frac {\mathrm {d} \left(\frac {1}{x} \cdot \frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} t}\right)}{\mathrm {d} x} = \frac {1}{x} \cdot \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm {d} t ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm {d} t}{\mathrm {d} x} - \frac {1}{x ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} t} = \frac {1}{x ^ {2}} \left(\frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm {d} t ^ {2}} - \frac {\mathrm {d} y}{\mathrm {d} t}\right).$代入原方程可得$\frac{\mathrm{d}^2 y}{\mathrm{d}t^2} -\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t} +\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t} -9y = 0$，即$\frac{\mathrm{d}^2 y}{\mathrm{d}t^2} -9y = 0.$这是一个二阶常系数齐次线性微分方程. 该方程的特征方程为$r^{2} - 9 = 0$，特征根为$r_{1,2} = \pm 3.$于是，该方程的通解为$y = C_{1}\mathrm{e}^{3t} + C_{2}\mathrm{e}^{-3t}.$代入$x = \mathrm{e}^{t}$可得$y = C_{1}x^{3} + C_{2}x^{-3}.$进一步可得$y^{\prime}(x) = 3C_{1}x^{2} - 3C_{2}x^{-4}.$由$y\mid_{x = 1} = 2,y^{\prime}\mid_{x = 1} = 6$可得$\left\{ \begin{array}{l}C_1 + C_2 = 2,\\ 3C_1 - 3C_2 = 6, \end{array} \right.$解得$\left\{ \begin{array}{l}C_1 = 2,\\ C_2 = 0. \end{array} \right.$因此，$y(x) = 2x^{3}$.

（Ⅱ）由第（I）问的结果可得$\int_1^2 y(x)\sqrt{4 - x^2}\mathrm{d}x = 2\int_1^2 x^3\sqrt{4 - x^2}\mathrm{d}x.$下面用两种方法计算$\int_{1}^{2} x^{3}\sqrt{4 - x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x.$（法一）令$t = 4 - x^{2}$，则$\mathrm{d}(x^{2}) = -\mathrm{d}t.$于是，$\begin{aligned} \int_ {1} ^ {2} x ^ {3} \sqrt {4 - x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x &= \frac {1}{2} \int_ {1} ^ {2} x ^ {2} \sqrt {4 - x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} \left(x ^ {2}\right) \xlongequal {t = 4 - x ^ {2}} \frac {1}{2} \int_ {3} ^ {0} (4 - t) \sqrt {t} (- \mathrm {d} t) \\ &= \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {3} \left(4 t ^ {\frac {1}{2}} - t ^ {\frac {3}{2}}\right) \mathrm {d} t = \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {8}{3} t ^ {\frac {3}{2}} - \frac {2}{5} t ^ {\frac {5}{2}}\right) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {3} \\ &= \frac {4}{3} \cdot 3 \sqrt {3} - \frac {1}{5} \cdot 9 \sqrt {3} = \frac {1 1 \sqrt {3}}{5}. \end{aligned}$（法二）令$x=2\sin t$，则$\begin{aligned} \int_ {1} ^ {2} x ^ {3} \sqrt {4 - x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \xlongequal {x = 2 \sin t} \int_ {\frac {\pi}{6}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} 8 \sin^ {3} t \cdot 2 \cos t \cdot 2 \cos t \mathrm {d} t &= 3 2 \int_ {\frac {\pi}{6}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \sin^ {3} t \cos^ {2} t \mathrm {d} t \\ &= 3 2 \int_ {\frac {\pi}{6}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \left(1 - \cos^ {2} t\right) \cos^ {2} t \sin t \mathrm {d} t \xlongequal {u = \cos t} - 3 2 \int_ {\frac {\sqrt {3}}{2}} ^ {0} \left(u ^ {2} - u ^ {4}\right) \mathrm {d} u \\ &= 3 2 \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\sqrt {3}}{2}} \left(u ^ {2} - u ^ {4}\right) \mathrm {d} u = 3 2 \left(\frac {u ^ {3}}{3} - \frac {u ^ {5}}{5}\right) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\frac {\sqrt {3}}{2}} \\ &= 3 2 \cdot \left(\frac {3 \sqrt {3}}{8} \cdot \frac {1}{3} - \frac {9 \sqrt {3}}{3 2} \cdot \frac {1}{5}\right) = \frac {1 1 \sqrt {3}}{5}. \end{aligned}$因此，$\int_1^2 y(x)\sqrt{4 - x^2}\mathrm{d}x = 2\cdot \frac{11\sqrt{3}}{5} = \frac{22\sqrt{3}}{5}.$

questionText: 已知函数 y=y(x)满足微分方程$x^{2}+y^{2} y^{\prime}=1-y^{\prime}$，且 y(2)=0，求 y(x)的极大值与极小值.
analysisRich:
整理原微分方程得，$(1 + y ^ {2}) \mathrm {d} y = (1 - x ^ {2}) \mathrm {d} x.$这是可分离变量的微分方程. 方程两端积分得$y + \frac {y ^ {3}}{3} = x - \frac {x ^ {3}}{3} + C.$代入$x = 2$，$y(2) = 0$，得$C = \frac{2}{3}$，从而得到关于$x,y$的一个隐函数方程：$x^{3} + y^{3} - 3x + 3y = 2.$要求$y(x)$的极大值与极小值，可先求$y^{\prime}(x)$. 由（1）式可得$y ^ {\prime} = \frac {1 - x ^ {2}}{1 + y ^ {2}}.$由此可知，当$x=\pm1$时，$y^{\prime}=0$；当$x>1$或$x<-1$时，$y^{\prime}<0$，$y(x)$单调减少；当$-1<x<1$时，$y^{\prime}>0$，$y(x)$单调增加.

于是，$y ( x )$在$x=1$处取到极大值，在$x=-1$处取到极小值.由$x^{3}+y^{3}-3 x+3 y=2$可计算得，当$x=-1$时，$y=0$；当$x=1$时，$y=1$因此，$y ( x )$的极大值为$y ( 1 )=1$，极小值为$y (-1)=0.$

questionText: 微分方程$x y^{\prime}+y(\ln x-\ln y)=0$满足条件$y(1)=\mathrm{e}^{3}$的解为$y=$___.
analysisRich:
解 由题设中微分方程的表达式知 x > 0，y > 0，且原方程可化为$y ^ {\prime} = \frac {y}{x} \ln \frac {y}{x},$此为齐次方程. 令$u=\frac{y}{x}$，则$y=ux,\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=u+x\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}$，于是方程（1）化为$u + x \frac {\mathrm {d} u}{\mathrm {d} x} = u \ln u.$分离变量，得到$\frac {\mathrm {d} u}{u (\ln u - 1)} = \frac {\mathrm {d} x}{x},$即$\frac {\mathrm {d} (\ln u - 1)}{\ln u - 1} = \frac {\mathrm {d} x}{x}.$对上式两端积分，得到于是$\begin{aligned} \ln | \ln u - 1 | &= \ln x + C _ {1}, \\ \ln u - 1 &= C x, \end{aligned}$其中$C = \pm \mathrm{e}^{C_1}$. 代回原变量$u = \frac{y}{x}$，得到原方程的通解为

注意这里由于 x > 0，y > 0，故 u > 0从而$\int \frac{1}{u}=\ln u+C$，但由于$\ln u-1$的正负无法判断，故$\int \frac {\mathrm {d} (\ln u - 1)}{\ln u - 1} = \ln | \ln u - 1 | + C.$$\ln \frac {y}{x} - 1 = C x.$将$y ( 1 ) = \mathrm{e}^{3}$代入上式，得到$C=2$，于是$\ln \frac{y}{x}=2x+1$，从而所求初值问题的解为$y = x \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x + 1}.$

questionText: 微分方程$2 y y^{\prime}-y^{2}-2=0$满足条件$y(0)=1$的特解$y=$___
analysisRich:
解 整理原方程可得$2 y \frac{\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x}=y^{2}+2.$分离变量可得$\frac{2 y}{y^{2}+2}\mathrm{d} y=\mathrm{d} x.$方程两端积分，$\int \frac{2 y}{y^{2}+2}\mathrm{d} y=\int \frac{\mathrm{d}\left(y^{2}+2\right)}{y^{2}+2}=\ln \left(y^{2}+2\right)=x+C,$其中 C为待定常数.

代入 x=0，$y(0)=1$可得，$C=\ln 3$.于是，$y^{2}+2=3\mathrm{e}^{x}.$又因为$y(0)=1>0$，所以$y=\sqrt{3\mathrm{e}^{x}-2}.$

questionText: 差分方程$\Delta^{2} y_{x}-y_{x}=5$的通解为 ___
analysisRich:
解 由于$\Delta^{2} y_{x}=\Delta y_{x+1}-\Delta y_{x}$，故$\Delta^{2} y_{x}=\Delta y_{x+1}-\Delta y_{x}=\left(y_{x+2}-y_{x+1}\right)-\left(y_{x+1}-y_{x}\right)=y_{x+2}-2y_{x+1}+y_{x}.$由$\Delta^{2} y_{x}-y_{x}=5$可得，$y_{x+2}-2y_{x+1}=5$即$y_{x+1}-2y_{x}=5.$下面用两种方法解$y_{x + 1} - 2y_{x} = 5.$（法一）这是一个一阶非齐次线性差分方程.该方程对应的齐次差分方程的通解为$\tilde{y}_{x}=C2^{x}$其中C为任意常数.

设原方程的一个特解为$y_{x}^{*} = k$，代入原方程得 k-2k=5.解得 k=-5.于是，特解为$y_{x}^{*} = -5.$因此，原方程的通解为$y_{x} = C2^{x} - 5$其中 C为任意常数.

（法二）由$y_{x+1}-2 y_{x}=5$可得，$y_{x+1}+5=2 \left( y_{x}+5 \right).$于是，$\left\{y_{x}+5\right\}_{x \in \mathbf{N}}$是一个首项为$y_{0}+5$公比为2的等比数列.记$C=y_{0}+5$，可得$y_{x}+5=C2^{x}$即$y_{x}=C2^{x}-5.$由于$y_{0}$可取任意常数，故C为任意常数.

questionText: 差分方程$\Delta y_{t} = t$的通解为$y_{t} =$___
analysisRich:
解（法一）由于$\Delta y_{t}=y_{t+1}-y_{t}$，故$\Delta y_{t}=t$等价于$y_{t+1}-y_{t}=t$，为一阶常系数非齐次线性差分方程.

因为$a = 1$，所以$\tilde{y}_t = C$为$y_{t + 1} - y_t = 0$的通解.

又因为自由项为 t，所以可设$y_{t}^{*} = t \left(B_{0} + B_{1} t\right).$代回$y_{t+1}-y_{t}=t$可得$B _ {0} (t + 1) + B _ {1} (t + 1) ^ {2} - B _ {0} t - B _ {1} t ^ {2} = 2 B _ {1} t + B _ {1} + B _ {0} = t.$于是，$B_{1}=\frac{1}{2}, B_{0}=-\frac{1}{2}.$从而，$y_{t}^{*}=\frac{1}{2} t^{2}-\frac{1}{2} t.$因此，原方程的通解为$y_{t}=\frac{1}{2} t^{2}-\frac{1}{2} t+C$，其中C为任意常数.

（法二）由已知条件可知，$y_{t + 1} - y_{t} = t.$于是，$y _ {t} - y _ {t - 1} = t - 1, \quad y _ {t - 1} - y _ {t - 2} = t - 2, \quad \dots , \quad y _ {2} - y _ {1} = 1.$从而，$y _ {t} = \left(y _ {t} - y _ {t - 1}\right) + \left(y _ {t - 1} - y _ {t - 2}\right) + \dots + \left(y _ {2} - y _ {1}\right) + y _ {1} = \frac {t (t - 1)}{2} + y _ {1}.$由于$y_{1}$可以取任意常数，故$y_{t}=\frac{t(t-1)}{2}+C=\frac{1}{2} t^{2}-\frac{1}{2} t+C$，其中C为任意常数.

questionText: 若二阶常系数线性齐次微分方程$y^{\prime \prime}+a y^{\prime}+b y=0$的通解为$y=( C_{1}+C_{2} x ) \mathrm{e}^{x}$，则非齐次方程$y^{\prime \prime}+a y^{\prime}+b y=x$满足条件$y ( 0 )=2, y^{\prime} ( 0 )=0$的解为 y=___
analysisRich: 解 由题设及二阶常系数线性齐次微分方程通解的形式知，特征方程$\lambda^{2}+a\lambda+b=0$的根为$\lambda_{1}=\lambda_{2}=1$，从而 a=-2,b=1.设非齐次线性方程$y^{\prime \prime}-2y^{\prime}+y=x$的一个特解为$y^{*} = cx+d$代入该方程，整理得到$c x + d - 2 c = x.$于是$c = 1,d = 2c = 2$，从而非齐次线性方程的通解为$y = \left(C _ {1} + C _ {2} x\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {x} + x + 2.$进而$y^{\prime} = \left(C_{1} + C_{2} + C_{2}x\right)\mathrm{e}^{x} + 1.$将$y(0) = 2,y^{\prime}(0) = 0$代入，得到$C _ {1} + 2 = 2, \quad C _ {1} + C _ {2} + 1 = 0.$解得$C_{1} = 0, C_{2} = -1.$因此，所求解为$y = -x\mathrm{e}^{x} + x + 2.$

questionText: 设函数 f(u)具有二阶连续导数，$z=f(\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y)$满足$\frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial y^{2}}=(4 z+\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y)\mathrm{e}^{2 x}.$若 f(0)=0，$f^{\prime}(0)=0$求 f(u)的表达式.
analysisRich:
解分别计算$\frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x^{2}}$和$\frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial y^{2}}.$$\frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = \cos y \mathrm {e} ^ {x} f ^ {\prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right), \quad \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} = \cos y \mathrm {e} ^ {x} f ^ {\prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right) + \cos^ {2} y \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x} f ^ {\prime \prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right),$$\frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = - \sin y \mathrm {e} ^ {x} f ^ {\prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right), \quad \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} = - \cos y \mathrm {e} ^ {x} f ^ {\prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right) + \sin^ {2} y \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x} f ^ {\prime \prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right).$由$\frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial y^{2}}=(4 z+ \mathrm{e}^{x} \cos y) \mathrm{e}^{2 x}$可得$\mathrm {e} ^ {2 x} f ^ {\prime \prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right) = \left[ 4 f \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right) + \mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y \right] \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x},$即$f ^ {\prime \prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right) = 4 f \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right) + \mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y.$我们得到一个二阶常系数非齐次线性微分方程$f^{\prime \prime}(u) - 4f(u) = u.$该方程对应的齐次方程的特征方程为$r^{2}-4=0$，因而解为$f(u)=C_{1}\mathrm{e}^{2u}+C_{2}\mathrm{e}^{-2u}$，其中$C_{1},C_{2}$为待定常数.

由于0不是特征方程的根，故$f^{\prime \prime}(u) - 4 f(u) = u$有形如$z^{*} = C_{3} u + C_{4}$的特解.代入原方程得$- 4 C_{3} u - 4 C_{4} = u.$于是$C_{3} = -\frac{1}{4}, C_{4} = 0.$因此，原方程的解为$f (u) = C _ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {2 u} + C _ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 u} - \frac {1}{4} u.$代入初值以确定$C_{1}, C_{2}$的值.由$f(0)=0$得，$C_{1}+C_{2}=0.$由$f^{\prime}(0)=0$得，$2 C_{1}-2 C_{2}-\frac{1}{4}=0.$从而解得$C_{1}=\frac{1}{1 6}, C_{2}=-\frac{1}{1 6}.$因此，$f ( u ) = \frac { 1 } { 1 6 } \mathrm { e } ^ { 2 u } - \frac { 1 } { 1 6 } \mathrm { e } ^ { - 2 u } - \frac { 1 } { 4 } u .$

questionText: 若函数$f(x)$满足方程$f^{\prime\prime}(x)+f^{\prime}(x)-2f(x)=0$及$f^{\prime\prime}(x)+f(x)=2\mathrm{e}^{x}$，则$f(x)=$___.
analysisRich: 解（法一）由题设知，$f(x)$满足二阶常系数齐次线性微分方程$y^{\prime \prime}+y^{\prime}-2y=0.$其特征方程为$\lambda^{2}+\lambda-2=0$，解得$\lambda_{1}=1,\lambda_{2}=-2$，于是$f(x)=C_{1}\mathrm{e}^{x}+C_{2}\mathrm{e}^{-2x}$其中$C_{1},C_{2}$为待定常数.将$f(x)$的表达式代入$f^{\prime \prime}(x)+f(x)=2\mathrm{e}^{x}$中，得到$C _ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {x} + 4 C _ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x} + C _ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {x} + C _ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x} = 2 \mathrm {e} ^ {x}.$化简得$2 C _ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {x} + 5 C _ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x} = 2 \mathrm {e} ^ {x}.$于是$2C_{1} = 2,5C_{2} = 0$，从而$C_{1} = 1,C_{2} = 0.$故$f(x) = \mathrm{e}^{x}.$（法二）由$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} f^{\prime \prime}(x) + f^{\prime}(x) - 2f(x) = 0, \\ f^{\prime \prime}(x) + f(x) = 2\mathrm{e}^{x} \end{array} \right.$得到$f^{\prime}(x) - 3f(x) = -2\mathrm{e}^{x}$. 由一阶非齐次线性微分方程的求解公式知，$f (x) = \mathrm {e} ^ {\int 3 \mathrm {d} x} \left[ \int (- 2 \mathrm {e} ^ {x}) \mathrm {e} ^ {- \int 3 \mathrm {d} x} \mathrm {d} x + C \right] = \mathrm {e} ^ {3 x} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 x} + C\right) = \mathrm {e} ^ {x} + C \mathrm {e} ^ {3 x}, C \text {为待 定 常 数}.$将$f ( x )$的表达式代入$f^{\prime \prime} ( x )+f^{\prime} ( x )-2 f ( x )=0$中，得到$1 0 C \mathrm{e}^{3 x}=0$即有$C=0$（或者将$f ( x )$的表达式代入$f^{\prime \prime} ( x )+f ( x )=2 \mathrm{e}^{x}$中，同样可得$C=0 )$.于是$f (x) = \mathrm {e} ^ {x}.$

代回（2）式，得$\mathrm {e} ^ {x} + 9 C \mathrm {e} ^ {3 x} + \mathrm {e} ^ {x} + C \mathrm {e} ^ {3 x} = 2 \mathrm {e} ^ {x}.$从而 C=0.

questionText: 设函数$y=y(x)$是微分方程$y^{\prime\prime}+y^{\prime}-2y=0$的解，且在$x=0$处$y(x)$取得极值3，则$y(x)=$___.
analysisRich:
解 由于$y^{\prime \prime}+y^{\prime}-2 y=0$的特征方程为$r^{2}+r-2=0$，故 r=-2和r=1为其特征方程的两个根.于是$y=C_{1}\mathrm{e}^{x}+C_{2}\mathrm{e}^{-2 x}$为原方程的解，其中$C_{1}, C_{2}$为待定常数.

由于$y(0)=3$，故$C_{1}+C_{2}=3$.又由于$y(0)=3$是y(x)的极值，故$y^{\prime}(0)=0$，从而$C_{1}-2 C_{2}=0.$由$\left\{\begin{array}{l l} C_{1}+C_{2}=3, \\ C_{1}-2 C_{2}=0 \end{array} \right.$解得，$C_{1}=2, C_{2}=1.$因此，$y=2\mathrm{e}^{x}+\mathrm{e}^{-2 x}.$

\lambda_ {1}\right) \lambda_ {1}}{\lambda_ {1} \lambda_ {2} \left(\lambda_ {1} - \lambda_ {2}\right)} \\ &= \frac {\lambda_ {2} ^ {2} - \lambda_ {1} ^ {2} + \lambda_ {1} - \lambda_ {2}}{\lambda_ {1} \lambda_ {2} \left(\lambda_ {1} - \lambda_ {2}\right)} = \frac {1 - \left(\lambda_ {1} + \lambda_ {2}\right)}{\lambda_ {1} \lambda_ {2}}. \end{aligned}$由于$\lambda_{1},\lambda_{2}$为特征方程$\lambda^{2} + 2\lambda +k = 0$的两个根，故$\lambda_{1} + \lambda_{2} = -2,\lambda_{1}\lambda_{2} = k.$因此，$\int_0^{+\infty}y(x)\mathrm{d}x = \frac{1 - questionText: 设函数 f(x)满足$f^{\prime\prime}(x)+af^{\prime}(x)+f(x)=0(a>0)$，且 f(0)=m，$f^{\prime}(0)=n$，则$\int_{0}^{+\infty}f(x)\mathrm{d}x=$___
analysisRich:
解 原方程的特征方程为$r^{2}+ar+1=0$. 该方程的判别式$\Delta=a^{2}-4$. 下面根据 a 的取值讨论解的情况.$\textcircled{1}$a > 2.$r^{2}+ar+1=0$有两个不同实根$r_{1,2}=\frac{-a\pm \sqrt{a^{2}-4}}{2}, r_{1}, r_{2}$均小于零. 原方程的解为$f(x)=$$C_{1}\mathrm{e}^{r_{1}x}+C_{2}\mathrm{e}^{r_{2}x}$，其中$C_{1},C_{2}$为待定常数.$f^{\prime}(x)=C_{1}r_{1}\mathrm{e}^{r_{1}x}+C_{2}r_{2}\mathrm{e}^{r_{2}x}.$$\textcircled{2}$a=2.$r^{2}+2 r+1=0$有两个相同实根$r_{1,2}=-1$. 原方程的解为$f(x)=\left(C_{1}+C_{2}x\right)\mathrm{e}^{-x}$，其中$C_{1},C_{2}$为待定常数.$f^{\prime}(x)=\left(C_{2}-C_{1}-C_{2}x\right)\mathrm{e}^{-x}.$$\textcircled{3}$0 < a < 2.$r^{2}+ar+1=0$有一对共轭复根$r_{1,2}=-\frac{a}{2}\pm b\mathrm{i}$，其中$b=\frac{\sqrt{4-a^{2}}}{2}$原方程的解为$f(x)=$$\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{a}{2}x}\left(C_{1}\cos bx+C_{2}\sin bx\right)$，其中$C_{1},C_{2}$为待定常数.$f^{\prime}(x)$的形式与f(x)的形式相同.

II. 设$a_{n}=\int_{n \pi}^{+\infty} f(x)\mathrm{d} x$，求$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_{n}.$
analysisRich:
解（I）$y^{\prime \prime}+2 y^{\prime}+5 y=0$的特征方程为$r^{2}+2 r+5=0$.解得特征根$r_{1,2}=-1\pm 2 \mathrm{i}.$由特征根与解的关系可得$f (x) = \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \left(C _ {1} \cos 2 x + C _ {2} \sin 2 x\right),$其中$C_{1}, C_{2}$为待定常数.

由$f(0) = 1$可得，$C_{1} = 1.$计算$f^{\prime}(x).$$f ^ {\prime} (x) = - \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \left(C _ {1} \cos 2 x + C _ {2} \sin 2 x\right) + \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \left(- 2 C _ {1} \sin 2 x + 2 C _ {2} \cos 2 x\right).$由$f^{\prime}(0)=-1$可得，$-C_{1}+2 C_{2}=-1$，解得$C_{2}=0.$因此，$f ( x ) = \mathrm{e}^{-x}\cos 2x.$（Ⅱ）（法一）由$y^{\prime \prime}+2 y^{\prime}+5 y=0$可得，$f(x)=-\frac{1}{5}[f^{\prime \prime}(x)+2 f^{\prime}(x)]$.于是，$\begin{array}{l} a _ {n} = \int_ {n \pi} ^ {+ \infty} f (x) \mathrm {d} x = - \frac {1}{5} \int_ {n \pi} ^ {+ \infty} \left[ f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) + 2 f ^ {\prime} (x) \right] \mathrm {d} x = - \frac {1}{5} \left[ f ^ {\prime} (x) + 2 f (x) \right] \Bigg | _ {n \pi} ^ {+ \infty} \\ = - \frac {1}{5} \left\{\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \left[ f ^ {\prime} (x) + 2 f (x) \right] - \left[ f ^ {\prime} (n \pi) + 2 f (n \pi) \right]\right\}. \\ \end{array}$由第（I）问可知，$f(x) = \mathrm{e}^{-x}\cos 2x,f^{\prime}(x) = -\mathrm{e}^{-x}\cos 2x-2\mathrm{e}^{-x}\sin 2x.$从而，$\lim_{x\to +\infty}f(x) = 0,$$\lim_{x\to +\infty}f^{\prime}(x) = 0,f(n\pi) = \mathrm{e}^{-n\pi},f^{\prime}(n\pi) = -\mathrm{e}^{-n\pi}.$因此，$a _ {n} = \frac {1}{5} \left[ f ^ {\prime} (n \pi) + 2 f (n \pi) \right] = \frac {1}{5} \mathrm {e} ^ {- n \pi}.$$\sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} a _ {n} = \frac {1}{5} \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- n \pi} = \frac {1}{5} \cdot \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- \pi}}{1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- \pi}} = \frac {1}{5 \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\pi} - 1\right)}.$（法二）计算$a_{n}$$\begin{array}{l} a _ {n} = \int_ {n \pi} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x} \cos 2 x \mathrm {d} x \xlongequal {t = x - n \pi} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- (t + n \pi)} \cos 2 (t + n \pi) \mathrm {d} t \\ = \mathrm {e} ^ {- n \pi} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \cos 2 t \mathrm {d} t. \\ \end{array}$下面计算$\int_{0}^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^{-t}\cos 2t\mathrm{d}t.$$\begin{array}{l} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \cos 2 t \mathrm {d} t = - \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \cos 2 t \mathrm {d} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- t}\right) = - \left[ \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \cos 2 t \Big | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} - \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \cdot (- 2 \sin 2 t) \mathrm {d} t \right] \\ = - \left(- 1 + 2 \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \sin 2 t \mathrm {d} t\right) = 1 - 2 \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \sin 2 t \mathrm {d} t \\ = 1 + 2 \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \sin 2 t \mathrm {d} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- t}\right) = 1 + 2 \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \sin 2 t \Big | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} - \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \cdot 2 \cos 2 t \mathrm {d} t\right) \\ = 1 - 4 \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \cos 2 t \mathrm {d} t. \\ \end{array}$由上式可得，$5\int_{0}^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^{-t}\cos 2t\mathrm{d}t=1$即$\int_{0}^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^{-t}\cos 2t\mathrm{d}t=\frac{1}{5}.$因此，$a_{n}=\frac{1}{5}\mathrm{e}^{-n\pi}.$$\sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} a _ {n} = \frac {1}{5} \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- n \pi} = \frac {1}{5} \cdot \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- \pi}}{1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- \pi}} = \frac {1}{5 \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\pi} - 1\right)}.$

questionText: 若微分方程$y^{\prime \prime}+ay^{\prime}+by=0$的解在$(-\infty,+\infty)$上有界，则（    )
analysisRich:
解 由于二阶常系数齐次线性微分方程必有零解，而零解为有界解，故微分方程$y^{\prime \prime}+ay^{\prime}+by=0$必然存在$(-\infty , +\infty)$上的有界解.本题实际上是要求此方程的所有解都有界.

微分方程$y^{\prime \prime} + a y^{\prime} + b y = 0$的特征方程为$\lambda^{2} + a \lambda + b = 0.$- 若$\Delta=a^{2}-4 b>0$，则特征方程有两个不同实根$\lambda_{1},\lambda_{2}$，从而至少有一个实根非零.此时，微分方程的解为$y=C_{1}\mathrm{e}^{\lambda_{1}x}+C_{2}\mathrm{e}^{\lambda_{2}x}.$取$C_{1} = C_{2} = 1$，则$\lim_{x\to -\infty}\left(\mathrm{e}^{\lambda_{1}x} + \mathrm{e}^{\lambda_{2}x}\right) = +\infty$或$\lim_{x\to +\infty}\left(\mathrm{e}^{\lambda_{1}x} + \mathrm{e}^{\lambda_{2}x}\right) = +\infty$. 该解在$(-\infty , +\infty)$上无界.

- 若$\Delta=a^{2}-4 b=0$，则特征方程有两个相同实根$\lambda$.此时，微分方程的解为$y=(C_{1}+ C_{2} x) \mathrm{e}^{\lambda x}.$取$C_{1} = 0, C_{2} = 1$，则$\lim_{x\to -\infty}x\mathrm{e}^{\lambda x} = \infty$或$\lim_{x\to +\infty}x\mathrm{e}^{\lambda x} = \infty$. 该解在$(-\infty , +\infty)$上无界.

- 若$\Delta=a^{2}-4 b<0$，则特征方程有一对共轭复根$\lambda_{1,2}=\alpha\pm\beta\mathrm{i}$.此时，微分方程的解为$y=\mathrm{e}^{\alpha x}\left(C_{1}\cos \beta x+C_{2}\sin \beta x\right).$当$\alpha \neq 0$时，取$C_{1} = 1, C_{2} = 0$，所得解$y = \mathrm{e}^{\alpha x}\cos \beta x$是$(-\infty , + \infty)$上的无界函数.

当$\alpha=0$时，微分方程的解为$y=C_{1}\cos \beta x+C_{2}\sin \beta x$.对任意常数$C_{1},C_{2}$，该解在$(-\infty, +\infty)$上均有界.根据求根公式，$\lambda_{1,2}=-\frac{a}{2}\pm \frac{\sqrt{4b-a^{2}}}{2}\mathrm{i}$，即$\alpha=-\frac{a}{2}.$于是，$a=0.$结合$a^{2}-4b<0$可知，$b>0.$因此，$a=0,b>0.$应选C.

微分方程$y^{\prime \prime}+a y^{\prime}+b y=0$的特征方程为$\lambda^{2}+a \lambda+b=0.$- 若$\Delta=a^{2}-4 b>0$，则特征方程有两个不同实根$\lambda_{1},\lambda_{2}$，从而至少有一个实根非零.此时，微分方程的解为$y=C_{1}\mathrm{e}^{\lambda_{1}x}+C_{2}\mathrm{e}^{\lambda_{2}x}.$- 取$C_{1}=C_{2}=1$，则$\lim_{x\to -\infty}\left(\mathrm{e}^{\lambda_{1}x}+\mathrm{e}^{\lambda_{2}x}\right)=+\infty$或$\lim_{x\to +\infty}\left(\mathrm{e}^{\lambda_{1}x}+\mathrm{e}^{\lambda_{2}x}\right)=+\infty.$该解在$(-\infty, +\infty)$上无界.

- 若$\Delta=a^{2}-4 b=0$，则特征方程有两个相同实根$\lambda$.此时，微分方程的解为$y=(C_{1}+ C_{2} x) \mathrm{e}^{\lambda x}.$取$C_{1} = 0,C_{2} = 1$，则$\lim_{x\to -\infty}x\mathrm{e}^{\lambda x} = \infty$或$\lim_{x\to +\infty}x\mathrm{e}^{\lambda x} = \infty$.该解在$(-\infty , + \infty)$上无界.

- 若$\Delta=a^{2}-4 b<0$，则特征方程有一对共轭复根$\lambda_{1,2}=\alpha\pm\beta\mathrm{i}$.此时，微分方程的解为$y=\mathrm{e}^{\alpha x}\left(C_{1}\cos \beta x+C_{2}\sin \beta x\right).$当$\alpha\neq0$时，取$C_{1}=1,C_{2}=0$，所得解$y=\mathrm{e}^{\alpha x}\cos \beta x$是$(-\infty, +\infty)$上的无界函数.

当$\alpha=0$时，微分方程的解为$y=C_{1}\cos \beta x+C_{2}\sin \beta x$对任意常数$C_{1},C_{2}$，该解在$(-\infty,+\infty)$上均有界.根据求根公式，$\lambda_{1,2}=-\frac{a}{2}\pm \frac{\sqrt{4b-a^{2}}}{2}\mathrm{i}$即$\alpha=-\frac{a}{2}$于是，$a=0$结合$a^{2}-4b<0$可知，$b>0.$因此，$a=0,b>0$应选C.

questionText: 如果对微分方程$y^{\prime \prime}-2ay^{\prime}+(a+2)y=0$的任一解 y(x)，反常积分$\int_{0}^{+\infty}y(x)\mathrm{d}x$均收敛，那么 a的取值范围是（    )
analysisRich:
解微分方程$y^{\prime \prime}-2 a y^{\prime}+(a+2) y=0$的特征方程为$\lambda^{2}-2 a \lambda+a+2=0.$- 若$\Delta=4 a^{2}-4 ( a+2)=4 \left( a^{2}-a-2\right)>0$，则特征方程有两个不同实根$\lambda_{1},\lambda_{2}$.此时，微分方程的解为$y(x)=C_{1}\mathrm{e}^{\lambda_{1}x}+C_{2}\mathrm{e}^{\lambda_{2}x}.$由于$\mathrm{e}^{0 \cdot x} = 1$，而$\int_0^{+\infty}\mathrm{d}x$发散，故当$\lambda = 0$时，$\int_0^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^{\lambda x}\mathrm{d}x$发散.对$\lambda \neq 0$，$\int_0^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^{\lambda x}\mathrm{d}x = \frac{\mathrm{e}^{\lambda x}}{\lambda}\bigg|_0^{+\infty}$当且仅当$\lambda < 0$时收敛，故对任一解$y(x)$，$\int_0^{+\infty}y(x)\mathrm{d}x$均收敛当且仅当$\lambda_{1},\lambda_{2}$均小于0.

由$\Delta > 0$以及根与系数的关系可得$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} a^{2} - a - 2 > 0, \\ 2a < 0, \\ a + 2 > 0, \end{array} \right.$解得$a \in (-2, -1)$.

- 若$\Delta = 4\left(a^{2} - a - 2\right) = 0$，则特征方程有两个相同实根$\lambda$.当$a = 2$时，$\lambda = 2$，当$a = -1$时，$\lambda = -1$.此时，微分方程的解为$y(x) = \left(C_{1} + C_{2}x\right)\mathrm{e}^{\lambda x}$.

- 由于$\int_0^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^{\lambda x}\mathrm{d}x,\int_0^{+\infty}x\mathrm{e}^{\lambda x}\mathrm{d}x$收敛当且仅当$\lambda < 0$，故此时对任一解$y(x),\int_0^{+\infty}y(x)\mathrm{d}x$均收敛当且仅当$a = -1.$- 若$\Delta = 4\left(a^{2} - a - 2\right) < 0$，则特征方程有一对共轭复根$\lambda_{1,2} = a\pm \sqrt{-a^2 + a + 2}\mathrm{i} = \alpha \pm \beta \mathrm{i}$此时，微分方程的解为$y(x) = \mathrm{e}^{\alpha x}\left(C_1\cos \beta x + C_2\sin \beta x\right)$，其中$\alpha = a,\beta = \sqrt{-a^2 + a + 2}$.

由于$\int_{0}^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^{\alpha x}\cos \beta x\mathrm{d}x,$$\int_{0}^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^{\alpha x}\sin \beta x\mathrm{d}x$收敛当且仅当$\alpha < 0$（见注），故此时对任一解 y(x)$\int_{0}^{+\infty}y(x)\mathrm{d}x$均收敛当且仅当$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} a^{2}-a-2<0, \\ a<0, \end{array} \right.$解得 a$\in(-1,0).$结合以上三种情况，若对任一解$y ( x ) , \int_{0}^{+ \infty} y ( x ) \mathrm{d} x$均收敛，则 a的取值范围是（-2,0）因此，应选C.

questionText: 设 y=y(x)是区间$(-\pi,\pi)$内过点$\left(-\frac{\pi}{\sqrt{2}},\frac{\pi}{\sqrt{2}}\right)$的光滑曲线.当$-\pi < x < 0$时，曲线上任一点处的法线都过原点；当$0\leqslant x < \pi$时，函数 y(x)满足$y^{\prime \prime}+y+x=0.$求 y(x)的表达式.
analysisRich:
解 在（-$\pi$，0）以及[0，$\pi$）上分别计算 y(x).

当$x\in(-\pi ,0)$时，曲线上任一点$(x,y)$处的法线都过原点，故点$(x,y)$处的法线斜率为$\frac{y}{x}$由同一点处的切线斜率与法线斜率的乘积为-1可得，点$(x,y)$处的切线斜率为$y^{\prime} = -\frac{x}{x}$.

分离变量得$y \mathrm {d} y = - x \mathrm {d} x.$于是$x^{2}+y^{2}=C$，其中C是待定常数.由$y\left(-\frac{\pi}{\sqrt{2}}\right)=\frac{\pi}{\sqrt{2}}>0$可知$y=\sqrt{C-x^{2}}$，再代入$x=-\frac{\pi}{\sqrt{2}},$$y=\frac{\pi}{\sqrt{2}}$可求得$C=\pi^{2}.$因此，在$(-\pi, 0)$上，$y ( x ) = \sqrt {\pi^{2}-x^{2}}.$当$x\in [0,\pi)$时，通过解$y^{\prime \prime} + y + x = 0$得到$y(x)$的表达式.$y^{\prime \prime}+y+x=0$为二阶常系数非齐次线性微分方程，其对应的齐次线性微分方程为$y^{\prime \prime}+y=0.$由于$y^{\prime \prime}+y=0$的特征方程为$r^{2}+1=0, r=\pm \mathrm{i}$为特征方程的一对共轭复根，故$y^{\prime \prime}+y=0$的解为$y=C_{1}\cos x+C_{2}\sin x$，其中$C_{1}, C_{2}$为待定常数.

由待定系数法求$y^{\prime \prime}+y+x=0$的特解.由该方程的形式可知，该方程有形如$y^{*} = ax+b$的特解.$(y^{*})^{\prime}=a, (y^{*})^{\prime \prime}=0.$代回$y^{\prime \prime}+y+x=0$得$ax+b+x=0$，故$a=-1,b=0$，所求特解为$y^{*}=-x.$因此，$y^{\prime \prime} + y + x = 0$的解为$y = C_{1}\cos x + C_{2}\sin x - x$，其中$C_{1}, C_{2}$为待定常数.

由于所求曲线$y=y(x)$为光滑曲线，故$y(x)$连续且一阶导数连续，特别地，$y(x)$在分界点$x=0$处连续且一阶导数连续，可由该条件确定$C_{1}, C_{2}$的值.$y \left(0 ^ {-}\right) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {-}} \sqrt {\pi^ {2} - x ^ {2}} = \pi , \quad y \left(0 ^ {+}\right) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \left(C _ {1} \cos x + C _ {2} \sin x - x\right) = C _ {1}.$由$y(0^{-}) = y(0^{+})$得，$C_{1} = \pi .$$y ^ {\prime} (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} - \frac {x}{\sqrt {\pi^ {2} - x ^ {2}}}, & x \in (- \pi , 0), \\ - C _ {1} \sin x + C _ {2} \cos x - 1, & x \in (0, \pi). \end{array} \right.$由于$y^{\prime}(x)$连续，故$0 = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {-}} \left(- \frac {x}{\sqrt {\pi^ {2} - x ^ {2}}}\right) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \left(- C _ {1} \sin x + C _ {2} \cos x - 1\right) = C _ {2} - 1.$于是$C_{2}=1.$综上所述，可知$y (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \sqrt {\pi^ {2} - x ^ {2}}, & x \in (- \pi , 0), \\ \pi \cos x + \sin x - x, & x \in [ 0, \pi). \end{array} \right.$

questionText: 设函数 y(x)具有二阶导数，且曲线 l：y=y(x)与直线 y=x相切于原点.记$\alpha$为曲线 l在点（x,y）处切线的倾角，若$\frac{\mathrm{d}\alpha}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}$求 y(x)的表达式.
analysisRich:
解（法一）构造关于$\alpha$，$x$和关于$\alpha$，$y$的微分方程

由$\frac{\mathrm{d}\alpha}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}$可得，$\alpha=y+C_{1}$，其中$C_{1}$为待定常数.于是，可以将求$y(x)$的表达式转化为求$\alpha$的表达式.

由导数的几何意义知，$\frac{\mathrm{d}\alpha}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=\tan \alpha$，故$\frac{\mathrm{d}\alpha}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{\sin \alpha}{\cos \alpha}.$分离变量得，$\frac{\cos \alpha}{\sin \alpha}\mathrm{d}\alpha=\mathrm{d}x$，解得$\sin \alpha =C_{2}\mathrm{e}^{x}$，其中$C_{2}$为待定常数.

由于曲线$y=y(x)$与直线$y=x$在原点相切，故当$x=0$时，$\alpha(0)=\frac{\pi}{4}$从而可求得$C_{2}=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2},$$\alpha(x)=\arcsin \frac{\mathrm{e}^{x}}{\sqrt{2}}.$$y (x) = \alpha (x) - C _ {1} = \arcsin \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x}}{\sqrt {2}} - C _ {1}.$下面求$C_{1}.$由于$\alpha (0)=\frac{\pi}{4}, y(0)=0$，故$0=\frac{\pi}{4}-C_{1}, C_{1}=\frac{\pi}{4}.$因此，$y (x) = \arcsin \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x}}{\sqrt {2}} - \frac {\pi}{4}.$（法二）由于曲线 l：$y=y(x)$在点（x，y）处的切线斜率为$y^{\prime}$，故$\tan \alpha =y^{\prime},\alpha =\arctan y^{\prime}.$由链式法则可得，$\frac{\mathrm{d}\alpha}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{y^{\prime \prime}}{1+(y^{\prime})^{2}}.$又因为$\frac{\mathrm{d}\alpha}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}$所以$\frac {y ^ {\prime \prime}}{1 + \left(y ^ {\prime}\right) ^ {2}} = y ^ {\prime}.$(1) 式为可降阶二阶微分方程.令$p=y^{\prime}$，则（1）式变成$p^{\prime}=p(1+p^{2})$，分离变量得，$\frac{\mathrm{d} p}{p(1+p^{2})}=\mathrm{d} x.$方程两端同时积分得$\frac {1}{2} \ln \frac {p ^ {2}}{1 + p ^ {2}} = x + C,$其中 C为待定常数.

由于曲线$y = y(x)$与直线$y = x$相切于原点，故$y^{\prime}(0) = 1$，即$p(0) = 1.$代入$\frac{1}{2}\ln \frac{p^{2}}{1+p^{2}}=x+C$得，$\frac{1}{2}\ln \frac{1}{2}=0+C$从而$C=\frac{1}{2}\ln \frac{1}{2},x=\frac{1}{2}\ln \frac{2p^{2}}{1+p^{2}}$即$\frac{2(y^{\prime})^{2}}{1+(y^{\prime})^{2}}=$$\mathrm{e}^{2x}.$解得$\left(y ^ {\prime}\right) ^ {2} = \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {2 x}}{2 - \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x}}, \quad y ^ {\prime} = \pm \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x}}{\sqrt {2 - \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x}}}.$由于$y^{\prime}(0) = 1$，故取$y^{\prime} = \frac{\mathrm{e}^{x}}{\sqrt{2 - \mathrm{e}^{2x}}}$对$y^{\prime}$积分求$y ( x )$的表达式.由于曲线过原点，故$y ( 0 ) = 0$从而$y (x) = \int_ {0} ^ {x} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {t}}{\sqrt {2 - \mathrm {e} ^ {2 t}}} \mathrm {d} t = \int_ {0} ^ {x} \frac {\frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {t}}{\sqrt {2}}}{\sqrt {1 - \left(\frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {t}}{\sqrt {2}}\right) ^ {2}}} \mathrm {d} t = \arcsin \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {t}}{\sqrt {2}} \Big | _ {0} ^ {x} = \arcsin \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {x}}{\sqrt {2}} - \frac {\pi}{4}.$因此，$y ( x )$的表达式为$y ( x ) = \arcsin \frac{\mathrm{e}^{x}}{\sqrt{2}} -\frac{\pi}{4}.$

questionText: 设函数 f(x)在定义域 I上的导数大于零.若对任意的$x_{0}\in I$，曲线 y=f(x)在点$\left(x_{0},f\left(x_{0}\right)\right)$处的切线与直线$x=x_{0}$及 x轴所围成区域的面积恒为4，且 f(0)=2，求 f(x)的表达式.
analysisRich:
解如图所示，曲线$y=f(x)$在点$\left(x_{0},f\left(x_{0}\right)\right)$处的切线为$y - f \left(x _ {0}\right) = f ^ {\prime} \left(x _ {0}\right) \left(x - x _ {0}\right).$令$y = 0$，注意到$f^{\prime}(x) > 0$，解得$x = x_{0} - \frac{f(x_{0})}{f^{\prime}(x_{0})}$，即该切线与$x$轴的交点为$\left(x_0 - \frac{f(x_0)}{f^{\prime}(x_0)},0\right)$.

曲线$y=f(x)$在点$\left(x_{0}, f\left(x_{0}\right)\right)$处的切线与直线$x=x_{0}$及x轴所围成区域为三角形，底边长$\left|x_{0}-\left[x_{0}-\frac{f\left(x_{0}\right)}{f^{\prime}\left(x_{0}\right)}\right]\right|$，高$|f(x_{0})-0|$.于是，$\frac {\left| f \left(x _ {0}\right) - 0 \right| \cdot \left| x _ {0} - \left[ x _ {0} - \frac {f \left(x _ {0}\right)}{f ^ {\prime} \left(x _ {0}\right)} \right] \right|}{2} = 4, \quad \text {即} \frac {\left| f \left(x _ {0}\right) \right| \cdot \left| \frac {f \left(x _ {0}\right)}{f ^ {\prime} \left(x _ {0}\right)} \right|}{2} = 4.$由于$f^{\prime}(x) > 0$，故$\frac {\left[ f \left(x _ {0}\right) \right] ^ {2}}{f ^ {\prime} \left(x _ {0}\right)} = 8, \quad x _ {0} \in I,$即$f(x)$满足微分方程$8y^{\prime} = y^{2}$.

分离变量，得$\frac{8}{y^{2}}\mathrm{d}y=\mathrm{d}x.$方程两端积分，得$-\frac{8}{y}=x+C$其中C为待定常数.由于$f(0)=2$故 C=-4，从而$y=\frac{8}{4-x}.$因此，$f (x) = \frac {8}{4 - x}, \quad x \in I.$

questionText: 已知高温物体置于低温介质中，任一时刻该物体温度对时间的变化率与该时刻物体和介质的温差成正比。现将一初始温度为$1 2 0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$的物体在$2 0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$的恒温介质中冷却，$3 0 \mathrm{~m i n}$后该物体温度降至$3 0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$，若要将该物体的温度继续降至$2 1^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$，还需冷却多长时间？
analysisRich:
解设物体温度$T$为关于时间$t$的函数$T(t)$，则物体温度对时间的变化率为$\frac{\mathrm{d}T}{\mathrm{d}t}$.

由于任一时刻物体温度对时间的变化率与该时刻物体和介质的温差成正比，且介质温度恒为$20^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$，故可以建立关于$T, t$的微分方程：$\frac{\mathrm{d} T}{\mathrm{d} t}=k ( T-2 0 ).$注意：k的符号表示温度随时间推移增加或减少.由于温度随着时间推移而降低，这里的比例系数k是一个小于零的数.

分离变量得$\frac{\mathrm{d} T}{T-2 0}=k \mathrm{d} t.$对该方程两端积分得$\ln ( T-2 0 )= k t+C$其中C为待定常数.

当 t=0时，$T(0)=1 2 0$，由此可得 C=2ln10；当 t=30时，$T(30)=30$，由此可得 k=$\frac{\ln 1 0-2 \ln 1 0}{3 0}=-\frac{\ln 1 0}{3 0}.$因此，$\ln (T - 2 0) = - \frac {\ln 1 0}{3 0} t + 2 \ln 1 0.$当 T=21时，代入（1）式，可得$0=-\frac{\ln 1 0}{3 0} t+2 \ln 1 0$，解得 t=60，即冷却 30 min后，还需要继续冷却 30 min，才能把该物体温度降至 21$^{\circ} \mathrm{C}.$

questionText: 设 y(x)是区间$\left(0, \frac{3}{2}\right)$内的可导函数，且 y(1)=0.点 P是曲线 l：y=y(x)上的任意一点，l在点 P处的切线与 y轴相交于点（0，$Y_{P}$），法线与 x轴相交于点（$X_{P},0$），若$X_{P}=Y_{P}$，求 l上点的坐标（x,y）满足的方程.
analysisRich:
解曲线 l在点 P（x,y(x)）处的切线方程为$Y-y(x)=y^{\prime}(x)(X-x).$由于 l在点 P处的切线过点（0，$Y_{P}$），故可得$y - Y _ {P} = y ^ {\prime} x.$由于同一点处的法线与切线相互垂直，故曲线 l在点 P(x,y(x))处的法线方程为 Y-y(x) =$- \frac{1}{y^{\prime}(x)}(X-x).$又因为法线过点（$X_{P},0$），所以得$y = \frac {1}{y ^ {\prime}} \left(X _ {P} - x\right).$由（1）式可得$y - y^{\prime}x = Y_{P}.$由（2）式可得$y^{\prime}y+x=X_{P}.$由$X_{P}=Y_{P}$可得$y-y^{\prime}x=y^{\prime}y+x.$于是，$y ^ {\prime} = \frac {y - x}{y + x} = \frac {\frac {y}{x} - 1}{\frac {y}{x} + 1}.$这是一个齐次微分方程.令$u=\frac{y}{x}$，则$\frac{\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x}=u+x\frac{\mathrm{d} u}{\mathrm{d} x}.$（3）式可化为$u + x \frac {\mathrm {d} u}{\mathrm {d} x} = \frac {u - 1}{u + 1}.$这是一个可分离变量的微分方程. 整理得$\frac {(u + 1) \mathrm {d} u}{u ^ {2} + 1} = - \frac {\mathrm {d} x}{x}.$(4) 式两端同时积分可得$\int \frac {u + 1}{u ^ {2} + 1} \mathrm {d} u = \int \frac {u \mathrm {d} u}{u ^ {2} + 1} + \int \frac {\mathrm {d} u}{u ^ {2} + 1} = \frac {1}{2} \ln \left(u ^ {2} + 1\right) + \arctan u = - \ln x + C.$当 x=1时，y=0，$u=\frac{y}{x}=0$. 代入上式得 C=0.

将 u =$\frac{y}{x}$代回，整理得曲线方程为$\ln \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) + 2 \arctan \frac {y}{x} = 0, x \in \left(0, \frac {3}{2}\right).$

questionText: 设函数 f(x)可导，且$f^{\prime}(x) > 0$，曲线$y=f(x)(x\geqslant0)$经过坐标原点O，其上任意一点M处的切线与x轴交于 T，又MP垂直x轴于点P.已知由曲线$y=f(x)$，直线MP以及x轴所围图形的面积与$\triangle M T P$的面积之比恒为3：2，求满足上述条件的曲线的方程.
analysisRich:
解 点 M，T，P如图所示.

计算$\triangle M T P$的面积.

曲线$y=f(x)$上任意一点$M(x,f(x))$处的切线方程为$Y - f (x) = f ^ {\prime} (x) (X - x).$令 Y=0，可得点 T的横坐标为$X=x-\frac{f(x)}{f^{\prime}(x)}.$由于$y = f(x) (x\geqslant 0)$过原点，且$f^{\prime}(x) > 0$，故点M的纵坐标$f(x) > 0.$$|MP|=f(x),$$|TP|=\left|x-\left[x-\frac{f(x)}{f^{\prime}(x)}\right]\right|=\left|\frac{f(x)}{f^{\prime}(x)}\right|=\frac{f(x)}{f^{\prime}(x)}.$于是，$S_{\triangle MTP}=\frac{1}{2}|MP||TP|=\frac{1}{2}\cdot f(x).$$\frac{f(x)}{f^{\prime}(x)}=\frac{[f(x)]^{2}}{2f^{\prime}(x)}.$由定积分的几何意义可得，曲边三角形 OMP的面积$S=\int_{0}^{x} f(t)\mathrm{d} t.$由曲边三角形 OMP的面积与$\triangle M T P$的面积之比恒为3：2可知$\frac{\int_{0}^{x} f(t)\mathrm{d} t}{\frac{[f(x)]^{2}}{2f^{\prime}(x)}}=\frac{3}{2}$即$4 \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t) \mathrm {d} t = \frac {3 [ f (x) ] ^ {2}}{f ^ {\prime} (x)}.$对（1）式两端同时求导可得，$4 f (x) = \frac {3 \left\{2 f (x) \left[ f ^ {\prime} (x) \right] ^ {2} - \left[ f (x) \right] ^ {2} f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) \right\}}{\left[ f ^ {\prime} (x) \right] ^ {2}}.$整理可得$2[f^{\prime}(x)]^{2}=3 f(x)f^{\prime \prime}(x)$，即$2(y^{\prime})^{2}=3 y y^{\prime \prime}.$这是一个可降阶微分方程. 令$p = y^{\prime}$, 则$y^{\prime \prime} = p \frac{\mathrm{d}p}{\mathrm{d}y}$. 原方程化为$2 p^{2} = 3 y \cdot p \frac{\mathrm{d}p}{\mathrm{d}y}$, 即$3 y \frac{\mathrm{d}p}{\mathrm{d}y} = 2 p$. 分离变量可得$\frac{\mathrm{d}p}{p} = \frac{2}{3 y} \mathrm{d}y$. 方程两端积分可得$\ln p = \frac{2}{3} \ln y + C_{0}$（$C_{0}$为常数，这里不用加绝对值符号是因为由已知条件可得$p > 0, y > 0$）。由此可得$y^{\prime} = p = C_{1} y^{\frac{2}{3}}$, 其中$C_{1}$为常数，即$\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x} = C_{1} y^{\frac{2}{3}}$.

由$y = f(x)$过原点可知，$f(0) = 0$. 代入$2[f^{\prime}(x)]^{2} = 3 f(x) f^{\prime \prime}(x)$可知$f^{\prime}(0) = 0$. 由$f(0) = 0$和$f^{\prime}(0) = 0$无法确定$C_{1}$.

分离变量可得$\frac{\mathrm{d} y}{y^{\frac{2}{3}}}=C_{1}\mathrm{d} x.$方程两端积分可得$3y^{\frac{1}{3}}=C_{1}x+C_{2}.$由$f(0)=0$可得$C_{2}=0.$从而$3y^{\frac{1}{3}}=C_{1}x$即$y^{\frac{1}{3}}=\frac{C_{1}}{3}x.$因此，$y=\frac{C_{1}^{3}}{27}x^{3}=Cx^{3}, C=\frac{C_{1}^{3}}{27}.$由于 y > 0，故 C > 0.

综上所述，$y=Cx^{3}$，其中C为任意正常数.

（Ⅱ）由第（I）问的结果可知，$f ( x ) = \int_{1}^{x} t ( 2 - \ln t ) \mathrm{d} t.$由变限积分的求导公式可得$f^{\prime}(x) = x(2 - \ln x)$. 解$2 - \ln x = 0$可得$x = \mathrm{e}^{2}$. 于是，$x = \mathrm{e}^{2}$为$f(x)$在$(0, + \infty)$上的唯一驻点.当$0 < x < \mathrm{e}^{2}$时，$f^{\prime}(x) > 0$，$f(x)$单调增加；当$x > \mathrm{e}^{2}$时，$f^{\prime}(x) < 0$，$f(x)$单调减少.$x = \mathrm{e}^{2}$为$f(x)$在$(0, + \infty)$上的最大值点，最大值为$\begin{aligned} f \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {2}\right) &= \int_ {1} ^ {\mathrm {e} ^ {2}} t (2 - \ln t) \mathrm {d} t = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {1} ^ {\mathrm {e} ^ {2}} (2 - \ln t) \mathrm {d} \left(t ^ {2}\right) = \frac {1}{2} t ^ {2} (2 - \ln t) \left| _ {1} ^ {\mathrm {e} ^ {2}} - \frac {1}{2} \int_ {1} ^ {\mathrm {e} ^ {2}} t ^ {2} \cdot \left(- \frac {1}{t}\right) \mathrm {d} t \right. \\ &= 0 - 1 + \frac {1}{2} \int_ {1} ^ {\mathrm {e} ^ {2}} t \mathrm {d} t = - 1 + \frac {1}{4} t ^ {2} \Bigg | _ {1} ^ {\mathrm {e} ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{4} \mathrm {e} ^ {4} - \frac {5}{4}. \end{aligned}$

questionText: 设某公司在 t 时刻的资产为 f(t)，从 0 时刻到 t 时刻的平均资产等于$\frac{f(t)}{t}-t$. 假设 f(t) 连续且 f(0)=0，则$f(t)=$___.
analysisRich: 解对 t > 0，从0时刻到 t时刻的平均资产为$\frac{1}{t}\int_{0}^{t} f(u)\mathrm{d}u$，故由已知条件可知$\frac {1}{t} \int_ {0} ^ {t} f (u) \mathrm {d} u = \frac {f (t)}{t} - t.$整理可得$\int_ {0} ^ {t} f (u) \mathrm {d} u = f (t) - t ^ {2}.$对（1）式两端关于 t求导，可得$f (t) = f ^ {\prime} (t) - 2 t, \quad \mathrm {即} f ^ {\prime} (t) - f (t) = 2 t.$由一阶非齐次线性微分方程的通解公式可得$\begin{array}{l} f (t) = \mathrm {e} ^ {\int \mathrm {d} t} \left(\int 2 t \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {- \int \mathrm {d} t} \mathrm {d} t + C\right) = \mathrm {e} ^ {t} \left(\int 2 t \cdot \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \mathrm {d} t + C\right) \\ = \mathrm {e} ^ {t} \left[ - 2 \int t \mathrm {d} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {- t}\right) + C \right] = \mathrm {e} ^ {t} \left[ - 2 \left(t \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} - \int \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} \mathrm {d} t\right) + C \right] \\ = \mathrm {e} ^ {t} \left(- 2 t \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} - 2 \mathrm {e} ^ {- t} + C\right) = C \mathrm {e} ^ {t} - 2 t - 2. \\ \end{array}$代入初始条件$f ( 0 ) = 0$，可得$0 = C - 2$，即$C = 2.$因此，$f ( t ) = 2 \mathrm{e}^{t} - 2 t - 2.$

（Ⅱ）点$\left( \mathrm{e}^{\frac{3}{2}},\frac{\mathrm{e}^{\frac{3}{2}}}{2} \right)$处的切线与坐标轴所围成的三角形面积最小，最小值为$S \left( \mathrm{e}^{\frac{3}{2}} \right)=\mathrm{e}^{3}.$
analysisRich:
解（I）由导数的几何意义可知，点 P(x,y)处的切线方程为$Y-y=y^{\prime}(X-x).$该点到y轴的距离为$|x|\frac{x>e>0}{x}.$令 X=0，可得 Y=y-xy'.由点 P(x,y)到 y轴的距离等于该点处的切线在 y轴上的截距可得 x=y-xy'.整理可得$y^{\prime}-\frac{y}{x}=-1.$由一阶非齐次线性微分方程的通解公式可得$\begin{aligned} y &= \mathrm {e} ^ {\int \frac {1}{x} \mathrm {d} x} \left[ \int (- 1) \mathrm {e} ^ {- \int \frac {1}{x} \mathrm {d} x} \mathrm {d} x + C \right] = \mathrm {e} ^ {\ln x} \left(- \int \mathrm {e} ^ {- \ln x} \mathrm {d} x + C\right) \\ &= x \left(- \int \frac {1}{x} \mathrm {d} x + C\right) = x (C - \ln x). \end{aligned}$代入$x=\mathrm{e}^{2}, y=0$可得 C=2. 因此，$y(x)=x(2-\ln x).$（Ⅱ）点（x,y）处的切线与两坐标轴所围成的三角形是一个直角三角形，记切线在 x轴，y轴上的截距为$x_{0}, y_{0}$，则三角形的面积$S=\frac{1}{2}|x_{0}||y_{0}|.$由第（I）问可知，点$P(x,y)$处的切线方程为$Y-y=y^{\prime}(X-x),y_{0}=y-xy^{\prime}.$令$Y=0$，可得$X=x-\frac{y}{y^{\prime}}$从而切线与x轴的交点为$\left(x-\frac{y}{y^{\prime}},0\right),x_{0}=x-\frac{y}{y^{\prime}}.$又由第（I）问可知，$y=x(2-\ln x)$$y ^ {\prime} = \left[ x (2 - \ln x) \right] ^ {\prime} = 2 - \ln x - x \cdot \frac {1}{x} = 1 - \ln x.$于是，$\left| x _ {0} \right| = \left| x - \frac {x (2 - \ln x)}{1 - \ln x} \right| = \frac {x}{\ln x - 1},$$\left| y _ {0} \right| = \left| x \left(2 - \ln x\right) - x \left(1 - \ln x\right) \right| = x.$由此可得$S ( x ) = \frac { x^{2} } { 2 ( \ln x - 1 ) } .$下面求 S（x）的最小值.

计算$S^{\prime}(x).$$S ^ {\prime} (x) = \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {2 x (\ln x - 1) - x ^ {2} \cdot \frac {1}{x}}{(\ln x - 1) ^ {2}} = \frac {2 x \ln x - 3 x}{2 (\ln x - 1) ^ {2}} = \frac {x \left(\ln x - \frac {3}{2}\right)}{(\ln x - 1) ^ {2}}.$当且仅当$x=\mathrm{e}^{\frac{3}{2}}$时，$S^{\prime}(x)=0$.又因为当$\mathrm{e}<x<\mathrm{e}^{\frac{3}{2}}$时，$S^{\prime}(x)<0,S(x)$单调减少，当$x > \mathrm{e}^{\frac{3}{2}}$时，$S^{\prime}(x)>0,S(x)$单调增加，所以$x=\mathrm{e}^{\frac{3}{2}}$是 S(x)的最小值点.

因此，点$\left(\mathrm{e}^{\frac{3}{2}},\frac{\mathrm{e}^{\frac{3}{2}}}{2}\right)$处的切线与坐标轴所围成的三角形面积最小，最小值为$S(\mathrm{e}^{\frac{3}{2}})=\mathrm{e}^{3}.$

questionText: 设函数 f(u)具有2阶连续导数，$z=f(\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y)$满足$\frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial y^{2}}=(4 z+\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y)\mathrm{e}^{2 x}.$若 f(0)=0，$f^{\prime}(0)=0$求 f(u)的表达式.
analysisRich:
解分别计算$\frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x^{2}}$和$\frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial y^{2}}.$$\frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = \cos y \mathrm {e} ^ {x} f ^ {\prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right), \quad \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} = \cos y \mathrm {e} ^ {x} f ^ {\prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right) + \cos^ {2} y \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x} f ^ {\prime \prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right),$$\frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = - \sin y \mathrm {e} ^ {x} f ^ {\prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right), \quad \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} = - \cos y \mathrm {e} ^ {x} f ^ {\prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right) + \sin^ {2} y \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x} f ^ {\prime \prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right).$由$\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=(4z+\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y)\mathrm{e}^{2x}$可得$\mathrm {e} ^ {2 x} f ^ {\prime \prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right) = \left[ 4 f \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right) + \mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y \right] \mathrm {e} ^ {2 x},$即$f ^ {\prime \prime} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right) = 4 f \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y\right) + \mathrm {e} ^ {x} \cos y.$我们得到一个二阶常系数非齐次线性微分方程$f^{\prime \prime}(u) - 4 f(u) = u.$该方程对应的齐次方程的特征方程为$r^{2}-4=0$，因而解为$f(u)=C_{1}\mathrm{e}^{2u}+C_{2}\mathrm{e}^{-2u}$，其中$C_{1},C_{2}$为待定常数.

由于0不是特征方程的根，故$f^{\prime \prime}(u)-4 f(u)=u$有形如$z^{*} = C_{3} u+C_{4}$的特解.代入原方程得$-4 C_{3} u-4 C_{4}=u.$于是$C_{3}=-\frac{1}{4}, C_{4}=0.$因此，原方程的解为$f (u) = C _ {1} \mathrm {e} ^ {2 u} + C _ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 u} - \frac {1}{4} u.$代入初值以确定$C_{1}, C_{2}$的值.由$f(0)=0$得，$C_{1}+C_{2}=0.$由$f^{\prime}(0)=0$得，$2 C_{1}-2 C_{2}-\frac{1}{4}=0.$从而解得$C_{1}=\frac{1}{1 6}, C_{2}=-\frac{1}{1 6}.$因此，$f ( u ) = \frac { 1 } { 1 6 } \mathrm { e } ^ { 2 u } - \frac { 1 } { 1 6 } \mathrm { e } ^ { - 2 u } - \frac { 1 } { 4 } u .$

questionText: 微分方程$(2y-3x)\mathrm{d}x+(2x-5y)\mathrm{d}y=0$满足条件$y(1)=1$的解为 ___
analysisRich:
解（法一）整理$( 2 y-3 x ) \mathrm{d} x+( 2 x-5 y ) \mathrm{d} y=0$得到$\frac{\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x}=\frac{2 y-3 x}{5 y-2 x}=\frac{2 \frac{y}{x}-3}{5 \frac{y}{x}-2}.$令$u=\frac{y}{x}$则$y=u x,\frac{\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x}=u+x\frac{\mathrm{d} u}{\mathrm{d} x}$原方程可化为$u+x\frac{\mathrm{d} u}{\mathrm{d} x}=\frac{2 u-3}{5 u-2}.$这是一个可分离变量的微分方程.整理该方程可得$x\frac{\mathrm{d} u}{\mathrm{d} x}=\frac{-5 u^{2}+4 u-3}{5 u-2},$进一步分离变量可得$\frac{(5 u-2)\mathrm{d} u}{5 u^{2}-4 u+3}=-\frac{\mathrm{d} x}{x}.$方程两端同时积分可得$\frac{1}{2}\ln |5 u^{2}-4 u+3|=-\ln |x|+C$进一步可得$5 u^{2}$$-4 u+3=\frac{C_{1}}{x^{2}}$其中$C_{1}$为待定常数.

当$x = 1$时，$y = 1, u = 1$，代入$5 u^{2} - 4 u + 3 = \frac{C_{1}}{x^{2}}$可得$4 = \frac{C_{1}}{1}$，即$C_{1} = 4.$由此可得$5 u^{2} - 4 u+3 = \frac{4}{x^{2}}.$代入$u = \frac{y}{x}$可得$\frac{5 y^{2}}{x^{2}} - \frac{4 y}{x} + 3 = \frac{4}{x^{2}}$，即$5 y^{2} - 4 x y + 3 x^{2} - 4 = 0.$（法二）考虑隐函数$F ( x,y)=0$，若$F ( x,y)$满足$\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}=2 y-3 x, \frac{\partial F}{\partial y}=2 x-5 y$，则$(2 y-3 x)\mathrm{d} x+ ( 2 x-5 y ) \mathrm{d} y=0$即$\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}\mathrm{d} x+\frac{\partial F}{\partial y}\mathrm{d} y=0.$对$\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}$关于 x积分可得$F (x, y) = \int \frac {\partial F}{\partial x} \mathrm {d} x = \int (2 y - 3 x) \mathrm {d} x = 2 x y - \frac {3}{2} x ^ {2} + \varphi (y),$其中$\varphi(y)$为关于y的一元函数.

对$F(x,y) = 2xy - \frac{3}{2} x^2 + \varphi(y)$关于$y$求偏导数可得$\frac{\partial F}{\partial y} = 2x + \varphi^{\prime}(y)$，与$\frac{\partial F}{\partial y} = 2x - 5y$比较可得$\varphi^{\prime}(y) = -5y$. 于是，$\varphi (y) = \int \varphi^ {\prime} (y) \mathrm {d} y = \int (- 5 y) \mathrm {d} y = - \frac {5}{2} y ^ {2} + C,$其中 C为待定常数.进一步可得$F ( x,y) = 2 x y - \frac{3}{2} x^{2} - \frac{5}{2} y^{2} + C.$将$x=1,y=1$代入$F ( x,y) = 0$可得$2 - \frac{3}{2} -\frac{5}{2} + C = 0$，解得$C=2.$因此，微分方程的解为$2 x y-\frac{3}{2} x^{2}-\frac{5}{2} y^{2}+2=0$即$5 y^{2}-4 x y+3 x^{2}-4=0.$

questionText: 设$y_{1}, y_{2}$是一阶线性非齐次微分方程$y^{\prime}+p(x)y=q(x)$的两个特解，若常数$\lambda,\mu$使$\lambda y_{1}+\mu y_{2}$是该方程的解，$\lambda y_{1}-\mu y_{2}$是该方程对应的齐次方程的解，则（    )
analysisRich: 由题设知，$y _ {1} ^ {\prime} + p (x) y _ {1} = q (x), \quad y _ {2} ^ {\prime} + p (x) y _ {2} = q (x).$又由题设知，$\lambda y_{1} + \mu y_{2}$也是$y^{\prime} + p(x)y = q(x)$的解，故$\left(\lambda y _ {1} + \mu y _ {2}\right) ^ {\prime} + p (x) \left(\lambda y _ {1} + \mu y _ {2}\right) = q (x).$整理（1）式，得$\lambda \left[ y _ {1} ^ {\prime} + p (x) y _ {1} \right] + \mu \left[ y _ {2} ^ {\prime} + p (x) y _ {2} \right] = q (x),$即$(\lambda +\mu)q(x) = q(x)$. 由于$q(x)\neq 0$，故$\lambda +\mu = 1.$又由$\lambda y_{1} - \mu y_{2}$是$y^{\prime} + p(x)y = 0$的解知$\left(\lambda y _ {1} - \mu y _ {2}\right) ^ {\prime} + p (x) \left(\lambda y _ {1} - \mu y _ {2}\right) = 0.$整理（2）式，得$\lambda \left[ y _ {1} ^ {\prime} + p (x) y _ {1} \right] - \mu \left[ y _ {2} ^ {\prime} + p (x) y _ {2} \right] = 0,$即$(\lambda -\mu)q(x) = 0.$由于$q(x)\neq 0$，故$\lambda -\mu = 0.$联立$\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \lambda + \mu = 1, \\ \lambda - \mu = 0, \end{array} \right.$解得$\lambda = \frac{1}{2}, \mu = \frac{1}{2}$. 应选A.

questionText: 设 f(x)为周期为2的周期函数，且 f(x)=1-x,x∈[0,1]，若 f(x)$\frac{a_{0}}{2}+\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_{n} \cos n \pi x$，则$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_{2n}=$___.
analysisRich: 解 由于 f(x) 的傅里叶级数展开式为余弦级数，故 f(x)为偶函数.由余弦级数的系数计算公式可知，当 n≥1时，$\begin{aligned} a _ {n} &= 2 \int_ {0} ^ {1} (1 - x) \cos n \pi x \mathrm {d} x = 2 \left(\int_ {0} ^ {1} \cos n \pi x \mathrm {d} x - \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \cos n \pi x \mathrm {d} x\right) \\ &= 2 \left[ \frac {1}{n \pi} \sin n \pi x \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} - \frac {1}{n \pi} \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \mathrm {d} (\sin n \pi x) \right] = - \frac {2}{n \pi} \int_ {0} ^ {1} x \mathrm {d} (\sin n \pi x) \\ &= - \frac {2}{n \pi} \left(x \sin n \pi x \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sin n \pi x \mathrm {d} x\right) = \frac {2}{n \pi} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \sin n \pi x \mathrm {d} x \\ &= \frac {2}{n \pi} \cdot \left(- \frac {\cos n \pi x}{n \pi}\right) \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {- 2}{n ^ {2} \pi^ {2}} (\cos n \pi - 1). \end{aligned}$于是，$a _ {2 n} = \frac {- 2}{(2 n) ^ {2} \pi^ {2}} \left(\cos 2 n \pi - 1\right) = \frac {- 1}{2 n ^ {2} \pi^ {2}} (1 - 1) = 0.$因此，$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_{2n}=0.$

questionText: 已知函数 f(x)=x+1，若 f(x)$\frac{a_{0}}{2}+\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_{n} \cos n x,x \in[0,\pi]$，则$\lim_{n \to \infty} n^{2} \sin a_{2n-1}=$___.
analysisRich: 解 由于 f(x)的傅里叶级数展开式为余弦级数，故 f(x)为偶函数.由余弦级数的系数公式可知，当 n≥1时，$\begin{aligned} a _ {n} &= \frac {2}{\pi} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} (x + 1) \cos n x d x = \frac {2}{\pi} \left(\int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \cos n x d x + \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} x \cos n x d x\right) \\ &= \frac {2}{\pi} \left[ \frac {1}{n} \sin n x \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi} + \frac {1}{n} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} x d (\sin n x) \right] = \frac {2}{n \pi} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} x d (\sin n x) \\ &= \frac {2}{n \pi} \left(x \sin n x \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi} - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin n x d x\right) = - \frac {2}{n \pi} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin n x d x \\ &= \frac {2}{n \pi} \cdot \frac {\cos n x}{n} \Big | _ {0} ^ {\pi} = \frac {2}{n ^ {2} \pi} (\cos n \pi - 1) = \frac {2}{n ^ {2} \pi} [ (- 1) ^ {n} - 1 ]. \end{aligned}$于是，$a _ {2 n - 1} = \frac {2}{(2 n - 1) ^ {2} \pi} [ (- 1) ^ {2 n - 1} - 1 ] = \frac {2}{(2 n - 1) ^ {2} \pi} (- 1 - 1) = \frac {- 4}{(2 n - 1) ^ {2} \pi}.$因此，$\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} n ^ {2} \sin a _ {2 n - 1} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} n ^ {2} \sin \frac {- 4}{(2 n - 1) ^ {2} \pi} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {- 4 n ^ {2}}{(2 n - 1) ^ {2} \pi} = - \frac {1}{\pi}.$

questionText: 已知函数 f(x)$\left\{\begin{array}{l l}0,&0 \leqslant x < \frac{1}{2}\\ x^{2},&\frac{1}{2} \leqslant x \leqslant 1\end{array} \right.$，的傅里叶级数为$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} b_{n} \sin n \pi x$，S(x)为$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} b_{n} \sin n \pi x$的和函数，则$S\left(-\frac{7}{2}\right)=$
analysisRich:
解 由 S(x)为正弦级数的和函数可知，$S ( x )$为[0,1]上的 f(x)作奇延拓后再作周期为2的周期延拓所得函数的傅里叶级数.

由于 S（x）是周期为2的奇函数，故$S \left(- \frac {7}{2}\right) = S \left(- 4 + \frac {1}{2}\right) = S \left(\frac {1}{2}\right).$又因为$x=\frac{1}{2}$是$f(x)$的间断点，所以由狄利克雷收敛定理可得$S \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) = \frac {1}{2} \left[ \lim _ {x \rightarrow \frac {1}{2} ^ {-}} f (x) + \lim _ {x \rightarrow \frac {1}{2} ^ {+}} f (x) \right] = \frac {1}{2} \left(0 + \frac {1}{4}\right) = \frac {1}{8}.$因此，$S\left(-\frac{7}{2}\right)=\frac{1}{8}.$

questionText: 设有两个数列$\{a_{n}\} ,\{b_{n}\}$，若$\lim_{n\to\infty}a_{n}=0$，则（    ）

textOptions.C: 当$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \left| b_{n} \right|$收敛时，$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_{n}^{2} b_{n}^{2}$收敛

analysisRich:
解 令$a_{n}=\frac{(-1)^{n+1}}{\sqrt{n}}, b_{n}=\frac{(-1)^{n+1}}{\sqrt{n}}$，则$\lim_{n\to\infty}a_{n}=0$$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}b_{n}$收敛，但$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}a_{n}b_{n}=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{1}{n}$发散.选项 A不正确.

令$a_{n}=\frac{1}{n}, b_{n}=\frac{1}{n}$，则$\lim_{n\to\infty}a_{n}=0$$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}b_{n}$发散，但$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}a_{n}b_{n}=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{1}{n^{2}}$收敛.选项B不正确.

令$a_{n}=\frac{1}{n}, b_{n}=\frac{1}{n}$，则$\lim_{n\to\infty}a_{n}=0$$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}|\boldsymbol{b}_{n}|$发散，但$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}a_{n}^{2}b_{n}^{2}=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{1}{n^{4}}$收敛.选项D不正确.

由排除法可知，应选C.

下面证明选项C正确.

由$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \mid b_{n}\mid$收敛知，$\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty} \mid b_{n}\mid =0$，于是存在$N_{1}$，使得当 n > N1时，$\mid b_{n}\mid <1$，从而$b_{n}^{2}\leqslant \mid b_{n}\mid$又$\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty} a_{n}=0$，故存在$N_{2}$，使得当 n > N2时，$\mid a_{n}\mid <1$，从而$a_{n}^{2}<1$.令 N =$\max \{N_{1},N_{2}\}$，则当 n > N时，$0\leqslant a_{n}^{2}b_{n}^{2}\leqslant \mid b_{n}\mid$，再由比较审敛法知，$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_{n}^{2}b_{n}^{2}$收敛.

questionText:
9. (本题满分10分)

设数列$\{a_{n}\}$$\{b_{n}\}$满足$0 < a_{n} < \frac{\pi}{2}, 0 < b_{n} < \frac{\pi}{2}, \cos a_{n}-a_{n}=\cos b_{n}$，且级数$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} b_{n}$收敛.

I. 证明$\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty} a_{n}=0;$II. 证明级数$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{a_{n}}{b_{n}}$收敛.
analysisRich:
证（I）（法一）由于$0 < a_{n} < \frac{\pi}{2}, 0 < b_{n} < \frac{\pi}{2}, \cos b_{n} = \cos a_{n} - a_{n} < \cos a_{n}$，且$\cos x$在$\left( 0, \frac{\pi}{2} \right)$上单调减少，故$0 < a_{n} < b_{n} < \frac{\pi}{2}.$又级数$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} b_{n}$收敛，故$\lim_{n\to \infty}b_{n}=0$，从而由夹逼准则知$\lim_{n\to \infty}a_{n}=0$，结论得证.

（法二）当$x\in \left(0,\frac{\pi}{2}\right)$时，$\cos x > 1 - \frac{x^2}{2}$，从而$-\cos x < \frac{x^2}{2} -1.$由于$b_{n}\in \left(0,\frac{\pi}{2}\right)$，故$a _ {n} = \cos a _ {n} - \cos b _ {n} < 1 + \frac {b _ {n} ^ {2}}{2} - 1 = \frac {b _ {n} ^ {2}}{2},$即$0 < a_{n} < \frac{b_{n}^{2}}{2}$. 又级数$\sum_{n = 1}^{\infty}b_{n}$收敛，故$\lim_{n\to \infty}b_n = 0$，从而由夹逼准则知$\lim_{n\to \infty}a_n = 0$，结论得证.

（Ⅱ）（法一）由（I）中法一知，$0 < a_{n} < b_{n} < \frac{\pi}{2}$从而$\begin{aligned} \frac {a _ {n}}{b _ {n}} &= \frac {\cos a _ {n} - \cos b _ {n}}{b _ {n}} = \frac {2 \sin \frac {a _ {n} + b _ {n}}{2} \sin \frac {b _ {n} - a _ {n}}{2}}{b _ {n}} \\ < \frac {2 \cdot \frac {a _ {n} + b _ {n}}{2} \cdot \frac {b _ {n} - a _ {n}}{2}}{b _ {n}} \quad (x > 0 \text {时}, \sin x < x) \\ &= \frac {b _ {n} ^ {2} - a _ {n} ^ {2}}{2 b _ {n}} < \frac {b _ {n} ^ {2}}{2 b _ {n}} = \frac {1}{2} b _ {n}. \end{aligned}$又$\sum_{n = 1}^{\infty}b_{n}$收敛，故由比较审敛法知，$\sum_{n = 1}^{\infty}\frac{a_n}{b_n}$收敛，结论得证.

（法二）由（I）中法一知，$0 < a_{n} < b_{n} < \frac{\pi}{2}$从而由拉格朗日中值定理知，存在$\xi_{n}\in\left(a_{n},b_{n}\right)\subset\left(0,\frac{\pi}{2}\right)$，使得$\frac{a_{n}}{b_{n}}=\frac{\cos a_{n}-\cos b_{n}}{b_{n}}=\frac{-\sin \xi_{n}\cdot\left(a_{n}-b_{n}\right)}{b_{n}}=\frac{\sin \xi_{n}}{b_{n}}\left(b_{n}-a_{n}\right)<\frac{\sin \xi_{n}}{b_{n}}\cdot b_{n}=\sin \xi_{n}<\xi_{n}<b_{n}.$又$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}b_{n}$收敛，故由比较审敛法知，$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{a_{n}}{b_{n}}$收敛，结论得证.

（法三）同（I）中法二得到$0 < a_{n} < \frac{b_{n}^{2}}{2}$，于是由$b_{n} > 0$知，$0 < \frac{a_{n}}{b_{n}} < \frac{1}{2} b_{n}$. 又$\sum_{n = 1}^{\infty}b_{n}$收敛，故由比较审敛法知$\sum_{n = 1}^{\infty}\frac{a_n}{b_n}$收敛，结论得证.

（法四）由（I）知，$\lim_{n\to \infty}a_n = \lim_{n\to \infty}b_n = 0.$又$\cos b_{n} = \cos a_{n} - a_{n}$，故$\begin{aligned} \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {\frac {a _ {n}}{b _ {n}}}{b _ {n}} &= \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {a _ {n}}{b _ {n} ^ {2}} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \left(\frac {1 - \cos b _ {n}}{b _ {n} ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {a _ {n}}{1 - \cos b _ {n}}\right) = \frac {1}{2} \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {a _ {n}}{1 - \cos b _ {n}} \\ &= \frac {1}{2} \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {a _ {n}}{1 - \left(\cos a _ {n} - a _ {n}\right)} = \frac {1}{2} \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {1}{\frac {1 - \cos a _ {n}}{a _ {n}} + 1} = \frac {1}{2}. \end{aligned}$再由$\sum_{n = 1}^{\infty}b_{n}$收敛及比较审敛法的极限形式知，$\sum_{n = 1}^{\infty}\frac{a_n}{b_n}$收敛，结论得证.
